Adler_SkillDes.GA_Adler_Skill_background:
<Italic>"This commission… let's get to know our target first. We…"</>
<Italic>"Coluccis! Roll out!"</>
<Italic>"…Stay safe, I'll handle everything else."</>
Adler_SkillDes.GA_Adler_Passive_2_background: <Italic>"Sometimes a forceful strategy is preferable to lengthy negotiations."</>
Adler_SkillDes.GA_Adler_UtraSkill_background: <Italic>The folks at Eibon like to guess the names of Adler's Sunyas. When they guess correctly, Adler rewards them with handmade desserts!</>
Adler_SkillDes.GA_Adler_Melee_background: <Italic>A cane makes for quite the fitting accessory… a gentleman's weapon.</>
Adler_SkillDes.GA_Adler_Passive_1_background: <Italic>A meticulously pressed uniform and even hair, even in battle. The butler's first lesson is to maintain an impeccable appearance.</>
Adler_SkillDes.GA_Adler_Passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Scorch Enhancement</>: Applies one of three random debuffs whenever Scorch is inflicted on a target: -20% ATK, -10% Esper RES, or +10% Break Efficiency, lasting for 15s. The same effect cannot stack.

Each target takes <NumGreen>5</> instances of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>. Deliverance
Wields his weapon to perform up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks. Grants <NumGreen>1</> stack of Karma when a Basic Attack hits an enemy, up to <NumGreen>20</> stacks.

Liberation
Enters Aim status, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to enemy in the crosshair and granting <NumGreen>2</> stacks of Karma.

Ignorance
Wields his weapon in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area upon impact.

Karma

Cang_SkillDes.GA_Cang_QTE_background:
<Italic>"Captain Baicang still isn't here? This is urgent!"</>
<Italic>"Though being late for missions is pretty much routine for him…"</>
<Italic>Maybe I should ask the lieutenant for help—they might know where he is!</>
Cang_SkillDes.GA_Cang_Melee_background: <Italic>Just some really basic moves. Day after day of training under family discipline since childhood, the young boy's arms have become strong and broad.</>
Cang_SkillDes.GA_Cang_Passive_1_background: <Italic>Sigh… break time's over again. Now then, let's wrap this up quickly, shall we?</>
Cang_SkillDes.GA_Cang_Skill_background: <Italic>Every strike carries genuine intent. The voice once found, the home once briefly held, keeping memories of the departed close to heart. Smile! For now he has to power to protect.</>
Cang_SkillDes.GA_Cang_UtraSkill_background: <Italic>No one understands the power of words themselves better than Baicang. Until the very last moment, no one knows whether those waveforms taking shape in the air represent curses or blessings. Perhaps—only by glimpsing into the heart can one truly discern.</>
Cang_SkillDes.GA_Cang_Passive_2_background: <Italic>Sure, we're all a bunch of eccentric weirdos who do our own thing, but we have our moments of perfect teamwork too. Spend enough time together, and your body starts to remember each other's habits and movements. What was that just now? Why, that was ETD-4's passionate combo, of course!</>

Haniel is a mid-to-long range <red>Support</>.
<red>Silent Moonlit Forest Guardian</> summons <red>Hootie</> in the area ahead, granting <red>buffs</> to the <red>entire team</>. While <red>Hootie</> is active, continuously hitting enemies triggers <red>Ensemble</>, dealing AoE DMG; this effect remains active even when Haniel is off the field.

CharacterTeachGuide.Xiaozhi_TotalDes:
Chiz is a <red>damage-focused melee character</>.
Hold Basic Attack to use Basic Attack: Blighted Vale, which <red>devours small mobs</> and <red>grants Fons</>.
Use Basic Attack: Exiled Swordplay to gain <red>Grain</>. Hold Redirect Skill: Pink Paws Priority Principle to <red>consume Grain</> and deal <red>high damage</> based on the amount of Grain.
Use Ultimate: Zero-Sum Game to enter the <red>Grain Market</>. While the market is open, each use of Redirect Skill: Pink Paws Priority Principle will <red>settle the Grain</> based on the current <red>Grain Price</>, which fluctuates over time.
Hold Redirect Skill: Pink Paws Priority Principle to cast Redirect Skill: No Grain, Redirect Skill: Half Grain, and Redirect Skill: Full Grain, in that order. Even if you <red>switch characters</> while casting these skills, Chiz will <red>remain on the battlefield</> until the attack finishes.

Fadia is a <red>Survival character</> centered around <red>Damage Redirect</>. When Fadia's current HP is <red>greater than 1 point</>, she can use her Esper Ability to redirect damage for teammates before it hits their shields.
Using Redirect Skill: Existence applies Destructive Experience to the enemy with the highest Max HP within range. During this effect, when Fadia takes damage, the target will <red>share</> part of the damage Fadia receives.
After using Ultimate: Agony to Euphoria, Fadia enters Lilith state and <red>recovers HP</>. While in Lilith state, using Basic Attack: Wordless Rejection again allows up to five follow-up attacks, with each follow-up dealing <red>Mental DMG</>.

CharacterTeachGuide.Xun_TotalDes:
Hotori is a <red>Support</> who provides <red>damage buffs</> while also having significant Burst DMG potential. When added to the team, the Non-Closed Timepiece begins to accumulate energy over time.
When the Timepiece has accumulated energy and Hotori is <red>out of combat</>, holding Basic Attack activates the Frozen Snow Ritual, slowing time to a near standstill.
Once the Timepiece has at least half of its energy, casting Present Replay <red>observes and records</> all <red>Support Skills</> and <red>Redirect Skills</> cast by the team for a set duration.
When the Timepiece is <red>fully charged</>, casting World's Tide switches Hotori to katana attacks and nearly halts time in the surrounding area. During this time stop, the Timepiece pointer continuously rewinds. Katana attacks build combo stacks, and reaching 10 stacks triggers <red>Ultimate DMG</>, which, or the pointer rewinding to its minimum, ends the time stop.
CharacterTeachGuide.Xun_Phase4_ForceGuide1: Hotori's Ultimate will stop time in the surrounding area and replay all recorded Esper Cycles and Redirect Skills once.

CharacterTeachGuide.Dafudier_TotalDes:
Daffodill is a Burst-type, <red>Melee-DMG</> character who provides Break Boost.
Press Dodge during a Basic Attack to trigger the special Dodge <red>Displaced Edge</>. She is invincible while Dodging and <red>does not interrupt</> her current combo.
When an ally casts a <red>Support Skill</>, it increases the damage and Break dealt by <red>Resonance</>, up to 2 stacks. At maximum stacks, <red>Resonance</> is upgraded and replaced by <red>Echoes</>.
After using her <red>Ultimate</>, Daffodill unlocks a new skill, <red>Phantom Step</>, which automatically activates when switching to Daffodill from another character.
<red>Finale</> inflicts <red>Insight</> on the target. If the target enters a <red>Break state</> while affected by <red>Insight</>, they take an additional instance of <red>Break DMG</> from Daffodill.

Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_UltraSkill_des:
No turning back, max the leverage. Throws Brown Sugar Boba to strike, dealing AoE <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> once and entering Grain Market for 7s. During this time, the first Grain Settlement DMG is guaranteed to Crit.
Converts all remaining <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes4">Grain Loans</> into <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">Grains</> and enters the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes2">Surplus</> state after casting Zero-Sum Game. Invests all Grains into the Grain Market. Afterward, press Pink Paws Priority Principle to gain Grains based on current <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes5">Grain Price</> fluctuations during <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes6">Grain Settlement</>. Hold Pink Paws Priority Principle to trigger Grain Settlement once based on the Grain Price on first activation.
Leaves the Grain Market and prioritizes repaying Grain Loans with all available Grains when Grain Market duration ends.
Grants access to the Grain Market while in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes3">Debt</> state and holding any Grain Loans.

Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_Skill_des_tidy:
Redirect Skill can accumulate up to 3 charges.

Press consecutively to cast 3 instances of the skill, consuming corresponding skill charges and dealing additional <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> to the target based on current Grain count. Cannot Crit.

Hold to consecutively cast 3 instances of the skill, consuming corresponding skill charges. During the second instance, <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">Grain</> is continuously consumed, dealing consecutive bonus <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> based on the Grain consumed. Cannot Crit.
Chiichan_SkillDes.GA_Chiichan_Skill_des:
The more, the merrier; the more, the better.nStacks Redirect Skill attempts, up to 3 stacks

Press Redirect Skill to consume 1 stack and cast No Grain, dealing Cosmos DMG once. Press Redirect Skill consecutively to consume stacks and cast No Grain, Half Grain, and Full Grain in order, up to 3 times in a row.
Press to cast Pink Paws Priority Principle while in the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes2">Surplus</> state, dealing bonus <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> based on available <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">Grains</> using Redirect Skills. Cannot Crit.

Hold Redirect Skill to consume 2 stacks and cast No Grain and Half Grain. Continuously consumes <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes1">Grains</> while Half Grain is active, dealing consecutive bonus <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> based on available Grains. Cannot Crit. Consumes all available Grains (including all <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes4">Grain Loans</> from the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&ChiichanRes3">Debt</> state) when Half Grain ends. Press Redirect Skill again to consume 1 stack and end Half Grain early, allowing Full Grain to be cast without consuming Grains. Hold Redirect Skill to consume 3 stacks and use all available Grains (including all Grain Loans from the Debt state). Casts No Grain, Half Grain, and Full Grain in order.
Hold to cast Pink Paws Priority Principle while Surplus is active, dealing bonus <Guang>Cosmos DMG</> with No Grain based on remaining Grains. Cannot Crit.

Press Blighted Vale to throw Brown Sugar Boba to devour the target, dealing 2 instance of Cosmos DMG, granting a certain amount of Grain and Fons. Triggers up to once every 2.5s.
