Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_Skill_background: <Italic>"Ice cream is cool, mint is cool, so mint ice cream from Blizzi means double the happiness! Ooha… I'm already shivering just thinking about it!"</>
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_Melee_background: <Italic>"First place in the Containment Simulation Exam: Mint, from CSU-2."</>
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_Passive_1_background: <Italic>"Watch closely now! I'm not the same as before! You're now face-to-face with an elite operative!"</>
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_Passive_2_background:
<Italic>There's always that extra burst of energy when work's almost done, especially when putting out new arrivals…</>
<Italic>"Five minutes till close! Line up nicely and get nullified!"</>
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_UtraSkill_background: <Italic>The full name is "Mint's Ultimate: Super Duper Ultra 360 Whirlwind Slash", but I had to shorten it to what it is now because people wouldn't stop laughing about it.</>
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_Passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Blossom Enhancement</>: Expands Vita Pistils' damage area on hit.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_Passive_1_des_tidy: <TextHLT>Blossom Enhancement</>: Expands Vita Pistils' damage area on hit.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_star2_des: Redirect Skill: Ultimate: Super Claws damage increases by <NumGreen>40%</>.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_starExtra1_des: Increases the skill level of Perfect Containment, Ultimate: Super Claws, and Ultimate: Thunderous Whirlwind Slash by <NumGreen>1</>.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_star1_des: Resets the cooldown of Ultimate: Super Claws when Caramel Crisp hits an enemy. Triggers once every <NumGreen>3s</>.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_UtraSkill_des: Are you ready! Channels the surrounding wind into her dual blades, transforming them into wind blades that deal multiple instances of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area. Lands with a final hit that deals massive <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_starExtra2_des: Grants an additional <NumGreen>2</> Cycle Energy after successfully casting Ultimate: Super Claws.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_Skill_des: Time to cool things down! Dashes forward, then returns to her original position, dealing <NumGreen>2</> instances of AoE <Ling>Anima DMG</> to enemies along the path.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_QTE_des: Perfect finishing work from an elite member! Charges and leaps into the air, performing a penetrating attack on enemies, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_Passive_2_des: While Mint is on the field, her DEF is increased by <NumGreen>20%</> and her resistance to Interruptions is increased by <NumGreen>30%</>.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_star5_des: After casting Redirect Skill: Ultimate: Super Claws, Mint's CRIT DMG increases by <NumGreen>25%</> for <NumGreen>6s</>.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_Melee2_des: Wields her weapon in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_star4_des: Increases Mint's Crit Chance by <NumGreen>12%</> when dealing damage to the last enemy on the field.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_star6_des: Mint deals <NumGreen>15%</> increased damage to targets below <NumGreen>40%</> HP.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_Melee1_des: Wields her weapon and performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_star3_des: When any character triggers Blossom or Hexed against an enemy, Mint's ATK is increased by <NumGreen>15%</> for <NumGreen>15s</>.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_PerfectEvade_des: Triggers when using Perfect Containment after a Critical Dodge. Leaps up to dodge an attack, seizes the enemy's opening, and swiftly swings her weapon, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area and reducing Break.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_Passive_3_des_tidy: Hold Basic Attack to continuously deal <Ling>Anima DMG</> for 4s.
Mint_SkillDes.GA_Mint_Passive_3_des: Hold Basic Attack to make Mint dance and spin, forming a tornado that continuously drains Stamina and deals continuous <Ling>Anima DMG</> to surrounding enemies.

Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_QTE_background: <Italic>Unafraid of the noise around her, she follows only the beat within—clear, strong, and unwavering, like a bold dissonance in a score. Deep down, Aurelia secretly wishes she could be that kind of person.</>
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_Melee_background:
<Italic>Vocal technique is key for any conductor, so I keep practicing. Engage the core, relax the jaw, let the sound flow from the back of my head and out through my brow…</>
<Italic>"Ah—ah—"</>
<Italic>…Why does it feel like even my own voice is slipping away?</>
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_Skill_background: <Italic>If she hadn't joined the Tamamochi Street Resident Association, Aurelia might have ended up as an administrator on Cadenza Street instead. In the end, perhaps it's all just a matter of fate.</>
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_Passive_2_background: <Italic>Strong… stronger… Super Sound… Ultimate Sound! Want it even louder? Then the drummer will just have to throw themselves into the drum headfirst!</>
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_Passive_3_background: <Italic>Being unable to take a single step doesn't mean you can't keep moving forward. Let your heart be as free and boundless as the world—once you set out, there's nowhere you can't reach.</>
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_UltraSkill_background: <Italic>Whether it was the school choir or that short-lived, chaotic band, these were Aurelia's most cherished memories. Even a brilliant solo would feel far too lonely.</>
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_Passive_1_background:
<Italic>How do you prove that sound is a wave? Toss a stone into water and see the ripples spread; toss a stone at someone, and you’ll hear wave after wave of noise.</>
<Italic>"…Am I supposed to laugh?"</>
<Italic>"Aurelia's jokes aren't funny at all—"</>
<Italic>"No way! People used to eat that up… you kids just have your humor standards way too high."</>
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_Passive_1_des_tidy: <TextHLT>Nova Enhancement</>: Deals damage 3 times to the target when their Nova state ends.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_Passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Nova Enhancement</>: Deals 3 instances of <Hun>Psyche DMG</> to the target after their Nova status ends, each equal to 50% of ATK.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_starExtra1_des: Increases the skill levels of Cappella, Cadenza Aria, and Canon Chorus by <NumGreen>1</>.

Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_star6_des: Increases the maximum stacks of Crescendo to 20. Grants 10 Crescendo stacks after casting Cadenza Aria.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_QTE_des: True command means never mistaking the timing. Commands the jellyfish to strike, dealing 1 instance of AoE <Hun>Psyche DMG</> on hit.
Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_star4_des: Increases Aurelia's DEF by <NumGreen>20%</> when casting Staccato.

Mitsuki_SkillDes.GA_Mitsuki_Skill_des: Transform the everyday into a rainbow melody and let it roar across the skyline. Deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of AoE <Hun>Psyche DMG</> and enters the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&MitsukiSkill">Cadenza</> state for <NumGreen>12</>s.

Extends the duration by <NumGreen>5</>s if the state's already active. The <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&MitsukiSkill">Cadenza</> state lasts for up to <NumGreen>12</>s.

Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_Melee_des:
Colucci Secret Skill
Bares her fangs and brandishes her claws, performing up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>.

Heavy Hitter!
Triggers by holding Basic Attack. Performs up to 3 powerful attacks, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</>, which can be triggered after Critical Riposte and the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 5th attacks of Colucci Secret Skill.

Colucci Secret Gundo
Hold to aim, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to enemy in the crosshair.

Grand Entrance!
Swings her claws in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area upon impact.
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_star5_des: Increases Nanally's ATK by <NumGreen>2%</> for <NumGreen>each</> <TextHLT>follow-up attack</> she performs, up to <NumGreen>20%</>. Disappears when Nanally leaves the battlefield or exits combat.
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_UtraSkill_des:
I'm way stronger than them! Deals <NumGreen>7</> instances of <Ling>Anima DMG</> immediately to surrounding enemies and summons Underboss to fight alongside her.
Creates a small pull effect on surrounding enemies with Nanally's attacks while Underboss is active, and coordinates with all of Nanally's attacks to launch strikes, dealing <Ling>Anima DMG</> that also counts as <TextHLT>follow-up attack</> damage.
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_QTE_des: Time to get serious! Charges with a spinning motion, delivering a kick and dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area.
Nanally_SkillDes.GA_Nanally_PerfectEvade_des: Triggers when using Colucci Secret Skill after a Critical Dodge. Charges toward the target at full speed, planting one hand on the ground, delivering a roundhouse kick that deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Ling>Anima DMG</> to an area, and reducing Break.

Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Skill_background: <Italic>"Sa… Sakiri, can I eat this?" "Moron, next time ask before you eat!"</>
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_QTE_background: <Italic>Kiroumaru, stop right there! Hm? Did you just bump into something?</>
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Passive_2_background: <Italic>Those on the naughty list… will be taken by ghosts… or perhaps eaten?</>
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_UtraSkill_background: <Italic>No prey escapes before Kiroumaru has its fill.</>
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Melee_background: <Italic>According to Mr. T, an oddity who survived the depths of Kiroumaru's belly and lived to tell the tale thanks to Sakiri's timely intervention, hints at an unexpected perk: Amidst the gloom, one might unearth a half-digested game console to while away the hours—a quirky, entertaining twist to an otherwise harrowing wait for rescue.</>
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Passive_1_background: <Italic>It's not time to start yet! Instead of swallowing whole… wouldn't it be better to add more ingredients? Can't let the fun pass!</>
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Scorch Enhancement</>: Increases DoT taken by the target by 25% for each type of DoT effect while in Scorch state, up to 100%.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_UtraSkill_des_Tidy: <TextHLT>Suppresses</> enemies, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>. Increases Team ATK (excluding Sakiri) based on her ATK.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_star5_des: Fully restores Feast of Gluttony's Ultimate Energy and resets its cooldown immediately when Devour Whole makes the target airborne.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_starExtra1_des: Increases the skill level of Kiroumaru Headbutt, Devour Whole, and Feast of Gluttony by <NumGreen>1</>.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_star2_des: Deals extra damage with Feast of Gluttony to airborne enemies, scaling with the target's mass and capped at <NumGreen>600%</> of ATK.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_star1_des: Extends the immovable effect inflicted by Feast of Gluttony to <NumGreen>6s</>.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Skill_des:
Skill: Blurp
Kiroumaru opens its mouth, drawing near enemies with range, then swells up, and knocks them down.

Skill: Gravity Eater
Hold to active, Kiroumaru opens its mouth, drawing near enemies within range, and then bites through the ground. The gravity of the bit place will be devoured and enemies in that place will float in the air (not effective against Bosses).
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Skill2_des_Tidy: Pulls and levitates nearby enemies, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_star3_des: Increases Devour Whole and Feast of Gluttony damage by <NumGreen>6%</> for <NumGreen>each</> enemy defeated by the Team over the next <NumGreen>15s</>, up to <NumGreen>60%</>. Resets when out of combat.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Melee_des:
Basic Attack: Ram
Sakiri wields Kiroumaru and performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks.

Basic Attack: Eating Mode
Hold to activate Eating mode with Kiroumaru.
Kiroumaru opens its mouth to continuously pull targets nearby within a cone. Movable objects in the scene will be destroyed, and weak enemies will be devoured.
Each <NumGreen>devoured enemy</> takes <NumGreen>180s</> to be digested and only <NumGreen>1</> target can be digested at a time.
When enemies being digested reach the limit, Kiroumaru remains free to move but can't pull or devour anymore.
Release to exit the mode.

Basic Attack: Swallow
Sakiri wields Kiroumaru in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area upon impact.
Sagiri_SkillDes.Sagiri_Eat_des: Moves continuously while riding Kiroumaru. Pulls in and devours weak enemies during this time. Takes time to digest each devoured enemy.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Melee3_des: Wields Kiroumaru in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Passive_2_des: Reduces enemies' DEF by 10% for 20s after inflicting Airborne or <TextHLT>Suppress</>.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Melee1_des: Sakiri swings Kiroumaru and performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks, dealing <Zhou>Incantation DMG</>.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Skill1_des: Press to activate. Kiroumaru opens its mouth, pulling in nearby enemies. Kiroumaru then inflates and knocks down the enemy.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_starExtra2_des: For each negative effect on the target, Sakiri deals <NumGreen>3%</> increased damage to the target, up to <NumGreen>12%</>.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_QTE_des: Let's see which unlucky soul is about to get squashed? Sakiri slams the enlarged Kiroumaru heavily onto the target, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_PerfectEvade_des: Triggers when using Ram after a Critical Dodge. Leaps high into the air and strikes down hard with Kiroumaru against enemies left vulnerable by their missed attacks. Deals <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area and reduces Break.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_UtraSkill_des: No escaping this time! Kiroumaru spits out a large amount of Gravity Slurry from above, dealing <NumGreen>6</> instances of <Zhou>Incantation DMG</> to an area. Applies strong gravity to hit enemies, pressing them heavily to the ground (not effective against Bosses). Prevents <TextHLT>Suppressed</> enemies from moving for a period. Increases Team ATK (excluding Sakiri) based on Sakiri's Base ATK.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_star4_des: Increases Team ATK (excluding Sakiri) by <NumGreen>30%</> of Sakiri's Base ATK for <NumGreen>20s</> after casting Feast of Gluttony.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Melee2_des_Tidy: Hold to activate <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&SagiriEat">Eating Mode</> with Kiroumaru. Mounts Sakiri onto Kiroumaru, allowing movement.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Melee2_des:
Hold to activate <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&SagiriEat">Eating Mode</> with Kiroumaru. Mounts Sakiri onto Kiroumaru, allowing movement.
Opens its mouth to continuously pull nearby targets within a cone while Hungry. Destroys movable objects in the scene and devours weak enemies.
Takes <NumGreen>180s</> to digest <NumGreen>each</> devoured enemy, with only <NumGreen>1</> target digested at a time.
Becomes Full when the number of enemies being digested reaches the limit, remaining movable but unable to pull or devour enemies.
Release to exit the mode.
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_Skill2_des: Hold to activate. Kiroumaru opens its mouth, pulling in nearby enemies. Kiroumaru then bites through the ground, devouring the gravity in that area, levitating enemies there (not effective against powerful enemies).
Sagiri_SkillDes.GA_Sagiri_star6_des: Allows Kiroumaru to devour and digest up to <NumGreen>3</> enemies at a time in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&SagiriEat">Eating Mode</>, with the digestion time for each enemy calculated independently.

Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Melee_background: <Italic>"The doggo… This dark stuff comes out with doggo punches… pretty impressive."</>
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Passive_2_background: <Italic>Your body might be free to move, but your shadow is held in an iron grip, rendering you immobile… Quite the peculiar sensation.</>
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Skill_background: <Italic>Some nimble troublemakers might think they can escape ETD's pursuit… They should check what's lurking beneath their feet.</>
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Passive_1_background: <Italic>Usually, there's no need for physical intervention—Skia can subdue targets with just his shadows, keeping facilities undamaged. Plus, he helps with cleanup… According to a BAC cafeteria survey, 84% of staff welcome Skia at their work site—less hassle for them!</>
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Passive_3_background: <Italic>Fadia once asked Skia what position his body feels like when submerged in shadows. Unable to describe it, Skia told her to use her imagination. He'd rather not know what images that sparked in her mind.</>
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Passive_1_des: <TextHLT>Remora Enhancement</>: Inflicts an additional Remora on a target when <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> locks onto them in Remora state.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_star1_des: Increses the auto-attack DMG Ratio for <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> by <NumGreen>60%</>.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_star4_des: Extends the duration of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill1">Tailed</> to <NumGreen>12s</>. Increases Attachment DMG by 2% per second a target is <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&attach">attached</>, up to 40%.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_star6_des: Increases the Extra DMG Ratio of <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> by <NumGreen>20%</> while in <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">Shadow Hound Gnaw</> mode when touching an enemy locked onto by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</>.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_starExtra1_des: Increases the skill level of Arresting Art, Shadow Hound Chase, and The Pack by <NumGreen>1</>.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Melee3_des: Splitting from Skia's shadow, these shattered shadows resemble the fangs of a giant beast. They automatically track and <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&attach">attach</> to targets, disappearing after dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.
Skia_SkillDes.skiamelee1_des: A state applied to targets on hit, up to 3 stacks. Disappears after dealing damage to the target.
Skia_SkillDes.Skia_SpecialSkillEffectUnableTips: Special skill effects are disabled in the current mode
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_starExtra2_des: Reduces the locked-on target's Lakshana RES by 2% per <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</>, up to 6%.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_star5_des: Increases the target's mass by <NumGreen>50</> and reduces its Movement Speed by <NumGreen>20%</> for each <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> locked onto it.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_QTE_des: The relentless shadows cannot be shaken off. Commands the shadow like a police canine to bite the target, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Melee1_des:
Performs up to <NumGreen>5</> consecutive attacks using steady martial arts techniques, dealing <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>.
Splits <NumGreen>1</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> from his shadow to pursue <NumGreen>each</> target hit. Locks each target with up to <NumGreen>3</> <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrusts</> simultaneously.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Melee2_des: Strikes in the air and plunges, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area upon impact. Increases DMG based on fall height, up to 100%.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_star2_des: Increases Skia's Crit Chance by <NumGreen>10%</> and Resistance to Interruptions by <NumGreen>50%</> for <NumGreen>15s</> after casting Shadow Hound Chase.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_star3_des:
Skia's damage to targets locked by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> is increased by <NumGreen>4%</>.
If only one target is locked onto by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> on the field, Skia's damage to it is further increased by <NumGreen>4%</>.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_PerfectEvade_des: Triggers when using Arresting Art after a Critical Dodge. Strikes enemies with ink-splash shadows, dealing <NumGreen>1</> instance of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area and reducing Break.
Skia_SkillDes.skiaskill2_des: Deals additional <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> when touching targets marked by <TextEXPL>Fang Thrust</>. Deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to hit targets upon exiting.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_SneakAtkquit_1_des: Shadow Hound Gnaw Outro DMG Ratio
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Skill_des:
A workflow designed for pursuit. Enters the <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill1">Tailed</> state, leaps into own shadow, and deals <NumGreen>6</> instances of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area. Splits 3 <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrusts</> from shadow for each target hit, then enters <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">Shadow Hound Gnaw</> mode.

<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill1">Tailed</>
Prevents <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrusts</> from disappearing after dealing damage to targets during the state.

<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">Shadow Hound Gnaw</>
Allows movement on ground or wall surfaces, similar to Shadow Hound mode.
Remains undetected when approaching enemy targets.
Grants immunity to certain attacks, but cancels the mode when hit by ground damage.
Triggers additional attacks from <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrusts</> whenever touching an enemy already marked by <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">them</>.

Converges multiple shadows on a single location like well-trained canines, dealing <NumGreen>3</> instances of <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> to an area.

After casting, <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</>'s damage is increased, and applies a control effect on each hit.
Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Skill_des_tidy:
Deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</> and enters <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill1">Tailed</> state. Applies 3 <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrusts</> to the target on hit, then enters <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">Shadow Hound Gnaw</>.

<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill1">Tailed</>
Prevents <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrusts</> from disappearing after dealing damage to targets during the state.

<hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiaskill2">Shadow Hound Gnaw</>

Skia_SkillDes.GA_Skia_Melee1_des_tidy: Deals <Xiang>Lakshana DMG</>. Inflicts <hot textstyle="TextEXPL" param="nouns&skiamelee1">Fang Thrust</> on a target when hit, allowing up to 3 per target.

Hold Movement and Dodge to enter Shadow Hound mode

Shadow Hound
Lurks within his shadow, allowing movement on ground and wall surfaces.

Grants immunity to certain attacks, but ends if hit by ground damage.

Reaching the edge of elevated positions and moving forward also cancels the mode.

ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_Trinity_TrinityDlg_015_bubble_002: With so many artists living in 144, it's not surprising to see Anomalies.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_Trinity_TrinityDlg_006_bubble_001: 59541… 59514… 591… Wait, what was the verification code again?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_070040_001: Seafood from 7-Oceans, prepped and ready to serve!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_013_002: ...Brother, get ready to be beaten down by reality.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_007_001: I wonder what songs are popular these days.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_016_002: He'd love for us all to behave ourselves and not tarnish his performance.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_012_002: Your mom is so good. Do your best and get out of retirement soon to take care of her.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_006_001: How do you think the officer's complexion is today?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_009_001: You said... after I go out, will everyone look at me strangely?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_003_001: Your carpentry work is quite good.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_015_002: Your prediction is more accurate than the weather forecast; I'll have to be careful when hanging out the laundry tomorrow.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_008_002: Don't even mention it. My mom said that after I went in, half of my dad's hair turned white.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_010_002: Don't keep swiping; the more you swipe, the more anxious you become. Like me, I swipe once a week, and it makes time fly by.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_001_001: It's boiled potatoes and cabbage again. I could guess next week's menu with my eyes closed.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_003_002: Hey, I've never done this before, but now I've learned a skill that might come in handy when I go out.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_002_001: Two years for a single phone. What was I thinking?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_019_002: I just can't stand that person's arrogant attitude.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_014_002: We waste our time here while they age faster outside.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_011_001: After I leave, I want to find a job, work hard, and start over where nobody knows me.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_012_001: My mom said, "Don't think about anything, just focus on reforming yourself, and the family will wait for you."
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_004_001: My child wrote to say that the family dog seems to not recognize my scent anymore.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_008_001: was supposed to graduate from university this year. Now... my classmates are taking graduation photos, and I'm operating a sewing machine.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_002_002: I'm even more wronged than you. I only tried to stand up for him, and now that person is living a carefree life outside.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_014_001: My dad has so many more wrinkles in the video. He used to be such a meticulous person.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_015_001: My knee hurts; it's definitely going to rain tomorrow.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_013_001: The year I came here, pork was only a dozen cubic meters per pound.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_009_002: Hold your head high and straighten your back. You make your own life.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_011_002: That's good, I'm going back to my hometown.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_019_001: I told you not to fight! Do you want to be locked up in a dark room?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_004_002: It's okay, just spend a couple more days playing with it and it'll remember.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_006_002: He looks alright, at least he's not frowning like he did yesterday.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_001_002: Be content; at least it's better than that rock-hard loaf of bread from last week.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_007_002: The first thing I'll do when I get out is buy a new phone and replace my old one.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_005_002: It's alright, but the detective novels are all overdone. You'll have to wait in line if you want to read them.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_005_001: Does the library here have many books?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_Prison_TBS_016_001: The young police officer seemed even more nervous than we were.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_Trinity_TrinityVending_001_dlg_Player: <purple>An empty vending machine? What should we do?</>

ST_AmbianceDialogue.SA_NPC_001_A_Player_006: <purple>Maybe it just wants to wander around.</>

ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_Trinity_NPC_001_A_001_dlg_Player_013: <purple>Eclipse is so dazzling that it's becoming a blur.</>

<purple>The vending machine has another slot for items. What should I do?</>

ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_Graffitistreet_005_: Wow! Won't you look at that? Do it again! Now that's what I call street dance! I'm all fired up!

ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC097008_001: …Sorry, I'm still thinking about that performance just now.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_363_005: …No, I definitely need to keep an eye on that old fool of mine.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_WA045_NPC1029_009: ...But I'm actually kinda curious what it tastes like...? Alright, I'll take one, please!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_384_004: …What the heck?! What kind of lame story is that? It doesn't even make sense. You just wanted an excuse to say those words, didn't you?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_415_002: …What? There's a problem with the report? I'll head back right away to fix it…

ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_364_003: …Hey, take it easy there, or you might end up flooring it straight into the lake…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_364_001: You want to practice driving here?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_425_001: …Do you think our agency's idols could ever make it to such a big stage?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_452_003: …Do you think these flowers will ever completely fall?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_358_002: …keep running around like that, and you'll get nothing but lettuce for dinner tonight!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SA_CNPC_001004_004: It's… it's just temporary! Whatever, I'm not wasting time talking to you here—I have urgent matters to attend to at the CSU office…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_indoor_Flowershop_002_bubble_0: …The same flower with a different color has different meanings? Is that a thing?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_simple_271_Player_006: …Spit it out, now. The owner can't find their stuff and they're getting anxious.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_SNPC_027: …Ugh… I'm fine, I just got a bit seasick on the boat.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_Eibon_001_dlg_004: Ahem, to show my gratitude, I am willing to tell you an incredible secret that only I know.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_439_002: …Wow, these colors… they're absolutely perfect! No editing needed at all!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_296_004: …Hmph, every single one of them needs me to nag them to get moving.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_simple_269_Player_006: Ahaha, just kidding! Just saying whatever came to mind. You don't actually have to pay anything…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_C070070_Player_004: …Oh, then you're probably out of luck.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_378_005: …Eh? That car brand? How would that even work as a collab… They're not actually going to release official itasha cars, are they…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_338_005: …Mm. Then I suppose I'll have to be a fisherman.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_376_005: …Yeah, that must be… the reason, haha…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_342_003: …Well, looks like we're at least consistent!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_005011_003: …Huh? Wait?! Did you just say n-next year…?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_Anomaly_032_Player_004: …I think I can hear Nacupeda's hungry stomach growling.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_sitrest_002_dlg_004: All right, fine. I'm a mere lackey who hasn't received any missions yet, so I'm just stuck here watching the kiddos.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_443_001: …Such an abstract sculpture. I can't tell what it's supposed to be at all.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_377_005: …If that happens, make sure you capture my final expression on camera.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_088001_005: …Child, cherish those who walk by your side. The most regretful goodbyes often come without any warning…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_NPC_004_012: …Oh, remembered. While waiting for Mint… Lacrimosa ate all the french fries…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_355_003: …I don't care anymore! Ha! Ha ha! Tonight I'm feasting on meat buns and oden!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_070024_007: …I know this approach makes me weak, but I'm terrified of continuing this meaningless existence…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_070024_006: I've heard that when Pawn Moonlight grants your wish, it also takes something important in return… sometimes even your future…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_302_004: I remember you were! I saw you take off your headset and put it on the table when you came back from the bathroom.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_300_004: Sounds like you want to go fishing there…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_WA008_NPC_011_004: The Colucci family… has conquered all of Hethereau…!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC001015_005: …Though, I keenly observe that you have not earned the privilege of such an honor. Turn around now, and return to the sunlight! That is where you belong…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_381_003: I see. Modern technology sure is convenient these days…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_WA008_NPC_011_003: Looks like… I'll have to vanquish this buffet by myself…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_282_005: When you do pass… make sure to tell everyone I taught you how to drive.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_289_005: …Wait! What if I bring my figurines to the museum at night…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SD_CNPC_078004_009: …Whatever, I give up trying to get you to listen to me.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC111001_003: …Oh well, a little daydreaming now and then won't hurt…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_Eibon_001_dlg_012: Forget about it. I don't expect much of you anymore.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_simple_269_008: …That much? Do store clerks really make this kind of money?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_simple_270_007: Is the editor gone? Thank you so much! You're my lifesaver!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_084006_003: …Bah, forget it! Actually, I'm just doing some health exercises I saw on TV. I was just indulging in the feeling of sounding like some mystical kung fu master…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_segu_carcinema_005_bubble_010: How about we just watch through the rearview mirror…?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_450_003: …I wonder what the view would be like if you climbed to the treetop?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_360_001: …Huh? Stuck at the delivery station for a month?! What's going on with that?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_271_003: …Obviously I'm here for the latest manga!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_343_003: …I see. So I'm the only one who gets knocked down by life all the time.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_370_001: Um… t-the… the moonlight tonight… it's really beautiful…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_coffeetalk_002_bubb: Then I'll give you my dessert too.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_simple_227_004: Urk… Do we have any options besides camping…?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC073016_001: …! New issues are now on the shelves at Moby-Dick Bookstore! Come in and take a look!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_CNPC_082003_005: ♪Will you remember that I'm still here♪…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_CNPC073016_003: The latest chapter of "Duke K"… Zzz…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_CNPC073016_005: The latest chapter of "Duke K" is on sale!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_CNPC103015_001: "Clear Skies in Summer"… It's got really high ratings on Bagel.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_SecondPhase_017_bub: Three new "Tales of Nil" chapters at once?!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.BSA_simple_181_003: "Orange Cat in the Sun", "Cattykyutes from Outerspace", and "Even the Cat Doesn't Know What's Going On!"
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_DSD_001_dlg_002: Drink more, Sing loud, Dance on the floor—that's DSD.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_segu_cargaizhuang_002_dlg_007: That's Knight One, our boss's beloved car. It has accompanied him through many years of racing and is even helping out in the shop after retirement.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_072006_Player_007: Budori… could make you forget all about dieting with its delicious food…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_boduoli_001_dlg_002: Budori is the name of our Taishou, the Oddity on the sign. He's also the adoptive son of Granny Chiyo.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_indoor_Coffee_003_bubble_001: Cocoa Energy Bomb is really delicious!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.BSA_simple_173_001: I've gone through the Speak Singers' materials so many times now…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.BSA_simple_173_003: Delusion Express! It's this voice acting show with so many pros in it!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SD_CNPC_076013_003: Protect the City, battle the forces of Chaos!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_288_004: "I will be the one to settle my family's blood debts…"
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_CNPC073017_002: Little Sparrow is thrilled to have you here!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SA_CNPC_041001_006: The Anomaly Express Ghost Train is a special intercity anomaly metro system set up by the Hethereau Bureau of Anomaly Control.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPC003_ACT_007: "When life gives you lemons, grab salt and Tequila."
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_simple_295_001: "Tonight's performance will begin at seven o'clock…"
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC084011_001: Culinary Peaks is officially closing today. Thank you for your support over the years. I've been tending this soup for 40 years; now that I have to turn off the stove, I really can't bear to let go.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_073001_Player_005: You can't beat the Nutty Storm.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_072006_Player_005: Maybe a massage with the Ora Puncher could reduce bloating and help with body sculpting…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_WA017_NPC_003_002: "When the soul is wrung with direst woe, then shines its fairest light."
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_073001_Player_006: The Spicy Challenge has my heart.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SA_CNPC_041001_Player_001: What does the Daily Safety Department do?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_C092013_Player_002: Nacupeda, I guess. Taking it easy… laying there and getting coins tossed my way… Sounds like a dream.

ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_CNPC038049_003: "The only good goblins are the ones that never work." Young people will love it!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS469_004: "This time, shatter the lies!"—does that ring any bells?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_NPCS033_008_001: "What a coincidence, you're here too?" Nonono, that sounds WAY too forced…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SA_CNPC_001004_Player_001: Soon… which means you're not as good as her right now, correct?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_CNPC090012_001: "Misty Rain Fried Goods" is trending. It takes at least three hours for your turn to be served.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_379_001: One… two… red light! I saw you move!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_SecondPhase_034_bub: An anomaly made entirely of sand who is good-natured enough to allow people to dig around on it?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC_083003_002: This ordinary… unremarkable… completely average radio tower?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_segu_carcinema_003_bubble_006: One two three four, two two three four!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_CNPC010021_003: We already replaced so much of the action footage with roll we snagged from real BAC operations…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_NPC_Sub_040_MapTransfer_049: Maybe I'll take a stroll around Kyllene.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SA_CNPC_041004_006: There's an emergency meeting coming up at the bureau, and a senior asked me to make twenty copies of this very environmentally-friendly document.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_Garbagestreet_001_b: How about we get ice cream first?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_348_001: When we go to the mall to try on clothes later, let's confirm our secret signal! When I say it's okay…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_SecondPhase_028_bub: Can you show me your homework later, in the car?
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SDW_simple_271_002: A visitor's guitar. They supposedly lost it here, but I've gone through all the guitars in the campground and still can't find it.
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_CNPC_051003_001: One bite of this hot dog, and poof! Your worries are gone like the wind!
ST_AmbianceDialogue.AM_City_A_banjiaojie_Eibon_001_dlg_009: Not even a word of praise for my beauty… How rude…
ST_AmbianceDialogue.SUW_TBS_294_003: As soon as my kid gets back home, I get fed and massages. Ah, even a considerate kid can be bothersome…

ST_Clone.ResourceClone001_Des: The strange phone booth connects to a shattered, lost dimension, a place that may have once been a bustling, vibrant metropolis. The people of that past are long gone, and the lost beings wander forever in endless silence and desolation.
ST_Clone.Trailclone_exp_Des: "Five Years of Appraisal, Three Years of Practice," "Complete Guide to Anomalies," "38 Sets of Nexus Identification"… all in the "Anomaly Hunter Essential Collection."
ST_Clone.DLC_forkbreakthrough_005_Des: You stupid groundhogs! This just terrible! Granny Mary is definitely going to kick your butts! O-oh, hey there, old buddy! Want to try some new cans? They're just incredible!
ST_Clone.DLC_forkbreakthrough_004_Des: Ice cold and delicious treats - that's how they look, and can merchants never lie. That fuse? Oh, that's just decoration.
ST_Clone.DLC_Museum_Lamp_02_Recommend_01_Des: A protagonist who deserves no sympathy. His situation is entirely of his own making.
ST_Clone.DLC_forkbreakthrough_003_Des: The price of a sweet dream is quite expensive, but everyone wants a good night's sleep. Perhaps you'd like to watch sheep running? I hear humans all love counting sheep.
ST_Clone.CloneEnter_04_Des: A black rabbit fell into the hole, a gray rabbit fell into the hole, and a white rabbit looked at its pocket watch and said: "We're going to be late! We're going to be late!" So jump! Jump! Hurry and jump into the hole! The game is about to begin!
ST_Clone.DLC_Museum_Lamp_01_Recommend_03_Des: Today's parting cannot erase the love we once shared.
ST_Clone.Hospital_Ending_01_Des: He lied to us. At this rate, we'll all turn into monsters—and I can't allow that to happen.
ST_Clone.Hospital_Ending_04_Des: He remains there forever: forever waiting, forever lost.
ST_Clone.WeeklyClone_Des_01:
Who dares disturb her slumber?
Who lifts the hem of her dress?
Who… wishes to dance with her?
ST_Clone.DLC_equipment_005_Des: Pixels light up one by one. At the edge of consciousness, you see the rabbit…
ST_Clone.DLC_equipment_006_Des: The rabbit-headed train requires only one golden radish train ticket.
ST_Clone.DLC_equipment_003_Des: The rabbit said it would rain, and so it began raining along a single line of latitude.
ST_Clone.CloneEnter_01_Des:
As for Houdinii himself, the rumors are as spectacular as his magic. A young man skilled in card tricks, or perhaps a playful trickster adept at transformations? Could it be that this grand magician, famous for his escape acts, has already escaped Time's prison and become the freest dove of all?
No one knows for certain.
ST_Clone.DLC_levelbreakthrough_003_Des: Join us, appraise this world, and the truth will eventually appear before your eyes.
ST_Clone.CloneEnter_03_Des: Ms. Cassandra's famous play "The Red Tin Soldier and the Blue Tin Soldier" is now showing to great acclaim at Cape Dome! Show your ticket stub and enjoy half-price Bubble Cans! "Praise the most honest canned goods merchant! Praise the most beautiful Ms. Cassandra!"
ST_Clone.DLC_Museum_Lamp_01_Recommend_04_Des: Regret, remorse, guilt… These are all inseparable parts of life that we must learn to accept.
ST_Clone.DLC_equipment_004_Des: Chanting… Great Revival Spell! Battle for the radishes until the very end!
ST_Clone.ResourceClone001_CloneDesBody01: A rare stable fragment in the shattered lost dimension, almost completely unaffected by spatial turbulence.
ST_Clone.ResourceClone001_SpecialTips02: Engaging the enemy during skill cooldown is not a wise choice.
ST_Clone.DLC_talent_005_Des: Find the exit before the water reaches your neck!
ST_Clone.DLC_talent_002_Des: Enjoying delicious afternoon tea in the garden… White roses? There are none here.
ST_Clone.ResourceClone001_SpecialTips03: Switch between different characters to trigger Esper Cycle to deal higher damage.
ST_Clone.DLC_forkbreakthrough_002_Des: She is a genius, she is an artist. Within the spiral of intertwined words, my birth is the greatest symphony of this century.
ST_Clone.Hospital_Ending_03_Des: The research must continue. I must find a way to rid myself of "it" before I turn, no matter the cost.
ST_Clone.Trailclone_gold_Des: Even the power of lies cannot turn a fake coin into a real coin.
ST_Clone.ResourceClone001_Introduce: Though the shattered dimension is fraught with danger, a stroke of luck might allow you to bring back treasures from other realms.
ST_Clone.DLC_Museum_Lamp_02_Des: We love hearing tales of heroes. We love hearing how they use their extraordinary strength and will to save the world. But these stories forget to teach us how to save ourselves, so when the heroes leave, we find ourselves lost.
ST_Clone.DLC_Museum_Lamp_01_Recommend_02_Des: How many people have we lost because we were too shy to express our love?
ST_Clone.DLC_talent_004_Des: I bet you're thinking right now: What should I have for lunch?
ST_Clone.ResourceClone001_SpecialTips01: Focus on the enemy's movements before attacks and dodge at the right moment to avoid damage.
ST_Clone.DLC_talent_003_Des: The prerequisite for drawing something good is that you have to reach your hand in.
ST_Clone.DLC_equipment_001_Des: The hands sometimes move forward, sometimes backward, so order and chaos coexist within the Rabbit Hole.
ST_Clone.DLC_Museum_Lamp_01_Recommend_01_Des: The protagonist of this story is a designer, and fittingly, the scene has a uniquely artistic flair.
ST_Clone.DLC_Hockshop_Introduce: Pawn Moonlight is a separate space created by the Anomaly Morphix; only those with strong desires can enter.
ST_Clone.DLC_Museum_Lamp_01_Recommend_05_Des: I hope I get to meet Patty in person someday. We have a lot in common to talk about.
ST_Clone.DLC_levelbreakthrough_001_Des: Come on, let's expose the fraud of the so-called greatest magician. This is merely the first step toward the truth.
ST_Clone.DLC_Museum_Lamp_02_Recommend_02_Des: Justice will prevail, and justice has stripped away this so-called hero's self-serving ambitions.
ST_Clone.DLC_bank_Safety_Des:
After the movie "Vault Heist" became a huge hit, many unknown criminals began eyeing Pink Paws Bank's vault… Though no one has ever seen the vault's entrance, someone smelled a business opportunity.

Dvořák has teamed up with renowned film director Cinema Lee to launch the reality show Pink Paws Heist, featuring a one-to-one recreation of the movie's sets for an immersive experience of a different kind of life, with generous rewards prepared for the winners! However, rumor has it that some "particularly capable" winners might find themselves on a rather strange list…
ST_Clone.DLC_Museum_Lamp_01_Des: A swing: a piece of recreational and athletic equipment. Wild roses: genus Rosa, cold-resistant, with numerous cultivated and wild varieties… Okay, enough beating around the bush. It's time to focus on what's really in front of us. Go on, express your love.
ST_Clone.DLC_Museum_Lamp_02_Recommend_04_Des: Putting on a character's costume doesn't mean you become the character themselves.
ST_Clone.DLC_Museum_Lamp_02_Name: Heroes don't always arrive in moments of glory.
ST_Clone.DLC_Museum_Lamp_02_Recommend_01_Name: Want to give it a name?
ST_Clone.DLC_equipment_002_Des: Do not look directly into the rabbit statue's eyes! Remember, there are no rabbit statues here!
ST_Clone.DLC_talent_001_Des: Oh white dove, symbol of peace, please don't steal my french fries.
ST_Clone.wpexp_des:
Midas Arc Dye, your great helper! Only 999 Fons!
Or just 0 Fons and a little game.
ST_Clone.Trailclone_Wpexp_Des: Midas Technologies partners with the greatest magician, Mr. Houdinii, to bring you a spectacular performance as dazzling as a Kaleidoscope!
ST_Clone.DLC_forkbreakthrough_001_Des: This can contains a poison apple with one bite taken, a rotten apple half-eaten, and one complete, sweet appleseed.
ST_Clone.CloneEnter_02_Des: This is a special bonus performance carefully prepared by the world's greatest magician, Mr. Houdinii! Oh poor little—I mean, cute, cute lucky one… choose whichever show you prefer. After all, this is the only thing you'll get to decide for yourself.
ST_Clone.Hospital_Ending_02_Des: Everything here belongs to the Sterling family—their sickness, their lives, and their deaths.
ST_Clone.DLC_Museum_Lamp_02_Recommend_05_Des: Even Garuda has his own convictions, but those swept away by fame and fortune have nothing at all.
ST_Clone.DLC_levelbreakthrough_002_Des: A magician? Ha, just a fame-seeking fraud. Building reputation by stepping on peers… No matter how great he claims to be, the stench of corruption sticks to him plain as day.

ST_Description.DMP01_04_0018:
November 31
Winter snow has blanketed the cherry trees.
Over the past few months, I have welcomed my "children" one by one. Bella was the first; she is flawless in managing the family, so perhaps one day I will entrust all our affairs to her. Then came Teresa, a gentle soul who breathed life into the stagnant courtyard, adorning the lifeless manor with fragrant flowers. Next was Elliot, my first son and the finest chef—no one knows my palate better than he.
Albert is a lively child. Unlike his older siblings, Albert is full of energy and obsessed with cleaning and repairs, often erasing the manor's imperfections before the servants even spot them. He and his two younger siblings—his little sister and brother—have also grown quite fond of games, though only within my sight. Yvette has such nimble hands; the very day she awoke, she inventoried my wardrobe and began sewing unique ornaments onto those dull fabrics. Erving was the last to wake—a quiet, good boy who loves to read and has a curious mind. Though he hasn't shown a specific talent yet, I know he will be just as brilliant as his older siblings.
There is still one child who has yet to wake. I want to give her the final, most unique purpose… a place in this family like no other. I have already chosen her name…
"Renee." Your mother is waiting for you to wake up…
ST_Description.DMP01_04_0015:
Early February.
My memories continue to slip away. Even the little things I can still recall are blurred now, like faded photographs. The passage of time barely registers; I can't even remember what day it is. Sometimes, when I host a banquet, it slips my mind and I forget to show up myself. The irony is that even with the host missing, the guests still carry on, pretending to have the time of their lives. Hardly anyone is actually offended by my absence. What binds them to me is profit and need—not respect, and certainly not loyalty. Even if I ignore them, they'll still come scrambling to attend the next one.
How tedious.
The curse of "immortality" has finally bared its fangs. As my old acquaintances grew older and passed away one by one, I was left only with those who wanted something from me. In their eyes, I am either a savior or a monster—but never a human. By now, I've stopped caring about the hushed whispers behind my back. In this frozen flow of time, everything has lost its meaning. Once the last traces of human warmth faded, all I've been able to feel… is an endless, icy void.
ST_Description.DMP01_04_0019:
March 27th.
Teresa hurt her hand while working in the courtyard. I completely lost my composure—such utter powerlessness is something I haven't experienced in decades. Yvette bandaged her up, and Teresa didn't show even a flicker of pain; instead, she apologized for "letting me down."
Letting me down? Once, I only wanted a "family" that was quiet, obedient, and loyal. That wish is what awakened the children, but now I see it became their shackles, too. They exist only to fulfill my desires. Even now, when I want them to live for themselves, it's already too late…
But Renee is different. She's sweet yet willful, like a curious little kitten. She ignores the "rules" born from my wishes. She has her own thoughts and her own desires—and because of that, she's more "human" than any of us.
Renee, you are my little petal, my treasure, and my hope.
All I can wish for is that you live your life as a ordinary person.
ST_Description.DMP01_04_0016:
A certain day in May.
Cordelein gave me a gift. He came in person, but I could barely recognize him anymore. In my memory, he was still a young man, chasing investors with nothing but a silver tongue and big ideas. That elder with the wrinkled face and unsteady steps… was that really Cordelein?
He brought me a set of "puppets"—seven in total, each one meticulously carved and lifelike. He said he hoped this gift would be of use to me, and he blessed me to find my desire.
What is it that I desire…?
I think I'd want someone to serve me, to be loyal to me. I'm tired of being surrounded by people from The Circle who only care for my wealth and making connections, putting on an act just to get close.
I want a "family." Quiet, obedient puppets… maybe that wouldn't be so bad.
ST_Description.DMP01_04_0017:
Early June. The 5th… or maybe the 6th?
For the first time in a long while, I have a day worth remembering. A wish I've carried for years has finally become reality. I've always treated these "puppets" as my true family, and this morning, one of them came to life! Her calling woke me, and she asked me what her name was. I bestowed a name upon my daughter—
"Bella."
She says she awakened solely to serve me, and has already begun putting the house in order. She gleams like a pearl, so vivid and alive. She does everything in her power for me with a pure heart—no complaints, no demands. Is this what a family's "love" feels like? Will the others wake up just as she did?
Bella, my daughter… The servants may need some time to get used to her… Not that it matters. If there's one thing I'm not short on, it's "time."

ST_Description.DMP01_04_0025:
B: Little Renee insisted on sitting on her brother's shoulders while we were taking the family photo, saying, "This way, I'll be the tallest person in the family!" Elliott never refused her requests, so of course he lifted her up—but mother didn't seem very pleased.
Mother called little Renee into the room, probably to scold her, as Renee wiped tears from her eyes during dinner.
Later, mother told me: if we always indulge Renee and continue to pamper her, she will never learn manners. She will never understand that she should respect and cherish her siblings.
I could tell it was important. Mother's expression was serious: whether it's her words or Renee's words, we don't always have to comply. First, we must strive to be "ourselves." Every person is equal, and each is an important part of the family.

I replied: fulfilling all your wishes is the mission we are born to carry.

Mother sighed and told me to get some rest early.

ST_Description.DSU01_08_0004:
SOS! If you're an Anomaly Hunter, please come help me! 

I'm a graffiti artist, and I've been tormented by the anomaly Graffiti Goof recently. It's completely ruined all my artwork walls with its random scribbling! No matter how many times I fix it, those ugly patterns appear again the next day… Day turns to night, night turns to day, day turns to night, night turns to day… I can't even remember how many hours it's been since I last slept. 

Because of this Graffiti Goof, my recent creative work has completely stalled, and I can barely make ends meet. But I won't let you work for nothing. You can come to my place and take any of my artwork that catches your eye. I can even come to your place and create live graffiti art for you, using the one thing I'm good at to repay you…

I live on the 3rd floor of Acorn Apartments on Fiscus Avenue. Please, come and nullify that damn Graffiti Goof!
ST_Description.Hospital_Clue_16:
V's gone insane—using that… that "thing" for such an incredibly dangerous experiment. I don't even know how the higher-ups approved it… But I have to admit, it's his style to a T: brazen and uncouth. Looks like he's trying to solve the Phantom Burn Syndrome in one fell swoop. At his age and with his talent, he could be the next prodigy in the medical field.
██/█/█
…Such a "great sacrifice" is necessary, huh? So that's what V said? Cold-blooded bastard. Even when I first joined this project, I had my reservations; he probably couldn't have cared less. Hmph—the Family will likely value him for that.
██/█/█
Couldn’t handle the psychological pressure after all, huh? The resignation was out of the blue—the higher-ups didn't even have time to reassign a new researcher, so everything fell onto Director N. Tough luck… Though I never expected Director N's methodology to be so similar to V's.
██/█/█
What's the death count at this time? These absolute maniacs… Constantly in a rush… What's N in such a hurry for? Is this serving the Family's interests?
…It was said again: "The Great Sacrifice" is a necessary evil—probably V telling him the same. Come to think of it, N is so much like V in every way; put a mask on him, and he'd be practically indistinguishable… though, frankly, I'm forgetting what V looked like.
██/█/█
I've never seen N this happy—he stormed out, saying he has to talk to K, so there must be a breakthrough in the research. Good. N's been on edge lately; get too close to him and he stiffens up into a brick wall. He looks completely worn out… Hopefully they approve him for some days off…
██/█/█
So the Phantom Burn Syndrome can be cured…? Unbelievable… my hunch was right—he's a total savant…
What a pity. K's really lost it—with a chance to make his name in the field right in front of him, he still worries about trivial matters of who's who, as if pretending not to know would stop anything. Hmph, he brought this on himself.
…No water, no power, and a bunch of specimens out there… survival is out of our hands now.
Is this the ending you wanted, V?
██/█/█

—A Mysterious Note—
…This isn't the ending I wanted…
ST_Description.DSU01_08_0003:
Topic: SOMEONE TAKE CARE OF THIS ANOMALY
Posted by: Epic Shorts Posted: 1m ago

I am the biggest victim of the Graffiti Goof incident! I initially wanted to seek help online, but looking at my posting record, it's been a whole week since my first plea. During this time, aside from a few sarcastic replies, no one has sent me any direct messages, nor any communication info, let alone visiting me in Fiscus Avenue… (I live on the 2/F of Acorn Apartments btw) I don't have much to pay for your help, but you can come to my place and take anything you fancy, my works! I can also come to your place to graffiti on-site, using what I have, my skills, to repay you…

The destructive actions of the Graffiti Goof have severely affected my life and creativity. No matter how many times I repair the damage, the ugly pattern appears on my work wall the next day… Night falls, day breaks, night falls, day breaks… I've lost count of how many sleepless hours have passed. Help me, whoever you are, if you can nullify that damn Graffiti Goof, please!

ST_Description.Hospital_3F_Office_Ambient:
—Chat Log Between ██ and ██—

: Have you finished your pathology report? The director just asked me earlier—he claims he never received yours.
: No way, I finished it and sent it yesterday.
: Did you double check?
: …Huh? It's… not in my Sent folder.
: See? I told you.
: I swear I sent it… What's going on…?
: It's been a long couple of days--you're probably just tired. I had the same thing happen to me a few days ago, actually. I swore I remembered handing in a patient's consultation request, but the direction said he never got it, so I had to run back to the Consultation Department.
: Are we starting to lose our minds?
: No way we start having identical problems at the same time, right?
: What other explanation could there be? We're cursed? As if.
: Don't say things like that. Just rewrite the report, quickly.

Don't forget: tonight, we stay awake.

B: Little Renee hurt her knee while climbing a tree. She sat wailing so loudly that the whole manor could hear her cries, only stopping once I arrived with the first aid kit to bandage her wound. Mother, along with other siblings, were concerned about her injury, but her attention quickly shifted to the insects in the courtyard, and she seemed to forget all about the pain.
Little Renee is always like this—constantly following her impulses. One moment, she's pestering mother for a story; the next, she's clinging to Elliott for her favorite cake. Sometimes she follows Teresa and me, asking us endless questions; other times, she drags Yvette and Erving into games with her.
Mother told us that we could refuse Renee, that we should finish what we wanted to do first. She would also scold Renee, reminding her not to interrupt our work constantly. But I don't understand—wasn't Renee the one mother loves most? Why, then, does mother always look so conflicted whenever we set aside our tasks to entertain her mischief?
Renee has changed mother in so many ways. She smiles more often now, as if the "eternal" ice within her is slowly thawing. Though Renee constantly surprises us with her unpredictability, we have never resented her—after all, she is our little sister.
Mother said that tonight, after Renee falls asleep, she wants to have a talk with us. As always, we will meet her expectations.
ST_Description.DMP01_04_0023:
Don't forget: The tailor Mother invited will arrive tomorrow at 3 PM.

B: Aside from little Renee, who's always climbing trees and squeezing into corners, our clothes are all in great shape. The tailor really only needs to measure her, right? Yet Mother desires new outfits for everyone… could it be she's bored with the styles we're wearing now?
Remember to round everyone up early tomorrow. Little Renee always loses track of time when she's playing, so let's make sure we catch that little troublemaker first.
ST_Description.DMP01_04_0024:
Don't forget: Subscribe to some simple cookbooks.

B: Mother has suddenly developed a keen interest in cooking.
She says being able to make things for us with her own hands makes her happy. Even if the prep is a hassle… and she has to start from zero with no prior experience… Does that really make her happy? I don't quite get it.
She seems to be looking forward to the next time she cooks, saying she'll prepare dishes we'll like. Little Renee's tastes are easy to guess, but she hasn't managed to discern ours yet.
I told her the rest of us don't have any specific preferences, and she looked a bit disappointed.

Hey buddy, how have you been?

Thanks to the Graffiti Goof, I've gotten more customers since resuming my art, and even some major commercial events have reached out to me… Pretty ironic, huh? But this time, I didn't reject them all like I used to. I've realized something—I need money. Not just to pay off my debts, but to take me to farther places.

Remember when you told me why the Graffiti Goof targeted me? The colors in my spray paint. My style was too rigid before, which came from isolating myself while creating. Graffiti is a dialogue between art and people, and I can't lose that ability to communicate. So, I've decided to travel the world, to listen to people, talk with them, and create colorful works with diverse styles. That's what I'm looking forward to.

I used to think I was the biggest unfortunate soul on Fiscus Avenue. But then you knocked on my door, and my luck turned around. That feeling is indescribable, and I'll never forget it. I'll use graffiti to capture this unforgettable experience in every city I pass through.

Ethan

ST_Description.Hospital_Clue_12:
Experiment ID: █-██-00
Researcher: V
Objective: Explore the potential application of the experimental Anomaly "Jigsaw" in ███ and cellular replacement therapy
Sample Source: ████████
Methods and Records:
It is known that under manual division, the sample can be split into multiple units, or "pieces". Each unit, after separation, retains basic activity and exhibits a tendency to move toward similar units. If the distance is excessive (>5m), units enter a low-metabolic dormant state; reducing any distance restores activity in the unit.

Active units placed in contact with the subcutaneous tissue of mouse hosts show clear fusion at the unit-host interface. No host rejection was observed. After 48 hours, units and host tissue were nearly fully fused; portions of host cells were replaced by unit-derived quasi-chimeric cells, and spreading. No rejection from the host was observed. When units were subsequently placed beyond active range, units re-entered dormancy while host activity markedly decreased, suggesting strong interference of the units with host consciousness.

Application to Use Specimen No. ███ and No. ███ may be requested for further study.

Archive Date: █/█
Note: This report is restricted to Group ██ internal review only and must not be disclosed to the public.

Experiment II
The operator shared a sealed space with the subject. After 10 minutes and █ seconds, the operator experienced dizziness and disorientation, symptoms similar to those observed in Experiment I. Personnel outside the sealed space showed no abnormalities.
Experiment suspended; the operator was transferred to the ██ Department for continued observation.

Experiment III
The operator attempted to breach the subject's casing with a sharp instrument. Observed within the laboratory: wwwwwwww0x7F3Aw→⌀wwwwww wwwww
Experiment permanently suspended.

ST_Description.DMP00_01_0012:
Tips for Becoming a Top Photographer:
1. Plan well before taking photos. If the client has specified a style, try to learn more about similar styles. If it's a regular customer, try to understand their habits in advance. It's best to find pose references beforehand to improve shooting efficiency.
2. Most people have one side of their profile that looks better. Before shooting, ask the customer which side they prefer. If it's a regular customer, figure it out before the shoot.
3. When taking overhead shots, it's best to have the person sitting down instead of standing, as it can make them look short.
4. If the customer is not good at posing, let them move around freely and try to capture candid shots. However, note that the parameters for candid shots need to be adjusted more compared to those of fixed poses.

ST_Description.DMP01_01_0008:
First interaction: Smell it
You remember the wild strawberry field from your childhood—maybe there was no such place in your childhood, but this scent makes you think of it, that carefree, sweet, and sour ordinary afternoon.

Second interaction: Smell it
It's the screen still glowing in the deep night, the perpetually red traffic light, the swollen legs and the blisters from rubbing flesh, fatigue is the heaviest and most frivolous, exuding a salty and bitter taste.

To ██:
…
That's unheard of. We mistakenly held the anesthetist responsible, but who could have predicted that a fully sedated patient would wake up just because someone removed the bandages from his arm? These Anomaly disorders make absolutely no sense. As for that poor anesthetist, he's now become like the others who wrap themselves in bandages… At least they're still human, I suppose.
I don't know what exactly happened in V's operating room. I don't understand how it spreads. I suspect this shouldn't be classified as a disease, but rather a curse… Anyone would think the same if they saw a group of madmen wrapping bandages around themselves.
But silver lining: V got injured but wasn't infected. At least, I don't think so. He just looks like he's lost his soul. He's been on sedatives constantly. I don't know what that poor guy went through in there. I'm just relieved he can still be of use. Otherwise, I'd be the one who has to take over dealing with these terrifying monsters…
Once the hospital lockdown is lifted, I need to pick somewhere for a proper vacation… How about Hethereau?

ST_Description.Hospital_WaterRoom_1:
(Scrawled handwriting in a medical chart)
They're definitely after my box! I knew it all along!
Every night, his heels are outside, on the walls, on the ceiling, pacing back and forth, tick-tock, tick-tock, splash, splash…
When they mop the floor, they pour water everywhere, trying to flood my box and short-circuit it!
And the cameras! They hide cameras in my room every day! They want to film where I hide my key!
They want to steal my box, take my medical records, my medicine, my name, my life… my…
…What else… What else?!
ST_Description.DMP01_04_0021:
(This paper appears old and brittle, one corner stained by spilled ink, rendering the text illegible.)
The toll for trifling with fate has finally come due. I breathed life into the inanimate, yet I craftily evaded the price for doing so, only to summon the "Debt Collector" knocking to my door.
Ever since Bella awoke, the shadow of the end has loomed over me. Every night, at the exact same hour, it arrives to claim the debt I owe to fate, and I have no way to resist it. Wealth, fame, connections, power—all are pathetically fragile against the relentless collection of natural law. The decisive moment is closing in.
I must speak to Bella. No… I must gather all my children, I want… (The rest is obscured by ink stains.)
ST_Description.DMP01_04_0022:
(This paper looks old and brittle. The handwriting is bold and forceful, as if the writer had finally steeled her resolve.)
I've spoken with the children, and each and every one supports my decision. This only makes my heart ache all the more. If they had fought me on this, or told me I was no mother of theirs, perhaps it wouldn't hurt this much. But they simply accepted our fate with such quiet grace.
Bella. Teresa. Elliot. Albert. Yvette. Erving.
My dearest children, please forgive your mother's selfishness. Grant your mother this one final wish.
Where dead wood decays, new life shall bloom.
We leave the future to Renee.
ST_Description.DMP01_04_0020:
(The paper looks old and brittle, the lines steeped in sorrow and grief.)
It was the Esper Ability. The children awakened because my Esper Ability awakened… Even though I was… (the ink is smeared here, the words are illegible) …blessed, and the countdown of my "mundane life" was frozen, their awakening set that frozen time into motion once more. When that time hits zero, the children will fall back into slumber, leaving me alone in this world once again. Why is fate so cruel, granting me happiness, only to tear it away?
They all know this. But to them, the very reason they woke up was to fulfill my wish, so none of them complain—except Renee.
"If we die, we won't be with Mommy anymore! I don't want that! I want to stay with Mommy, Brothers, and Sisters!"
My Renee… (several words here have been crossed out)
There's still some time before that destined moment arrives. I can still think of a solution. Until then… even if it's as ephemeral as foam, I want to hold on to this happiness for just a moment longer.
