ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0163_CNPC073007_004: Mahjong is our specialty! We all like to say, "Maid cafes are common, but mahjong maid cafes are rare!"
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0163_NPE07319_Player_002: What are the rules for mahjong?
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0026_NPC_03723_004: Whoa! How do you know so much about this? Could it be that you're also…
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_Prison_CNPE117025_Player_001: ({Gender}||gender(His,Her) radio was probably nabbed from Spider…)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0117_CNPC_096001_Player_002: (…There are so many complaint files. They can't all be for stuff like this, right?)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0162_CNPC_114001_Player_003: (Come to think of it, maybe I could make some extra cash here at the hospital with my Esper Ability…)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0117_Anomaly_047_Shop_004: (But there are also some really skilled hunters who've figured out the most efficient ways to use them for different battles, completing all the challenges using only a few gifts of mine.)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0117_CNPC_097003_Player_002: (There are actually risks like this when riding the Ghost Train…)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_Prison_CNPE117017_Player_002: (Given the height of the railings in the guard tower area, if I had a rope…)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_Prison_CNPE117014_Player_005: (But there really is something in the infirmary that could help me… Maybe I can use this information to get my hands on it?)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0117_Anomaly_047_Shop_005: (You can try challenging yourself if you want! But of course I'd recommend taking more of them!)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0117_Anomaly_047_Logistics_002: (Go for it! Collect all the seals!)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_Prison_CNPE117013_Player_003: (There are chemicals in the infirmary that can corrode metal, and it doesn't sound too hard to get them… Worth remembering.)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_Prison_CNPE117019_Player_002: (So in other words, if I cut the power to the door, the lock would fail…)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0041_CNPC_103006_Player_003: (Ah… looks like someone else is also quite anxious…)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0126_CNPC_005016_Player_002: (Huh? I thought this was supposed to be an urban romance movie?)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0117_Anomaly_047_Shop_003: (Since my abilities are limited, each of my "gifts" can only help you once per battle. In theory, the more gifts you use in each battle, the better!)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_Prison_CNPE117010_Player_001: (So the sewer behind the wall leads outside the prison… That might be worth remembering.)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_Prison_CNPE117008_Player_006: (If I give {Gender}|gender(him,her) a spoon and have {Gender}|gender(him,her) sneak it into the electrical room, it might short-circuit the power system in the cell block…)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0108_NPC_06301_001: (Oh, a guest! A guest is here! Welcome! Please, take a seat!)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0117_Anomaly_047_NextLevel_002: (I knew an Anomaly Hunter like you wouldn't give up so easily… All aboard! The Ghost Train is departing the station!)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0117_Anomaly_047_Logistics_004: (Anyways, if you run into any problems, just come find me!)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0117_Anomaly_047_NextLevel_003: (Is there something you still need to take care of? Or did you accidentally leave something behind? Go ahead, but stay safe!)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0117_Anomaly_047_Shop_002: (Oh, you're here! Come take a look at what you need!)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0005_CNPC_005015_Player_002: (A world where no one gets hurt is completed…)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0108_NPC_06301_003: (Stray cats! Jingle Wrangle can be your new home!)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_Prison_CNPE016009_Player_014: (Got the guard tower key. Sneak up and have a look?)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0062_CNPC_048003_004: (The money she saved probably doesn't even cover the transport…)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0130_Player_005: (What a lively father and son duo…)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0117_Anomaly_047_Logistics_0010: (Seriously, who keeps dropping all this stuff?!)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0113_Player_030: (Is that really the right way to describe it…?)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_Prison_CNPE117017_Player_001: (It's true, the fabric they issue here is pretty sturdy. If I could cut it into strips and tie them together, it would probably make a decent rope.)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0112_Player_0036: (I'm starting to think this "Invincible Player" title is self-proclaimed…)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0117_Anomaly_047_NextLevel_001: (You've finished exploring everything at this stop. Where to next?)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0026_CNPC_075005_005: (Sounds like that Anomaly might be Mysty. I should look around for it.)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0113_Player_035: (It's completely written all over my face, isn't it…!)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0117_Anomaly_047_NextLevel_004: (That's more like it! Be a good passenger and don't make the Train Manager fret all the time. All aboard, let's head back!)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0022_CNPC_038020_Player_003: (No way anyone's gonna believe me, but why not.)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0117_Anomaly_047_Staff_001_001: (If you love sightseeing so much, why take the Ghost Train?!)
ST_Dialogue_CityMark_Chat.SD_S0132_CNPC072030_Player_001: (No one but Nanally would do something like that…)

ST_Dialogue_Date.D0041010T_NPC011_006: No, no, that doesn't count. I didn't eat enough today. I couldn't pack my punch!
ST_Dialogue_Date.D0041010T_NPC011_005: Ah, win some lose some. Besides, losing to me is nothing to be ashamed of. I'll go easy on you next time, I promise.
ST_Dialogue_Date.D0041010T_NPC011_004: Do you want to play with me? I won't go easy on you!

ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_006: <TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/>…<TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/>…<TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/>…<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03304_008: <TypingImg id="6"/>Not allowed to speak<TypingImg id="6"/>Shouldn't speak<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03304_015: <TypingImg id="6"/>No<TypingImg id="6"/>Do not interfere with my rebirth<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_026: <TypingImg id="6"/>Master, having been put through excruciating pain by the deadly venom, was barely able to think with a straight mind. In his last days, he still cried for all those compliments and good things he loved to hear.<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_015: <TypingImg id="6"/>Master has a new wish? No. His wish never changed.<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_003: <TypingImg id="6"/>You should try to behave and talk as elegantly as a flower. Restrain yourself with the vines and discipline yourself with the thorns.<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_004: <TypingImg id="6"/>Not a single bit of noise, an absolutely quiet place. Noble families that were highly regarded once lived here.<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_028: <TypingImg id="6"/>But we all become nutrients anyway! We squeezed Master dry down to his last gulp of rotten breath.<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_010: <TypingImg id="6"/>Who amongst the children is the meanest and most malicious.<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_016: <TypingImg id="6"/>After that, silence is back upon the garden, and all the noise green plants.<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03304_010: <TypingImg id="6"/>But now<TypingImg id="6"/>finally<TypingImg id="6"/>I've found it<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_005: <TypingImg id="6"/>And now, people don't even want to joke about them.<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03304_004: <TypingImg id="6"/>A guest<TypingImg id="6"/>An invited one<TypingImg id="6"/>You are?<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_030: <TypingImg id="6"/>Sorry. We're not supposed to tell the world about what happened in the family. All these. We're sorry. Master never allowed us to talk about these things.<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_011: <TypingImg id="6"/>Will have a good time squeezing money out of the dead man to make up for their lost childhood.<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_029: <TypingImg id="6"/>There is no chance to make ourselves heard anymore. This is a regretful, happy, and satisfying end<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_002: <TypingImg id="6"/>Manor is the master's elegant and solemn hall. Family members are decorations that are exactly where they should be.<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_017: <TypingImg id="6"/>The garden is a place where Master commands absolute power. Inappropriate or disobedient opinions don't have a place here.<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_031:
<TypingImg id="6"/>We want to say it<TypingImg id="6"/>We must say it<TypingImg id="6"/>We have to say it<TypingImg id="6"/>So we said it<TypingImg id="6"/>
<TypingImg id="6"/>Did we say it?<TypingImg id="6"/>We said it, right?<TypingImg id="6"/>We said it<TypingImg id="6"/>We said it<TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/>We said it<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03304_011: <TypingImg id="6"/>Words <TypingImg id="6"/>burst forth like a storm of pollen<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Tcang01_NPC03304_002: <TypingImg id="6"/>Thoughts take root<TypingImg id="6"/>and grow<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Tcang01_NPC03304_001: <TypingImg id="6"/>I've mastered a truly beautiful way of speaking<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_007: <TypingImg id="6"/>Everything that's been said hardly makes sense.<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_009: <TypingImg id="6"/>Master is completely useless when he's old and bedridden. Your reputation is as good as dead when you're old and weak.<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_020: <TypingImg id="6"/>Some had formidable thorns growing out of their throats, while some had their ears swarming with pests.<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_021: <TypingImg id="6"/>Some of their teeth came falling off with the rotten fruit, and some had their tongues twisted off by the vines that had infested them.<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_027: <TypingImg id="6"/>No one was there. No one was there to tell him, "You've worked hard for this family."<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_024: <TypingImg id="6"/>Wishing you happiness!<TypingImg id="6"/>Wishing the whole family happiness!<TypingImg id="6"/>Wishing the whole family happiness forever!<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_022: <TypingImg id="6"/>A family raised with hard work and a house that once made him so proud. And there they were drowning in the elegance and fragrance!<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03304_012: <TypingImg id="6"/>A garden lush <TypingImg id="6"/>and radiant <TypingImg id="6"/>I will stay here <TypingImg id="6"/>and live as one with it <TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_019: <TypingImg id="6"/>Conflict spreads like pollens, and malice comes oozing out like poison.<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Tcang01_NPC03304_003: <TypingImg id="6"/>And words<TypingImg id="6"/>bloom like flowers<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_012: <TypingImg id="6"/>There is more to it than what's been said.<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_001: <TypingImg id="6"/>Long story. Just say whatever that's on your mind.<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03304_003: <TypingImg id="6"/>Thank you… for your praise<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_014: <TypingImg id="6"/>All the old and disgusting rules, discarded like wild weed! Furnishings decay, the manor is beautiful no more.<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03304_009: <TypingImg id="6"/>For so long<TypingImg id="6"/>my flaws brought my parents shame<TypingImg id="6"/>burdened them<TypingImg id="6"/>made others stare<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_013: <TypingImg id="6"/>All the hidden intentions and fights among family members feed into and further spread the malice. The manor has become a noisy place with quarrels.<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_023:
<TypingImg id="6"/>Refined!<TypingImg id="6"/>Elegant!<TypingImg id="6"/>Beautiful!<TypingImg id="6"/>

<TypingImg id="6"/>Stunning!<TypingImg id="6"/>Marvelous work!<TypingImg id="6"/>Truly enviable!<TypingImg id="6"/>

<TypingImg id="6"/>Family bliss!<TypingImg id="6"/>Family bliss!<TypingImg id="6"/>Harmony!<TypingImg id="6"/>Harmony!<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_QL_Interact_008: <TypingImg id="6"/>Love between siblings doesn't come with a color or smell, and can't be used to decorate the garden or the house.<TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_035: <blue>"ETD EXPOSED! Lacrimosa the Tomato Devil: Arrogant, Egotistic, and Destructive?!"</>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03501_001: Maiyue from Class B… Who's that?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_052: ETD member… gone mad… attacking innocent people?!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_049: Must be busy in ETD, huh.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_118: Sure. I'll find you after closing.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_153: Don't worry! I've been mining songs from this anime I'm really into lately—
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_166: After tonight's performance at StarSign ended…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_011: <TypingImg id="Text_yinfu_01"/><TypingImg id="Text_yinfu_01"/>So? Pretty great vibe in here, right?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_112: "When you do care about someone, you will always find a way to understand him."
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_070: "And then, at Night of Moondog… their performance shook the city! It was the beginning of something unforgettable!"
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_211: …Though maybe that's just someone's overconfidence rubbing off on me.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_211: …Though maybe that's just someone's overconfidence rubbing off on me.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03304_013: <TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/> <TypingImg id="6"/>I don't want to<TypingImg id="6"/><TypingImg id="6"/>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_036: Why is he not saying anything now?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_141: Well, sometimes catching a little of that overconfidence… helps chase away the fear.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_041: So I see you still remember who you are. Good.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_204: …You're the vocalist, aren't you? I only stepped in to help you practice.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_056: You said you're on your time off?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC005_005: …You don't need to stay. Wasn't your leave already approved? I'll handle this myself.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_040: …You just came up with that, didn't you?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_207: …See you all in two days. Don't be late.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_075: …Ugh… they're attacking senpai again… Why do people have to be so mean?!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_032: If you don't mind listening. So this is the deal…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Tcang01_NPC006_013: Pffft! That's… That's a really unique club for a hobby!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_075: Alright, doesn't seem like that's gonna happen.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_025: …Am I the only one who remembers this is a Livehouse, not a music school?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_112: Right… language is not the only way we communicate, like you said.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_025: I didn't think we were that close…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_184: I was too harsh with them just now…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Tcang01_NPC005_004: The flowers sure are smelling stronger than before…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_128: Well, Maiyue lost his vocal capabilities because we got rid of the nexus for him, so, in a way, I think I failed to live up to my promise to them.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_008: …Somehow I feel like that was your plan all along.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_182: …I'll take care of the equipment. You two can leave now.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_160: …Am I dreaming or has the world finally flipped? Kiyosawa, here? At this hour?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_001: …Good evening, Haniel. No commission tonight—I'm just out for a stroll, really.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_110: Hm? Even though you were totally going to ask me something?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_094: You're right! We've gotta be like those birds flying straight into the wind—chasing the sky!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_007: Sigh… It really can't be helped, can it?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_232: …Oh no! You're right! It really is an emergency!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_065: Please—just promise me one thing. Don't let them drag you into their madness.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_003: …Correction. You were blocking the line, so I just gave you one of the drinks we couldn't sell to move things along.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_010: I was about to ask you to give me a detailed account of why you skipped work…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC07006_002: …I don't know about this… What if…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_020: Fine… Let's move now. Look out for yourselves.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_093: …That's what a guitarist I admire once said, anyway. I still think it's a little too optimistic.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03801_027: We should leave this to you now, thank you.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03801_002: Yes, yes! Thank you. Please, come in, and, have a seat.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_166: …! Hello? Haniel? Where are you two?!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03801_022: Of course! Thank you! Thank you so much!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_142: … (When and why did he learn sign language?)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_022: Like they said in "Sin City Chronicles"—"The family business is the pride of this family, and it should be the pride of this city."
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_131: But my clients told me this—people who truly care about him will always be patient enough to understand what he's trying to say, no matter how he chooses to express himself.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_101: How well is the family doing?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC08201_022: First time back on stage since the LINES disbanded, huh? Got any plans now?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC1029_021: "I'll be waiting at your next stage"—even if it's from way out in the audience.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_101: The posters will change when it's about to start. If they haven't yet, we've still got time.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_141: Night of Moondog is a Location Anomaly. It's not some dog-shaped oddity. The stage itself is the anomaly.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_084: The crowd at Night of Moondog will be way bigger—and tougher.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_162: Night of Moondog is just around the corner!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC09601_009: The incidents have been going on for quite a while now and the BAC hasn't made a move… Maybe they're covering it up… Tsk, who knows?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC09801_002: There are many rumors about the Tomato Devil. The earliest version tells of a tomato that refused to be made into jelly, so it turned into an anomaly and escaped from transport.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC010_015: The Tomato Devil situation might naturally fade away once public interest dies down.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_031: Tomato Devil? Are you onto the case too, Mint?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC004_049: Skia… got off work… and back to work already…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Tcang01_NPC006_025: The smell of someone talking? Well, that's unheard of.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_208: Let's see if you can back up all that bark, Tiger.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC010_023: Whether a rumor simply fades away or is properly dispelled… For those involved, the difference is immense.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC08201_013: Store's gotten lively again in just one day. Who was that on bass just now?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_026: At first, the discussions online were pretty friendly. People were saying that even though what she did wasn't exactly right, there was something endearing about this <blue>girl</>!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03901_002: We just hope he isn't involved in an anomaly incident… We want to find him before it's too late.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_058: Uploading to Bagel! New album time… let's call it "The Evolution of a Guitar Prodigy"!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_001: Taking the stage?! That's awesome! Not bad, Appraiser—I've seriously underestimated you! I look away for one second and bam! You've already launched a whole new venture for the family!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_149: A group that scored a hundred out of hundred made a projection of Hethereau Skytower appear on stage. And it wasn't tricks or espers—
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC00508_001: So how was that live show you went to?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_125: Hey… it's got a nice flowery fragrance in it.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_002: Afternoon. I heard you joined Eibon, but haven't had time to visit.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_091: Good afternoon. Here, I really like this flower tea so I asked them to make one for you.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_158: Afternoon, Appraiser. You're early—so am I, actually. Hang on a second.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_083: Wait, when's the next Night of Moondog again? Didn't Akane mention it before?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_218: …Next time, just come to the shop. Bring you know who too.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_218: …Next time, just come to the shop. Bring you know who too.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_014: Not at all. Actually, it was my first time experiencing this kind of… cheering? It was kind of exciting.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_032: No way! This is Haniel's way of showing gratitude! And besides… I drank way too much—need to move or I'll explode!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_097: For now, focus on something simpler—like how you and Nanally speed up every time you play together. That has to stop.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_003: To be honest, sometimes I don't even know how to spend the downtime… By the way, you're off today too? Headed to a concert?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_146: It wasn't easy, but we did better than most. That counts for something.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC02315_002: Wait, StarSign only has shows at night!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Tcang01_Player_012: No, it's… the smell of someone talking, I can smell it…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_115: Not a single drop on the instruments, I swear! You can inspect 'em!

ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_007: You know where this Tomato Devil is?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_120: No more staying up late browsing Bagel tonight, Taygedo.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_098: Hey Taygedo, ready to start streaming?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_022: Come on, Taygedo. Let's check out the other vending machines.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_051: Taygedo, search online for new posts about Lacrimosa.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_011: Taygedo, this vending machine seems untouched. The Tomato Devil probably hasn't been here yet.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_108: Treat them like test subjects! Then we'll discover the zap boom pow formula!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_087: I'm not good. I can't breathe! Skia, you gotta bring a gurney here and carry me back!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC010_022: The public's misconceptions about Lacrimosa will remain in their hearts… and might one day come back to bite once more.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_113: Maybe we're all just overtired. Let's call it for today. Haniel, once you've picked the new song, we'll regroup.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC08201_030: Great work today, everyone. That set was fire. The crowd energy felt like a legit livehouse gig.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC08201_018: Actually, we've got an event in a couple days and need a warm-up act. Want to give it a shot?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Tcang01_NPC006_017: Guess I know why Maiyue never really spoke now.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC04801_008: The family communicates in sign language, and I guess the boy's parents learned it for the boy.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC00508_004: Oh wow, perfect timing! Do you have tickets? I'll buy one!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_086: Thanks so much, Coco! And Taygedo too! I'm counting on you both to take care of senpai!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_083: Brilliant idea, Coco! A livestream will be way more convincing than any post!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_041: The boy often visited this florist. Maybe there are clues we missed. Then, we'll go to the school.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC010_025: You've both had a long night. Now, enjoy some much-deserved rest.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_132: All her energy has to come from somewhere, I guess.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_006: A-alright then… sure, I'll come check it out.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Tcang01_NPC006_027: Hey, don't be so upset. I was just trying to lighten up the mood…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_191: Makes sense though—it's the 99th event! Totally a landmark one!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_103: Well, fine, my ability is plant talk, and I had a meaningful and soul-touching conversation with the plants in the glasshouse through a frequency neither of you could pick up. I asked them to wither for a second to clear out a path for us to save the kid.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_140: Hmph. 20 is pitiful—60 is just right for the Coluccis' grand musical debut!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC00508_005: Alright, next time we'll go together.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_048: Aww man, oh well! We'll do it next time—super-spicy, hellfire-level ramen! Last time Illica cried after one bite. Weak sauce! But I believe in you and Akane!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_008: Alright, alright! Light up now! Let me do a proper introduction.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_048: Alright, alright. I did listen a little. You've improved—just a teeny bit.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_042: Yay yay yay! Thanks, Kiyosawa! Thanks, Akane!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_189: Yesss! Mission complete! Amazing! Amazing, amazing!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_010: Yes! You're gonna love it—it's totally electric! C'mon, let's go!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_106: These plants that underwent rapid growth are like the arms and legs—or sensory organs, if you will—of the manor… They can hear and understand what we're saying…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03801_023: If—and I mean "if"—our boy went missing because of what's been on his mind…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_023: If he's in a unique situation and you can't communicate, it'll be troublesome…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_067: Double my pay and I'll even pay out of pocket to put up more.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_073: Getting a high or perfect score means instant fame in Hethereau. It's basically a gold stamp on your music career.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC010_005: Please look into it and, report any updates you may have, back to me, even if it doesn't have anything to do with anomalies.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_047: If you don't want trouble, be careful not to disturb them.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_201: If we'd scored 59, I might've been too embarrassed to post it on Bagel… but 60? Totally postable.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC09701_006: We're anomaly hunters, not "people hunters". If it's a person doing the deeds, there's nothing we can do about it.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_051: If you're too shy to ask the shop for help, just leave it to me, the Ichi-daime of the Coluccis! Any unsold tickets, my family will take care of them!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC02318_001: If it's tomorrow, I already have plans with a friend, so I'm afraid I can't… Wait, maybe…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC010_021: Even if the anomaly naturally fades into nullification as people's attention shifts to new trends, without your intervention…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_145: If no one scores perfectly, it continues until the crowd thins out, then the highest score wins.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_105: If people online keep arguing, the Tomato Devil might appear again. But with all this evidence now, Lacrimosa should be much less affected.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_024: If this isn't just a passing phase, I'll look forward to it.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_084: Divergent thinking? I like that. I'll tag along.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC010_009: The client lives on <blue>White Parrot Street</>. I will ask them to wait at home. Appraiser, please head out at once.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_043: …You want to join us, don't you?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_080: Can you not? We're trying to actually practice here! I've got a video to post later, and if we're not better than yesterday…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_102: Since you brought it up, I assume you already have a name in mind?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_120: Nanally asked me about a specific anomaly yesterday… I think I know where they went. I'll go after them.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Tcang01_NPC006_011: The school's club activities include quite a variety of interests, huh.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_143: announcing acts and holding up score cards, all in line with the anomaly's will.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC004_035: Will have a lotta lotta lotta lotta lotta tomato jelly…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_022: Senpai is, well… not exactly the most sensical person.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_084: Senpai is probably still sleeping at this hour, but I'll let her know about tonight later!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_062: If you ever need any help, Lacrimosa, feel free to come to us.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC005_003: Mint has informed me about Lacrimosa's situation. Thank you for your help.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC005_010: Lacrimosa, I've taught you this before.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_008: If it really comes to it, I'll go alone and deal with him later.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03901_005: We have no idea where he could possibly be… We didn't notice any signs either.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_015: No need to be so formal. Anyway, I've still gotta clean up before we close, so I won't walk you out.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03801_011: Kidnapping shouldn't be one of our worries…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_029: The family's descendent who is also the owner of this manor, does not live in Hethereau. The <blue>BAC Intercity Affairs Department</> has been trying to get in touch for the entire day but to no avail.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_089: Correct. If we could show the world that Lacrimosa wants to defeat the Tomato Devil, it would be even better.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_005: Yes. We were to handle something together, but he talked his way out. "Oh I'm sure my trusty lieutenant can handle it alone!" "I'd be a burden there!"…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_051: I'm so sorry, Akane. I may have overestimated her…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_050: Don't forget tomorrow afternoon! Got it? Okay, nighty night, Appraiser!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_132: Oh, what did you say to Maiyue when you spoke to him in sign language?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03801_016: Oh, I don't mean to be rude, but… do you know sign language?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_225: Oh, and Kiyosawa says we're welcome to start performing at the shop regularly—not just as openers.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_225: Oh, and Kiyosawa says we're welcome to start performing at the shop regularly—not just as openers.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_067: By the way, Adler, do you know anything about Meme Anomalies?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_022: Would you happen to know where he might have gone?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC005_011: You should express your gratitude when someone helps you. It's common courtesy.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03601_002: Yeah, I guess he moved here because of his parents' work.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_160: Yeah! You're way too good not to be on stage!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_013: Oh right—let me introduce you to a friend of mine. She's here too!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_032: Yeah, yeah! That's exactly what I was trying to say! That's pretty much how it works! Isn't it totally bizarre? The anomaly even started looking just like senpai!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC04801_010: Oh, there is this one thing I remember about them. There was this one time I made the boy some extra food because his parents were too busy with work to cook for him.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC003_001: When you thank that dog, make this gesture—it shows your most sincere gratitude.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_031: The pollens are suffocating. And it's almost like… our throats are being constrained by something.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_164: I told Nanally about what happened at StarSign over the past two days…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_037: With such youthful energy, my time-cherishing little gremlin, what exactly did you spend that time on?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_042: She's got a full-blown Bagel addiction…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC02102_001: Hey, keep it down. It's guys from the bureau. From ETD, no less!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_047: Leave it to us! Opening act? We've got this in the bag!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_076: Like what Captain Baicang said, I'm looking for this teenager who went missing, and it seems like he's involved in this incident.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_113: He's trying to tell us something with these flowers here. Maybe we can do the same with the flowers in this manor and try to wake him up?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC08201_032: Do it for me, an old fan of LINES! Let our guitar-vocalist make a grand return!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_150: I mean the kind person who bought our ticket earlier! Did they say anything about our performance?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_151: Still, I'll take it! It's the boost we need to start prepping for Night of Moondog!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_009: No backsies now! There's no time to hesitate! The show's about to start—let's go, let's go, let's go!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_040: For public safety, the higher-ups had to put senpai on temporary leave…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_156: You're a genius! Only Nanally could've come up with something like that!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_191: I gave them that whole lecture, but… truth is… I'm the one who should've known better.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_083: These are Rockroses, and their floriography means sensitivity and rejection…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_116: Because work drains me. Unlike you, I don't have an infinite energy meter.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC1029_004: StarSign… I haven't been there in ages… So, you're performing too? Since you're selling tickets.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC09801_004: Several people have already been attacked. If you don't want to get caught, bring some garlic with you. It'll spit you right back out if it tastes garlic.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_027: Might as well stop resisting now… But at least come in the afternoon.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03901_001: We've called everyone already… what are we gonna do…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_157: Too late, I'm already in too deep…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC031A_006: Bunibuni! Ni! (But I get to decorate the house with lots of flowers!)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC031A_002: Bunibuni! (I tend to flowers with Maiyue every day!)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC031A_003: Bunibuni… Bunibuni! (Mom and Dad are going out… I'll watch the house and soak up the sun!)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC031A_001: Buni? Buni! (Oh, are you here to help? Hi! Hello!)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC031A_004: Bubuni. (I'm watching to see if Maiyue comes back.)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_114: Friends who've been quietly goofing off together suddenly step into the limelight—bam! The classic twist!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03302_002: I don't think anyone would purposely give him a hard time… He was a really nice guy.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_100: House rule. Every band that plays here has to sell part of their own tickets. It's tied to your payment.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_069: A deserted manor, huh… Thank you.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_157: Has the job gotten so easy that you've completely forgotten the danger they pose?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_092: The BAC sure has their hands full. Let's do our best too, Taygedo.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_020: There is no way that a BAC personnel would damage public property, right?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC010_016: The bureau's approach is definitely the safer option here.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_197: Just think of it as me investing in the future legends of the music world—The Whoots… I'll skip saying the four exclamation marks out loud. Just feel them.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC09801_006: It even made the news! For days, the <TypingTitle titlename="SNS" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">Bagel</> forums were filled with all sorts of wild theories. You wouldn't believe the stuff people can come up with.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC04801_012: And, boy, was I touched… Argh, this really reminds me of those ungrateful brats of mine back home…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_019: No way! Senpai would never be like that!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_018: Of course I do! Taygedo made me this tiny one once, and the moment I picked it up—bam! Pure melodic bliss!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_025: And right now, the best help might be… in front of you.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_104: You're fired up—good. Let's do this.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_185: Mind helping smooth things over for me?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC07006_001: Quick, take some pictures! See that vending machine?!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_131: Come on, let's order and wrap up soon. We're all exhausted.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_073: So, what's up, Coco? Need my help with something?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC08201_028: Why? Weren't you supposed to meet up somewhere?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_062: How can they do this?! It's those two guys! Too much! They need to be physically contained!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_062: Sooo? Tell me we leveled up today!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03302_001: It just seemed like… you know, he had a very difficult time forming his language and expressing himself…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_223: Some don't even get a score. Just a note that says "Even the dogs were shaking their heads."
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_223: Some don't even get a score. Just a note that says "Even the dogs were shaking their heads."
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_231: No wonder we couldn't tell—it's invisible, like a soul.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_080: Well, to sum it up, if we just destroy these plants, it's going to put Maiyue at risk, too.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC005_006: In any case, I sincerely apologize for the trouble we have caused.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_002: Here you are! I've been trying to call you!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_113: So now you get it, huh? That stage isn't just another gig—it's a real trial by fire.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_085: I mean… at this point, maybe embracing the chaos isn't such a bad idea.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_147: Doesn't seem like it. Past perfect scores have come from wildly different genres.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_069: Probably not as strongly as you do, but these flowers here are indeed spreading the emotions they're meant to represent…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC010_018: Don't worry about it. It's getting late, sweet dreams to you both.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_117: And what you wanted them to know… Was "the thing you've been trying to tell them all along."
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_047: Remember how I was really surprised when I ran into you today? Well, seems like we're looking at more surprises down the road now.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_088: Oh yeah! I remember now! It's shown up a few times, but I never had time to go. This time, since Jiuyuan hasn't assigned me very many jobs… I've got a shot!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03501_002: Oh, the dude that came last semester…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_034: He's not thinking straight. Listen to what he says and it's clear that he doesn't mean to say any of these.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_070: Anger, malice, and unwillingness to have their inner worlds looked into.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_099: Those who truly care will always be patient enough to understand the thoughts of those who can't speak…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_227: Lazy brats. You do realize if you just dump tickets on the same folks, the shop's never gonna get new customers, right?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_227: Lazy brats. You do realize if you just dump tickets on the same folks, the shop's never gonna get new customers, right?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_069: I mean—we'll head out now! Thank you Akane! Byeee! Appraiser, move it! Her aura's turning lethal!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_082: I… I… what I really want is…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC07006_004: I… I… won't tell anyone what I saw. Please let me go!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_021: Hey, I helped out a lot too, you know! Akane, let me show you that move I did—here, like this—!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_108: I know there's something wrong with the pollens… but I don't think they hurt as badly as you make it.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_016: Mind if I pitch in with the gratitude too?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_122: I'll help you. Haniel, Nanally—you go on ahead.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_064: Same here. My heart was in my throat the whole time. Somehow managed to swallow it back down, though. Whew…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_131: I even saw one of the nice folks who bought our tickets waving at me… I'm so touched!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_046: Look, I'm not that dumb. After all that lecture, I knew better than to tackle it head on. So I tried a different approach instead!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_041: That's what I thought! But… the experts at the bureau said that when rumors are spreading hot, the best solution is to, um… what was it? Minimization? Ahh, basically just let things blow over.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_129: I've been in the group chat because Haniel dragged me into it, not the band. Never said I was joining.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_059: Let's go, we'll take Lacrimosa back.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03801_020: We've been looking for him everywhere for the entire day but haven't had any luck… Argh. Any progress there…?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC00607_002: Oh, StarSign? That's the place we were just talking about. Another show tomorrow, huh…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03901_006: We kept calling him but he never picked up…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_071: We'll head to bed then. Good night, Adler.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03801_004: We've looked for him for the entire night and we still couldn't find him. There's no news from the <blue>Security Office</> either, that's when we decided to turn to anomaly hunters…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_009: We're about to head out and take care of it.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_178: We're okay, Akane! Just got a bit of paint on us!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_125: Our "heartbeat" is finally here! Let's kick things off and feel the rhythm!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_065: Our efforts… finally stood in the spotlight!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC02303_002: Right, his parents actually came here earlier, too.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Group_10: We will become the strongest in Hethereau!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_038: We will become the strongest in Hethereau!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_095: We will become the strongest in Hethereau!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_177: Let's try one of the newer ones, okay? Just stop freaking out and listen for once!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_203: Then we must be geniuses! This is peak content for my "The Evolution of a Guitar Prodigy" series!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_034: We figured there was no way you'd actually wake up.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_144: Our fan club! We need to give a name to fans of "The Whoots!!!!"
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC02702_001: Makes me wonder where the boy went…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_066: We ran into a bit of a situation…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_070: I'll do my best! See you all!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_008: I'll look into it as soon as I can, but I do have a few questions that need to be confirmed before I get there.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_126: Of course. Don't worry too much. You know what they're like—they'll bounce back soon enough.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC00508_003: I'm in! Got a ticket? I'll take one!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_029: I'm on vacation, bored, and helping you earns me a free tea. It's not a bad deal.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_108: This is the best I can do for ya…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_035: I wasn't lying! The assignment is at night, so it's technically my time off right now!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_028: Taygedo and I were investigating a Commission here when we ran into her. You called her senpai, so she's your colleague at BAC?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC04801_004: We make a pretty nice neighborhood. People here knows Maiyue.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_044: I have this really nice friend at ETD who spent ages tutoring me… They told me that a part of Meme Anomalies come from… the minds and lies of people…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03801_007: My son is not exactly the most outgoing person… He has never been comfortable around strangers, and he usually only goes home and some places around school that he's familiar with.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC00607_005: I'll skip it, though. Still tired. You go have fun.

ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_035: Knew it… she better show up early today or I'm gonna—yawn—
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_113: I've got it! We save the real show for Night of Moondog—when we rise as Hethereau's best!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC02303_005: Let's see… I remember looking into it this morning. The last time… pink carnations…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_156: Would you happen to know this boy…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_109: I can feel the Nexus… It's around Maiyue… Wait, no… I think it's inside him.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_058: I get it now—selling tickets personally means instant superfans! Aka future Colucci diehards!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_013: I'm going to investigate the places that Maiyue often visits, but you two should rest now. I'll reach out once I have updates.

ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_085: I might have an idea to turn this around…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_007: It's high time for tea. You could join in? Come on? Join in!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_036: Ugh, questions about <blue>Meme Anomalies</> always give me such a headache during exams. Like, how does a post getting shared around just create an anomaly out of nowhere? It's so weird. How can that even happen?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC08201_015: Wasn't me. Maybe Akane put it up—she's always sneaking her favorite bands onto the walls.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_138: I made him set it to replay three times a day! He'd better memorize every second of our dazzling debut!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_118: Let me guess. Is it "I ran into this super interesting person!"? Or "I found this thing I've never seen before!"…?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC08201_029: No relocation plans for my store, Rolling Tiger. It was Akane who insisted I bring the gear out here.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_153: I know you're about to obsess over this, but please, don't fall down that rabbit hole. It's not worth it.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_108: Look, I get it. Your first real audience is nerve-wracking. But at least trust in the work you've put in.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03601_001: I know him, the quiet guy.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_186: I know. That's what I admire about them… if they weren't like that, I wouldn't—
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_090: I get it, though. I totally get how Nanally feels right now!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_194: I gave it some more thought.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_018: Me? Are you sure that's okay?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.TLacrimosa01_Player_003: We could find a working vending machine nearby.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_113: So, why don't you try caring for me? My answers might be right here.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_117: Which brings us to today's meeting—new ticket-selling strategy time!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03801_009: Which is why we're so worried and thinking if something bad happened to him…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_024: As you can see, not exactly the most sensical…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_015: So you're saying that he might have been trapped in there since last night?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_131: I'll do everything I can to make sure it doesn't. You don't have to carry it all alone.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_039: Hence the recent rumors, that Lacrimosa is the Tomato Devil.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_210: Honestly, it feels like I could reach out and touch the moon.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_210: Honestly, it feels like I could reach out and touch the moon.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_019: Excuse me, I'm looking for this boy by the name of Maiyue. He went missing.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_069: Hey there—sorry to interrupt. There's a show tomorrow at a nearby livehouse! It's called StarSign—
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_072: Hey there—sorry to interrupt. There's a show tomorrow at a nearby livehouse! It's called StarSign—
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_116: Exactly! We lay low now and go out with a bang later! So don't breathe a word to the others! Got it!?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_009: She put you to work so quickly… That is SO her.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_156: What do you think anomalies are? Some cuddly little pets?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_092: You want your playing to be that natural. That automatic.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_082: Oh! We can go live on Taygedo's account! Show everyone that senpai is no Tomato Devil!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03901_013: Sorry… but our son actually suffers from voice disorder, which is why you probably need to know sign language to communicate with him.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_130: Sorry… the moment I saw the crowd, my fingers locked up, my brain just—blanked out…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_042: Well, I'm actually looking for a boy who went missing… and as far as we know, he came around a lot.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_012: Sorry about that, Appraiser. You weren't too close to the chaos, right? Even I nearly jumped out of my skin, and I was way at the back.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_064: You're right… I got carried away there.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_082: Sorry, but I can't say anything right now. Too many uncertainties.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC09701_005: I'll tell you. The Tomato Devil isn't an anomaly in the first place.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_021: You'll never make it big if you keep hiding on an empty stage with no audience!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03801_013: Thank you. We're counting on you.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03901_010: His teacher asked the class about it, but no one has a clue either.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_012: We had JTF onto the situation as per the protocols, except the sun was already up by the time they arrived. The plants in the manor were activated and startled from exposure to the sun, distorted and twisted into an anomaly we had never recorded before.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC09601_006: Word is… it's someone from <TypingTitle titlename="Enforcement Tactical Division" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">ETD</> in the BAC.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC010_004: Word is that several <TypingTitle titlename="Tomato Jelly" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">Tomato 100</> vending machines around Bridge Crossings and Illusion Town have been repeatedly damaged by an unknown anomaly. Multiple units are already out of order.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03801_003: <male=>The anomaly hunter is here! Come on… Let's pick ourselves up and tell him what we know.<male><female=>The anomaly hunter is here! Come on… Let's pick ourselves up and tell her what we know.<female>

ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_076: City of Rock? Roaring Tiger of Rock?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_090: Hey, remember you promised to chat over tea with me?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_037: Relax. Skia is more reliable than he seems… despite being dreadfully boring.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_082: Did he give up trying to communicate? It's not necessarily what he meant to do, of course…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_083: But rest assured that we'll bring him home safely.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_205: Don't worry, Akane! That'll never be a problem again—because next time…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_207: New customers… Ah! People saw us on the Night of Moondog, maybe they'll come to the store for us!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_028: No worries. The Bureau's rules are too complicated to remember anyway.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_053: Time is the most precious treasure in the world! Can't waste it on silly things like sleep! A quick power nap and I'm golden!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC07305_002: Fresh or creamy, we got 'em all!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_101: Which means… Akane, you have to join us now!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_121: If Haniel's treating, I won't hold back.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_040: Since you're doing okay, get to your feet on your own and come back with me for the mission report.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_027: Life's tough, more skills help… Want me to join?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_009: Well, I got stuff to do. See you.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC1029_015: It's getting late, I should head back. See you next time.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_127: Time's just about right—let's go, Appraiser! Quietly! We can't let Taygedo spot us!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_070: We can come back tomorrow, right?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_203: Rest up tomorrow and recharge. Kiyosawa and I will be watching from the crowd—so don't screw it up!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_049: Tomorrow. That's enough for today. You've got passion, and that's good—but I've got a business to run.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC1029_008: You've got this! I'll definitely be there tomorrow!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_022: Thank you, Akane. Get some well-earned rest.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_002: Settling in Hethereau but not visiting the Bureau to see me? As a friend, I've been keeping an eye on you.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03403_001: We were still here yesterday talking about how we were going to buy some more exotic flowers…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC02104_003: I finally saved enough for my dream guitar!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_029: Skia senpai already took care of the compensation, and Lacrimosa senpai apologized properly! But for some reason, no one seemed to care about these facts. No one even shared them!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_014: Looking confused but letting valuable info slip by isn't wise.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_025: But I thought we're supposed to be careful with what we say so we don't get attacked again…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_045: But I thought we're supposed to be careful with what we say so we don't get attacked again…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_071: Then just join us already! Imagine how epic we'd be—
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_171: That was scary… I've never seen Akane like that…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_184: Akane couldn't resist jumping in after all!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_057: Akane, hang in there! They're trying to convert you!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_109: Akane's right. Let's just focus on performing our best and not overthink it.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_129: Akane… I might not know exactly what happened…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC02303_006: I think it was eight days ago.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC02701_002: Of course! We take good care of this community garden here.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_093: It's hard to explain. Just… a strange, powerful feeling.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_110: Maybe… she thought we're not treating music seriously…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_084: Sure, but if they stay holed up here forever, that confidence might get dangerously out of hand…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_050: Pretty sure it's from some manga.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_150: It was a response to the emotional charge in their music… It is said that the tower is a witness to their promise to one another.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03403_003: Rumor has it that there was this kind of flower… that's unlike anything we've seen before…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_213: I see… so that's what this is.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_213: I see… so that's what this is.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC02701_004: I guess so. He comes around every week from the florist with something.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC04801_009: Yup. They share a very special bond, the three of them!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC09701_007: Yeah, we've looked into several vandalized vending machines. They all show clear signs of human tampering, just like this one.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC1029_019: Of course. I always said I'd be there.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_029: See! Cheer squads are crucial to a live show's energy!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_002: Because Eibon only accepts anomaly-related commissions?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_078: Words alone can't prove much, huh…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_106: Probably 'cuz you've been thinking about nothing but the Tomato Devil these days.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC08201_019: Just a short set before the crowd fully arrives. If you play like you've been practicing, you'll be fine.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_102: They just showed up way too early today.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_142: Oh, one of the kind ones. Tell them thanks from us too!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_083: It's about the posts online. I need to talk to you.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC010_006: It is what we do. Moreover, if the case is not an anomaly incident we will still be able to provide reassurance to the family in their predicament.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_037: Only because Kiyosawa is such a great teacher!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_075: Yes, have you been there before?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_004: That's right! Senpai is from ETD-4! One of the very best!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC02303_004: Yes, ever since school started after the break. He'd always buy a bunch of flowers from us, but other than that he'd have some groceries with him… maybe some books, too.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_076: Yes—well, we're just doing the warming up the crowds. The shop's letting us try the stage.

ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_059: You mean… playing in front of the audience?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_025: But everything here's just too good! I just came from that fancy hotel bar at the Kapé, and honestly? You're on par with them now…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC1029_002: Are you in trouble? Need help with anything?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_138: He made this in bed in the hospital and asked his parents to give it to us…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_180: Sure, and maybe this time you could. But what if something had gone wrong?! One misstep—just one—and you'd be injured!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC004_031: Good night, Appraiser… Good night, Otter TV…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC010_014: The common approach is to weaken these collective perceptions as much as possible, and let time take care of the rest…

ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC09801_008: This anomaly's been quite the hot topic lately. The high bounty's attracted some people to stake out at night. They've even managed to snap some photos.

ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_162: Want a chance to make up for missing the last one?

ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_136: With you on stage, we'd all feel a lot more at ease.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_010: Thanks, Akane. That's very generous of you.

ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_116: Looks like everyone's already moved on to the next big thing…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_099: I'm actually kind of excited for your first performance.

ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC04901_003: I mean, I wouldn't remember anyone like that since we get people reading books quietly here all the time.

ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_026: We did some research about this manor before coming here.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_114: We're not gonna get any more serious just standing around, let's get some rest.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_089: So the anomaly knows a few words… but we're hardly communicating…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC02318_002: On second thought, I'd better not. She doesn't like noisy environments much. Sorry about that.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_003: The Coluccis… are entering the music scene!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03901_011: CCTV confirms that Maiyue left school alone soon after class… and he hasn't been seen since then…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_028: Intel reveals that this house belonged to the <blue>Serenetti family</> hundreds of years ago.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_001: Welcome to StarSign. Tonight's all-you-can-drink special is 800 Fons. We've also got some limited-edition mixes… Oh—it's you, Haniel.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC07305_001: Welcome to Blizzi! The right amount of sweet in a blitz! Plenty of flavors for you to choose from!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC010_008: Welcome back. I hope the commission wasn't too taxing?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_088: Hey, that's no way to talk to your captain when he almost died from a mission!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03402_006: Umm… No for the most part…? We usually just talk about the club.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_147: Eh? Why does it sound weird? Is it broken?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_040: Eh!? Really?! Then I need more practice! I'll be the official birthday band for everyone!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_002: Oh? If it isn't the Appraiser! Good evening! Out and about without the rest of the gang tonight?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_026: That's why you need me—the Roaring Tiger of Rock, future greatest bassist in all of Hethereau!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_144: Each act is scored. The event ends immediately once the first perfect score is awarded.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_043: Every week, huh… So I guess coming here was like a routine thing for him to do?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_195: It's way bigger than StarSign's! Gotta snap some pics!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_069: Closer to an open audition. But technically, Night of Moondog is a Location Anomaly that pops up irregularly.

ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC010_012: After all, brute force alone means nothing against Meme Anomalies. That's why most anomaly hunters can't come up with an effective way to deal with them.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_035: This could be our shot at instant stardom!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_022: Can we please act normal for five minutes? I'm trying to go home…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_209: Just checking that I can still feel my fingers.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_209: Just checking that I can still feel my fingers.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_056: Don't worry about it. I mean, unless she ends up being even more of a handful than Haniel.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03901_014: No, that's fine… We're already grateful that you're willing to help!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_015: That's fine. I don't know sign language, but I'll try my best to communicate.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC08201_004: No worries, no worries. People who come to StarSign getting curious about the stage or instruments is totally normal.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC08201_009: Totally. Come on, it'll be fun!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_055: Aw c'mon, I can help you clean up again tonight!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_046: That's fine. I sort of know where he is now.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC04801_003: Ah… that's a pity. I have no idea, and I don't know how I can help.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_014: Shocking, right? But when my guitar spirit awakens, all of Hethereau will tremble!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_038: Someone got super mad at senpai after seeing the posts on Bagel. Obsessive, even!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_076: None. Just wait for new posters to appear, tear one down, and show up at the plaza on performance day—wait a second. Don't tell me you're thinking—
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_017: Nooo, not this time! I'm actually playing host tonight! Look—I brought a friend!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_072: Not at all! I just woke up. Actually, I was about to send a message to you too!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_048: It doesn't feel like it's nullified. The anomaly disappeared on its own.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_017: That's no compliment by the way.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC1029_009: No, I was here. But this kid's way too big to fit through the door, so we listened from outside.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_112: If we tell them now, we're just spoiling the reveal that we're in a band!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_146: That means I've got the soul of a bassist burning inside me! Time to meet my new self!
