ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_120: They were so moved, they instantly became a hardcore fan!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_020: Kiyosawa, you spoil her way too much… Seriously, are you two long-lost siblings or something?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_086: Hi, Kiyosawa. Is this a new poster for the shop?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_199: Where'd Kiyosawa stash my water and throat lozenges… Ah, found them.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_075: Over time, it became a city-wide music fest. Some use it to prove their skills, others to break out of obscurity.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_087: The desire to destroy… It was quick to react to that.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_071: On the day of the show, a huge billboard-sized poster shows up in New Herland District—never paying for venue, of course.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC06103_001: A show? Hmm, sounds pretty interesting…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_037: And then these past few days, something terrible happened…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_181: Then no more hunting… no more music… no more chasing the thing you love most with the people you care about…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC57A_002: But perhaps, even brighter than the lone moon—
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_122: Tamamochi Street, Pukaland, and Bluegaze Campground—all prime spots, full of young people! Higher success rate!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC00402_001: It's club activity time, no outsiders allowed.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC010_020: With platforms like Bagel these days, the speed and reach of Meme Anomalies are incomparable to what they used to be.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_124: They're still the same. No need to rush—you've got time to learn a new track.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_124: This place is so green it looks anything but deserted.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_093: Yeah… At this rate, we'll be lucky if people aren't laughing at our awful score.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_027: But then… but then someone found out that senpai is in the ETD, and the comments just kept getting nastier and nastier.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_144: I decided to drop it since I didn't think you'd answer me anyway.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_006: The moment I saw your passion for music, my guitar spirit started burning! I couldn't hold it back any longer!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_014: Looks like Haniel's charm worked on the big boss again. Too bad she's never had to serve customers herself—she'd see how draining it is.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_058: So the rival's making her dramatic debut. Guess that means you'll have to seriously consider backing down, huh?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_144: So you really did complete your little mission.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_122: Looks like you're doing just fine.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_022: Seems like they can just corrode the plants around them…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_126: They have a bunch of plants that seem hard to keep alive and they seem like weeds now.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_215: Watching all those new stars shine, chasing their dream…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_215: Watching all those new stars shine, chasing their dream…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03801_021: You did? Where is he? What happened to him? Is he doing okay? What exactly is…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_085: I'm done with all these flowers and weeds here… Thank God we're leaving.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC00508_002: Ugh, I wanted to go, but I had tutoring that night…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC07007_003: What if? Then we're gonna be famous! Just go!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_160: That's a shame. In that case, let's catch the next one when we're free.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_220: You two still have that much energy? I figured you'd be sulking by now.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_220: You two still have that much energy? I figured you'd be sulking by now.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_128: Can't wait to see our faces on TV!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_034: Wait, seriously?! Thank you, Kiyosawa! Whoa, I'm getting nervous now!!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_030: For real!? Thank you, Kiyosawa! You're officially the second coolest and kindest person I know!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_092: Thought I could sneak that one past you…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03801_015: Thank you! But I think… we're just going to look for him some more… Can't really just go to bed feeling all worried…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_137: But once it's all done, let's grab a big celebratory meal together!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC07007_001: Yeah, yeah, let me get some close-ups of that ETD weirdo too. She'll be our ticket to those sweet views tomorrow.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_003: Debunk the urban legend of the <blue>Tomato Devil</>… Tomato Devil?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_073: Totally. I was bouncing around all night like crazy. Ugh!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_055: Guess you do have a point… Well, thank you anyway.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_127: It suits you both. Sorry you're stuck with it, Appraiser.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC010_007: Good luck, and be careful out there.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_094: It just popped out like that?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_136: First try and we passed! That means next time we're going for a perfect score!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_060: Once I hit my final form, then I'll unhide it. Settled!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_121: Not so fast, Nanally! We've got to split up—it's the most efficient method, straight from delivery work life hacks!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC09801_001: Hey, they look pretty fresh. Let's not give them a hard time.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_036: Fanbase… interviews… contracts… the Coluccis going global!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC08201_017: Good energy, though! I actually recorded your session—let's watch it together and find areas to improve.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC1029_018: So you're stepping onto Night of Moondog again.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_043: This is it—the beginning of our legend!!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_202: And now… just two days until Night of Moondog.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_129: After all that training, day after day after day—today's the day!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC09701_008: …so, to conclude, this commission's a dead end. We will be picking up other jobs. No point in wasting any more time here.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC04801_011: And guess what? He gave me this flower card he'd made himself—just to thank me!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_060: And it just ran away like a coward! That's so cheap!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC08201_021: Don't worry, it's just ten. If you really can't sell them, just return the rest.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_029: Here, Haniel. Have a throat candy. Otherwise, you'll be howling about a sore throat all day tomorrow and I'm not listening to it.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_020: Skia senpai said the Tomato Devil might have been a product of all these nasty rumors about senpai.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_061: Skia, can you stand there and pretend to be a ladder for a second?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_122: Skia, can you take the lead and turn on the lights?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Tcang01_NPC006_026: Skia, is the dope fursuit the only thing you got from your ability? I mean, did it sort of… you know, upgrade your nose?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03301_004: Well, we've been told to be a little more patient with him.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC02702_003: And we didn't see anything out of the ordinary about him…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC09801_009: And from what I've heard, the ETD is full of weirdos… even pardoned criminals. Wouldn't surprise me one bit if they really were behind this.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03401_002: He struggles to form coherent sentences even on text…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_111: What matters is that you pulled through. You found your rhythm, got the crowd going—that's a solid opening performance.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_033: And because everyone's main impression of senpai had been set in stone as "the girl who loves destroying Tomato 100 vending machines"…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC010_004: By the time they reached out to Eibon, they were on the verge of breaking down… We couldn't turn down their commission.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_164: So it's an anomaly… that talks to dogs?!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_038: Having your help would be great… but…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_016: Well, compared to someone who skipped work and dug this all out, I wouldn't say I'm catching on fast at all.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_134: And the thing that made all the plants wither in an instant… was that your ability?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_056: At the very least, it's a more concrete goal than just noodling around.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_046: But at least they're partially similar to your normal plants. They become less active at night, for instance…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_057: Guess it won't take Alphard longer to go through your additional submission than it would take her to approve my pay cut.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Tcang01_NPC006_044: Is it just me or are we seeing more flowers now?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_071: The pollens give you a sting if they land on your skin… Oh, guess you don't feel it with the fursuit?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_091: Don't worry about us. We will be there with Lacrimosa.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC004_034: Mint said… otter TV streaming… Lacrimosa on camera..
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC00107_001: Check check. Mint, urgent! We need you for a containment assignment. You have the coordinates.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_088: Mint, could you get in touch with Lacrimosa? Let's find the devil tonight.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_101: Although there's no sign of proper nullification… the Tomato Devil is clearly weakened and can't maintain its appearance anymore…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_007: I'd very much like to have him back on his duty, but I have to prepare for the assignment myself…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_025: Skia senpai tried to fix things up by bringing Lacrimosa senpai to make a proper apology, but by then, photos of her lifting the vending machine were already making rounds on the internet.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_027: I've always known that this garden exists here, but I don't remember having been told who owns this place.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_195: Street performances really might help you all level up faster, especially with how little live experience you have. I get why you wanted to try it.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_119: Filling out bureau forms is just your specialty too, isn't it?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_059: Maybe we should contact the clients and have them speak to the teacher…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_068: Oh, getting ready to open? Then maybe I can—
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_018: We need to start working on this case as soon as we can.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_106: We've gotta make that happen! That "resonance" must be like—zap boom pow! Right?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_039: If it was an ETD mission, we'd have free access, unfortunately…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_086: I mean, what if Moondog calls out, "First place goes to… what band it is?" That'd be lame!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_091: If we score high—maybe even perfect—on Night of Moondog…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_067: Should we try to share what we already have figured out?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_004: If it's a situation where only I can save the day… I suppose I could sacrifice tonight's concert… If I absolutely must…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_039: If you're here to practice, then get to it. When you're done, go home and rest. No hanging around till closing today!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03401_001: Well, I guess he's just an awfully quiet guy.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03801_024: If you do see him, please bring our words to him…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC57A_001: The chance to reach the moon—only comes once per night.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC07006_003: Alright, fine. Just make sure you save me. We want assault footage, not murder footage, starring me.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_091: Think of it like lifting your arm. Doesn't matter how nervous you are—you can always do that, right?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_098: Yeah, they gave us some kind words. Said they'd keep supporting us, too.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_136: By the way, Akane! I had no idea you were such a killer guitarist! How come you never play around us?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Tcang01_NPC006_028: But, well, I'm not hearing anything weird either.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Tcang01_Player_014: It sounds more like… someone mumbling to themselves.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_092: Someone could even make an anime about us! "Legend of the Genius Girl Band!"
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_028: They were saying all sorts of awful things! Like how she was "abusing her privileges", how the BAC was "covering for her", and how she "never faces consequences for her actions"…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_010: Write this, stamp that, approve those, record these. Rules, rules, rules. Just lovely in the bureau.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_108: Alright then—let's go back and get ready!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC08201_001: That's right. Haniel really hyped the crowd tonight. You got vibes—come by more often! Drinks are on the house. Your friend too.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_079: Come to think of it, those trespassers when Lacrimosa is at work… and those two from yesterday… they were all trying to take pictures too…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_006: And now, he's nowhere to be found.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_014: Ugh, just thinking about it gives me a headache! Hey, I spotted a Blizzi truck at the intersection earlier. How about we grab some while we talk?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_096: Speaking of which, though, how did your clients do after that?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC1029_005: Speaking of which… my first time on stage was there too.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_028: Ehehe, I didn't expect they'd perform the theme from "Gen Z"! I couldn't help it!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_072: Huh?! Nanally? What are you doing here?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC02315_001: Eh, a show? Count me in!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_003: You know Lacrimosa senpai? Why am I not invited?!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_014: Could you tell me what you know about the Tomato Devil?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC1029_001: Um, excuse me. I noticed you've been standing here a while…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC09601_008: Hey, who knows? Maybe the stress got to them and they needed to blow off some steam. Can't rule anything out.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_116: Thanks, oh do remember to keep us updated if you ever come across rumors like that again. See, you really need things like that to spice up your life when you're a grown-up.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC004_053: Thank you… Appraiser… Thank you… Taygedo.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_030: Thanks for the… offer. Maybe next time when I'm free, I'll be glad to know more about your story.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_028: Thanks for the invite. I have a commission to handle though…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03304_019: To the big bro with a soothing voice… Thank you.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_132: Thanks for always looking out for us, Akane.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_082: Thank you, Akane. If you hadn't jumped in, I'm not sure we could've kept it together.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_070: Thank you, Adler. We'll take your advice into consideration and give it another try tomorrow.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03801_006: Thank you! Please, anything that will help.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC010_001: Good day, Appraiser. Taygedo seems quite cheerful—did something good happen?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC00607_001: It was amazing! The vibe, the crowd, the price—totally worth it. I screamed my lungs out!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_099: A supersonic star like you shouldn't be hiding in the shadows! Come shine with us!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_103: When I came to unlock the place, I found a little bird and a kitten already camped out at the door. Quite the sight.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC010_003: I've heard things about this Tomato Devil myself lately.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03403_002: Oh and we talked about this rumor, too…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_076: I thought we were here to save the kid, but it seems like we're not needed here.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_007: It's… definitely got a unique feel here.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_023: No point in defeating yourself to rumors.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03801_012: Anything else you'd like to learn about? Would it help if you went through our place?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC09601_005: Some posts theorized that it deliberately lurked near vending machines, knowing that tomato jelly lovers would show up there sooner or later. And it will, when the moment is right…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_039: We still need to wrap things up here. Are you… still good?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC04801_013: And there was this one time when we were trying to organize an event for people to adopt green space… Oops, you came to look for clues to find the boy, right? Guess I should let you go already!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03601_004: And I think he's part of the Garden Club… and that's pretty much all I know about him since we never talked.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC00607_004: This is wild—we were literally just talking about that show.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_087: Hey, remember that future magazine write-up?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03801_010: Kidnap…? We're just an ordinary family.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_046: The hands that built the Coluccis… might become powerless?!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_116: B-but this one seemed like something we could handle, me and Haniel are—
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC02701_003: He came up with all these nameplates for the plants with their information on them. He doesn't really talk, but he never slacks.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_078: How long is it gonna take for all this to blow over…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_012: Not a big place, but it's pretty popular around here. They bring in some indie favorites from time to time!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_087: That name sounds familiar… I think I saw it trending on Bagel once? Isn't it a concert or something?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_065: Don't think anyone wants it? It's probably just left to rot here because people think this place is too far for redevelopment.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_176: What the heck does this guy like?! We've cycled through every song we know!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_077: Oh, I get it! It's the classic second-episode rival arrival! The destined rival of the guitar prodigy!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC04801_007: Speaking of which, I don't think I've ever seen him start a conversation at all…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_003: What a coincidence—wait, don't tell me there's some super urgent commission in the area? The Appraiser, alone and desperate… just in time for me to make a heroic entrance!?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_038: So that's how it happened… The hate against Lacrimosa spreading across social media… it created an anomaly…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_070: The posters show up out of nowhere. It's less like promo… more like… an omen of the anomaly.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC09801_005: After these stories spread, there were indeed fewer people wandering around in the late nights. But it wasn't long before nearby vending machines started getting destroyed frequently. Tomato jelly splattered everywhere! The first witness even thought they'd stumbled onto a crime scene!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_073: You never know how or what we're gonna run into…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_002: Still manageable. Your sweet talk's as sugary as ever. What, here to mooch drinks again?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_023: There's no place for us to stand here. It's kind of hard to get up there…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_111: These flowers came popping up just now when he was talking…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_152: Hey there, sparkly little anomaly… Do you live here too?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_004: Lies and slander! I—Nanally, the Ichi-daime of the Coluccis—was born with the guitar spirit burning inside me!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Tcang01_NPC006_020: Well… life is gonna be hard for the kid…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_112: Why won't this thing sit still and listen!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_002: Exactly! That's what they call "an unspoken understanding"! I've actually been quietly brewing this plan for a while now. It's time I told you…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Tcang01_NPC006_029: Guess this is your Anomaly Perception at work?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_030: That's the spirit! Where to start?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_010: And this is Taygedo, Eibon's restorer.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_009: These are my friends from Hankaku Street. Coco, Eibon's appraiser.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_061: That's a bass. A lot of people can't pick out its sound, but the bass is the backbone of any band. It's the soul of the music.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_040: I see… but why? This is obviously affecting the operatives' ability to carry out missions effectively, and they are not doing anything about it?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_023: I see. Thank you for sharing that.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Group_02: So if we keep this up…?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_040: So if we keep this up…?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_097: So if we keep this up…?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC09601_002: We're not getting this done anyway. Might as well tell them what we know, right?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_005: That spirit runs deep—like the gut of Kiroumaru! Unfathomable, mysterious… awe-inspiring!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_107: I think this flower is more suitable when you're trying to thank your parents… and teachers.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_036: I've heard similar rumors during our investigation.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_083: Is this that invincible confidence only overzealous teenagers can summon? I'm almost impressed.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_043: It's a little dark here. Watch your steps.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_050: The plants here are overgrown… Probably happened when some kid came in not knowing better… and a new anomaly came into existence.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_106: I've seen this in anime! Bands always end up selling tickets themselves!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03901_012: Hey…! We're already causing so much trouble!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_024: When in doubt, don't be shy, talk to your partners, it's ok.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_109: Then… we'll get going for now…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_022: The missing boy has communication barriers, right?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC02702_002: The boy always puts his heart into it. Day after day.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC02303_003: The boy came here every week but never said a thing. He'd just point at the flowers he wanted, which is why we all remember him.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_033: I—! I'm sorry! I just couldn't hold back my burning desire for the stage!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_065: Well then, Taygedo and I should head back now. Good night.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_214: …You still come to every single one?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_214: …You still come to every single one?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_038: The kid had a lot of plants growing out of him with their roots deep inside him… which is why we found him in such bad shape. Thank God it wasn't life-threatening, though.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_198: Then you better power through it. Until Night of Moondog arrives, we'll be sticking to outdoor sessions. I'll be with you the whole way.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_049: I'll handle the rest! It's been a while since we bought intel from Sterry Express, Taygedo probably has saved up a bit in his stash by now.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_196: I overreacted the other day. Sorry.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_006: Alright, I'll come with you then.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC04801_005: I don't think the boy is unable to speak at all. He's been suffering from language impairment since he was a kid, which is probably why he just avoids talking and the embarassment.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC08201_012: Then it's settled! We're all packed up here anyway. Let's call it a night—see you tomorrow!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_034: The anomaly totally went along with those rumors and started wreaking havoc everywhere! Ugh, this just made everything so much worse!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_037: We'll get out of your hair. Thanks for today, Akane.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC005_009: We'll be taking our leave then.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_103: Huh. Then maybe we should enter late—that way we don't accidentally end it right away by being too good.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_064: Then what song did we play?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_133: Anyway, I'm heading out. See you later, The Whoots.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_060: I call Pukaland! I get backaches just thinking about the campground.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC005_037: I'll stay here, then, in case things get worse.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_025: You can't do that alone! If you want to reach that kind of stage, you need support. A family—or a band!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_041: So, you're trying to take matters into your own hands?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_117: I'm seeing two kids over there… Let's give them a try.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_060: Hey, hey, hey! Don't you think those few branches over there aren't looking so safe to be around?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC08201_020: Alright then, here—these are for you.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_057: Appraiser, strategy change! Total blackout. Not a peep to the shop folks!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_165: Question! What kind of performance earns a perfect score? Does the stage prefer a specific style?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_013: Since you ran into me, let me give you some advice as a senior.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_077: Told you. Gotta wait for the new ones. Don't be so impatient.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC010_024: I can say with certainty that Taygedo and Appraiser helped your new friend. That is, without a doubt, something to be proud of.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_012: Once the Coluccis break into the music world, everyone's getting a pair!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_043: Hey, Appraiser—are you free tomorrow? You should be free, right?! Come back with me!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_055: <male=>The Appraiser asked me last night if he could bring a friend today. That'd be Nanally.<male><female=>The Appraiser asked me last night if she could bring a friend today. That'd be Nanally.<female>
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_008: Wait, no way! Don't tell me this is your first time! Then you have to come with me! My treat!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_112: The Appraiser's right. That stage is a whole different beast. Not only are there more people, but the judges there actually score your performance.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_064: Appraiser… I had no idea your daily life was this exhausting…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC010_001: Appraiser, good day. We have a missing person commission for you. Can you take a look at the details first?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_085: Wrong! Obviously, the priority is coming up with our band name!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Tcang01_NPC006_018: He stopped talking for way too long, and his vocal capabilities suffered as a result.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03301_006: But other than that, we didn't notice anything else about him.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC006_125: The air smells a little nauseating… but as far as the plants go, I'd say whoever picked them does have a good taste.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_012: Hard to believe you've been working all day and still have that much energy…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC001_012: So that's the commission you two took on?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_077: Thank you so much for the support.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_095: Thank you so much for the support.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_070: Thanks so much for the support.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_071: Thanks so much for the support.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_015: Akane, Kiyosawa… Thank you both, I really had a great time tonight.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_086: Performing for an audience isn't the same as practicing. Their reactions will mess with your rhythm if you're not ready.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_135: "Was their legend doomed to end before it began? No! They rose, fighting back against the odds, reaching for the stars!"
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC014_078: Roaring Tiger of Rock! Do you even know how to play guitar?!
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_085: Easy there, Rolling Tiger. Your tail's showing.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC08201_014: Rolling Tiger, huh? That's pretty cute. Nice to meet you—I'm the manager here, Kiyosawa.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_057: The Rolling Tiger of Rock? Gotta say, it suits you. But… where exactly is this "City of Rock" you're talking about?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_013: Please don't drag me into this…
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_009: Don't push your luck. Finish your plates before ordering the whole menu.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_151: First of all, resonance doesn't guarantee a perfect score. Night of Moondog's standards are high. If you're not good enough, that's it.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC011_069: "Their debut opening gig was riddled with stumbles, and the pressure almost swallowed them whole—ROAR!"
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC02303_001: Fragrant flowers, grown with love. Need a blossom to speak for your unspoken feelings?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_NPC03402_001: How did Maiyue go missing, though…?
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_114: Maiyue, your parents sent us here.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_NPC023_098: And Appraiser, as the drummer, you're the heartbeat. Keep them in time.
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_028: (…Wait, all these unread messages? They're all from Haniel?!)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_102: (Guess I will have to find out myself.)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_122: (Meme Anomalies, huh… Even knowing their Nexus, this type is particularly tricky to deal with. Though seeing Taygedo's behavior, I can see why.)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_043: (Instead of dealing with the anomaly head on, protecting the vending machines might just work better…)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_013: (Then again, I kind of get it now. That live atmosphere—it really does pull you in.)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC004A_080: (Leave it to Taygedo! Rank 1 streamer in Hethereau!)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.TLacrimosa01_NPC004A_010: (It changed forms! It escaped! Not fair!)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC004A_072: (Grrr! Delete, block, delete block, delete, block!)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.TLacrimosa01_NPC004A_002: (Waaah, my wallet! Taygedo's wallet is gonna run dry!)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_005: (Haniel's energy is kind of overwhelming… but I guess I wasn't doing anything else…)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_061: (Defending ourselves here might just make things worse… Maybe the experts in the bureau were right about letting things blow over for now.)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.TLacrimosa01_NPC004A_005: (Taygedo the bodyguard! Off to buy some jelly! Taygedo the bodyguard! Protect Lacrimosa!)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.TLacrimosa01_NPC004A_006: (Taygedo the bodyguard! Off to buy some jelly! Taygedo the bodyguard! Protect Lacrimosa!)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_117: (Taygedo seems really down… I wonder if all our efforts were pointless after all…)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC004A_004: (Taygedo knew you would help! Appraiser, nice person!)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_005: (Taygedo seems really excited… Is he running low on pocket money again?)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC004A_010: (Nanally's territory, scares away the Tomato Devil!)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC004A_062: (Lacrimosa's so nice! She didn't even beat Taygedo when Taygedo woke her up!)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_109: (I should look after her for the time being.)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_092: (I didn't expect a fan to ask that…)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_024: (I should probably try my luck at some of the shops he usually goes to. Guess I'll hit the florist first…)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_026: (He did most of the talking back then, can't say we really hit it off…)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC004A_002: (Ta… Taygedo took a bounty commission! Gem commission!)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_148: (Didn't they use to say selling tickets personally was the key to gaining loyal fans…?)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_048: (She might be in for a surprise…)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_105: (Akane's really figured out how to handle these two…)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_116: (She doesn't seem upset… her mood seems normal.)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC004A_070: (Last night, Taygedo went on Bagel. Say good about Lacrimosa…)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_063: (So Haniel was feeling a little self-conscious about it after all…)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_103: (This is the one who came up with "Roaring Tiger of Rock," after all…)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC004A_057: (No one followed us! Taygedo the bodyguard, mission accomplished!)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC004A_102: (Mm, tomato jelly… Now Taygedo wants some too…)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC004A_007: (Watch out! Tomato Devil! Here comes Taygedo and Appraiser!)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC004A_040: (Could Lacrimosa really be the Tomato Devil?)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC004A_024: (Taygedo, trust you! Taygedo, back in action!)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_044: (I get the feeling she's coming no matter what I say… better let Akane know ahead of time.)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_027: (Guess I really did get worn out yesterday… Slept straight through the morning.)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_096: (Looks like they still need some time together…)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_094: (Mint certainly has a unique way of getting the message across. Though I suppose that's exactly what would appeal to Lacrimosa.)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_Player_050: (As expected of Mint's way of thinking. She's still all about taking forceful measures against the anomaly, going head on against it…)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC004A_034: (Oooh, Mint, taking jobs! Take gem away from Taygedo!)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_085: (This flower sure looks like a talk tube… Should I try saying something to it?)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.cang01_Player_064: (This is exactly what their neighbors said…)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Akane01_Player_145: (I give it a week before Nanally loses his admiration completely…)
ST_Dialogue_Legend.Lacrimosa01_NPC004A_114: (Mr. Adler! Look at Bagel! Look at Bagel!)

ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU023_NPC011_014: You're right… watching the original is definitely better. I have all the episodes saved, just can't remember which folder there's in…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_NPC03411_047: No matter what, I'm going to wake up Grandpa Miles and save Grandma's diary today!

ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU041_Player_005: …We'll have to add more milk now…

ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU072_NPC016_015: …to head over to Regalia to get a new motorcycle.

ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU067_NPC08405_005: Ah, seeing the little one make a friend… makes us old folks so happy.

ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU063_NPC_005_014: …Well, I supposed old habits die hard.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_NPC00411_031: Ah… it seems like it. I can't remember anything about walking here.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU009_NPC04416_003: Sigh… Well, if you put it that way… I'll have a slice.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_NPC01011_017: (Sigh) That old man is still the same. I can't do anything to change him.

ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU065_NPC004_018: Oh… reading party, prepared. Appraiser, no need to wait…
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU011_NPC06101_073: Haha… how embarrassing. I was trying to look cool, but ended up making a fool of myself.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU043_NPC011_010: …Oh, it's nothing. Just remembered something from before.
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU063_NPC_06301_006: …Ah! I got carried away talking again… Um… I-I'm sorry for wasting your time! I'll go right away…

ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU090_NPC026_033: …Yeah, next time let's give it a try—no planning, no agenda. Nothing!
ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU075_Player_023: Wait… could this movie outing be…?

ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU018_NPC00411_026: Yes, yes… it's almost time for the appointment.

ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU001_NPC007A_M_79: It doesn't seem as good as I thought.

ST_Dialogue_Liking.SU011_Player_030: …I feel your car was holding me back.

ST_Dialogue_Side.SU017_Player_075: We can wait a little longer if needed.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU006_NPC04002_040: Thank you, we really need you!

ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_105: Remember, pull your rods up as fast as you can! Don't let it drag you in!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU002_NPC03708_02: What are you doing sneaking up behind me late at night?!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU008_NPC09501_015: About a year ago, I paused all commercial work and started trying new things. I wanted to reach that next level.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU005_NPC02101_047: It's probably one of a kind. A unique piece. Makes for quite the memento, don't you think?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU002_Player_44: Sir, Fluffys don't speak human language…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_103503_002: Yo! The great hero's here? Justice always LOSES! Kekekekek!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_103503_003: Yo, great hero, show us how to win next time! See ya!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_103502_005: So, great hero, take a guess… if we hang you up here, how long will it take before your "justice" wins?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_04436_001: Ermahgerd! Is this a filming set for a new Kokoro Rider series?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC03417_169: Tiantian is too short, so that won't work either!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC03417_012: Bad weather, lousy gear, noisy passersby, poor water quality… They haven't caught many fish, but they've got a whole basket of excuses.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC07902_021: Th-that's wonderful… The President's sacrifice… wasn't for nothing…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_NPC06109_007: Crazy world out there! Why do I always have to run into scammers?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_02110_091: That was scary… Thanks for arriving in time to help.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU005_NPC02101_013: Thank you! Kodak was right about you people.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU005_NPC02101_028: That's wonderful, thank you so much.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC06503_025: Thank you so much! Letting that guy roam free, who knows how many more people he'll hurt.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC007A_M_64: Thank you so much. When we get the ad, you'll definitely get a share of the pay, too.
ST_Dialogue_Side.DSU01_004_0003: Insomniac's Dream Battle, giving you 99,999% sleep power!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU008_NPC09501_049: Strange… why didn't it show up?
ST_Dialogue_Side.ST004_Player_001: Strange… A phone booth. Why is it here?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC007A_M_49: Auddy, Ruddy… As the one who led the three of us, I felt obligated to plan for our long-term life, but I always ended up pushing my own agenda and never asked how you felt. You both have my apologies.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC007A_M_16: How did Auddy and Ruddy describe me?

ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC007A_R_94: Auddy likes "Gen Z". I don't care, but I don't want to be disgraced!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC007A_R_122: A pet product manufacturer has its eyes on us now because Auddy has been going around telling the world about us and the Soultractor.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_Player_94: Auddy's just been digging through trash and watching movies.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC007A_R_91: So Auddy hasn't found a new guarantor? Well, glad to know that I'm not the only one without a new guarantor, Woof.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC007A_M_80: Auddy, think long-term. We will have more bones in the future.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC10002_012: She's… a bit strange. She keeps saying things are wrong but she can never tell us what exactly they should look like.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC04003_018: When she reported to us, she claimed a large number of collectible figurines were scammed from her.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC07901_025: She apologized. I knew she didn't want to leave.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_059: Fishing was her favorite hobby when she was little. We'd do it together back when we lived on the shore… and she was always better than me. Quick, patient… and passionate, too.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_062: She's such a sweet, earnest kid. She's been trying so hard to adjust to being an Esper… but she's just not happy.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC1004_023: Did her suffering come from her mother, or from herself? What do you think?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_03746_002: Clarion is truly… waaaahhhh… a selfless hero!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC1004_024: He finally found his way out of the Security Office, only to walk into a prison of his own making.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_NPC06109_006: I manged to escape, ran to Eibon's Anomaly Hunters for help, but when I showed up at their door in the morning, the owner was completely drunk!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC007A_M_81: It's been a long time since we had Budoriya together. Budori has this new unadon now, apparently. Let's go. My treat.

ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC1004_014: Well, guides who talk too much tend to get complaints, so it's better to experience these wonderful stories for yourself.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC1004_007: Alright, enough small talk for now. I can't spend all my time chit-chatting during business hours.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_025: Alright… Then I will… approve the Appraiser's membership of the Hethereau Esper Angling Association!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_Player_033: Looks like there was an accident. The snowman explained what happened. Let me translate.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC007A_R_100: Woof… It seems pretty much useless…

ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_Player_115: It doesn't seem like it's working…

ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_Anomaly043_019: Alright, alight! I mean no harm, just extending a friendly invitation.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_Player_004: Okay… but how does the Snowman cool people down?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU008_NPC09501_081: Alright. I'll sleep for three days and nights and then start this plan!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC1004_017: Alright then, you seem to have many questions.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC05702_018: Alright, let's just say I'm doing a favor for Eibon! You gotta thank me!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_Player_022: I do hope we get to see summer snow. Where do we go first?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU035_NPC03402_006: Fine, since you want to see it so badly… I'll keep looking with you.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_NPC06109_027: Alright, you have persuaded me with your sincere heart! Give me the deposit and I'll hand over the keys.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC008_007: Nice one, Taygedo! Can't win an argument with Nanally so you start playing dumb. You're totally copying that scene from season three where the roadside villain meets the hero, realizes they can't win, and pretends to be an idiot to escape.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_111: Sure! It's been a while since we took a full Association photo… And now that we've got the Appraiser onboard, we need a new one!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU106_Player_003: Sounds goods. I guess I'll just do whatever? Call me if there's anything urgent.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_Player_095: At least that's not too heavy a price.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC054A_077: Study hard, buddy! Hope to see you at the Bureau again soon!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC054A_057: Yeah, yeah, yeah, I'll just take care of your cup then. No need to thank me—seriously, don't bother.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC007A_R_09: Woof! Remember to put me in the center!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC007A_R_11: Woof! Remember to put me in the center!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_Player_010: That was a suspiciously smooth example…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_099: What a keen nose! You actually sniffed out my secret bait formula!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_Player_031: What a unique Esper Ability… Hello, Master.

ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_Anomaly043_024: Alright, alright, Hughes. You're a meticulous one, I'll give you that. You make sure the Collection Hall… and I… are both neatly "managed," but sometimes it just gets a little… dull! Reminds me of my childhood…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC020A_002: Very well! Please submit all documents required for review, placing your personal statement and guarantor qualification certificates here. Before submitting your supporting materials, please check them thoroughly to avoid any errors or omissions.

ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC054A_042: Awesome! So buddy's made up his mind to work in the Logistics Department?

ST_Dialogue_Side.SU005_NPC02101_014: Sure, I'll be glad to help.

ST_Dialogue_Side.SU006_Player_029: Sure, I'll do my best to help.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU003_Player_074: I'll be sure to visit often.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC1004_032: Alright, give "us" some time to prepare. I hope you'll like the next one.

ST_Dialogue_Side.ST007_Player_055: If it were just a vision issue, regular glasses would be more practical than sunglasses, which make them more noticeable. That doesn't seem reasonable.

ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_Player_098: If you ever need help in the future, feel free to reach out to me again.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC04103_005: If this is your first visit, I recommend experiencing our signature anomaly exhibits.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU002_NPC06002_10: If I forget and the trash can catches fire, those Fluffies turn into big lumps and burst out of the trash can, like today.
ST_Dialogue_Side.DSU01_004_0006: With it, it feels like you are blessed by luck every day, and you can do anything you want!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC03417_015: If it turns out to be a dangerous anomaly, I'll find a way to gather evidence myself and report it to the Bureau of Anomaly Control. Let them handle it from there…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU004_Player_032: If they were from the same manufacturer, the sizes should be consistent.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_Player_117: If it were on land, CSU and I could take care of it easily.

ST_Dialogue_Side.SU002_NPC04304_07: If someone sees them while throwing away trash, they'll take them out of the trash can.

ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC03909_050: If I could be by her side again, if I could find something to hold onto…

ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC020A_019: If you'd like to learn more, feel free to check out the tips I've prepared on the magazine rack!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC010_003: If you haven't had breakfast yet, this would be a good time to fill your stomach while you wait.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC07901_026: But if I accepted all of this, wouldn't she be gone for good?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC05702_023: This repeated for several days… I found it suspicious and couldn't help but ask him.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC010_009: If they pass the Bureau of Anomaly Control's assessment, proving they can live independently and are willing to integrate into urban society while respecting and maintaining city order, they can obtain Anomaly Citizenship and enjoy the rights of a citizen.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU003_NPC047A_019: If you are looking for someone, please go directly to BAC.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU008_Player_001: Could the anomaly in the commission really just be doing <blue>graffiti</>?

ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_Player_111: Isn't the pose a bit pretentious? The arm is raised so high, like he's taking a selfie.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC010_025: Nanally and Taygedo are both pure-hearted kids. Sometimes they focus too much on expressing their own viewpoints and neglect to be understanding of each other.

She has many complaints about the sequels. Taygedo, on the other hand, can't stand any criticism of the third season because of his connection with Tako.

ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC010_030: As for Nanally, I'll keep an eye on her too.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU017_NPC07204_002: Their mere existence improves residents' happiness, making them truly beneficial to the spiritual and cultural development of the entire City!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU017_NPC09405_005: They suddenly appear on street corners, handing out delicious french fries to passing pedestrians! Once all the fries are given away, the Fry Beast naturally undergoes nullification and disappears.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU006_NPC03602_003: They are very aggressive, appearing on rainy nights and attacking passersby in the rain.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU002_NPC03708_29: Not only do they take over the lawn, but the air around it is filled with their cotton fibers! I've been sneezing and getting rashes!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_NPC10201_012: Furcat's sake! Don't pluck chopsticks in your mouth! We don't need a Snowman to perform sword swallowing!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_NPC10201_014: Oh meow gawd! You better not lick customers! The Food Safety Bureau will fine us 10,000 Fons if they see that!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_NPC10201_013: It hurts in my meow meow! Ramen is supposed to be served hot and steaming! Don't you add ice to customers' broth!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_NPC06109_017: The anomaly took the form of a plain food truck and only appears in late night, targeting night runners. The food came out of nowhere. I still remember the irresistible aroma—smoky BBQ, sizzling oil, and dripping syrup…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_03821_041: It's out of power. I need to recharge it… then everything will be fine!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC03417_099: It's in the lake as we speak. It could emerge any second! How can you be sure you won't get hurt?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC007A_M_22: It's a fantasy novel, sure—but before we split, I'd never have believed any of that stuff in it could be real.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC007A_R_121: It said its owner raised three dogs. It was raised by a dog! It's one of us!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC011_009: Protecting everyone and continuously inspiring the younger generations with the noble heroic cause! That's the real Mr. Galaxis, that's the true "Rider Spirit"!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_Player_005: A champion of justice, here to protect the peace of Hethereau.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC03417_035: It's over… I can't believe you think I'm recruiting for this group of idiots. Do I really look that dumb? Maybe it's contagious… What's happening…? I suddenly feel like crying…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC07902_029: If it gets too tough, just let go! We've got plenty of new fishing rods anyway!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC1004_026: The solution was pretty simple, but too many people are not good at expressing their feelings. Had Ms. Patty and her mother cleared the air, they wouldn't have needed to wait 25 years.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC00304_001: Hey! Meat? Ham hocks, sausages, ham… all fresh! Best prices from Uncle Prime's Butcher Shop—only at my place!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC007A_M_29: I'll give it some serious thought…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC04903_019: Oh, right… it's the anomaly I bought to help with the decorations.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU005_NPC02101_046: Correct. A record stolen by an anomaly, gifted to an Anomaly Hunter.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_NPC10201_020: I'm sorry… next time… I'll definitely… (sniff)… be more careful…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_02110_066: I'm sorry… I failed… I-I was too late…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_NPC10201_016: I'm s-sorry… I won't be so careless next time!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_NPC10201_018: I'm so sorry! I won't be so careless next time!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU017_NPC02321_010: I'm sorry, but could you please wait just a moment longer!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_NPC10201_002: I'm sorry! That won't happen again!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU008_Player_052: Right… Maybe we can find other clues nearby.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC054A_027: Oh right, oh right! I just remembered something super funny barra.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC007A_R_15: By the way, do you want to see for yourself how a Stardawg is made?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC06503_030: Anyways, looking for a drink? It's on me.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU005_NPC03903_005: Oh right, you did say you're trying to find out where the music went.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC007A_R_85: By the way, are you going to visit Buddy next?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU006_Player_049: By the way, about the <blue>"mastermind"</> who planted Weather Vine in the warehouse and attracted Rainmen…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU008_Player_067: Right, you mentioned seeing the Graffiti Goof's graffiti elsewhere earlier. Can you tell me where?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU017_NPC09405_013: Hey, I just had an idea! Since you can talk to oddities, could you do some market research on behalf of the Frizzle?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_052: Oh, right. Let me cover the investigation fee. And a little extra for your wasted time…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC1004_016: For us light bulbs, having the lights on and off means seeing two different worlds.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC04003_014: Do you have any leads on the perpetrator's identity?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_Player_057: This is the kind of ending someone like him deserves.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_Player_126: This totally has to count as a workplace hazard…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC001_007: Right?! They never mentioned anything like this during CSU training…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_Blank_001: Right, right? The classics are always the best. I've got a whole dozen in my toolbox barra.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC04903_022: Right? I thought so too! It really felt like a lifeline…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU006_NPC03602_012: Oh, right! I heard the BAC has increased patrols due to the recent Rainman incidents.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU006_NPC05401_005: Yeah. This place isn't far from my house, but it's much fresher here.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC00105_002: Let's resolve this quickly, shall we?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC02302_003: Mm-hmm! <blue>"The Windbringer's ocean of flowers is the symbol of miracles"</>—something like that. Many folks really wanna see it for themselves. Some even wish to have their birthdays or weddings there.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC04903_008: Yeah, yeah. The thing is, it's a long story… so, I wanted to make sure if this is the kind of work anomaly hunters would take before wasting anyone's time…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC00303_007: Oh, yeah! Our shop's taking part too!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU017_NPC09405_014: That's right! Think about it—if the Frizzle could hear firsthand how much everyone loves its fries, it wouldn't be so down in the dumps anymore, right?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_103502_024: Yep. Our business ends here. We won't be part of this.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC07901_029: Yes, that's how it should be. It would be just like when I was little—seeing each other every day, staying by each other's side.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU003_Player_031: Yes, I was just passing by and came down out of curiosity…

ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_Player_027: Finding an anomaly invisible to the naked eye isn't going to be easy… but I'll see what I can do.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC08503_012: It's easy to put yourself in someone else's shoes, but truly feeling what they feel… that's much harder, isn't it…?

ST_Dialogue_Side.SU003_NPC047A_154: Dear passenger, welcome aboard the Ghost Train. We wish you a pleasant journey!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC03821_017: Esteemed guests and members of the press…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC05702_004: Esteemed customer, welcome to Good Joe Vintage, the shop with the rarest collections, most complete guarantees, and fairest prices in all of Hethereau!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU002_NPC00403_01: Move it, kid. You're blocking people from getting rid of their trash. Stop bullying this old-timer here will ya…

ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_003: Xiaoman walked out of the examination room, looking exhausted…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC10002_011: Keep your voice down, I'm just venting a little.

ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC02111_009: Y-you know, like fishing. You just sit there, and you don't have to talk to anyone… D-do jobs like that exist?
