ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC054A_052: I was just like you before, bro, wanting some super cool number that was uniquely Barracuda's, y'know?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC02111_024: Back when I first lost my job, I started spacing out by the lake. By coincidence, e-every time I went, I'd see the President fishing nearby.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC03417_025: They were all resistant when I contacted the Bureau before, saying something like… if the authorities get involved, they might seal off Caltrop Lake, and that would affect fishing!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC02304_016: I thought about joining for fun, but my supervisor said it's a waste of time with no cash prize.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU006_Player_025: I will also keep an eye on the Rainman situation.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC007A_M_24: And that's when I became convinced that the Soultractor from the novel actually existed.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC06503_026: I can't just sit here doing nothing either. I need all my customers to remember this despicable guy so they won't fall for his tricks!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC04903_037: I can't just keep sulking like this, I should focus on the competition.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC02304_011: I've bought anomalies from him too. They work surprisingly well.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC022A_010: I'll be taking my leave as well. Thank you for your hospitality, Ms. Fei.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_Player_123: I haven't been with the Association for long either. To be honest, I don't have much field experience.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC10002_013: I've been a contractor for several years. I've never met a more difficult client.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU002_NPC06002_05: I want to give them <blue>cotton fabric</>, too, but I'm too scared…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC03417_129: I'm an idiot, too. I believed him for the longest time… 'Til I noticed his body wasn't what it used to be. He was getting gray hairs, looking more and more like a little old man…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC02111_025: I had nothing else to do, so I'd just watch. Every time his line snapped or he lost a catch, he'd complain that it was because I was watching him… B-but after a while, we got to know each other…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU006_NPC04002_046: Didn't think I'd jinx it that fast…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC03909_012: I know the contractors have been complaining a lot these past few days. Let me give them a raise.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU035_NPC03403_008: I could be just a little happier. Don't you like having pleasant dreams?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC04903_029: I thought so… could it be that I was in such a hurry to release it that it slipped out of the shop?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_039: I asked a few fishing buddies, and they're all saying it's nothin'. We've seen worse on fishing trips. No need to get all worked up over nothing…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU002_NPC06002_27: I'm staying by the trash can tonight. The moment they show up, I'll catch them.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC03417_139: When I was taking a taxi here from school, I didn't even dare to look at my phone… I was so scared the next message would… would be…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU008_Player_026: I never intended to mock you…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC04903_021: I thought he was a customer and was about to tell him we were closed for the day, but he said, "I'm here to help," out of the blue!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU002_Player_67: I thought the box by your feet was the trash you were going to throw away.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU017_NPC09405_011: I swear on my honor as a Clicky staff—Fry Beast's fries are downright delectable!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC050A_011: What about our dear short-stack? Want to tag along and try your hand at the job?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC050A_015: Our dear little lizard, you're not suggesting… that you want big, juicy cockroaches crawling around in our clean and tidy cafeteria, are you?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC03909_035: We'll bake cakes, swing, and listen to stories together. She'll clip this hair pin in my braids and pat my head.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU006_NPC04002_060: When we arrived, the warehouse door was locked from the inside and couldn't be opened from the outside. We didn't see anyone suspicious leaving the warehouse either…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_005: The full name of our association is: Hethereau Esper Angling Association! Every Esper you see before you is an extraordinarily accomplished angler!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_02110_027: Let's work together to keep pushing this "justice versus evil" thing. Think about it. Would you rather work with an ordinary guy like me, or work with Bureau lapdogs sitting in their cozy offices, or anomaly hunters who won't bat an eye at you unless you pay them well?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_095: We are PROFESSIONALS, of course everyone here's an expert! You may be good, but you're still leagues below me!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC06301_07: We might need to reconsider the spokesperson for this ad. You have my apologies.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_Player_008: We don't really understand what they're both standing up for, and rushing in to mediate might backfire. Let's wait and see if a better opportunity presents itself.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC007A_M_56: We usually walk dogs on Hankaku Street. You're welcome to join us.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC02111_027: X-Xiaoman has taken care of us so much. I really hope she can cheer up soon…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_065: We'd really appreciate if you, as a fellow Esper, could have a little chat with her and help her relax. We just can't empathize with those struggles like you can.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_Player_028: So that's where our commissions come from.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_Player_143: We're here for the Stardawg shoot.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_Player_034: We're here to renew our Anomaly Citizen IDs for the new year.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU006_NPC04002_020: After all, we don't want the powerful Espers thinking we're completely useless.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_103504_004: Our views and revenue are already pretty decent…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC054A_017: Our Annual Leave Thief still gives me some face, y'know.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_04436_002: We're all huge Kokoro Rider fans! Could you let us watch you film? We promise we won't tell anyone!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC007A_M_66: We need to put up missing cat posters.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_NPC007A_M_74: We are very particular about the quality of the ads we take. We want to buy a product from the manufacturer and experience it ourselves.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU008_Player_045: I'll find its motive for you, in my own way, instead of making guesses from thin air.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_07603_007: I promise! Kokoro Rider is the best!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU003_Player_076: I'll continue to prepare as much as I can.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC054A_056: I guarantee Ms. Fei's coffee won't let you down, bro.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU017_NPC08702_008: Let me tell you a secret—he absolutely devoured them yesterday! After we shared a bag, he was even licking his fingers like he couldn't get enough!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU035_Player_025: I came here out of curiosity. I don't want to take it or anything, I just want to have a look.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC03417_144: I just contacted the Bureau and told them about my dad getting attacked. They said they're finally expediting the case…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU008_NPC09501_050: The endless inspiration I had while creating… is it just a pile of trash?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_02110_030: I'm not the Kokoro Rider… I'm just an actor.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_NPC06109_020: I realized I was tricked when I bit into a ring mixed into the burger patty… I didn't even want to know where the ring came from. But when I tried to run away, it was too late!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU002_NPC03708_03: I'm just going downstairs to throw out the trash.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_Player_007: I was just curious and came to take a look.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_Player_032: I'm just passing by. I'm not here to commission you any work. I just overheard your contractors talking.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU034_Player_022: I'm just curious why you're in such a rush to sell it all the sudden. You were so proud of it during the race just now.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_Player_065: I love making deliveries, I have no bad intentions.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC02304_026: I tried to explain we don't support returns on opened boxes, but he grabbed my collar and almost hit me…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU003_Player_022: My name is {PlayerName}. Saturday. As for wheels, I don't really know…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU008_NPC09501_010: My name's Ethan, but some friends call me <blue>Wall Lord</>. Call me whatever you like, just don't use that weird nickname.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU008_NPC09501_083: My name's Ethan, but some friends call me Wall Lord. Call me whatever you like. You can also call me the unluckiest guy on White Parrot Street.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU002_Player_08: I can help you deliver it.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_Player_023: I could just buy you all the drinks.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU106_NPC_026_006: I can explain, may… may I?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU106_NPC_026_012: I can try helping you with the applica… Wait, really?!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_123: I'm gonna use my new bait to compete for second place! Tiantian, you better watch out!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU002_NPC00403_02: I don't get it… Mind speaking English?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU005_NPC03903_006: It's just there, down the alley.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU034_NPC02505_030: And I wanna win! I just can't do it—just like I can't fly, get the Headless Rider's autograph, or be the richest person in town. What's impossible is impossible. Life doesn't always go your way.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC1004_009: I'm wondering if this is a good story to share… Only one guest ever gave it positive feedback.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_Player_130: I have some apartments around here.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_Player_131: I also run some shops around here.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC06503_012: I was shocked asked him what he meant. He looked at me and said, "You're Fellie's owner, right? It said you're a great owner and it misses you a lot."
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU006_NPC05401_004: I'm strolling here at night just to catch a breath.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU006_NPC05401_008: My house is next to Brown's Used Electronics. You should check it out!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU002_NPC03708_10: I can't touch Fluffy because I'm allergic to cotton, and that's why I wear a mask.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU008_Player_074: I'm deeply sorry to hear that.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC1004_010: I record all the stories and share them with every visitor to this exhibition.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC06503_004: I just wanted to see Fellie one more time, that's why I got tricked by him…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU005_NPC02101_033: I knew it! Is it some kind of anomaly that specifically steals record players? I'll be reporting it to the BAC right now…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_03745_002: I knew it! The Kokoro Rider really exists!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_Player_094: I'll try to hold it in.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC03909_001: I already said I'm not taking any design projects, no matter how much the pay.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_Player_063: There should be a warning for viewers to take blood pressure meds beforehand.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC03909_052: I should be with her like when I was a kid…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU005_NPC02101_015: The record player in my shop is gone.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_Player_054: I have a lot of driving experience.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC06503_013: I couldn't help but burst into tears on the spot, asking him if he could talk to Fellie, and if there was a way for me to see it again, no matter the cost.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_Player_115: I didn't see the Octowpus… or the bait you mentioned.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC02304_028: I suggested he join the DSD POP Toys Community to exchange styles with others. That way, everyone gets what they want.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC03909_041: I was standing at the doorway, thinking how heartless she was to leave that easily. She even said—
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU002_NPC00403_05: I was praising this young man for waking up at five to exercise. Turns out it's a Fluffy.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU034_NPC02505_009: Of course I considered that! But when I really thought about it… if I just took the car to a used car dealership, I wouldn't have any say in who owns it.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC03417_042: Of course I know your ridiculous rules… This Appraiser here is a true Esper fishing expert!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_07603_003: I was scared, cold, and hungry, and I couldn't get out, but I had my Kokoro Rider sticker with me, so I made a wish—
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC03417_022: I need to head back to the Association to prepare… Meet me at Caltrop Lake tomorrow.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC02304_033: Still shaken, I expressed my concern to that good samaritan about bringing him into the conflict. He just laughed cheerfully, saying he was confident he wouldn't get hurt.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC02304_034: I couldn't help but ask why… He said because he was an "Anomaly Salesman," and he had an anomaly with him… <blue>Lona Misa</>, if I remember correctly.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU002_NPC06002_12: I suspect the trash can outside is an unprecedented anomaly.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_037: How wouldn't I know? Didn't I just tell you about the Anomaly that stole my catch? That's it, right there…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_Player_014: Why am I always the last to know?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU002_NPC03708_04: How is this sneaking? I'm just going downstairs to throw out the trash.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_064: I'm always trying to tell her that there's nothing to stress over… that even if the sky came crashing down, I'd be there to face it with her. I just… I really screwed it up this time.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC03909_026: I think… I'm starting to get ideas about how to design this yard.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC1004_007: I believe our dear Iris has already explained to you that this is a rather impressive anomaly exhibit.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU005_Player_008: I'd like to know more about the commission first.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_Player_051: I'd like to learn about this monster first.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_Player_123: I want to take a group photo with my friends here. Can we get a discount?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU035_NPC05408_013: I want to fully figure out how it works before I look. That way, I can observe it with a clear purpose.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_056: I wanted to ask if you'd have a chat with Xiaoman… as a fellow Esper who's been through so much.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_03821_022: I remember now… that child… I have to save him…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_063: I wanted to encourage her to open up, so I got a few fishing buddies together and started this Esper Angling Association. We call ourselves Espers, try to make her laugh. Give her a community, y'know?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU017_Player_080: I think, even though the fries will be gone, the happiness they brought will stay in everyone's hearts. That's why I hope you'll accept this gift.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_Player_107: I think the ice sculpture is…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC02304_003: Just got it recently and I haven't told anyone yet.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC04903_031: I called the number on the box, and the customer service said delays are normal, and asked me to wait a bit longer… but I just feel something's off.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC008_011: I bet Taygedo will be back to trailing Nanally everywhere like he always does—you know, the kind you can't shake off—before the day after tomorrow. Tomorrow night at the latest.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_Player_052: It was already damaged when I found it.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU017_NPC10302_004: Just as I pressed the shutter, the Danzaburou suddenly pounced, snatched the fries right out of my hand, and vanished. Quick reflexes, smooth movements—it was like he came to the street specifically to score some free fries!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_03821_025: I knew it. I knew this place should have been converted into a Kokoro Rider theme park back then. Ugh, my agent was a bit dim… totally wasted a great opportunity to make money.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC03417_024: I talked to the Association members yesterday about investigating the monster, hoping they'd cooperate… But they were all against it.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU017_NPC10302_003: I ran into the Frizzle around here yesterday and got some of its fries. But wouldn't you know it—the moment I pulled out my phone to take a commemorative photo, I encountered a Danzaburou…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_03821_023: I am… his hero… that's right.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_03821_013: I'm… I'm clearly… a real hero! Why won't you believe me!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC1004_002: I'm Tungsten, as in material used inside light bulbs.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC03417_131: I'm a trained Esper. I've taken all the classes. I know more about Anomalies than anyone else in my family, so isn't it my job to protect him?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU008_Player_006: I'm an Anomaly Hunter from the Eibon Antique Shop.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_Player_140: I'm a member of the Association. No reward needed.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU003_NPC047A_001: I'm Miss Levi, the Ghost Train route manager. How may I help you?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU006_Player_011: I'm an Anomaly Hunter, I should be able to help somewhat.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC001_012: I'm Mint, CSU-2 member under the Bureau of Anomaly Control! Reporting for duty… Wait, no! Here to handle the anomaly case!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_02110_016: I'm an ordinary guy. I'm the Kokoro Rider. I am… Clarion. Please have faith that—
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_02110_043: I am ordinary. I am the Kokoro Rider. I am Clarion. Please have faith that justice always wins.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC04103_002: I'm Iris, a guide in this museum. Would you like me to introduce our collection?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_02110_093: I'm the righteous Kokoro Rider! If they hadn't made me, I wouldn't have done such things!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_03821_036: I am justice, I am the hero, I am the Kokoro Rider…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU029_Player_059: I'm an assistant to a famous film director. Have you seen the movie, "Case in Point: Light and Shadow"?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_03821_038: I'm a hero! You can't treat me like this!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_03821_034: I'm the hero of this city…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU006_Player_030: I don't have time at the moment, sorry.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU003_Player_014: I don't have any questions for now.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC02304_021: I did buy one that wasn't certified, but it worked as advertised! So I told them "No."
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_02110_020: I have… I have money! Lots of it. I can give it all to you, just let me go.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC03417_029: I have an idea, but I'll need your help, Appraiser. Are you willing?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_02110_076: Did I do anything wrong? I'm just an ordinary person! The fault is with those high and mighty Espers. Why didn't they save the child?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC04903_011: I thought to myself, "There couldn't be a shop more beautiful than Hillside Blooms!" So, I signed up! I even bragged to the others, swearing that if Hillside Blooms loses, I'd eat a pot of flowers, whole stems and all!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU035_NPC05408_005: I came to this shop for some peace and quiet.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_082: Then, it hit me. If this thing's an Anomaly octopus that just possesses trucks… then it's got to have preferences similar to a regular octopus!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU005_Player_029: I'm investigating an incident. Did you happen to hear the sound of rock music today?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU005_NPC02101_008: As it happens, I've encountered something strange and I'd like to commission you people to handle it.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC03909_021: My mother was good at baking. She used to make these for me all the time. I only managed to learn the basics from her.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_Player_026: I don't have anything to ask.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_Player_059: I don't have anything else to ask.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC03417_008: I haven't seen it with my own eyes, but I'm worried… What if it's a dangerous Anomaly that might attack the Association…?
ST_Dialogue_Side.ST007_Player_019: I didn't sense any anomaly activity at the flower shop, because the so-called "containment device" purchased by the flower shop staff didn't contain any anomalies, just like in the other victims' cases.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_03821_040: I wasn't forgotten… I just… ran out of power.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_03821_015: I'm not available for interviews at this moment. I'll be holding a press conference at the Aurora Plaza in one hour. I shall answer all questions then.
ST_Dialogue_Side.ST007_Player_025: What clues back up this theory?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_Player_137: I'm not really available right now…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_Player_127: I'm a little busy now. Let's talk in a bit.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC06503_019: I was afraid he wouldn't lend it to me, so I immediately offered to pawn something valuable, letting him choose whatever he wanted! He took a look around the shop and finally picked a few rare models I used to decorate the place.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_Player_112: My client must be another victim of this series of incidents. And I suspect the DSD staff and the 9°C Coffee employees are also involved.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_Player_070: My client has an anomaly product with packaging similar to yours. I think they might've been sold by the same person.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC03417_014: I can't offer much for the Commission… But you won't have to do anything dangerous, honest! I just need you to investigate and identify what the monster really is!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC03417_007: It's a Commission to investigate a monster lurking in Caltrop Lake.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_Player_013: My Esper Ability helps me identify Anomalies.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_Player_126: I'm a pretty good photographer, but I guess I'm going to have a pass on Yummers Bones.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC03909_032: My mother has been gone for twenty-five years.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU005_NPC02101_021: My cat would've let me know.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_Player_046: I am fairly new to Hethereau, yes.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU006_NPC04002_058: My team has searched the nearby blocks. Unfortunately, we haven't found any suspicious individuals yet.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU008_NPC09501_067: I trust you, you're the professional.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU034_NPC02505_007: I can tell you know your stuff, so you should understand, right? With such an affordable price and such a great car, forget about car dealerships. You won't find anything like this at used car lots.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU035_NPC03401_001: I saw it, right there in a basin—ah, no no no, in a mirror!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU008_Player_008: I saw your post on the forum and found my way here with the address.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU008_Player_139: I saw your flyer and found my way here.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU008_NPC09501_043: Let's see… How about 2 AM, Davidia Avenue East? We can meet there.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU002_NPC06002_40: I know it's you again. Don't come back.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC03909_031: I know, because I'm the one who did it.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_NPC02304_038: I bought it right away, and I've been using it till today. You know, it really works. I haven't had any difficult customers for days.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU035_NPC03403_007: I'm sure I'll just be a common person my whole life. But what if I could see myself being extraordinary, even briefly, in some vision…?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC_02110_028: I'm faster and I'm better than all of them. Dude, trust me. People love this stuff.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC03417_128: When I got scolded by my teacher, I'd go home crying to him, and all he'd do was laugh. No matter what, he'd just stand there with that goofy grin, like he was unfazed by any problem in the world.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU031_NPC1004_003: Should I also consider a career change?
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU008_NPC09501_078: I want to create the greatest graffiti ever for you, I want to paint your name and portrait on every wall!!!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU008_Player_124: I need to ensure the employer's safety.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_NPC07901_030: I'm going back to her side.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU008_NPC09501_021: If I obediently stayed at home and let the Graffiti Goof cover my work piece by piece, in less than a month, Wall Lord would fall out of the minds of this city, like an outdated joke…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU007_Player_054: I've seen other people buying Anomalies, and the packaging is just like this.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC01903_114: I think it looks great. You're my daughter, after all. You'd look good in any photo…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU030_Player_060: I think your mother would want to see you grow up well, not trap yourself in guilt.
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU036_NPC03417_090: I remember now… They're highly territorial and aggressive. Could it be… that it's claimed Caltrop Lake as its habitat?!
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU001_Player_17: Let me give it a try…
ST_Dialogue_Side.SU015_NPC008_012: What did I tell you? See? It's not even evening yet.

ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DWQ1002_NPC_08203_021: The sun seen through the sea surface looks different than usual, doesn't it? Looking up at the sky through all that deep blue, it's like being in a legendary underwater kingdom…
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DWQ1003_NPC_02109_030: To let more people feel Hethereau's heartbeat through photography, that's my goal!
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW1014_NPC07502_002: Um… could you buy me a pack of Cool-lala Spicy Snacks?
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW1066_NPC_010_WF_001_Player_004: And the customer actually agreed to that?
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW_1077_CNPC_063003_009: That idiot… what exactly keeps happening to make him miss our dates…?
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW_0041_NPC_03312_0025: So in which of the following situations can Cheese help the user?
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW_0041_NPC_03312_006: Now for the next lesson: Cheese in the stands! What abilities do you really have?
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW_1077_CNPC_103005_0021: …Mio, would you still like to go to the Hethereau Skytower with me?
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW_0041_NPC_03312_0016: So then, what is Cheese's special ability?
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW3304_CNPC_097002_006: I won't take up any more of your time then…
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW1005_CNPC_005005_014: Thank you. I… I just got some unexpected "gifts" from our feathered friends up above, you see…
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW1010_Player_011: Then congratulations, and thanks for this.
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW_0061_NPC_03416_0017: Then I'll leave it to you.
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW_0060_Anomaly_060_0023: Then please accept this gift. It's my treasured sunglasses, and I hope they can witness our friendship.
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DWQ1001_NPC_01001_003: Of course! Film Orbit Studio isn't just famous in Bridge Crossings, we're among the top-rated in all of Hethereau!
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.SDW_CNPC_010002_003: You'll have to wait until I'm done here—this car is absolutely filthy! Can you believe it? The dealership doesn't even have a car wash service, so I have to wash it myself!
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW1010_Player_012: I'll take it then, thank you.
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW_0058_Anomaly_058_Player_0013: I'll find my way on my own then.
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW1010_Player_006: That's quite a catch you've got there.
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW1066_CNPC_070012_027: I've already eaten them all. Otherwise, I couldn't have made the judgment that they all taste good.
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW3301_CNPC_097002_005: I'm happy to compensate you! Though I don't know if such a skilled Anomaly Hunter like yourself would be willing to accept such a small request…
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW1014_NPC07502_008: Cool-lala Spicy Snack! Cool-lala Spicy Snack!
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW1010_CNPC_081005_008: Got some salmon! And look—more than one of them!
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DWQ1002_NPC_08203_018: What could be on the other side of the tracks?
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW3701_CNPC_021002_009: Don't regret it later if you miss this opportunity!
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW_0061_NPC_03416_0023: Every so often, the music teacher collects the children's footsteps and arranges them into new school songs.
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.SDW_CNPC_010002_012: No wonder that parking lot's been so quiet lately. They must have plenty of empty spots now—could be handy if you ever need parking there, I suppose.
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DWQ1001_NPC_01001_012: You've shot enough still life, let's try some portrait photography! Those people promoting shops on Hankaku Street are more than happy to be in front of the camera, so go take their picture.
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW_0061_NPC_03416_0015: Thank you so much. I'll remember this too! A whole month of meal cards!
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW1006_CNPC_004007_005: Thank you so much! Please accept this small token of my gratitude.
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW3306_CNPC_097002_001: Thank you so much! Please accept this reward as my thanks!
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW_0061_NPC_03416_0022: There are pressure sensors beneath the music classroom's steps that play a musical note with every footstep.
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW1038_CNPC_078002_Player_005: The name Missile really suits him!
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW1003_CNPC_070003_001: Thanks. Just take a photo of me with Deka Inori.
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW_0059_NPC_03413_008: Could you please tell The Guide that I've found the place?
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW3302_CNPC_097002_003: Please, I'm begging you! Just take a close-up shot of that kite in the tree ahead!
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW3502_CNPC_076003_002: The dark sky and the lingering light… it's so impressive… truly beautiful…
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DWQ1002_NPC_08203_Player_008: (The <blue>stairs</> and <blue>phone booth</>, plus all that <blue>wild grass growing everywhere</>… this must be near the <blue>basketball court at the end of Baihui Alley</>…)
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW1066_CNPC_070012_Player_048: (I better not ask any more questions… I feel like I might hear about some truly horrifying eating habits…)
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW1013_Player_004: (I don't see how that's progress at all…!)
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW1066_CNPC_070012_Player_058: (He's already tried Puka candy, and he's not exactly an Ellie fan either.)
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DWQ1003_NPC_02109_002: (I take the photo. It shows two street musicians performing and the audience cheering around them)
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW_1077_CNPC_103005_Player_0016: (So everything Mio said before was just said in anger, huh.)
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW1066_CNPC_070012_Player_005: (So he's just a tourist with delusions of grandeur, huh.)
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW1066_CNPC_070012_Player_009: (Strange guy, but he doesn't seem like a bad person.)
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW1066_CNPC_070012_Player_061: (I'm actually worried he might buy one of everything in the store…)
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW1066_CNPC_070012_Player_062: (Wait, buy everything? If he's really like that, maybe I should recommend…)
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW_0059_NPC_08404_Player_003: (Near Green Wall Slope… moving record player sounds… I wonder if I could still find it?)
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW1066_CNPC_070012_Player_001: (There's something strange rustling in the bushes. I should go check it out.)
ST_Dialogue_WorldHide_Chat.DW1066_CNPC_070012_Player_059: (Maybe I should think of something else…)

ST_Dialogue_WorldRandomCriminal_Chat.DWC_SH_NPC_Sub_Common_010: They must be! When I see them again next time… No, actually, I hope there won't be a next time! …Anyway, we're back to normal operation. Would you like to take a look around?
ST_Dialogue_WorldRandomCriminal_Chat.DWC_SH_NPC_Sub_Common_006: They come by so constantly, there's nothing I can really do… I should just focus on the business at hand. Would you like to take a look at our products?
ST_Dialogue_WorldRandomCriminal_Chat.DWC_SH_NPC_Sub_Common_009: I don't know who drove them away… They're truly my lifesaver…
ST_Dialogue_WorldRandomCriminal_Chat.DWC_SH_Player_008: You were really brave back there.
ST_Dialogue_WorldRandomCriminal_Chat.DWC_SH_NPC_Sub_Common_005: The cost of protection is just so high… I couldn't afford it even if I wanted to.
ST_Dialogue_WorldRandomCriminal_Chat.CityEvent_Crime_VT_Failed_Des: Vehicles aren't allowed in the area ahead. The sense of urgency towards city violations still seems nonexistent.
ST_Dialogue_WorldRandomCriminal_Chat.DWC_SH_NPC_Sub_Common_007: I was so scared, I was so scared, I was so scared…
ST_Dialogue_WorldRandomCriminal_Chat.DWC_SH_Player_003: Uh… Excuse me, are you open?
ST_Dialogue_WorldRandomCriminal_Chat.DWC_SH_CNPC_049008_001: Phew, I'm saved. My legs were actually shaking the whole time, but I kept thinking about what it says in "Ring of Secrets": "The hero of a story isn't the strongest one, but the one who perseveres the longest and travels the farthest." Perseverance is always meaningful…
ST_Dialogue_WorldRandomCriminal_Chat.DWC_SH_CNPC_037014_002: Goodness me! I need to go make an offering to Nacupeda, and pray for some peace and safety for my shop!
ST_Dialogue_WorldRandomCriminal_Chat.DWC_SH_CNPC_023005_002: Oh, right! Thanks for the help! Tell you what, take a look at these clothes and see if there's anything you like. I'll give you 20% off!
ST_Dialogue_WorldRandomCriminal_Chat.DWC_SH_NPC_Sub_Common_008: Oh, sorry! We're open for business! What can I help you with?!
ST_Dialogue_WorldRandomCriminal_Chat.DWC_SH_NPC_Sub_Common_004: That's wonderful… Well then, what can I help you with today?
ST_Dialogue_WorldRandomCriminal_Chat.DWC_SH_CNPC_049008_003: Oh, right! A thank-you gift! I don't really have anything to give, so let me recommend a couple of books! One is a fantasy novel called "Ring of Secrets." It's pretty long, but the story is absolutely perfect! And the other one is… Oh, I suddenly can't remember… Hold on, let me think!
ST_Dialogue_WorldRandomCriminal_Chat.DWC_SH_NPC_07318_002: Oh, right. Chasing them off must've been pretty tiring… Would you like some ice cream?
ST_Dialogue_WorldRandomCriminal_Chat.CityEvent_Crime_VT_Des02: Vehicle acquired. Drive it to the designated location.
ST_Dialogue_WorldRandomCriminal_Chat.DWC_SH_NPC_07318_001: Thank goodness you were here… Are the kids okay?
ST_Dialogue_WorldRandomCriminal_Chat.DWC_SH_CNPC_023005_001: I'm fine! As long as the goods are safe, I'm safe!
ST_Dialogue_WorldRandomCriminal_Chat.DWC_SH_CNPC_051003_001: Yeah. This place is out of the way, so the Security Office doesn't really come around. But those punks? They show up every few days, regular as clockwork. Like it's their job or something.
ST_Dialogue_WorldRandomCriminal_Chat.DWC_SH_Player_009: It's okay, I'm fine. Thank you though…
ST_Dialogue_WorldRandomCriminal_Chat.DWC_SH_Player_006: Have you ever thought about applying to set up shop somewhere else?
ST_Dialogue_WorldRandomCriminal_Chat.DWC_SH_CNPC_051003_002: File a request? I've lost count of how many times I've contacted headquarters. Every time they say they'll handle it, but nothing ever comes of it. Honestly, I've pretty much given up hope.
ST_Dialogue_WorldRandomCriminal_Chat.DWC_SH_CNPC_051003_003: Anyway, enough about all that frustrating stuff. You must've worked up quite an appetite just now, right? Come on, take a look! What would you like to eat?
ST_Dialogue_WorldRandomCriminal_Chat.DWC_SH_CNPC_049008_002: Thank you. When you drove them off, you were just like the hero of a story… That's so cool.
ST_Dialogue_WorldRandomCriminal_Chat.DWC_SH_NPC_Sub_Common_002: Now that we can operate normally again… What can I get for you?
ST_Dialogue_WorldRandomCriminal_Chat.DWC_SH_Player_005: Do these punks come here often?

ST_File.F_NPC011_015:
At age 8, during the "Puka Crispy Stick Snatching Incident," Nanally defeated a greedy kid and helped him quit sweets. He later lost weight and became the school heartthrob.
At age 9, during the "Torchwood Basketball Court Invasion Incident," she drove off three middle school bullies and opened a hole in a third-floor window with a basketball to improve ventilation.
At age 10, during the "Helping Granny Cross the Street Incident," she achieved the impressive record of only taking 5 seconds from one side of the street to the other. Granny's legs even recovered instantly, and she walked away briskly. What a miracle!
ST_File.NPC006_about_007: ETD is just a bunch of enigmatics doing whatever they want. They look good on the news, but working with them is nothing but headaches. Everyone showing off their special talents when they're together… it's more like a circus than a workplace. Though, I'll admit it is pretty entertaining… "You're part of it"? Ahaha, why, thank you!
ST_File.NPC004_about_008: ETD… busy. Doggo… meetings. Baicang… chaos. Fadia… "making friends". Lacrimosa… sleeping…
ST_File.F_NPC009_016:
"The most precious things are those that are breaking," isn't that right?
"Then why not be as greedy as possible? Go and gather more precious treasures into your embrace."
"Just like in that numbing bitter cold… I will reclaim the warmth of my own blood."
This is what she thought.
At the same time, she would think this countless times in the days to come. Inevitably.
She put away her pocket watch, stood up, and moved forward with joy.
ST_File.NPC001_Chitchat_019: Wait, that's not a good idea! If she finds out I put double sugar in my coffee, she'll put me on her black coffee list!
ST_File.NPC015_about_004: Illica… his problem isn't causing trouble but insisting on being smarter than everyone else. Especially when there's someone his age around, his little brain starts sparking. He's genuinely clever, but unfortunately uses it all for making trouble.
ST_File.NPC005_Chitchat_001: Did you… say something inappropriate to that customer? Business reputation is hard to maintain. If this impacts our ratings…
ST_File.NPC008_Chitchat_003: …Just don't turn this into some "famous shop" that rivals Eibon.
ST_File.NPC004_meet_001: Hello… Mmhm… Ah. Lacrimosa, not asleep. Not asleep…
ST_File.NPC010_self_004: Perfect, huh? You're far too kind. I simply have a few more years behind me, having seen a bit more of the world. When I was their age, I dreamed of being as bright as they are now.
ST_File.NPC009_Chitchat_015: You… didn't need to say that last part.
ST_File.NPC010_gift_002: I was just reminded of some things in the past… I like the gift a lot. Thanks.
ST_File.NPC016_Chit-chat_003: Umm… maybe your way of greeting is actually effective.
ST_File.NPC005_Chitchat_006: Hmmh… good idea. Go ahead, just put the tomato juice on my tab.
ST_File.NPC004_choose_001: …Mm, going out already? Want to… sleep five more minutes…
ST_File.NPC001_dead_003: Sorry… I held everyone back again…
ST_File.NPC026_self_002: E-Esper abilities… They're… r-really handy. Super con-convenient, ex-extremely useful. I-I'm an Esper, so… so thanks to… to these powers, I was able to move to Hethereau. I was also able to fi-find work easily, because of my abilities. Being an Esper here is… is really great. I like it here.
ST_File.NPC005_selftalk_003: It is my pleasure to serve you… please enjoy. If you have any feedback about our food, feel free to share with me anytime. Your needs and approval guide us in improving our service.
ST_File.NPC004_Chitchat_001: …Baicang, still have work, can't slack off.
ST_File.NPC003_Baicang_Chitchat_002: I made you some coffee… I hope it'll keep your mouth busy.
ST_File.NPC001_dead_001: If only I was… a little faster…
ST_File.NPC011_chat_003: Family Management… huh… Prologue… first of all… Ugh!!!
ST_File.NPC005_talk_002: Agent.LUCK handles all the paperwork nobody else at the Bureau wants to do. Tedious and endless as it may be. It persists in the belief that its master will return home once everything is complete… Watching it work diligently reminds me of that staff member who vanished into the lights and remains missing to this day, and of all the unresolved cases we still haven't found a way to tackle…
ST_File.F_NPC009_012:
"'All-you-can-drink' means you pay a fixed price based on the number of people in your group, and until you leave and settle the bill, you can take unlimited beverages from the drink area… that's what their menu says."
"Including alcohol? That's pretty generous! Everyone should really enjoy themselves today, and you kids better go grab the most expensive juice they have!"
"…Restaurants definitely lose money when they run into shameless customers like Hotori who can really hold their liquor, right?"
Of course, this business model has countermeasures for dealing with customers who go overboard: besides the inventory limits for each type of beverage, there's also the time restriction… but when it comes to Hotori, that just happens to not be a problem.
However, based on what happened later, when Hotori kept ordering table after table of appetizers to maximize the value of the all-you-can-drink deal… This rare dining-out experience still ended up with expenses far exceeding the budget.
ST_File.F_NPC011_014:
"Don't worry about my attitude, I'm tough as nails (snorts)." - Nanally
"Fist to flesh, thunder and lightning! This is the romance of gang life (throws punch)!" - Nanally
"Walking this path… it means constant encounters and farewells… I understand that (sighs)…" - Nanally
ST_File.F_NPC010_012:
"Mr. Adler, are you cleaning the storage room again?"
"Yes."
As the young man holding cleaning supplies stepped aside, the neatly dressed maid quietly thanked him, kindly reminding him to watch his steps, then hurried off. This estate housed too many people like him, so even this small act of kindness felt precious. The blind young man stood quietly at the storage room entrance until the maid's footsteps faded, then entered the room, feeling his way around while wiping dust with a soft cloth. The other servants disliked cleaning here since it was such tedious work, but Adler didn't mind. Cleaning was actually quite easy work for him—no need to talk to anyone, and the quiet environment made him feel especially relaxed. Though his blindness meant he often needed more time, fortunately this storage room didn't contain anything too fragile, so he just needed to be careful. Adler treasured this hard-won job.
The artifacts silently watched the busy young man. He didn't favor any particular piece, cleaning each one thoroughly, but whenever he wiped down that suit of armor hanging high above, he would always clean it with extra care. Adler had heard stories about this armor. It was called "Enlightenment,"and people told tales of the armor, with its great power and invincible previous owners. Those stories burned in his thin chest. Perhaps he too might someday… Whenever he thought this, Adler would calmly polish each scale even cleaner.
The peaceful days continued until one snowy night, when the long-silent armor began glowing softly. Deer-like creatures called "Sunyas" emerged from Enlightenment, treading on falling snowflakes as they gathered around the sleeping young man.
"New… master?"
"I like him!"
"Familiar scent."
"…Mhm."
"In this old one's opinion…"
Their chatter didn't wake the sleeping person; they wanted to let his dream last a little longer—they would tell the young man about the good news when the snow cleared and the sun shone bright the next day.
ST_File.NPC004_chat_003: Duke K is strong… Duke K also breaks things and gets scolded by others… just like Lacrimosa.
ST_File.F_NPC005_013:
"It's like being a frog slowly boiled alive…"
While drinking, the man on his left complained to the bartender about his predicament. The man was troubled, trapped in a state where every fiber of his being couldn't relax due to workplace pressure. If he wanted to escape, he'd inevitably face brutal consequences. The man was deeply conflicted about this.
"Next time I see you here, I hope you won't be sipping your drink with such restraint… You can only break free if you break down completely for once. You don't cure alcohol by drinking a cure. You simply throw up."
The man sitting on his right, with a menacing aura and face of scars, responded across the space. His deliberate, unhurried way of speaking, which contrasted sharply with his appearance, caught Skia's attention.
Becoming friends with that person marked the beginning of Skia realizing that he had the ability to build a routine wherever he was.
If on that chaotic and dangerous path, there were rules, order, and clear objectives, then perhaps…
ST_File.F_NPC008_013:
"Hehe, Edgar, what exactly did Sakiri say after she ate that Honest Popping Candy last time? Taygedo said I missed quite a show!"
"Um… Sakiri told me not to say…"
"Oh come on, it's fine, Sakiri's not…"
"Dummy! What are you whispering about with Nanally?! Time to get to work, Kiroumaru!"
"No no no no no no! I don't know anything yet!"
ST_File.NPC006_about_008: Squad 4's Captain is being isolated by his team members…? Who said that? That's not true! ST_File.F_NPC026_012:
"The outside world is dangerous." Chiz learned this when she was very young, back when food at home wouldn't just appear on the table. Sometimes, her older siblings would go out and never come back. And then Chiz reached the same age. It was her turn to go outside.
The number of wounds on her body grew faster than her height. The first wound was on her left arm, left by a branch that caught at her while she tried to flee an Anomaly. The second was on her right foot; she stepped in a trap while bumbling down the wrong path through the woods. The third was on her left thigh, where an Apocha bit her before becoming their family's dinner… Some wounds healed and disappeared. Others became scars. The last wound her homeland gave her was on her neck: a scar that remained deep even after healing. In the end, just like her siblings, Chiz went out and never came back.
Chiz boarded a ship headed who knows where; their routes were never fixed, after all. Chiz was unlucky: She became an Esper. But she was lucky enough to find a ship leaving the very next day. All of her mother's love became a thin stack of money pressed into the kind captain's hands. Leave, leave. Staying here will only bring more pain. Chiz began living on the ship with others from her homeland. Some were Espers like her. Others were ordinary people who could no longer bear the strain of staying. But they never really connected, even in such close proximity. One day, two days, three days… One month, two months… Then she lost count. People got on. People got off. The kind captain brought her to a clean, safe city. Chiz was almost landsick.
Chiz arrived at her new home. Here, there were lovely clothes, a warm bed. Delicious food appeared, almost magically, on the table. She sat quietly in a corner, eavesdropping, and learned this was the Dvořák family's orphanage. Chiz loved Dvořák. She loved the orphanage. She made new friends here, and every day they wore the same clothes and ate the same food.
"Why don't you wash your hands?" a friend asked Chiz one evening after dinner. "You should stay clean. You'll trouble the caretakers."
Chiz hid her sauce-stained hands behind her back in alarm. She finally realized that even wearing the same clothes and eating the same food, they were still different. She was a little mouse that had drifted for so long before being being washed ashore here. "Mice are the dirtiest of all!" said the picture books. Of course, her friend was kind. She led Chiz to the bathroom and helped wash the sauce off her hands. Chiz was very grateful.
"You have to wash your hands. If you don't, people won't like you."
Chiz was smart. She remembered this. From then on, she washed her hands spotlessly clean every day. Three rounds of soap. No slacking. Clean between the fingers and under the nails. Wash before bed, wash after waking up, wash before meals, wash after meals, wash before playing with toys, wash after playing with toys… As time went on, just like those old wounds, Chiz's hands became wrapped in bandages. The caretakers cautioned her that she couldn't wash her hands so often. Her friends were worried too, gently blowing on her hands and asking if it hurt. Chiz smiled at all of them. "It doesn't hurt," she promised, saying she'll remember.
Much more time passed. Even after all the wounds on her hands had healed, Chiz still kept the habit of wearing bandages.

A gold-edged rose, petal tips singed with scorch marks. It came from a murmured ritual, its giver claiming to be a devotee, though the flames spiraled out of control the moment the prayer was spoken.

ST_File.F_NPC1029_013:
Aurelia became friends with Akane and Suzuha on a springtime school trip. She was totally entranced by the jellyfish at the aquarium and, before she knew it, drifted away from the rest of her class's group. Just when she began to panic because she couldn't find a familiar face in the crowd, Akane and Suzuha spotted her. Each of them took one of her hands and led her back to the class rendezvous point, then sat on either side of her on the bus ride home.
From that embarrassing moment onwards, Akane and Suzuha became Aurelia's best friends. 

On the birthday that followed, Aurelia's living room wasn't empty anymore. In front of the incredible gift pile, two girls who'd never seen anything like it merely stared, wide-eyed. "What are you two doing, hiding over there?" The moment they heard Aurelia's voice, Akane immediately tried to shove the tiny present in her hands behind her back. But Aurelia, sharp-eyed as ever, caught her in the act.
"Is that for me? It has to be for me, right?!" Aurelia darted over, making an effort to grab the little box.
"You already have so many presents! T-this one really isn't anything special…"
"That doesn't matter!" Aurelia shouted, full of indignation. She finally managed to get a hold of the gift, hugging it to her chest. "This is my first-ever birthday present from a friend. It's mine, no takebacks!"
"Really… it's nothing…" Akane's voice grew quiet. 
Before she could finish, Aurelia had already ripped the wrapping paper to shreds. Out of the palm-sized box rolled out a few shiny little pins: souvenirs from that same aquarium where they'd first met. The tiny jellyfish mascot wore a cutesy, pitiful expression that, funnily enough, looked like Aurelia when she couldn't stop crying that day. 
Aurelia stared, unblinking, at the pins that had rolled onto the table. Beside her, Akane was so embarrassed she couldn't bear to stay a second longer. She grabbed Suzuha's hand and began to make a move for the door—but before they could even take a step, Aurelia barreled into both of them and wrapped them in a tight hug. The little crybaby was sobbing like the mascot on that pin again. "T-this is perfect… the best thing in the entire world!" She could barely get the words out between her tears.

Even though her parents still couldn't be there for that birthday in particular, Aurelia no longer felt lonely. Suzuha lit the cake candles for her, and Akane set a party hat on her head. The birthday song they sang for her became the most beautiful melody Aurelia had ever heard.
When she blew out the candles, she prayed with all her might that she'd be with these friends of hers forever.

Unlike the typical anime-watcher, Hathor wasn't a fantasy-type viewer who would arrange figurines and acrylic stands in magic circle formations, press "summon" on the latest Cubox Technologies tablet, then chant incantations to bless the spirit of binge-watching 24 episodes straight (none of which Haniel did).

She never skipped episodes or watched in double speed, and she categorized and filed the personal styles of the main creative team's directors, scriptwriters, and animation staff.

ST_File.F_NPC015_014:
It took Jiuyuan a lot of effort to retrieve Hathor after she was taken by the Bureau for losing control of her Esper Abilities. The loss of control itself wasn't the issue. What mattered was how Hathor handled the aftermath, and this was the first lesson Jiuyuan, as Hathor's mentor, needed to teach.
From that day on, Hathor doubled her training regimen on her own. Her movements grew faster and her decisions sharper as she shed off exhaustion for stability. Her expression remained calm, but her rhythm had become erratic. Jiuyuan knew this state all too well: the more one rushes to control one's powers, the easier it becomes for the powers to control them. She didn't stop Hathor’s training, nor did she warn her about overdoing it. Some students tend to mistake reminders for warnings or interpret concern as mentors thinking they aren’t trying hard enough. Rather than have Hathor quietly use such warnings as a new benchmark to push even harder, Jiuyuan thought it was better to let her train where she could watch. By keeping an eye on things, nothing would go wrong.
But the nature of Sterry's work meant Jiuyuan couldn't have Hathor's back forever. How could she pave the way before letting go? What she hadn't expected was that the solution would find its way to her. Haniel, who had stumbled onto the scene when Hathor lost control, unexpectedly had the ability to calm her. And as luck would have it, the girl was also interested in courier work…
Things just fell into place.

Hathor's execution and combat abilities were impeccable, but interacting with others left her at a loss. When the two little owlets first arrived, Hathor faced them like someone flipping through a book with no instructions: cautious, yet clueless about where to begin. The awkwardness in the shop didn't elude Jiuyuan. In a rare move, she gave Hathor a special commission: make an effort to understand today's youth and assimilate.
Imagining the ever-methodical Hathor carrying out this commission, Jiuyuan, who was usually so adept at controlling her emotions, couldn't suppress a smile—her first one.
What Jiuyuan had always known, but Hathor had yet to realize: that stubborn, almost clumsy honesty of hers, was exactly what she needed to connect with those two little owlets.

Changes began to occur in Hathor’s daily life: popular comics started appearing on her desk, and on days off, she would go to livehouses with Haniel and Illica instead of staying alone in the training room. Occasionally, new words she'd never used before would slip into her conversations.
Though Hathor still worried about losing control, much of her tension had vanished amidst the laughter and playfulness of everyday life at Sterry. After one Esper control lesson, Jenson, who had been watching, teased, "You've been mentoring her for so long, and now she's getting more popular thanks to being 'led astray' by those two little owlets. How does that feel?"
"I thought you only cared about fishing. Seems you haven't completely lost your sense as a spy."
Hathor's tone was as flat as ever: "Would you like me to conduct another loss-of-control test right now?"
Jiuyuan glanced at Jenson, who was silently calculating the renovation costs if Hathor decided to lose control on purpose. Jiuyuan couldn't help but smile. "No need. Things are just fine the way they are."
There's no need to mold a student to fit some standard. She can find her own answer.

ST_File.F_NPC015_011:
After retiring from her previous job, Jiuyuan settled into a fairly relaxed life at Sterry.
The day-to-day tasks aren't complicated: sending and receiving packages, checking receipts, and passing around clipboards for signatures… As long as the process is clear and the staff reliable, none of the tasks pose much of a challenge. The real headaches come from commissions that can't be handled through any standard procedures: those involving intel, Anomalies, and the Anomaly Hunters who handle them. Clients with hidden agendas tapping their fingers on the counter, buyers using Anomalies as cover for covert handoffs, clients falsifying danger levels to drag Sterry into their schemes, not to mention the tangled web of factions at play… These may not seem a big deal, yet calculated troubles are far more vexing than any package delivery.

Still, Jiuyuan handles them all with ease.
One moment she's making small talk with a contact at a banquet hall, and the next she's at the scene of a target's transaction, tidying up the mess. She never breaks a sweat, and leaves only the cool scent of roses in her wake. With her intel and finesse, she has quietly woven a web across the fabric of this city. Most ripples, no matter how faint, inevitably land in it.

Though, what she excels at most is reading people.

(Hey, newcomer, where are you from?)
(I used to sleep in a dirty street until someone took a liking to me and bought me. The cost of my freedom was 998 Fons. Does that put me at the bottom of the hierarchy in this shop?)
(There are plenty who don't even know their own worth. Like me, I stayed in a dark, cramped place for ages and ages… so long that the little crack I had grew bigger and successfully merged with the original carved patterns… until… light came in. That woman appeared, gently lifted me out, and smiled.)
(Was it one of those scheming, triumphant smirks?)
(No. It was a completely confident smile, like she was certain I'd be there. But for some reason, that smile made her seem somewhat… regretful?)
(Haha, I bet she dusted off the dirt only to discover you weren't in as good condition as she imagined!)
The discussion that never happened and never will happen grows more animated, accompanied by the blinking sounds of the Temporal Globe. The Mirror of Anam simply reflects peacefully, capturing all the stillness and the passage of time across its surface.
ST_File.F_NPC013_011:
The bodyguard at Eibon Antique Shop does not say much, always standing quietly beside everyone else. She seems to have a nickname, "Daff," which Hotori occasionally calls her. Whenever Hotori calls her that, Daffodill looks away, her ears turning completely red. As for the others… if they want to be cut to pieces, they are welcome to try using that name.

Daffodill owns many eyepatches. Though she wears them less now, she still keeps up her collecting habit. Nobody can tell the difference between those eyepatches, but she firmly believes in her taste. Leather ones, patterned ones, ones with especially neat stitching… she carefully sorts them by category and places them in her small collection box.

Daffodill was not born with poor vision; rather, it was the price of her Esper Ability. At nineteen, cruel truth burst into her eyes like a kaleidoscope, and since then she could see through anomalies to perceive layers of essence across time and space. Sometimes, glimpsing the truth is not a good thing. She learned about her parents' cause of death, about her own wishful emotional attachments, about needing and being needed… and lost the faith she had relied on for survival. The red-cloaked hero in the picture book silently turned her blade toward Mother, toward that hateful, beating heart that had once falsely given her warmth. If the goddess of vengeance wanted to punish her for this… then so be it.

Daff longed for a happy, beautiful place, and so accidentally embarked on a journey full of metaphors.
So then, what about the ending of the story?
Her life until now was one monopolized by lies. It was a life in which no one needed her… there was no point in continuing. That was what Daffodill had been thinking when she met that slightly tipsy woman. The woman talked about a daffodil growing in the center of the lake, proud and aloof, seemingly impossible for anyone to pick. She naturally needed that flower too, but would not pick it.
A strange woman and a strange flower. What reason did that daffodil have for growing alone there? It must depend on something. Surely it grew that way because it was rooted in others' need for it. When the wind rose, Daffodill heard a different sound of rustling leaves than before.

Why not follow the woman and seek answers in the life ahead?

ST_File.F_NPC016_012:
In Sterry's early days, there were only three people. Though few in number, they had clear divisions of labor. The Mentor, well-versed in human weaknesses, frequently moved in social circles, while Jenson, with his proper speech and meticulous attention to protocol and rules, could break through negotiation deadlocks with just a few words, making him better suited for business cooperation discussions. However, from beginning to end, Hathor always maintained some reservations toward Jenson. Her sharp instincts for danger, honed through long training, whispered warnings that this man wasn't as rule-abiding as he appeared, though the Mentor's good working relationship with him indicated that Jenson could currently be trusted. As for the heavy responsibility of package delivery, it naturally fell to Hathor, who joined last.
Sterry's Elite Courier, the tough biker chick of few words, first choice for urgent delivery quests. Regular items, fragile goods, anomaly packages—all reached their destinations accurately, safely, and intact to the roar of her motorcycle. Some statistics claimed that her single-day record was 200 regular deliveries and 11 anomaly containers, all completed while assisting as an Anomaly Hunter contain two Class III anomalies. She was truly a tireless delivery machine: cold, ruthless, efficient.
Hathor herself hadn't noticed that such a pace was too demanding and had gone on too long. It wasn't until she returned one day to the shop, seeing her Mentor smiling and introducing Sterry's new members, that Hathor truly realized how exhuasted from work she was.

Today's Quest: Deliver Package (0/1)

Service with a Smile (0/1)

When Haniel was little, she had a ton of so-called "hobbies": violin, horseback riding, chess… Just like every other kid in her circle, she went through the usual "elite education" routine. She didn't hate any of it, but that didn't mean she liked it either. It all felt like a drizzly, soggy day where the world's colors are washed out and even birds feathers get stuck together.
Haniel likes sunny days better. So, before her nightly bedtime story, little Haniel sat down with her mother for a real conversation on equal footing. She laid out what she wanted and what confused her, asking the person closest to her for help. Her mom gently stroked her hair and apologized, saying she'd failed to notice Haniel's feelings in time.
Finding your true "hobby," the thing that's really yours, is hard. Luckily, Haniel was one of the fortunate ones.

ST_File.F_NPC005_012:
At Leon International, Skia embodied the role of a regular office worker and was naturally suited for that kind of life.
In modern civilized society, the fact that awakening Esper Abilities could change physical appearance was already common knowledge. His transformation was indeed dramatic, and just one look gave him a worse shock than any he'd experienced in five years of work… but once he calmed down, there was nothing he couldn't rationalize. After all, it wasn't a job that depended on looks, so it shouldn't break his routine…
The truth was, his routine wasn't determined by his own mindset.
Back then, he'd stood up in the meeting room, unable to bear it any longer, forcing himself to remain polite as he asked why the projects he'd always handled weren't even going through him for reports anymore.
Sitting among the well-dressed elites around him, someone wrinkled their eyes forcefully. Skia later realized it was the kind of motion… like trying to squeeze out some murky substance that had fallen into their eye.
As the meeting adjourned, Skia raised his gaze, looking past the cracks in his self-imposed mask that he was forced to reexamine, his eyes meeting the massive silhouette in the center of the projection screen that rose with his standing figure.
Does he look like a monster to others?
Well, at least the price of gaining the Esper Ability's wasn't too high. Now he was a regular office worker in every way except appearance.

ST_File.F_NPC026_013:
In an age when digital payments are everywhere, Chiichan still insists on withdrawing her salary from the bank each month, exchanging it for cash, and dividing it into a thin stack and a thick stack. She picks up the thin stack and counts it carefully. Once, twice, three times. Then she takes a few bills from it and adds them to the thick stack before tucking it all into a sturdy envelope.
"This address…" she says. "We don't have direct delivery there." The post office clerk looks at the destination with some difficulty.
"Th-That's okay."
"There's a good chance it could get lost with that many transfers, you know?"
"…Yes, I know."
Chiichan hands the envelope to the clerk. The envelope is stamped; she receives a mailing receipt in return. Walking home with the receipt, a map slowly unfolds in her mind. Chiichan has looked at many maps. On them, the place where she was born is just a tiny dot. If she left from Hethereau, she would have to take a very, very long boat ride to reach a new city, then transfer to a train and ride for a very, very long time to yet another city… If she chose to fly partway, she would have to take a very, very long bus ride… But even once she's figured out the route home, she has to think about the travel costs, and the savings needed so her family could live happily together without ever having to hunt Apocha again. She calculates how much she can save each month, how long it will take… By the time she's done with all the calculations, she's arrived.
Chiichan stands in front of the mailbox by her door, breathing deeply. Whenever she moves somewhere new, the first thing she does is send her new address back home. Then she waits. Maybe today will bring a letter…
"Knock knock." Chiichan taps lightly on the mailbox. "Knock knock." Two more taps.
This is a secret code between the siblings: it means "I found you." When they couldn't speak, they would answer each other with soft knocks instead.
Chiichan opens the mailbox. Inside is nothing but dust. So it is, every month.
Chiichan closes the mailbox and goes home with another mailing receipt. There are a dozen identical ones in her bedside drawer. So it is, every month.
Chiichan doesn't know when she will receive a letter from home. Maybe tomorrow. Maybe next month. Maybe never.

The day Edgar came back from Lamplight Academy, aunts, uncles, neighbors, and their children all swarmed in droves to congratulate him, nearly trampling down his family's doorstep. Whether they came out of curiosity to see what made this so-called "neighbor's kid you should learn from" so special, or were reluctant children dragged along by parents demanding they "learn from his example," they all reached the same conclusion:
He really didn't look like anything special.

Meanwhile, Edgar found himself surrounded by adults, completely overwhelmed. He just couldn't keep up with their overlapping chatter. As they talked over each other, Edgar's future became crystal clear in their minds: he'd immediately become a star researcher at Zerogon Laboratory, the rising star of Yggash Court, the new director of the Bureau of Anomaly Control. ST_File.F_NPC026_015:
After completing basic employee training, Chiz's first task at Pink Paws Bank was to get a customer to sign up for a card.
"It's easy," said Mayu, her mentor, patting her on the shoulder. "Our bank has the best benefits in all of Hethereau. You've got this."
"Sorry, I don't need one."
"No thank you."
"Uh-huh, okay, okay, uh-huh, okay, I understand, okay, okay."
Chiz collected dozens of polite refusals and cold shoulders. The air conditioning blasted in the bank lobby; Chiz felt cold inside, too. She huddled in a corner, wondering about resigning. Maybe she wasn't cut out for this job. She was always bad at so many things. She didn't even know how to write a resignation letter.
Chiz would probably remember the day she met Kolinsna forever, with her beautiful golden hair and dazzling red dress. Chiz felt like she was looking at Fons herself walking among mortals. She remembered how Mayu had described it: "Someone who looks like they'd definitely sign up for a card." Chiz really wanted to stay. She just had to try a little harder. So she gathered her courage and walked up. "H-Hello!" she started, "Welcome to Pink Paws Bank… Would you like to sign up for a card?"
The girl with the golden hair and red dress seemed startled by her. She stared at Chiz for a good while, then spoke. Her voice was lovely… until she proceeded to point out Chiz's every flaw; from the way she talked, to her outfit and appearance, to her posture and the angle she was standing at. Chiz felt stares coming from every direction. Tears were already welling up in her eyes. She really wasn't suited for this job after all…
"I'll sign up for a card."
Would Mayu teach her how to write a resignation letter…?
"Hey, don't you even know how to process a card?"
"S-sorry!" Chiz apologized on reflex, then kept responding yes, over and over. Before her brain could catch up, she was already standing in front of the machine. Somehow, despite her fumbling, she managed to successfully issue a card.
"Th-thank you for coming." She didn't know why things had turned out this way, but the result was delightful. After seeing off the young noblewoman, Mayu finally found her chance to approach. She looked at Chiz, who was especially happy about successfully signing up her first customer, with an indescribable expression. "Chiz, do you know who that was?"
"She was… That lady just now?"
"She's the Dvořák family's young lady."
Chiz's smile slowly faded. Pink Paws Bank belonged to the Dvořáks.
Under Mayu's pitying gaze, Chiz choked out: "M-Mayu, do you know how to write a resignation letter?"

ST_File.F_NPC026_016:
Chiz is terrified of loud noises. She's been afraid of thunder since she was little, but it got so much worse after she became an Esper. This is the price she pays for her powers. The sound of popcorn machines, fireworks going off, even karaoke—any overly-noisy environment makes her heart race. Only her soundproof home soothes her. Because of this, Chiz never attends gatherings.
"Chiz, want to grab dinner together this weekend?"
Mayu was inviting her again. Chiz did want to go. She was so grateful to Mayu, the first person to show her kindness after she joined Pink Paws Bank. And it wasn't just Mayu; there was Haruna, Grace… All her coworkers were wonderful people. Chiz had always wanted to treat them to a meal and properly express her thanks. But someone like her…
"I should probably…"
"How about coming to my place? I'll show you my cooking. Come on, Chiz, come on."
If it was at someone's home, it probably wouldn't be too loud…
Chiz finally accepted. She stayed up all night reading posts on Bagel to learn how to be a polite houseguest. If she never got another chance, she had to make this one count.
"Welcome! You didn't have to bring anything!"
"Chiz's here? Come in, come in!"
"Um… H-Hello, everyone…"
The house was warm. There was the smell of home cooking and the chatter of coworkers. So this is what a gathering was like. How nice. Just as Chiz was secretly feeling happy, Grace handed her a box.
"F-for me?"
"Of course! Open it, quick." Haruna leaned in close to Chiz, urging her to open it.
Chiz untied the ribbon. Inside the box was a pair of noise-canceling earplugs. They were beautiful. And pink.
"Pretty, right? We all picked them out together."
"Other than being cute, they're almost completely useless. The noise-canceling is extremely average."
"But they're perfect for our Chiz, right?"
Yes, the noise-canceling was perfectly average… Just enough for Chiz to hear the sound of fireworks blooming in the sky without being so scared that she had to cover her ears and run away.
ST_File.F_NPC026_014:
Chiz keeps a diary. She hasn't stopped writing since receiving her first journal. She writes down everything worth remembering, so that when she sees her family again someday, she can tell them everything. Then, she'll finally say the words she's been preparing for so long: "Yes, I've been doing well out here."
But her diary isn't just words: there are rice ball wrapper labels, flower petals that landed on her shoulder, and stickers from coworkers. They're all proof that she's doing well. Chiz feels that only by recording things this way can she truly feel like she's not just stumbling through a pleasant dream.
At first, Chiz's diary entries were very short.
"M: XX, D: XX. Food was good."
"M: XX, D: XX. Clothes were pretty."
"M: XX, D: XX. Flowers smelled nice."
She didn't know what else to write, so she just honestly recorded how she felt. Once, a friend found out and suggested, "If you don't know what to write, why not try drawing?" But Chiz didn't think her drawings were all that good, either. She was still troubled.
One day, Chiz ate a delicious candy. She couldn't bear to throw away even the crinkled wrapper, so she put it in her diary. The candy was delicious, and her problem was solved. She's continued to this day.
"Ahhh, how is it this late already? I have work tomorrow!"
Chiz hurriedly closes her diary. Her entries have been longer and longer, lately. There's more and more worth recording. That tasty milk tea has to be written down. Getting praised by her manager has to be written down. The first sunny day of spring, the first sunny day of summer, the first sunny day of fall, and the first snowfall of winter all have to be properly recorded. Chiz doesn't like rainy days. She only likes sunny days, because on rainy days, food is hard to find.
But Chiz really likes snowy days in Hethereau. Snow is clean and white.
ST_File.F_NPC026_011:
Chiz stands, professionally dressed, in the gleaming lobby of a bank.
Chiz walks the corners where the streetlights don't reach, sewage pooling under the cracks in the pavement.
"Chiz, Chiz, where are you going?"

Once Chiz learned to run without stumbling, she had to leave home and help her older siblings find food outside. Shiny bread wrapped in plastic… Chiz only saw that once. Most of the time, all she could find were wild vegetables and mushrooms. When even those were gone, they had no choice but to hunt "Apocha." That's what they called the edible Anomalies. But Apocha were dangerous; it was common to get hurt, and medicine was even harder to find than food. And then there was that saying: "Eat too many Apocha, and you'll become an Esper." Espers, like Anomalies, were outsiders to be driven away; because, just like Anomalies, Espers attack. After dinner, Chiz watched her mother cradle her newborn baby sister; patting her, soothing her, singing to her. Chiz remembered when she was little, so little that the whole world was no bigger than her mother's embrace, her mother would gently pat her, soothe her, and sing to her.
"Chiz, Chiz, grow up quick."

Faster, faster. Chiz pressed her palm against the bleeding wound on her neck, glancing back at the Apocha that was closely tailing her. She ran as hard as she could, away from home. Farther, farther—until she couldn't run anymore. Chiz tripped on a rock and fell hard to the ground. The Apocha had vanished somewhere along the way. She didn't have the strength to stand, so she just lay there, nibbling at the food she'd found. She could only eat a little. She had to bring the rest home. Her family was waiting for her. She had to get home… Chiz couldn't remember how she found her way back. But somehow, she made it home with the food… and a new Ability. Maybe, just like the stories said, she had eaten too many Apocha. On her last night home, she used her new Esper Ability to put on a little fireworks show for her younger siblings. She remembered their eyes shining bright, their soft gasps; fighting over who got to play with their magical big sister.
The next day, her mother brought Chiz to the shore. A boat would take her away from home, carry her to a new world. Even after her mother's silhouette had completely disappeared from sight, Chiz could still hear someone calling out in the salty sea breeze.
"Chiz, Chiz, you must…"

Chiz now lives in the heart of Hethereau. Even at night, the whole New Herland District blazes with lights. Chiz often turns off all her lights indoors and leans against the window, watching the flow of cars outside. Back in her homeland, nights were deathly silent. Light didn't mean streetlamps or the moon; light meant danger. It could be an Anomaly's lure. It could be dangerous Espers and their weapons.
Chiz sits in the darkness of her room, while a glittering world sparkles outside her window. She hugs herself, imitating her mother from memory, softly humming a melody still warm with feeling.
"Chiz, Chiz, you must be happy."

ST_File.F_NPC015_015:
The year-end shopping list was, as always, Jiuyuan's responsibility. But this year, when it came to what to buy, things were a little different from before. The moment Haniel and Illica, who had just recently joined, heard about the year-end shopping, they immediately insisted on adding a celebration party that wasn't part of the original plan. And so, what was once a neat and simple list turned into an outing for all five of them.
"Jiuyuan! We need flowers, balloons, spotlights… and cake!"
"And a standee!"
"…What's a standee?"
"You know, one of those poster things with your photo on it that you put by the entrance. Hathor, wanna try it?"
"That won't be necessary… Master."

"What about presents? There should at least be presents!"
"Of course, everyone gets one."
"Hehe, Jiuyuan's the best!"
"What about Jenson? Did he get us presents?"
"Today's bill is going under his name."
"Jenson's so generous!"
"Then I'm adding a few new comics!"
"And the CD I didn't get last time!"
"…Fine, get it all."

The list was checked, revised, and added to over and over again.
As the two little owlets eagerly confirmed every checkmark with Jenson, Jiuyuan stood off to the side and let out a soft sigh.
A little noisy, a little chaotic.
But in moments like these, the accounts can wait, and the plans can be pushed back a bit.
Times like this… aren't so bad.
