ST_GameplayDec.Store_des:
<title>How to Manage The Cafe by Origen</>
1. Once an item is listed and stocked in your shop, it will gradually earn Fons over time, up to a maximum of 72 hours.
2. Level up characters with <orange>Management</>-type <orange>Life Skills</> and hire them at your shop to increase revenue.
3. Each shop allows you to swap out tables and chairs, and place specific furniture through the management page. Tables, chairs, and furniture provide Popularity, which increases shop revenue in tiers.
4. Fashion Center (unlocks at Management Level 20) updates daily at 12:00 PM. Match your items to the Fashion Trend to earn extra Fons.

<title>Management Level</>
1. Each time you collect shop revenue, you will gain corresponding Management EXP to level up your Management Level.
2. As your Management Level increases, you can invest in more shops, list more products, hire more employees, and earn more Fons.
3. Increasing your Management Level unlocks more items and lets you upgrade existing ones.
4. Reaching certain Management Levels unlocks additional convenience features.

<tips>Feature Details</>
<tips>Lvl 2: Delivery unlocked. 80% fee required.</>
<tips>Lvl 15: Delivery fee drops to 60%.</>
<tips>Lvl 20: Delivery fee drops to 40%. Fashion Center unlocked.</>
<tips>Lvl 25: Delivery fee drops to 20%.</>
<tips>Lvl 30: Delivery is free.</>
<tips>Lvl 40: Auto Restock unlocked.</>
ST_GameplayDec.TycoonRank_Dec:
<title>Wealth Board</>
An official *ranking published by Pink Paws Bank HQ (Note: Based solely on Pink Paws Bank data and may not reflect total assets) showcases the wealthiest individuals in Hethereau.

1. All Fons earned contribute to your total wealth and determine your rank on the Wealth Board.
2. Reach a rank for the first time to earn exclusive titles.

So, who will be the next tycoon of Hethereau?
ST_GameplayDec.GameplayDec_MonthCard_Content:
<title>Riftcrystal Mining Permit</>
Each purchase of a Riftcrystal Mining Permit grants 300 Riftcrystals immediately and activates the permit for 30 days.
While the permit is active, you can claim 90 Annuliths and 30,000 Fons daily upon logging in. Daily rewards refresh at 5:00 AM.
Rewards not claimed due to not logging in during the permit's active period will not be refunded.

<title>Important Notes</>
You can only purchase and extend the total active time when the remaining time on your Riftcrystal Mining Permit is less than 179 days.<title></>When the remaining time on your Riftcrystal Mining Permit is 179 days or more, you cannot purchase additional permits. If duplicate purchases of Riftcrystal Mining Permit occur due to special circumstances, the total active time will not be extended, and 330 Riftcrystals will be refunded.
ST_GameplayDec.EquipmentPlan_Des:
<title>Smart Equip Guide</>
1. Current Loadout: View the character's equipped Consoles, recommended improvements, and an overall loadout rating.
2. Recommended Setup: See a system-recommended Console combination tailored to the character.
3. Press Auto Equip to equip a recommended Console setup based on the Consoles available in your inventory.
4. Press Apply Setup to equip the Consoles you already own from the Recommended Setup to the current character.
ST_GameplayDec.GamePlayDes_CharacterTrialAward_Content:
<title>Event Rules</>
During the event, players can experience trial stages with <red>fixed teams</> unlimited times. 
Team compositions and their corresponding Arcs and Consoles in trial stages cannot be modified.

<title>Event Rewards</>
After completing trial stage challenges, you will <red>automatically receive</> corresponding rewards. Rewards can <red>only be claimed once during the event period. </>
During the event, if you have already completed the corresponding character's <red>tutorial stage</>, you can directly claim that character's trial stage rewards from this event interface.
ST_GameplayDec.MahjongRoomDescription:
<title>Special Rules</>
1. When a player wins (either by discard or self-draw), the game does not end. The winner draws a replacement card from the end of the wall and continues playing and staying in a ready hand. They can win multiple times (or deal into others' wins) until the wall is exhausted. This is the key difference from "Last Man Standing" (where winners exit after winning).

2. After receiving the initial hand, each player must select three tiles of the same suit to exchange with another player in the direction specified by the system. This is a crucial first step for adjusting your hand and building toward bigger wins.

3. Before play begins, you must designate one of the three suits (Dots, Bamboo, or Characters) as your "Void Suit" and prioritize discarding all tiles of that suit during play. When winning, your hand cannot contain any tiles of this suit.

4. Players who are not in ready hands (waiting to win) must pay compensation based on the highest possible multiplier of other players who are in ready.

5. Flower Pig: If a player's hand still contains all three suits at the end (meaning they failed to clear their Void Suit), they are considered a Flower Pig and must pay a higher compensation multiplier to all players in ready hands.

<title>Scoring Rules</>
1. Each player starts with 10,000 points. Points reset after each round.

2. When winning, the total multiplier is calculated by multiplying all applicable scoring patterns together. Strategically, small hands can build into big wins.

3. Kong tiles score instantly: When a Revealed Kong or Concealed Kong is declared, points are immediately collected from the other three players, providing ongoing scoring opportunities throughout the game.

4. After the game ends, rankings are determined by each player's final point total.

5. Special settlement: If three players all reach 0 points, the game ends early and rankings are settled.

ST_GameplayDec.RobbankGameplay_Dec:
<title>【玩法说明】</>
1. 在时间限制内尽可能多地收集地图中的「藏品」，成功撤离后，本局收益将转化为等价方斯。当本期收益进度已达上限时，无法继续获得奖励。
2. 地图中存在若干「ReroRero电话亭」，在限时时间内可选择任一电话亭安全撤离。超时或全部角色无法战斗后将失去全部收益。
3. 角色受到伤害时，有概率会损失收益，请谨慎规划探索路线并注意角色当前状态。
4. 地图中除了存在有价值的藏品外，还散落着「权限卡」、「金库门禁卡」等功能性道具。此类道具本身不存在收益，但可开启存放大量藏品的房间，亦可将其保留在背包内带出副本下次使用。
5.联机模式下，随着联机人数增加，局内所获奖励也将动态调整：击败目标的掉落奖励提高；高品质「藏品」出现概率提高；击败「玛门」后的奖励提高。

<title>【特别说明】</>
1. 在更新周期（两周）内，通过本玩法获得的收益存在上限，达到上限后将无法继续获得方斯收益，但仍可继续参与本玩法。
2. 局内存在特殊的<red>角色均衡模式</>，玩家上阵的所有角色均为固定面板，与具体养成无关，但保留角色觉醒效果。
3. 角色均衡模式下，部分角色的技能以及觉醒效果会有改变，具体情况如下：
3.1 白藏极轨终结的斩杀效果数值调整为：当目标生命值低于5%时（Boss生命值低于2.5%)，白藏发动即刻斩杀击败目标。
3.2 早雾觉醒效果「溶解性的暴食」无法生效。
ST_GameplayDec.OpActFriendlyCitizen_Dec:
<title>【玩法说明】</>
1. 活动期间，通过击败海特洛市游荡的异象怪物、到处捣乱的暴走族、以及强大的异象首领获取活动积分
2. 获得积分后，可以领取对应档位的道具奖励，每档奖励只可领取1次。
3. 每日最多可获取150积分，玩家在当天打满积分后，则不会再获得积分。
ST_GameplayDec.GamePlayDec_CombatAwards_Content:
<title>Circle Bounty</>
Circle Bounty are issued by the Anomaly Hunter Guild. Appraisers can obtain substantial reward after completing Circle Quests.
When each Circle Bounty season begins, Standard Hunter Supply is unlocked by default.<title></>You can purchase Elite Hunter Supplies or Honor Hunter Supplies for more generous rewards.

<title>Circle Quest Info</>Appraisers can complete Circle Quests to earn Experience Points, increase Circle Bounty levels, and claim seasonal rewards.
Circle Quests are divided into three categories: Daily Quests, Weekly Quests, and Seasonal Quests.
Daily Quests reset at <orange>05:00 daily</> (Server Time).
Weekly Quests reset at <orange>05:00 every Monday</> (Server Time).
Experience Points have a weekly earning limit. Experience Points obtained from Seasonal Quests are excluded from this limit.
After Circle Bounty reaches its level limit, Circle Quests will no longer increase its level.

<title>Special Notes</>
If special circumstances result in unlocking Elite Hunter Supplies or Honor Hunter Supplies more than once, or upgrading to Honor Hunter Supplies after Elite Hunter Supplies has already been unlocked, Experience Points do not stack. Any corresponding Riftcrystal purchase cost will be refunded directly.
At the end of a Circle Bounty season, any unclaimed level rewards will be sent via Mail.
ST_GameplayDec.RoomPreviewIconInvite:
<title>Character Invitation Guide</>
1. After owning a house, you can invite different characters to move in via the invitation interface.
2. Once a character is invited to move in, they will reside permanently in the designated house.
3. Characters will act autonomously after moving in, such as reading books, wandering around, etc.
4. Each action's <orange>first</> interaction with a resident character will increase Affection.
5. Each property can accommodate different numbers of invited characters.
Wiener Apartments can accommodate <orange>1</> character.
Eden Apartments can accommodate <orange>2</> characters.
Skyview Halls can accommodate <orange>2</> characters.
Golden Capital can accommodate <orange>3</> characters.
Fenglin Villa can accommodate <orange>5</> characters.

<title>Invitation Interaction Guide</>
1. Invitation interactions are divided into Solo Actions and Interactive Actions.
Both action types require reaching the corresponding <orange>Bond Level</> or placing the corresponding <orange>furniture</> to unlock.
2. Obtaining Character Interactions: When a character's Bond Level reaches <orange>Lvl 4</> and <orange>Lvl 6</>, you can obtain the Bond Items <orange>Familiar</> and <orange>Close Friends</>. Upon obtaining them, some of that character's actions will be automatically unlocked.
ST_GameplayDec.GamePlayDesc_Abyss_Content:
<title>Beyond the Rails</>
Beyond the Rails puts your skills to the test with <red>high-difficulty</> challenge stages. Complete stage objectives to earn <red>Platform Seals</>, which can be exchanged for rewards once enough are collected.
Each station hosts unique <red>Anomalies</> that reveal Esper Ability <red>weaknesses</> and <red>resistances</>. Check station details and plan your <red>Companions</> carefully to tackle them efficiently.

<title>Train Routes</>
There are two route types in Beyond the Rails:
1. <red>All-Day Route</>: Permanently available. Rewards can be claimed <red>once</> per completion.
2. <red>Special Route</>: Rotates periodically with tougher stages, updated content, and exclusive rewards. Unlock it by completing the All-Day Route first.

<title>Otherworld Resonance</>
Every route comes with a unique <red>Resonance Effect</> that applies to all stations along it. Learning how to use this effect can give you a big edge in completing challenge objectives.

<title>Otherworld Supply Stop</>
1. Unlocking a route grants <red>Shadowquills</>.
2. Spend Shadowquills at the Otherworld Supply Stop to obtain <red>Miss Levi's Gift</>, which grants powerful skill effects.
3. Miss Levi's Gift works only at the current station and cannot be carried forward. Resetting a station lets you choose a new one for it to take effect.
4. Note: Shadowquills and Miss Levi's Gifts are route-specific and cannot be shared.

<title>Route Updates</>
Special Routes typically reset <red>every 14 days</>. When that happens: a) All Platform Seals are cleared. b) Otherworld Resonance and station Anomalies change. c) Challenges in progress during a reset automatically fail.

<title>Fast Travel</>
After a Special Route resets, your total Platform Seals from the previous route determine how far you <red>auto-progress</> in the new route. Stations cleared automatically retain the Companion setup from the previous run in your Otherworld Travel Log.

18–20 Seals: Auto-complete Station 1, jump to Station 2.
21–23 Seals: Auto-complete Stations 1–2, jump to Station 3.
24–26 Seals: Auto-complete Stations 1–3, jump to Station 4.
27–29 Seals: Auto-complete Stations 1–4, jump to Station 5.
30 Seals: Auto-complete Stations 1–5, jump to Station 6.

ST_IntroduceMsg_World.Hospital_AnomalyCanIntro_Clock:
"Looping Clock"
Ensure the specimen's form is intact and operating normally. If its hands rotate abnormally or it has been damaged recently, contact the Central Laboratory immediately.
Remaining in the same space as this specimen for extended periods of time is strictly prohibited.
ST_IntroduceMsg_World.Hospital_AnomalyCanIntro_Bandage:
"Bodiless" (Section)
The specimen's true form is a bandage-wrapped shell with a twisted humanoid silhouette; some exhibit peculiar behaviors, such as being drawn to the universe or puppeted by sound.
Any physical interaction with this specimen is strictly prohibited!
ST_IntroduceMsg_World.Hospital_AnomalyCanIntro_Jigsaw:
Jigsaw (Type ?) 
This experimental subject's body can be artificially divided into at least four or more sections. It is generally used as a Bio-lock space requiring high levels of security to access; the sample itself must be fully recombined with its other fragments, or "pieces," before a specific space can be opened.
It holds significant medical research value and may be combined with █████████; investigation is still ongoing.

ST_IntroduceMsg_World.Hospital_AnomalyCanIntro_Mian:
"Fluffy"
This specimen will change its form if provoked or injured; ensure it remains in its current form.
If you observe any changes in form, contact the Central Laboratory.
ST_IntroduceMsg_World.Hospital_AnomalyCanIntro_Water:
Drowner
Store in isolated, sealed containers. If a dark shadow is detected in the water, promptly split it into separate sealed containers until the shadow is no longer visible.
Under no circumstances should the test subject be exposed to any body of water.
Strictly prohibit ingestion or injection.
ST_IntroduceMsg_World.Hospital_AnomalyCanIntro_Mimic:
"Mysty"
This experimental object is known to be able to transform into other objects roughly similar in size. If the object's form changes, ignore it.

ST_IntroduceMsg_World.Hospital_AnomalyCanIntro_Shadow:
Etcher

If the subject remains visible in the absence of light, also contact the Central Laboratory.

ST_Item.RobBankItem_G015_desc: Grants access to Vault No. 10, a little-known and mysterious vault. To this day, no one knows what treasures lie inside.

ST_Item.RobBankItem_G007_desc: Grants access to Vault No. 2, frequently rented out to various clients and typically containing several safety deposit boxes.
ST_Item.RobBankItem_G008_desc: Grants access to Vault No. 3, owned by a senior member of the bank. You might even find access cards for other rooms inside.
ST_Item.RobBankItem_G009_desc: Grants access to Vault No. 4, one of the bank's most commonly used vaults, usually holding loose stacks of cash.
ST_Item.RobBankItem_G010_desc: Grants access to Vault No. 5, used to store the bank's daily operating funds. You may find a sizable amount of cash inside.
ST_Item.RobBankItem_G011_desc: Grants access to Vault No. 6, which stores a large reserve of backup currency. Considerable amounts of cash may be found inside.

ST_Item.DSDvipcard_usedesc: With this card, you can accumulate VIP Points while shopping at DSD POP.
ST_Item.item_WorldMaterial_03_usedesc: A bestseller from DSD POP. The first bare-handed touch after unboxing determines the T-Rex's color and texture. If you're lucky enough to fish out a translucent, emerald green T-Rex, head left to the Regalia 4S dealership and pick your dream sports car!
ST_Item.disc_0006:
Leave eyerything behind.
Come to the other side.
When you want to be mine.
Find me in the Elysium.
ST_Item.Vehicle020_skin_1_Painting_desc: The official vehicle livery of Swift Cab. Its bold, recognizable colors have made it one of the city's iconic sights.
ST_Item.Vehicle020_skin_1_CeilingLight_desc: A standard roof light used by Swift Cab taxis. Simple, highly visible, and easy to spot even in the busiest streets.
ST_Item.item_quest_011_desc: XXXX-XX-XX, XX:XX:XX, 5 kg. Don't ask where, don't ask how. I fished it. Thanks for your praise.
ST_Item.MetaClue_1_desc:
…This isn't the first time you've come here, ██. I'm curious—what kind of pull does this terrifying, eerie, lifeless hospital hold for you…
…Truthfully, I'm glad you've set foot in this dead place more than once, ██. To experience. To witness. To use your own eyes to seek the truth—and the truth behind the truth…
…I know you'll continue your search, ██, because now, reality is also your nightmare…

—Mysterious Note—
…My fate was sealed long ago…
ST_Item.item_CharacterUpMaterial_lv3_desc:
"From I to VIII: The Ultimate Hunter's Anomaly Catalog!"
—No one had ever seen the special Anomalies it documented until one day, when an anonymous user uploaded a cryptic image. Its blurry figures and puzzling scenes seemed to obliquely validate something…
ST_Item.BigPoster003_desc: A poster of "Gen Z". It's the cover of a popular chapter about a member codenamed "Recorder" who meets the three protagonists and struggles on the boundary between good and evil.
ST_Item.BigPoster001_desc: A poster of "Gen Z". The cover of the latest chapter, telling the story of a member who returns following an investigation into a missing colleague in the "Robot Factory Theft Case", but loses their memory…
ST_Item.Furniture_draw_0014_desc:
"Flowers: Dream Path" by Bichir Whites, and an anonymous contributor.
Whites mentioned multiple times in his diary that he met a close friend during his travels, and they would often meet to discuss art. They even slept side-by-side in the studio, painting through the night. The "Flowers" series was created during this period. Perhaps influenced by this friend, Whites' paintings from this time used lighter, fresher colors and focused mainly on depicting the concrete forms of objects.
"Dream Path" is the first painting in this series, created by Whites based on his friend's description of a pathway from a dream.
ST_Item.Furniture_draw_0015_desc:
"Flowers: Butterflies to Flowers" by Bichir Whites, and an anonymous contributor.
Whites mentioned multiple times in his diary that he met a close friend during his travels, and they would often meet to discuss art. They even slept side-by-side in the studio, painting through the night. The "Flowers" series was created during this period. Perhaps influenced by this friend, Whites' paintings from this time used lighter, fresher colors and focused mainly on depicting the concrete forms of objects.
"Butterflies to Flowers" is the third painting in this series, created by Whites after hearing a tragic local love story. The other person wrote a poem for this artwork.
"The butterfly messenger seeks branches where buds first bloom, half-rolled rouge petals, shy of the eastern wind's gaze."
ST_Item.ExperimentClue_1_des: "Director N seems to have landed a big client. The hospital director approved a special budget to establish a dedicated research group for them…"
ST_Item.MysteriousVisitorClue_1_des:
"V's loyalty requires further observation. Subject may have become aware of surveillance. Recommend switching to more covert methods.
Will ensure the experiment proceeds. Rest assured."
ST_Item.BandageClue_5_des: "…This is an emergency. I implore you to intervene immediately and implement isolation and containment measures for V!"
ST_Item.BandageClue_4_des: "…I don't know what V went through in there. I'm just relieved he can still be of use. Otherwise, I'd be the one who has to take over dealing with these terrifying freaks."
ST_Item.flower_sp_usedesc: Quest Item - Love that Begins with Lies
ST_Item.food_sp_001_usedesc: Quest Item - Love that Begins with Lies
ST_Item.ExperimentClue_4_desc: "If you really take a look at this schedule, you'll notice something doesn't add up…"
ST_Item.ExperimentClue_3_desc: "Should find a chance to speak with N, just in case."
ST_Item.Universal_BusinessCard_1021_desc:
Edgar's namecard as a staff member of Eibon Antique Shop.
The photo is from Edgar's personal resume. Edgar went all out preparing to apply for a position at Eibon Antique Shop… but in the end, none of it was actually necessary.
Still, Taygedo, whom Edgar respectfully treated as the "interviewer," got a real kick out of it.
ST_Item.Universal_BusinessCard_1010_desc:
Nanally's namecard as a staff member of Eibon Antique Shop.
The textured watermark patterns on the paper (crumpled from sleeping on it), the understated luxury color scheme (ran out of budget for color printing), the faintly visible decorative lines (hand slipped while drawing)… Every detail speaks to the mysterious and noble identity of the card's owner. She calls this "boss vibes." Surely someone out there gets it.
ST_Item.Universal_BusinessCard_1003_desc:
Sakiri's namecard as a staff member of Eibon Antique Shop.
"What do you mean you don't have a namecard? How can a member of The Coluccis not have a namecard? Go get one made right now!" This namecard was born from that exact demand. It's unclear how Sakiri actually feels about it, but at least Nanally is satisfied.
ST_Item.Universal_BusinessCard_1005_desc:
Daffodill's namecard as a staff member of Eibon Antique Shop.
What does it mean for a person to have a namecard? Is it like a dog having a tag with its name on it? She doesn't quite understand the significance yet. But one thing she knows for certain: before, she always used different codenames for different missions. Now, she just needs to be Daffodill.
ST_Item.Universal_BusinessCard_1029_desc:
Hotori's namecard as the Owner of Eibon Antique Shop.
Almost every antique acquisition deal that ends with the buyer being duped by fakes or inferior goods somehow traces back to Hotori through this card. So every now and then, she takes it out for a good look, wondering if there's something wrong with the placement of the photo and text in the layout… from a feng shui perspective.
ST_Item.Universal_BusinessCard_1033_desc:
The official namecard of the Butler of Eibon Antique Shop.
Present this card at the shop to receive personal service from the Eibon Butler, along with a special discount! But for Adler himself, the very existence of this card signifies something more: a wanderer who drifted through half a lifetime has finally found a place to call home.
ST_Item.WeaponGacha_desc:
"The first is the creation of truth, the second is the trajectory of stars, and the
third is the law of gods."
ST_Item.item_quest_008_usedesc: "A Retrograde Poem for You" Quest Item
ST_Item.CityStamina_des: "Submerged in noise, yet believing oneself to be the king of the city."
ST_Item.BandageClue_3_des: "Serious incident occurred. Patient regained consciousness during surgery and ███. Suspected cause: ██ attempted to remove bandages binding the patient's limbs."
ST_Item.WishingItem_04_desc: "Through seasons of change, fortune finds its way."
ST_Item.CityAbility_UpMaterial_desc: "Plant a thousand seeds in a thousand fever dreams."
ST_Item.cookbook_13_desc: In the deserted workspace, something fierce is surging violently within me. It's as if countless arms grow from my heart, scratching and tickling at my insides because I stopped working, driving me to madness… I must find relief, I need to become a mindless module integrated into the office network, my body a nonstop stream of complex numbers and information, simply inputting, processing and outputting…
ST_Item.item_CharacterUpMaterial_lv2_desc:
"How I Became The Chosen Hunter - Anomalies, Tests, And Notes"
—This is a hunter's guide with over 10,000 bookmarks on Bagel. No serious hunters, no powerful arcs, no flashy Espers, just a slice-of-life light novel about taming high threat Anomalies into minions around the city. The high bookmark count is probably because hunters wish to be blessed by such luck.
ST_Item.Universal_avatar1_1039_desc: I'll come to like anything she likes too.
ST_Item.CityStamina_addpotion_desc: "A functional beverage rich in electrolytes, restoring your energy anytime, anywhere."
ST_Item.EquipmentUpMaterial_lv3_desc: "Above all trash, I am the lord of this manhole."
ST_Item.Dicelimite_Jin_desc: "Drunk on wine, the moon is high—snow drifts gently, another year gone by."
ST_Item.MysteriousVisitorClue_2_des: "Confirmed to be Researcher V. An interrogation will be conducted regarding this matter."
ST_Item.EquipmentUpMaterial_lv1_desc: "Take me along? Sure, why not—it's not like I have anything better to do."
ST_Item.PortableVision_BlueDrawing_desc: "Architecture is the art of combining planes and space… If it's hard to understand, why not try looking at it from a different angle?"
ST_Item.Universal_BusinessCard_1008_desc:
Skia's namecard as Lieutenant of ETD-4.
A namecard should include essential information such as the holder's name, title, full company name, detailed address, and valid contact methods like phone number, email, Bagel account, and Sesame Codes, ensuring that clients and partners can easily get in touch. However, this card, produced in a standardized format, seems to fall short on information. Skia is not amused.
ST_Item.Universal_BusinessCard_1004_desc:
Lacrimosa's… namecard? As a member of ETD-4.
"Just hand this card to someone, and they'll know who you are without any introductions." Sounded convenient enough, so Lacrimosa decided to make one herself… The photo might not be the most professional, but it certainly leaves an impression.
ST_Item.Universal_BusinessCard_1039_desc:
Fadia's namecard as a member of ETD-4.
When a bold and provocative lipstick mark is printed on a namecard, the recipient tends to have an interesting reaction. A secret thrill from mistaking it for an invitation, perhaps. The awkwardness of something beyond normal social norms. A fleeting flash of disdain… In truth, it's all just a little test. She uses it to catch a glimpse of their true colors, and she never gets tired of it.
ST_Item.Universal_BusinessCard_1023_desc:
Baicang's namecard as the Captain of ETD-4.
Concise wording, clean layout, and so professional that it doesn't seem like Baicang's card at all. Of course, that's because he didn't actually make it himself. All credit goes to his dependable Lieutenant. As for Baicang's take on it… well, how could a little piece of paper ever define a living, complex person?
ST_Item.Universal_BusinessCard_1019_desc:
Mint's namecard as a member of CSU-2.
Does seeing this card make you think of Mint? Then open up Bagel and chat with her right away! Mint's always got endless topics to talk about, and she'll absolutely reply in a flash! Well, except when she's on duty, of course.
ST_Item.BandageClue_1_des: "The patient exhibited significant anxiety and abnormal behavior, insisting on tightly binding the affected areas with bandages and refusing to remove them. Patient also shows extreme sensitivity to visual and auditory stimuli."
ST_Item.item_quest_K110358_usedesc: "We! Are! One! —Conscientious Giant Pup!" Quest Item
ST_Item.food_059_desc:
Seize the day. 
Fill a large mug from the barrel's spout with frothy, deep golden Heitwein. Raise it high with friends, or even strangers! Laugh heartily, and relieve all unhappiness! Immerse yourself in the satisfaction of the moment!
ST_Item.MysteriousVisitorClue_4_des: "After the Nursing Department's emergency response team intervened, all escaped test subjects were contained by 02:10."
ST_Item.Furniture_Ornament_005_desc:
"They say if you play this violin at dusk, you might glimpse the future."
The previous owner tried it. It's fake.
Regardless, this is still a finely crafted violin. Despite having only four strings, the melodies that flow from them can captivate any listener's heart.
"The performance may seem plain, but paired with youthful melodies, perhaps you'll see a future full of hope." That's what was written inside this violin's case.
ST_Item.Universal_BusinessCard_1014_desc:
Jiuyuan's namecard as the acting owner of Sterry Express.
The card was produced by Sterry in a standardized format, with the photo being a fixed element. The moment it's placed in your hands, a transaction has already quietly begun. It's just that most people don't realize what they've actually agreed to until much, much later.
ST_Item.Universal_BusinessCard_1020_desc:
Haniel's namecard as an Elite Courier of Sterry Express.
The card was produced by Sterry in a standardized format, but Haniel clearly added a little personal touch during the photoshoot. Apparently, when handing over the card, she's supposed to say: "When the cherry blossoms fall like rain, will we meet again?"
ST_Item.Universal_BusinessCard_1025_desc:
Hathor's namecard as an Elite Courier of Sterry Express.
This card was produced by Sterry in a standardized format, but the photo on it was not chosen at random. It doesn't promise any guarantees, yet it carries a silent message: at the very least, someone has already thought through your worst possible situations in advance.
ST_Item.item_CharacterUpMaterial_lv1_desc:
"Notes from a Rising Hunter: Your Guide to Promotion!"
—This is a hunter's guide that garnered 999+ Sesame ratings on Bagel. A rookie who had just received their hunter's license tried to put the book into practice, leaving only one comment: Be… ware… of… Anomalies!
ST_Item.RobBankItem_027_desc: The latest phone released by Cubox Technologies features significant improvements over previous models. The side effect of these upgrades is being even more addictive.
ST_Item.BandageClue_2_des: "Since you're handling the patient, you'll represent our department this time, V."
ST_Item.SpecialGift_letter_des:
"It's the sunlight streaming through the window into the room, The first breath of air when you open the door. The music drifting from the street corner. Even the rain falling on your hair, the wind passing through your fingers—I want to share it all with you in that very moment."
"This letter is too short, but there's so much I want to say. If this letter could convey even one ten-thousandth of how much I miss you… If when you read this, you happen to hear that music from the street corner too…"
…
Is this too over the top?
ST_Item.MysteriousVisitorClue_5_des: "Failure to secure Coldmount Hospital is a dereliction of duty by this department. In this operation, the Nursing Department will spare no cost."
ST_Item.energy_usedesc: The smallest unit in the Character Resolution Map, used as a criterion to evaluate the risk of a human being Encroached. The evaluation is performed with Character Photo Paper developed in Zerogon Laboratory.
ST_Item.ExperimentClue_2_desc: This report is for the eyes of Group ██ only. Do not disclose.
ST_Item.WishingItem_02_desc: "Flourishing branches bring connections far and wide."
ST_Item.Dicelimite_Nanally_desc: "The Coluccis are doing a major hiring spree—apply now to skip the entire interview process and get hired right off the bat… at least that's what it says on EZ-Hire, right?"
ST_Item.item_quest_005_usedesc: "Colucci Anecdote - Family Token Showdown!" quest item.
ST_Item.WishingItem_01_desc: "Deep roots bring lasting peace to the home."
ST_Item.PortableVision_Anomaly_010_desc: Fluffy is a docile Anomaly creature that resembles a white rabbit in appearance. It survives by feeding on cotton textiles and makes "fluff fluff" sounds, often appearing in groups during sunny afternoons. Blankets "processed" by Fluffy become exceptionally soft and warm, providing deep, restful sleep. Under normal circumstances, Fluffy poses no threat. However, it is extremely sensitive to flames. Once exposed to burning, it triggers a "rage mode" where its originally gentle appearance completely breaks down in fury, replaced by endless anger and iron fists.
ST_Item.Prison_Paralyser_usedesc: A paralytic drug specially made by Living Fossil. After injection, it induces a deep coma with a cause that's nearly impossible to determine.
ST_Item.Birthday_cake_des: A full team effort went into this anniversary celebration: Hotori funded it, Taygedo did the shopping, Edgar designed the cake, and Daffodill brought it to life. Sakiri and Nanally handled the decorations, while Adler crafted the sponge, cream, jam, frosting, and even tiny fondant figures of every Eborn member.  The preparations are complete… now all that's left is someone to blow out the candles.
ST_Item.abysspoint_usedesc: Miss Levi spends her days traveling through the Anomalous Realms, so she's bound to drop a few precious feathers along the way. If you can collect these feathers and return them to her, you'll receive a thank-you gift in return. However, when returning them, whatever you do, don't ask whether losing so many feathers affects her plumage… even if you mean well.
ST_Item.Universal_BusinessCard_1070_desc:
The namecard of Aurelia, the administrator of the Tamamochi Street.
Everyone on Tamamochi Street knows about her. When newcomers arrive, she usually drags them around to every shop in town before they even have a chance to ask her for her name. No wonder the box full of namecards that she printed when she took the job remains untouched.

ST_Item.PortableVision_Anomaly_041_desc: Cheese looks just like a camera, but when you press the shutter, it instantly freezes all living beings within the shooting range in a state of time suspension. Their bodies cannot move and their consciousness falls silent, as if trapped within a single frozen frame. Cheese is a one-time-use Anomaly that immediately disappears after use. Ordinary people are severely affected by Cheese, with freeze duration lasting up to dozens of hours, and they completely lose their memory afterward, only vaguely recalling a blinding flash. Some Espers are only frozen for a few minutes and can clearly recall all details before the shot, including the identity of the camera holder. Due to its potential uses including assassination, escape, and hostage situations, ordinary people have no access to it, and it currently circulates mainly in underground market bounty trades.

ST_Item.Prison_playboy_desc: In the monotony of unchanging days, everyone craves something new, whether inside or outside the cage. The only difference is that within these walls, a stack of glossy paper printed with the latest news takes on a value far beyond its cover price. Whoever has it holds the power to define the "free world." When everyone else knows nothing of the outside, only you stay informed. It might not help you in any practical way, but it's enough to create the illusion that the world hasn't forgotten you yet.

ST_Item.Prison_Spoon_desc: Many inmates firmly believe that "he who holds the spoon holds freedom." Because of this, cafeteria spoons vanish constantly, at a rate rivaling that of doctors' blue pens. Obviously, the number of successful spoon-based escapes is next to none. One might reasonably suspect that allowing inmates to keep spoons is actually a deliberate strategy by the guards to drain their enthusiasm for escape attempts.

Gems, carried by blind, lost ravens that are unable to land, their origins unknown to all.
Rumors say that those who pick up Oracle Stones will be struck by misfortune… Though, don't worry if you happen to find one; the mysterious lady from the Witch's House can dispel your misfortune.

ST_Item.Universal_stickers_1025_desc: Keeping the world at arm's length is just another way of staying connected to it.

ST_Item.food_017_desc: Gubichi's favorite nut snack, nourishing and tasty.
ST_Item.food_067_desc: Coffee and cream cheese, a sweet duo—"Take me with you!".
ST_Item.BusinessCard_Characterawaken_Haniel_desc: A snapshot of Haniel. One day, all of Hethereau will be listening to her songs. After all, it's the invincible Haniel!
ST_Item.BusinessCard_Characterawaken_Hathor_desc: A snapshot of Hathor. At some point, she started to realize the journey before the destination had great views.
ST_Item.Universal_stickers_1020_desc: Oh, hey, you're the one who… Wha-! Don't just say my username out loud in public!
ST_Item.SpecialGift_Fries_des: Oh, honest child, do you want the french fries dipped in ketchup, the french fries dipped in sundae, or the super duper cutest new flavor Frizzle?
ST_Item.Universal_avatar1_1010_desc: Where? There. Where is where? There is there, of course.
ST_Item.food_003_desc: Arouse your senses to a new day full of impetus injected by 0-K Cold Brew.
ST_Item.item_weekboss02_02_desc: A crown that only the "Ball Queen" may wear, but remember—"Heavy is the head that wears the crown."
ST_Item.Visions_furniture_12_UpMaterial_desc: Hey, kid, you've earned my respect.
ST_Item.food_022_desc: Drinking milk alone can't make you taller; you also need adequate exercise and good nutrition!
ST_Item.Prison_comic_desc: People locked up for piracy can hardly resist going back to their old ways, even behind bars. These bootleg magazines may have weird colors and plenty of typos, but at least they let inmates keep up with their favorite series.
ST_Item.Flower0019_des: Clusters of sky blue hydrangeas. Butterflies dance gracefully and linger reluctantly, like colorful clouds upon the earth.
ST_Item.Flower0020_des: Clusters of tender pink hydrangeas. Once, a romantic scholar cut the flowering branches, hoping only to make the blossoms stay.
ST_Item.Flower0024_des: Clusters of deep blue hydrangeas. With the light rain still falling and subtle fragrance drifting in the air, this is the perfect time for flower viewing.
ST_Item.Flower0022_des: Clusters of pink-purple hydrangeas. Sparrows chatter noisily, circling and singing around the flowers. The meaning behind it all is known only to the flowers and birds.
ST_Item.Flower0023_des: Clusters of blue-green hydrangeas. Elegant and fragrant, they refresh the mind and uplift the spirit of those who behold them.
ST_Item.Flower0021_des: Clusters of deep purple hydrangeas. The delicate flowers and tender leaves are like carved jade, bringing joy to the heart.
ST_Item.worldboss_material_05_usedesc: A mask fragment from the Nestbound Bird, commonly used as Character Ascension Material.
ST_Item.Title_Fishing_001_usedesc: Obtained with Scale Coins at Luna Bay. Grants the title: Hooked for Life.
ST_Item.RobBankLvExp_usedesc: Credit earned in the Pink Paws Heist game mode. Reach certain credit thresholds to claim corresponding rewards.
ST_Item.Abyss_ticket_usedesc: Ghost Train Logs collected in Beyond the Rails can be exchanged for various rewards at the Otherworld Salvage Station.
ST_Item.Visions_furniture_04_unlock_desc: In Hamster Ball's itty-bitty recipe book, there are crunchy bits, just like the peanuts in peanut brittle.
ST_Item.flower_sp_desc: Commonly considered an essential for expressing love. You can't do without it, but if it's just this… some might see it as a lack of creativity.
ST_Item.Combat_Avatar_01_desc: Meet Eibon's fiercest Restorer: a cutting-edge sea otter who speaks in cryptic tongues and couldn't clear a fence if he tried.
ST_Item.disc_desc_08: Falling at the city's edge… All loneliness will eventually be guided home like the tides.
ST_Item.flower_0002_desc:
Among all the flowers, you are the sunflower: you pursue, you strive, you are wholeheartedly committed. 
And I only need to follow your lead, moving towards that blazing golden realm, burning with your passion, fiercely reaching for the sun.
ST_Item.food_060_01_desc: The glass's rim is coated with a touch of sea salt. The subtle saltiness enhances the drink's sweet and sour notes, making them linger longer. This was Skia's favorite way to drink it in the past… though he now thinks it's a bit unhealthy.
ST_Item.item_WeaponBreakMaterial_05_lv2_desc: After appreciating countless theatrical performances, you've become a qualified Drama Master. That's it.
ST_Item.Universal_frame_1005_name: In the Middle of the Lake
ST_Item.Universal_frame_1005_desc: There may be a daffodil in the middle of the lake… or maybe not.
ST_Item.item_WeaponBreakMaterial_05_lv3_desc: Seated in the prime viewing area, you now gracefully applaud every performance—even when an actor has just flubbed their lines.
ST_Item.Universal_avatar1_1021_desc: Edgar knows a lot of things, but ragdE doesn't know a thing!
ST_Item.BusinessCard_Characterawaken_edgar_desc: A snapshot of Edgar. Tayge! Tayge Tayge! (Edgar! Best at puzzles! At Eibon! Taygedo certifies!)

ST_Item.food_021_desc: Blended fruit juice developed with existing juice products, a mixture of various flavors that gives you surprises.

ST_Item.PortableVision_Truck_usedesc: Taygedo's prototype toy car. Use in battle to dash forward to assist in combat.
ST_Item.PortableVision_Speaker_usedesc: Taygedo's super speaker. Use in battle to fire sound waves at target locations to assist in combat.

ST_Item.food_048_desc: Crispy on the outside and soft inside scone, paired with basil pesto and crispy bacon. A savory delight loved by the salty party!
ST_Item.RobBankItem_057_desc: A wide-mouth jar with an exterior as black as ink. Legend has it that a poor writer who couldn't afford paper and pen once practiced writing on household jars and bottles using charred wood. Over time, the black char became a permanent stain. People later crafted ink-stained jars to commemorate him.
ST_Item.RobBankItem_056_desc: A long-necked vase with an exterior as black as ink. Legend has it that a poor writer who couldn't afford paper and pen once practiced writing on household jars and bottles using charred wood. Over time, the black char became a permanent stain. People later crafted ink-stained vases to commemorate him.
ST_Item.RobBankItem_048_desc: A porcelain vase with a peculiar appearance. It's hard to tell what it's used for at just a glance. Hmm… but isn't being nice to look at a purpose in itself?
ST_Item.Furniture_teapoy_011_desc: Furniture with a marble texture. This minimalist square white coffee table adds a refined touch and complements diverse spaces.
ST_Item.Furniture_teapoy_012_desc: Furniture with a marble texture. This minimalist rectangular white coffee table adds a refined touch and complements diverse spaces.
ST_Item.Furniture_cabinet_007_desc: Furniture with marble texture. A long, low-profile storage cabinet with substantial capacity, perfect for displaying decor items and storing miscellaneous objects.
ST_Item.Visions_furniture_11_UpMaterial_desc: A stone as soft as spring flower petals, perfect for scraping away dust.
ST_Item.common_003_desc: Remove the warped label and you can see the original name of this item - Taygedo Protective Spray. Judging by its status quo, it has limited effect as protective equipment.
ST_Item.RobBankItem_006_desc: If you're still struggling with math homework, why not practice by calculating how much this gold bar is worth in Fons?
ST_Item.RobBankItem_007_desc: This many gold bars could lift all the misfortune of poverty… if only your hands could lift them.
ST_Item.Furniture_Chair_0012_desc: With a shape as relaxing as comfy clouds, this one fulfills the fantasy of reclining in the skies.
ST_Item.BusinessCard_Characterawaken_Nanally_des: A snapshot of Nanally. The maiden breaks away from gravity and leaps through the inverted world.
ST_Item.food_sp_002_desc: Tomato jelly that Lacrimosa has a special fondness for. Perfectly balanced between sweet and sour with the unique freshness of tomatoes. It's the taste she treasures most.
ST_Item.BusinessCard_Characterawaken_lacrimosa_d: A snapshot of Lacrimosa. If that round-shaped thing up there were a tomato, it could make a lot of Tomato Jelly…
ST_Item.Yahaha_Mu_Lamp01_BadBear_desc: A completely broken teddy bear, tattered beyond repair. Holding it always brings to mind scenes from horror movies…
ST_Item.Lost_Bag_desc: A leather briefcase made entirely according to stereotype. Open it up and you'll find even the contents match exactly what you'd expect from an office worker.

ST_Item.Furniture_cabinet_006_desc: Furniture crafted from solid wood, preserving the unique grain patterns of natural wood. A two-tier chest of drawers that provides large-capacity storage space, compatible with various furniture series as a home accent piece.
ST_Item.Furniture_shelf_002_desc: Furniture made of solid wood, retaining the unique texture of the material. The striped design is both aesthetically pleasing and practical, adding rustic charm.
ST_Item.Furniture_shelf_003_desc: Furniture made of solid wood, retaining the unique texture of the material. The simple three-tier design, featuring delicate natural textures, combines practicality with aesthetics, significantly enhancing both storage and decoration.
ST_Item.Furniture_teapoy_017_desc: Furniture crafted from solid wood, preserving the unique grain patterns of natural wood. A sturdy and durable wooden coffee table that meets practical needs while also serving decorative functions.

ST_Item.Furniture_Light_005_desc: A lamp emanating warm light. The square, minimalist design fits well with various modern home decor styles.
ST_Item.Furniture_Light_010_desc: A lighting fixture that radiates a warm glow. The aqua blue lamp stand complements its moon-like illumination, resembling a tranquil moon-lit sea by your bedside with its own unique charm.

ST_Item.Furniture_Light_002_desc: A lamp radiating warm light. The simple square lampshade design produces a soft glow that makes one feel cozy.
ST_Item.Furniture_Light_013_desc: A lighting fixture that radiates a warm glow. Features a minimalist modern design with high-powered bulbs that can illuminate even the darkest rooms like daylight.
ST_Item.Furniture_Light_003_desc: A lamp emanating warm light. The finely textured lampshade and distinctive style require a certain aesthetic sensibility to coordinate properly.
ST_Item.Furniture_Light_011_desc: A lighting fixture that radiates a warm glow. Features a simple yet elegant design with hazy shadows, like the gentle glow of reflected snow.
ST_Item.Furniture_Light_007_desc: A lighting fixture that radiates a warm glow. Features a simple yet elegant design with gentle, tranquil illumination as smooth and warm as jade.
ST_Item.Furniture_Light_004_desc: A lamp radiating warm light. The conical lamp post combined with a three-dimensional base, and the soft light lampshade at the top shining like a pearl, exudes a strong sense of artistry.
ST_Item.food_029_desc: A tofu dish emitting a unique flavor. The special smoking process gives it a rich and mellow flavor, and the melt-in-your-mouth tofu is sublimely flavored with a slightly charred aroma!
ST_Item.worldboss_material_06_usedesc: Ticket stub-shaped paper pieces from the Swallowtail, commonly used as Character Ascension Material.
ST_Item.FishingCoin_desc:
Fons isn't worthless here, but in this tight-knit community of fishing enthusiasts, some things simply can't be measured in Fons.
"Tight lines, buddy!"
ST_Item.MovablePlayer_des: Cubox Portable Player. Don't forget to bring a tape of music when you head out.
ST_Item.CabinetKey_usedesc: An ownerless locker key that can be used to open "Griddy" storage lockers throughout the city.
ST_Item.PortableVision_Anomaly_060_desc: In the unnoticed cracks of walls dwells an anomaly called "Peepy." It has no complete form, and no one can even describe its outline. All witnesses can confirm is a single eye hiding behind the wall cracks. Peepy is obsessed with observing the minutiae of human life: steam rising from breakfast stalls, lovers' hesitant fingertips under streetlights, drunkards mumbling profanities at trash cans… All these vivid moments of life give it a kind of warm, tingling sensation. Unfortunately, this careful voyeurism is always perceived as an intrusion, followed by screams and angry shouts. Now… Peepy has gotten smarter. It has collected a pile of sunglasses, convinced they're the perfect disguise, fantasizing that it's wearing them and boldly blending into the bustling crowds.
ST_Item.food_104_desc: A signature super-sized takoyaki worthy of the "Taishou" title. Made with whole octopus for maximum impact, each piece is soft, chewy, and bursting with fresh flavor. Even takoyaki made by an actual octopus would be hard-pressed to match this incredible taste.
ST_Item.Universal_stickers_1005_desc: Amidst countless shimmering lights, only you illuminated her eyes.
ST_Item.RobBankItem_009_desc: No matter how music trends evolve, there'll always be people listening to the golden hits of the last century.
ST_Item.Worldboss_material_02_usedesc: Monster material dropped by Headless Rider, commonly used as character Ascension material
ST_Item.BusinessCard_Characterawaken_Sagiri_desc: A snapshot of Sakiri. Oi, take this. What…? It's not like I saved it for you!
ST_Item.Visions_furniture_07_UpMaterial_desc: A fashion magazine? How strange, why would the Spider Knowledge Collector have this in their collection?
ST_Item.Furniture_Fishtank_002_desc: A tasteful fish tank. Its avant-garde design purposefully highlights the beauty of the underwater world.
ST_Item.Furniture_Fishtank_001_desc: A chic household fish tank. Its wooden foundation is stylized with a modern finish, pairing nicely with its artisanal glass walls. This fish tank is a natural addition to any sophisticated home!
ST_Item.food_096_desc: Blink! Wink Battle! Your eyes sparkle instantly, and today you are the shining star!
ST_Item.Vehicle023_Skin_4_desc: Bold colors and powerful patterns coalesce to transform your vehicle into a mighty maelstrom!
ST_Item.Universal_avatar1_1014_desc: It should be "all nines return to one," but the noble Jiuyuan insists that "ten" is the perfect number.
ST_Item.cookbook_14_desc:
An ordinary molten strawberry cake, adorned with cream and strawberries, has become surprisingly popular! If you hadn't baked it yourself, you'd suspect a witch had slipped a few drops of love potion into the ingredients.
"This is definitely not an Anomaly!" Mint said, scarfing down the last piece at BAC.
These cake samples were collected from Illusion Town residents, based on a recipe featured in a local magazine's Valentine's Day special—Strawberry Box Cake. The cake's online presence caught BAC's attention due to its unusually high success rate in love confessions.
If it's not an Anomaly, why does it always spark love in those who eat it?
ST_Item.Universal_frame_1057_desc: Reach out your hand before yesterday's melody shatters completely.
ST_Item.DefaultCard_1_desc: Your Choo-Choo maid is here. Choo! Please feel free to give me any orders.
ST_Item.Universal_stickers_1019_desc: A member of CSU-2, not to be confused with a fugitive employee of Pink Paws Bank.
ST_Item.food_091_desc: A gigantic hamburger steak that will make you gasp! Tailored for meat lovers, it's the ultimate indulgence!

ST_Item.PortableVision_Anomaly_058_desc: Initially, The Guide was discovered during a rescue operation. An Anomaly Hunter who got lost in the wilderness encountered a floating ring of smoke in the dim forest. It silently shifted shapes, guiding the Hunter and leading him out of danger. Today, these smoke ring-shaped Guides can be seen everywhere, deployed in large shopping malls and tourist attractions, replacing traditional store assistants. When someone asks for directions, The Guide always knows a shortcut… though not necessarily a safe one.
ST_Item.Universal_stickers_1010_desc: What's up? The big pink cat's got your back!
ST_Item.energy_addpotion_usedesc: An item that increases Character Pixels effectively. It loads the condition of the user's Character Pixels based on Character Photo Paper and fixes the sequential imbalance of Character Pixels with the sloshing sound of the specially programmed base solution, thus reducing the Noise in the Character Resolution Map under the Anomaly's influence. Grants 60 Character Pixels.
ST_Item.item_Fons_usedesc: A tech-packed credit card featuring a fountain motif. It marks the birth of the monetary economy and culture.
ST_Item.Coupon_005_desc: Friend, mourn not my body's passing! I am the Fons you've saved, accompanying you for life.
ST_Item.Universal_frame_1073_desc: The morning dew holds the world's reflection, and yet… and yet…
ST_Item.energy_desc: 本性像素存在存储上限，并会按时间恢复，当达到或超出上限时将停止恢复。 可消耗环石兑换本性像素。异象家具「织梦结」可以额外提高本性像素的可恢复上限
ST_Item.Furniture_Jukebox_003_desc: A simple, minimalist music player, perfect for quietly enjoying an old vinyl record on a lazy afternoon.
ST_Item.Coupon_007_desc: Yakitori from Budoriya, a delicious taste that will never disappoint you!
ST_Item.Visions_furniture_11_unlock_desc: A wandering warrior from a foreign land could not grant it true liberation.
ST_Item.food_010_desc: A burst of extreme coldness, as if gulping down the glacier.
ST_Item.food_024_desc: The perfect encounter between nut and chocolate. Each bite is a feast for your taste buds.
ST_Item.item_quest_K110358_desc: A newly developed pet head massager from a pet product manufacturer. It's said that no pet can remain rational under its claws! "Hmph! We dogs will never bow to this thing!" "Arf. Woof! Keep going, keep going! Don't stop! Woohoo!"
ST_Item.Prison_erodent_usedesc: The undiluted form of a highly corrosive disinfectant. Concentrated enough to corrode metal.
ST_Item.food_060_desc: Citrus and spices sketch out the contours of memories. People's pasts are torn apart and sewn back together, indistinguishable between genuine and insincere amidst clinking glasses. It's better not to distinguish.
ST_Item.item_quest_005_desc: A token of the Colucci Family. Unlike other tokens, the one you possess is truly a hidden exclusive.
ST_Item.Furniture_Chair_004_desc: The chair frame and sky blue cushion seamlessly meld together, creating a fresh and simple style that complements any setting.
ST_Item.Universal_stickers_1023_desc: A butterfly in graceful dreams. Vivid, free, and light as can be.
ST_Item.Visions_furniture_10_Output_desc: Fluffy yawned and shed cotton fluff everywhere, as warm and cozy as sunshine.
ST_Item.Furniture_cabinet_0014_desc: A piece of furniture made from oak. A storage cabinet with a generous capacity, perfect for displaying decor and storing everyday odds and ends.
ST_Item.Furniture_Chair_0011_desc: An ochre round soft stool, with a lightweight design to meet a multitude of needs.
ST_Item.food_093_desc: Welcome to Dream Island! After your little hero has recharged, try searching the store for traces of popular Anomalies! You'll get a super cool Anomaly figurine as a reward!
ST_Item.Universal_stickers_1070_desc: Sing of the sea, sing of time, sing of every star.
ST_Item.AdvVision_ticket_desc: Every victory deserves recognition… but could these cold, hard medals be traded for fluffy cotton candy instead?
ST_Item.Visions_furniture_13_UpMaterial_desc: On every cold armor plate that once burned hot, the king's name is engraved.
ST_Item.Coupon_002_desc: Weekly special offer! Whether you're feeling tired or enjoying your leisure time, 9°C is here to keep you company!
ST_Item.food_098_desc: A daily Zhu! Vitamin! for a perfect combo with a healthy lifestyle!
ST_Item.item_WorldMaterial_06_usedesc: Each time you open it, the books wrapped in the cover will be different. Although these books are not hard to come by, they are very convenient for people who just want to read aimlessly and casually. The only inconvenience is remembering not to close the book until you finish it.
ST_Item.Prison_Analgesic_desc: Rather than taking it yourself, think about how much useful stuff you could trade this "hard currency" for. That might actually be better for the pain… "When there's profit to be made, nothing hurts anymore!"
ST_Item.Furniture_draw_0013_desc: An early practice work by Bichir Whites. Though the brushwork appears somewhat immature, the color palette already shows hints of what would later become Mr. DSD's signature style. Just like the philosophy Mr. Whites has always adhered to: when he paints a glass of water, it is simply a glass of water.
ST_Item.FrokPiece_Mamen_desc: A fluffy, soft yarn ball. Even kitten Anomalies would purr with satisfaction from just a single touch!
ST_Item.food_008_desc: Bubbles and health can be a perfect combo! It is even healthier without sugar.
ST_Item.food_009_desc: A combo of bubbles and lemon brings you an unprecedented sour-sweet flavor! Put it in cold storage for an even better taste.
ST_Item.Flower0017_des: The eternally blooming peach rose. In dreams filled with floral fragrance, a traveler softly hums a song from home.
ST_Item.Flower0003_desc: The eternally blooming white rose is like a hymn that lingers on the first snow, growing purer as the sky darkens.
ST_Item.Flower0016_des: The eternally blooming pink rose. He takes the bouquet she had kissed and presses it against his heart, like a burning vow.
ST_Item.Flower0018_des: The eternally blooming purple rose. In the depths of the forest, tiny beings no bigger than a finger use the petals as their cradles.
ST_Item.Flower0001_desc: The eternally blooming red rose, dyed with the heart and song of a nightingale, comes from the little bird's burning love.
ST_Item.Flower0002_desc: The eternally blooming blue rose has its secret hidden in the smallest room under the castle, but you must never open the door.
ST_Item.Flower0000_desc: The eternally blooming golden rose, a legendary spring of gold that burns the covetous.
ST_Item.food_083_desc: Springy ramen in a rich soy-based broth, simmered with kombu and matsutake. Topped with crispy handmade tofu skin—both fragrant and irresistible!
ST_Item.Universal_frame_1029_desc: In the mountains' deep slumber, the soft murmur of falling snow.
ST_Item.Visions_furniture_10_unlock_desc: Boiling blue flames and the roar of midnight beat wildly within the heart.
ST_Item.Prison_Towerkey_usedesc: Key to the Detention Center watchtower. Unlocks the gate to reach the rooftop.
ST_Item.BusinessCard_Characterawaken_fadia_desc: A snapshot of Fadia. For those who know her, whenever she wears that expression, it means the game has just begun.
ST_Item.Visions_furniture_09_UpMaterial_desc: Note: This product is intended only for Fluffy maintenances! We assume no responsibility for any adverse reactions resulting from direct consumption.
ST_Item.food_032_desc: As cute as snow, this pure and soft bean dish has seen struggles between the salty taste and the sweet taste. Why not try a spicy one?
ST_Item.Universal_stickers_1008_desc: The system is my hunting ground.
ST_Item.Furniture_Chair_0013_desc: A great house product combining aesthetics and practicality. The streamlined white chair body and layered baby blue base create a perfect contrast.
ST_Item.Furniture_Gacha_eri_004_name: Asahi Inori - Moon in the Mirror
ST_Item.food_045_desc: Rich cheddar cheese and creamy gouda cheese molten layer by layer on fresh beef patties—a cheesy showdown is about to erupt!
ST_Item.BusinessCard_Characterawaken_Jin_desc: A candid photo of Hotori. When she spots a rare treasure, price is never the question. She always knows when to make her move
ST_Item.SpecialGift_ticket_des: A limited-edition movie ticket for the Floe Cinema. Present this ticket to any usher for a free movie. "If you're unsure how to break the ice, perhaps this could be the 'ticket' to your wildest dreams!"
ST_Item.BusinessCard_Characterawaken_haiyue_desc: A candid photo of Aurelia. She still sometimes thinks of her closest friends, like a traveler glancing back at home.
ST_Item.worldboss_material_07_desc: Seawater, tears, or perhaps the sea's own tears?
ST_Item.Prison_Uniform_usedesc: A jumpsuit issued to detainees at the Hethereau Detention Center.
ST_Item.Prison_BedSheet_usedesc: A bed sheet issued in the cells of Hethereau Detention Center. Tear it apart to get cloth strips.
ST_Item.food_060_01_name: Sea Salt Deep in the Heart
ST_Item.food_sp_004_desc: The hugely popular Clicky Fries that can easily hold their own against even the Frizzle.
ST_Item.item_WeaponUpMaterial_lv3_desc: A special arc dye. Enhances arc performance quickly without side effects, except for the high price.
ST_Item.food_089_desc: The perfect combination of fresh lemon slices and Acqua Frizzante al Limone, with a touch of mint leaves, brings a refreshing taste.
ST_Item.Furniture_Chair_0015_desc: A refreshing color scheme, perfect for sitting on the balcony and sunbathing.
ST_Item.food_002_desc: Light tea that unlocks a new refreshing chapter for you. TeaRealm T-Fusion brings you a different urban tea-drinking experience.
ST_Item.food_074_desc: Sizzling, juicy meat skewers with the rich, intoxicating aroma of cumin. A temptation that haunts even the most dedicated fitness enthusiasts.
ST_Item.Prison_gameboy_desc: The scratched-up plastic casing is proof that it has survived countless surprise searches and chaotic brawls. The guards are thorough when they search, perhaps because those night shifts can be so hard to get through.
ST_Item.food_034_desc: A sushi boat with a variety of different handmade sushi, stocked with seasonal fresh ingredients, coupled with a small dish of wasabi soy sauce that carries your craving for food. To the faraway land, set sail!
ST_Item.PortableVision_Anomaly_061_desc: Drop into the left eye to see his chains, drop into the right eye to understand her loneliness. Anomaly product eye drops that, once applied, briefly allow you to enter another's view and borrow their eyes to re-examine the world. After using the eye drops, someone sitting on a park bench suddenly finds themselves on all fours, transformed into their own pet dog. Everything becomes blurry, the scenery fades, and the whole world turns dull gray. This is a dog's view after all, unable to even distinguish traffic lights. Miraculously, whenever they look at their "self" on the bench, everything turns bright yellow. It turns out that in a dog's eyes… their owner glows!
ST_Item.PortableVision_Hospital_Smoke_usedesc: When activated, creates a smoke screen that blocks line of sight, then dissipates after a short time.
ST_Item.Equipment_PurpleTicket_desc: Gray rabbits love shiny carrots that taste like the moon.
ST_Item.Flower0004_desc:
The brilliantly blooming sunflower loves vivaciously and passionately, remaining as bright as the day it first bloomed, with its colors refusing to peel off like paint.
"After losing my ears, I only look at you, like a sunflower."
ST_Item.food_030_desc: Fried until golden, this dish is crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. Careful, it's hot!
ST_Item.cookbook_14_usedesc: The sold-out Valentine's Day dessert special unlocks the recipe for Strawberry Box Cake.
ST_Item.food_071_desc: Caramel and crunchy nuts jump on the tip of your tongue, as if reveling in a golden autumn harvest feast. Whoever counts calories at this moment, let them be forever alone!
ST_Item.flower_0001_desc:
Love is the paradoxical unity of beauty and fragility, the entanglement of the fleeting and the eternal. It is like a rose blooming in a garden, nurtured with care, reflecting those rich and passionate moments in life. 
My floral language speaks of intense love.
But also beware of the thorns that follow the tenderness.

ST_Item.Yahaha_Mu_Lamp01CookFormula_desc:
Ingredients:
3 eggs, 35g corn oil, 40g milk, 50g cake flour, 30g granulated sugar, half a lemon
Instructions:
1. Separate egg whites and yolks into two bowls.
2. In a new bowl, add 35g corn oil and 40g milk, whisk until yogurt-like consistency.
3. Add egg yolks and cake flour, mix until smooth.
4. Take egg whites from refrigerator, add lemon juice, gradually add sugar in three portions and whip thoroughly.
5. Take 1/3 of the meringue and fold into the egg yolk mixture until evenly combined.
6. Pour the mixed cake batter into the meringue bowl and fold until evenly combined.
7. Pour cake batter into mold, use a toothpick to pop surface bubbles.
8. Bake in oven at 150°C for 60 minutes.

ST_Likeability.1001_des: She has a lively, cheerful, and outgoing personality, is warm and generous, and possesses a strong sense of humanity. She is curious about the unknown and speaks frankly and directly, clearly expressing her likes and dislikes. However, she is unexpectedly slow to react in certain areas, and becomes incoherent when nervous. She has extremely poor learning abilities and surprisingly bad intuition, consistently ranking last in all internal exams by guessing and avoiding all correct answers.

In Illica's otherwise smooth-sailing life, "getting along with her relative Haniel" was definitely not on the list. From major things like exam grades to trivial matters like who could eat the spiciest chili, everything was a competition. What should have been a farce that ended with graduation was now playing out once again at Sterry Express. The mysterious shop owner and underboss are just silent coworkers, and as for the secrets behind Sterry…
"Secrets? That doesn't matter. What matters most is that I can't lose to Haniel!"

ST_Likeability.H_NPC_01902_des:
There's a saying in Hethereau's racing circles: "An anomaly hunter who can't make tofu will never be a good racer."
Creating a perfect plate of fried tofu first tests a master's knife skills. The thickness of each slice determines the final texture. Next comes temperature control, where the heat can't be too high or too low. Finally, there's timing: three minutes to prepare the perfect fried tofu, three minutes to finish a race. While the engine cools down, tender fried tofu with secret sauce makes the perfect pairing.

Skia's first positive impression of the Bureau occurred when he was updating his resume.
He decided to give the job at the Bureau a try when he was invited to apply, but the formality of a resume was still required. Since leaving his previous job, he hadn't bothered to think of resumes and job applications… Now, he had no choice but to polish up his old resume.
 He uploaded a new ID photo, replacing the original one—he nearly didn't recognize the young man in the portrait anymore—then clicked submit.
 —This is usually where the systems tell him "face not detected, please upload an appropriate portrait" and what not. Strangely, the file was submitted without issue.

ST_Loading.loading_5_2:
Esper Abilities are supernatural, non-reality abilities awakened in ordinary humans, which can generally be divided into six types based on different manifestations: Cosmos, Anima, Incantation, Lakshana, Psyche, and Chaos.
Not all Esper Abilities are powerful or possess battle capabilities. Some abilities are weak and some even somewhat comical.
ST_Loading.loading_2_2:
Anomaly is an umbrella term for all beings, objects, phenomena, places, and memes that possess supernatural attributes from a human perspective.
The origins of Anomaly manifestations are varied, but their very existence in this world is the greatest unsolved mystery.
ST_Loading.loading_10_2:
The Circle refers to the authorities on anomaly related matters.
Strictly speaking, the Circle usually refers to the five topmost authorities: the Bureau of Anomaly Control, the Celaeno Compound, the Yggash Court, the Zerogon Laboratory, Ghroth Island, and the Supreme Tribunal A6.
However, in a broader sense, the Circle also refers to various public institutions, as well as private Anomaly Hunters or Hunter organizations.
ST_Loading.loading_19_2:
These members of the Circle don't answer to any public authorities, but rather conduct anomaly investigation, containment, and nullification work under their tacit approval. Anomaly Hunters often form or operate under companies or businesses.
Their revenue comes from a wide variety of channels, including guilds and private commissioners.
ST_Loading.Hospital_1_2:
A nameless hospital abandoned after an unknown incident; an inescapable nightmare, ever-present yet never defined.
"Its name, its past, its truth… You will come to know them all."
ST_Loading.loading_22_2:
Generally speaking, Anomalies have Wertheimer Index values in the negative range below -1, while espers have values in the positive range above 1. The larger the absolute value, the greater the degree of deviation from reality.
Things that do not deviate from reality at all theoretically have a Wertheimer Index of 0. Since being affected by Anomalies or Esper Abilities in daily life is quite common, ordinary humans typically have actual Wertheimer Index values between -1 and 1.
ST_Loading.loading_29_2:
An Oddity that has a contract with the Dvořák family, whose time of appearance is beyond memory.
Legend says the Dvořák family's vast wealth comes from the mysterious Ladon. Please do not call it by any name other than "Ladon," and when necessary, use the title "Lord Ladon." As for nicknames like "udon"… no matter where you heard that, you must forget it immediately.
ST_Loading.loading_6_2: Individuals who have awakened an Esper Ability are called Espers. Theoretically, Espers have varying lifespans depending on the impact of their awakening. Some Espers are no different from ordinary people. Others may have a significantly shorter expected lifespan as the "price" of their awakening, while some may live longer, and some may even become effectively immortal.
ST_Loading.loading_23_2:
A comprehensive social media platform in Hethereau.
It covers all functions that support expressing opinions and sharing info with others, including forum posts, friends' feed updates, messaging, albums, rolls, live streaming, and more.
ST_Loading.loading_8_2: The more humans interact with Anomalies, learn about them, and become obsessed, the more likely they are to be affected physically and even mentally. This phenomenon is called Encroachment.
ST_Loading.loading_25_2:
Anomalies that integrate into society as Anomaly Citizens, enjoying civil rights while also bearing civil obligations.
Most Anomalies with citizen status are Oddities, but this is not limited to Bio Anomalies. Other types of Anomalies that have received sponsorship, possess self-awareness and autonomous behavioral capacity, have sufficient intelligence, and have passed evaluation can also become Anomaly Citizens.
ST_Loading.loading_15_2:
Real-time monitoring of Wertheimer Index fluctuations is an essential means of maintaining vigilance against high-level Anomalies manifesting in our world.
Large-scale measurements have already been popularized primarily through Wertheimer Towers, but more convenient and precise measurement technology has not yet been achieved on a technical level. Accurate measurement of Wertheimer Index values for specific targets requires quite complex procedures to accomplish.
ST_Loading.loading_3_2:
The critical point when a specific intervention is applied to an Anomaly, causing its internal or external manifestation to undergo drastic changes.
The Nexus is one of the core characteristics of an Anomaly, closely related to the Anomaly's form of existence, behavioral choices, and its response modes to external interventions. Current research has yet to provide a comprehensive explanation of it.
Each Anomaly's Nexus is unique, often playing a key role in the containment or nullification of the Anomaly.
ST_Loading.loading_17_2:
For some Anomalies with a certain level of intelligence, as well as some Anomaly owners, sponsorship means protection. Through sponsorship, the basic rights and safety of that Anomaly being allowed to exist in human society can be maintained.
Sponsorship is not mandatory, does not mean that the sponsored Anomaly necessarily has citizen status, does not mean that the sponsor and the Anomaly have necessarily signed a contract, nor does it contain implications of a master-servant power relationship. It has the broadest scope of coverage.
ST_Loading.loading_24_2:
"OP" refers to the "original poster" on Bagel.
You can see bagel-shaped barcodes covered with sesame seeds posted in places, called "Sesame Codes." You can scan these Sesame Codes to view the corresponding Bagel pages.
It's convenient in every way, and has become an indispensable platform in modern life.
ST_Loading.loading_18_2:
A domain constructed by an Anomaly using its own abilities that cannot be mapped to real-world coordinates.
The Anomalous Realm itself is, in most cases, one of the abilities of the main Anomaly. Therefore, what is commonly referred to as an Anomalous Realm generally cannot be considered an independent derivative Anomaly, and is thus distinguished from the concept of Location Anomalies that can be mapped to real-world coordinates.
ST_Loading.loading_16_2:
The influence that Anomalies have on real, ordinary things.
Minor Encroachment rarely manifests visibly. Major Encroachment manifests in various ways depending on the corresponding Anomaly.
Encroachment caused by the same type of Anomaly also manifests differently depending on the form of the real thing, such as living beings or objects.
ST_Loading.loading_9_2:
The city where the headquarters of the Bureau of Anomaly Control is located. It is an inclusive, open, and fashionable metropolis.
Since the establishment of the headquarters, this city has become a paradigm of public safety. Its influence can be seen in the city's design and atmosphere, placing Hethereau at the forefront of global Anomaly and Esper applications.
ST_Loading.loading_27_2:
A commercial bank under the Dvořák Group.
One of Hethereau's largest commercial banks with a long operating history and strong financial foundation. Its branches and ATMs are commonly seen throughout the city. The main building is located in the downtown area, and its Pink Paws logo originates from the anomaly Ladon, which has a Contract with the Dvořák family.
ST_Loading.loading_7_2:
All espers have paid a price for their abilities, be it mental, or physical, or something abstract and unfathomable like "karma" or certain weaknesses that had only surfaced after their awakening.
It is worth noting that the price may not follow the "law of equivalent exchange", and its effects are often unmeasurable.
ST_Loading.loading_online_1_2:
Play with up to 4 friends as you explore and adventure in the same world together.
In multiplayer, team up to take on fierce anomalies, challenge each other in arcade games, speed through the streets of Hethereau, visit other players' uniquely decorated homes, and much more.
ST_Loading.loading_6_4:
Espers can be divided into two categories based on when they acquire their Esper Ability: Espers from nature and Espers from nurture, who usually undergo a specific life-changing event.
In terms of appearance, some Espers have no obvious differences from ordinary people, while others exhibit features distinct from ordinary humans, such as animalistic appearances, horns, or neon-colored skin.
ST_Loading.loading_28_2:
A variety show funded and produced by the Dvořák family.
Inspired by the movie Vault Heist, the Dvořák family partnered with renowned directors to create a variety show called Pink Paws Heist, aiming to give citizens a chance to experience a different kind of life. However, while winners receive generous rewards, they also seem to be added to some mysterious list…?
ST_Loading.loading_26_2:
Chairman of Pink Paws Bank, eldest son of the Dvořák family, and Hethereau's renowned love poet.
Forever pursuing true love, he pays no attention to anything else he considers "trivial matters." Though passionate by nature, his relationship with his children seems rather strained.
ST_Loading.loading_20_2:
A confirmed product created or invented with the participation of one or more Espers using their abilities, where the inclusion of esper abilities is an essential and irreplaceable part of the product's creation process that cannot be substituted by ordinary materials or methods used by regular people.
These can be divided into two major categories: esper technologies and esper constructs.
ST_Loading.loading_13_2:
The act of collecting the remnants of Anomaly Activity and other Anomaly-related elements.
Apart from handing over the contained or temporarily contained Anomaly itself, sending the captured Anomaly-related elements to Midas Technologies may also assist in the research of the Anomaly. Based on contributions in this area, one may sometimes receive an "Arc" that carries part of the anomaly's abilities as a reward.
ST_Loading.loading_1_2:
Wertheimer Index is the value used to measure the degree of deviation from reality of a subject.
With this value, it is possible to determine whether a subject is an Anomaly or an esper.
The Wertheimer Index is also an important reference to classify Anomalies.
ST_Loading.loading_11_2: The act of temporarily restricting and isolating Anomalies is classified as "Temporary Containment". It is more common for Anomalies with lower or stable threats and is generally applicable to Anomalies that can be controlled by conventional technology, isolation facilities, or standard containment procedures. Sometimes it can be performed with Esper Abilities as well.
ST_Loading.loading_12_2: The act of restraining and isolating Anomalies through critical measures, preventing them from posing threats to reality or human society.
ST_Loading.loading_4_2: The act of critically erasing an Anomaly from the human world is classified as "nullification." However, nullification does not annihilate the Anomaly entirely, and it may still emerge into the human world.
ST_Loading.loading_14_2:
A newly developed city marked by rapid growth and a large population. 
Once criticized as being "well constructed in every respect, yet lacking character," the arrival of the Anomaly, "Hypervortex," has stained the city with an inescapable sense of abnormality.
