ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_094: Kenneth… Isn't that the cook who hired us?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_134: What did Kenneth talk about before?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00201_016: Wait… Kenneth went to you guys, too?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC010_032: Mr. Kenneth arrived not long ago. You came back at the right time.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00201_007: Kenneth exchanged 10 years of his sense of taste for a dish that would grant his restaurant another star. I gave up 20 years of my sense of smell for a unique fragrance that would go down in history…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_066: A bid of 1 Fons, no competition, then the gavel hits—by the book, really. Is our unexpected guest about to become Ebisu's VIC?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_048: After the bid and the gavel drop, Ms. Thief "bought" the item for 1 Fons "normally." If so, why was the security anomaly triggered…?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00201_017: Once I leave, I'll contact Bianca right away and transfer the commission fee to your establishment's account.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_084: …so many faces… so many names… Let me think…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_005: I'm a taxi driver. I start at 8 AM and finish at 8 PM. For lunch, I grab something quick from a convenience store. After work, I go to Food First for a set meal.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_094: The cost of defeating the current culinary virtuoso is a lifetime's sense of taste… No wonder he hesitated.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_053: Let's not compromise the dignity of Eibon over such a small matter.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC011_002: Ah, <TypingTitle titlename="Line from Sin City Chronicles" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">"A capable boss makes promises to the family, but keeps things unspoken with outsiders."</> Get it?
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC008_013: Tch, the contract says we don't have to pay for damages!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_004: Hmph, I got the fastest delivery record, you snail!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_050: You've got to be kidding me. Eibon has one of the lowest customer satisfaction scores on Hyelp……
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_072: Was that an Anomalous Realm, or some baddie's Esper Ability?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_009: Was that a Space Anomaly, or someone's Esper Ability?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC010_023: Miss Bianca had some misunderstandings about Eibon earlier, I hope you won't take it to heart.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_042: I didn't notice before, but wow… it's grown so tall already!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_067: What was that just now? Something… from the past?
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC012_005: I found a key to the basement earlier but haven't investigated it yet.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC01001_002: We just got the message that they're booked until next week! But they want us to stay closed until the situation is addressed.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_076: It was bright just a moment ago. Why is it so small and dark here now?
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC011_002: Wasn't that the owner of <TypingTitle titlename="Photo Studio" titlecolor="grey" font="16" contextcolor="blue">Film Orbit Studio</>? He always looks anxious, and he seems even more worried today!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC009_010: That bookshelf seems to be targeted by a viewfinder. As Sakiri guessed, the anomaly nexus might be related to cameras. Let's use that as a clue.
ST_MainDialogue.HM_Prologue_MainSQC006_Alphard_00007: I'm sure you wouldn't want to be stuck here and be monitored by the BAC every day after leaving Ghroth Island, right?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_059: You'd be gravely mistaken if you think I'd be scared here on your turf!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_052: Do not let your guard down. Be careful.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_072: No worries. It's not your fault. Besides, we hunters are used to being pulled into Anomalous Realms.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC009_017: Ha, don't worry, the containment level needs your expertise more.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_043: The branches might be thin, but they're sturdy. Nanally, do you want to climb it?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_060: Stop fooling around. Ebisu has sold Class V Anomalies before.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_031: Don't be sad. You'll catch new crickets, with shinier shells and better songs.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC027_001: We're here. The Eibon Antique Shop.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_045: Is it really here? The client didn't mean it as a hole in the ground, right? Like a hole behind these trees that we can't see?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC009_004: If that happens, what you'll have to do… won't be as simple as a bit of cleaning. Do. You. Understand?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_008: It looks like we'll need to take care of the first two items today…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1049_007: Two nights ago, little Renee and I finished dinner and were about to head home. She offered to give me a ride, so we walked to the parking lot together. That's when we encountered this "cloaked person"…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_022: Leave the thinking to my minions!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_055: What do you mean by "bring it to life"?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC01401_033: Have you gotten the news which group took the items?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC010_009: If both Lady and the appraiser step in, there must be more to the commission than meets the eye.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC016_012: Including privately containing a Class V anomaly?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC008_002: As if little Taygedo could pull off some secret mission behind our backs…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_091: There's no way a crappy door can stop Master and the Ichi-daime!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02501_024: I am very sorry, my attitude just now might have caused you some trouble. Perhaps we should communicate as equals.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_059: The banquet hall's all lit up for another masquerade.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC009_024: Unilateral plundering doesn't deserve to be called <blue>pawning</>.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1050_006: Chaos, consider this: if anyone received a black card from the anomaly, you are welcome to bring them to the Witch's House for divination.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1050_004: The cards are the derivatives, aren't they?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_107: It should end at three o'clock.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_053: Crisis or not, rules must be followed. How "civilized"!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_026: About the final auction item… Any thoughts, boss?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC012_016: The original reason for not considering this scenario was insufficient manpower… After all, Mr. Adler and the Appraiser are already needed to play Taygedo's subordinates, making it difficult for them to simultaneously create the crisis.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_144: So… we used to be puppets…
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC001_026: So, you're an Appraiser! No wonder you're like an anomaly radar!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_105: She's been here all along, waiting for me to come home.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_003: I see. In his eagerness to impress, Taygedo unconsciously told a better story than reality is, about Eibon and himself.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_028: I see, so Taygedo has to make sense of it.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_148: So that's basically it. Everything Renee and I saw… was just an illusion from the Debt Collector's Anomalous Realm.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_008: Interesting ability. It took us a long time to understand Taygedo, but now he won't be lonely.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_020: Oh… Did I really say that?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC011_016: An anomaly auction? And that Grinster left that tidbit out?!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_082: So it's done with <TypingTitle titlename="Anomaly" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">Picky</>.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC034A_031: Oh, you mean Azure Vista! I've seen people mention it in their posts!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_Player_032: So that's how things turn into photos.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_061: I see, so that's the psychological strategy at play here.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC034A_011: Wow, I had no idea there was such a history!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_058: Whoa, it's already so late! Today was… a lot of work without a lot of results, huh?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_255: I never realized there were many delicious dishes beyond the set meals at Food First. Why did I never try them before?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_227: Forgive me? I can still earn your forgiveness? And Mom will also…?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_029: The original invitation has a <blue>contract</> with the invitee. A replica of this level indeed can't pass inspection.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_254: I visited lots of quirky shops and tasted all their signature snacks.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_014: Entry to this auction requires a <blue>Special Invitation</>. Only guests of a certain status are eligible.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC04306_004: It's not like I did anything wrong, right? I spent so much time molding it. If it can't hold its shape, what's the point of it all?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_256: Or rather… why is Food First the only place I remember?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_035: Off it goes again. Hey, at least say thank you!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_022: The twins said the cost depends on the weight of the wish. I thought about wishing to become the best manga artist in the world just for fun! But they said it would cost me twenty years of my sight.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_014: Everything that happened here, everything about us, reenacts over and over again at this place.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_019: There's been some shuffling on the guest list too. Security's on high alert, so let's tread carefully.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_017: The cards in the pocket…? Huh…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_074: On the other hand, since Taygedo believes this is the best way to express his feelings fully, we should support his all-out effort as his friends. After all, our initial goal was to help him avoid any regrets.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC012_015: Furthermore, I've compiled statistics on the frequency of the "Damsel in Distress" trope in various shoujo manga series. The data confirms a consistent rise in reader popularity when this scenario is employed.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_066: Moreover, the attention and admiration from onlookers will create a sort of… invisible pressure.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_112: Got a few other things to verify.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_024: If it only says Eibon… then who exactly is this hint for…? Or could it be meant for all of us…?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_023: But… the black cards in the puppets' clothes…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC021_030: It's just a reference. You could see it as a fun story.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_082: But his wish hasn't come true.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC013_001: It's just a low threat anomaly. Does it really warrant a personal visit from Hotori?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_048: Just a coincidence or a vague statement.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_052: However, you've always taught us that true grace lies in upholding our principles even in the face of injustice. I humbly ask that you reconsider your actions, Sir.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_054: But Mother… we don't understand. Why are your eyes solely fixed on Renee?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC012_034: It's just speculation… but from all the clues, it seems that one of the two has an exchange ability related to the <blue>pawn contract</>.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_051: I assume we only need to confirm its authenticity and then bid to win it. Do we really need to arrange for extra help?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_046: It's best to remain vigilant in Anomalous Realms, especially with clocks.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_052: Ms Thief and I think alike. If I were after a super discount on the target anomaly, I'd play it the same way.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC009_026: I was just checking… Well, consider this a deal.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_069: However, I personally have some reservations about this plan…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_101: Only Renee's number is different! We… we won't let it turn into 0!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_115: We'll have to check the study.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC002_013: Once this Anomaly is contained and nullified, we can disclose what occurred to the public. Hopefully, our transparency will contain the situation.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_018: As long as information flows, Sterry Express is likely involved.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_212: If only I could go back to the past, back to that last day at home…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC02303_004: If you're handy, you can mold this anomaly dough into anything you want… at least to look like anything you want. It's pretty cheap too. I use it to decorate the place with something fancy. When I get bored of one, I can just remold it into something else.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC034A_027: As long as the toys belong to me and are loved, I can share my will with them!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00301_012: I just want to bust this fraud of a pawnshop and get my sense of taste back!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_067: As long as this makes you happy and fulfills your final wish, we'll maintain the facade of harmony… until that child's curse destroys us all.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_012: I only need one day. Friends helping one another is a beautiful thing, don't you think?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_076: It would've been so much easier to pretend and spoil you the way Mother did. We could have created the harmonious family Mother wanted, even if it was just a facade. That would have sufficed.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_088: Don't underestimate this one. The <blue>rules</> it enforces can't be broken by any external force within its domain.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_045: Don't go around saying I'm tough on the rookies, okay?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_190: But why… is my childhood self here? Back then, who was actually "it"? Was it Mom?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_106: And why is the puppet also called Bella?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_023: Excuse me, but we are interested in this diamond. Can we talk about this for a bit?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC034A_016: Really? Thank you! Thank you so much!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_071: But what did you do? You barely scooped some dirt before rushing to Mother for praise. When Mother saw the cuts on your hands from fooling around, she scolded Teresa for giving you hard work.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_080: That's a lot of people though… When I drive a taxi, I don't need to speak to more than two or three passengers…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC015_026: Don't forget my fee, new friend.
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Mint_00014: Don't worry, Coco. I'll protect you!
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Mint_00031: Coco! You're my seventh most respected person!
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Mint_00028: Coco, no time to waste, let's go!
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Mint_00039: Coco, don't you think there's something off about this place?
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Mint_00008: Coco?! Are you here to help?!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_021: Poor petal, it seems that even after forgetting us, you still haven't found what you desired.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC05901_005: Unfortunately, when you were scheming against others, you forgot that others might be secretly watching you too.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC00815_002: That's a pity. Dolores has the finest wine and chefs that I've ever known…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_042: Unfortunately, you abandoned all of our duties. You betrayed us and committed an unforgivable sin.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_011: But I don't remember owing anyone money. I did nothing to deserve harassment from this "Debt Collector."
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_165: But we couldn't stop Zankou from taking the Eternal Present…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_069: But did I just upset them? They don't seem too happy to see me.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_288: But I want to play with the Mighty King… he's been with me for a long, long time.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC001_020: But… but… it will delay safely guiding you to Eibon.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_151: But… Mom… our beloved Mom… where is she now?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_061: But didn't the Constantines disappear decades ago? That doesn't match up with my age…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_056: Renee… is the worst of us all. Always noisy, endlessly crying, habitually screaming, and forever demanding of your attention, like any other selfish child…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_079: However, in the face of death, in the face of the curse you brought upon us, even the most sincere love wears out. From the moment you were born, we've been shrouded in the shadow of your curse.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC021_027: Perhaps because her future extended indefinitely, with no end in sight. All I could see was… blankness.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC08901_004: Effortless recreation of your vision… How is it? Doesn't it feel like magic?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_109: Didn't this family disappear over fifty years ago? How could I…?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_059: But your name also appeared on the registry! Does that not matter at all? The youngest daughter that you love most…  declared the end of your life.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_004: The chatty one is Haniel! I'm Illica, the record holder for on-time deliveries this month!
ST_MainDialogue.HM_Prologue_MainSQC005_Alphard_00002: The Hypervortex was nullified, and <blue>Code Zero</> disappeared as well.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_072: I decided against mentioning it, partly to avoid dampening their enthusiasm, but also for two other reasons.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_103: How about we ask Lady Dolores?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_013: I heard from Jiuyuan that the appraiser and you, Nanally, have visited Sterry Express before—
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_021: See, I hesitated because I had to pay a price.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_035: It'd be good to hear what others have to say.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_070: Did you hear that? <blue>"The villain who stole the auction piece…"</> We've finally reached a happy consensus.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00905_002: Word is he got caught up in some trouble and had a rough time of it.
ST_MainDialogue.MT_DMP01_01_0020_02: It's said he saw the truth, As delicious as the star pie.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC01208_001: That should be Bella, the eldest daughter of Lady Dolores. She's the organizer of this farewell banquet.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_290: That sounds scary, I don't wanna—
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_049: Evidence of its accuracy is either too hard to gather or only declared reliable after it comes true.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC012_045: Sounds like an Anomalous Realm that requires a specific condition to enter…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC012_020: Sounds like a Space anomaly that opens on certain conditions…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_002: Sounds like a magazine on anomaly collection?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_001: This noise is making my head hurt, argh—
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Mint_00040: It's so noisy, and everyone's being so mean! Can't they give it a rest?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_046: Shut up already! I told you not to eat it, you stupid thing! if you're gonna puke, puke somewhere else!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_063: Uh… but how do I do that?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC09001_012: Um… alright. P-Please have a nice day.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_083: Uh… It said to be quiet…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_047: Uh… well… ahem… I stumbled into that place by luck. It was really dark, so I forgot…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_022: Umm… like a coded message in Sin City Chronicles… This is some kind of hint! The hint is… something that I, the Ichi-daime, should definitely be able to figure out…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_041: Uh… Yeah…! Boss and Adler! Very nostalgic and loyal people.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_075: Uh… maybe we should investigate before… taking action.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_049: Uhm… should we give it a try anyway?
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Mint_00021: Uh… it's so dark in this tunnel! …Coco, don't be scared!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_089: Ah, I can't take it! My head's going to explode!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_048: Keep the collar safe, dummy. We're giving it back to the poor guy when we meet him!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC012_032: Ask her to bring Boomboom here. He can come in just fine!
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Mint_00042: Waaah, Coco… At times like this, your voice is even more soothing…
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Mint_00009: Oh, you're the best! Once we deal with this thing, lemme treat you to a feast!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_006: Woohoo! An anomaly auction, how cool is that!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02201_016: Monday is <TypingTitle titlename="Drama" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">Gen Z</>. Thursday is <TypingTitle titlename="Drama" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">Duke K</>. Friday we go to buy <TypingTitle titlename="Monthly Manga" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">Monthly Romance</> and <TypingTitle titlename="Weekly Manga" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">Weekly Fantasy</>. Sunday is our mandatory workout day.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_Player_039: No anomaly presence detected around here, don't worry.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02201_038: We have mandatory workouts on weekends. We take a walk by the beach, then stop by the Convenience Store for our favorite snacks before heading home.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC05901_004: Hah… as expected of you, calculating even your colleagues.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_042: Hmph, rumors say one of the auction items can predict the future.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_022: Pfft, your glued-together plastic models will break into pieces!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_029: Phew! Finally, no more disguises! Who was that guy earlier?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_029: (struggling to breathe) Stay away…! Stay away from me!!!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_013: Huff, huff! Alright! Nanally's special training of watering flowers in horse stance… complete!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC021_017: O lost child of fate, your tomorrow is trapped in blankness…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC009_002: It's not your fault, it's someone else… Tch, forget it.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_219: My time with my family was running out. Mom had to witness my siblings enter the final countdown… yet she still had to answer questions like that.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1049_023: Same as usual, Spicy Chicken Cutlet Curry Rice.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_069: Very different from the previous items. This anomaly's fluctuations are extremely strong.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_047: It's the same type of card the Bureau is looking into! Let me contact Chaos.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_026: The plan needs a tweak. We need to get close to the invitee for the replica to work.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_058: Teaming up with the Appraiser sure makes life easier!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_120: Huh? If you're not related at all, why did you have to live together?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC034A_010: Huh? Why does Taygedo refer to the butler as <blue>Mr.</>?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_EC_NPC034A_006: Huh? Isn't Taygedo's job like that? (⊙_⊙)?
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Mint_00024: We need to find the nexus quickly. If we take too long, the space may enter superposition.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC034A_026: After I get my sugar fix, I can make toys move, you know? All kinds of toys!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC034A_039: I really loved this gift! Even though this accident happened and we couldn't keep it…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_EC_NPC034A_003: I recently watched a show where the protagonist is based on Mr. Galaxis from Acacia!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC034A_015: I want the new <blue>Limited Shell</> so bad… but I haven't had the chance to try it yet…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC010_012: Bianca came a long way. Let's hear the details before deciding.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_043: Ahem… Sir, have you forgotten? Our private theater at Eibon was vandalized by rivals the day before yesterday and is currently under renovation.
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Mint_00006: Cough, cough… J-Just kidding. If you're with the director… Ha… Haha…
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC008_007: Cough, cough, cough… Nanally! What are you spraying?

ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC009_047: Ahem, I mean for the future of Eibon, good luck!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00803_004: Ahem, New Helios… While BAC kept some details under wraps, many still remember the aftershocks that followed.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC034A_022: Wow! Is it really okay for me to accept all of this?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_051: Wow! Drank it all in one go, what tolerance! As expected of Eibon's Appraiser!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_007: Wow! You can see the fluctuations in the anomaly's intensity?!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_040: Ha—wasn't expecting that look. Thought we'd be up against some noir villain in shades and a suit!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_005: Hah—? Silly! Can't stand losing, so you make excuses!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_092: Huh—? What a weird place. Why does it also collect Taygedo's… kind?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC076A_003: Huh? I can control your body and eat wasabi if I want to, you know!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC080A_003: Huh? I can control your body and eat wasabi if I want to, you know!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC008_007: Phew… We've been running around non-stop! I'm absolutely wiped out!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_010: Hahuie! Shulahula! Ultimate high-voltage shockwave emitter, by the name of Haniel, appear!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_046: Haha, an intel dealer's chips won't be hidden in their counter or garage.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC011_005: Haha! A stroke of genius, all thanks to yours truly! Taygedo, try not to be too blown away!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_003: Haha, I knew we were poor, but not this poor!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_053: That Haniel just stuffs her face at events like this! How could she ever appreciate someone of my refined taste?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_031: Haniel, Hall Monitor, ready for action!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_131: Have you tried any of the delicacies here, Hathor?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_037: Did you really give them 20 years' worth of your vision?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC009_044: Wow, since our Treasure joined us, business has been booming. What should I buy next time?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_044: Phew, I'm a bit tired. I'll let you chat with Jiuyuan about tomorrow.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC009_022: Oh my! I told them a simple bank transfer would be fine, but they went ahead and sent someone over… Fresh bills are always so nice to look at though…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC08901_002: Oh certainly! That's our trendsetting hit product! You've got a good eye, customer! Let me guess… didn't you see someone else's creation with Imaginadough?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_083: Well, I'm just trying to clear the field for you. If we don't outbid them now, they'll stick like glue.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_110: Well, I didn't care about the others, but how could I let our Eibon crew fall for such cheap tricks?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_038: Oh, don't worry, I understand. I won't reveal your real identities in my work. It's more like an inspiration.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC015_002: Well, if it isn't the little ones from Eibon. A rare guest indeed.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_091: I'm just scaring off the competition for you. A few more rounds, and we'll have the upper hand when our real target shows up.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC009_013: Ah, there's one more thing I overlooked. Our new employee is eager to showcase their skills—
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC01802_01: Oops—sorry, sorry! Are you okay, gramps?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC07401_001: Oops—sorry, sorry! Are you okay, gramps?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC011_007: Oh, dear me. Totally forgot about that one.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_017: Hey, check my disguise again, will ya? Is it melting? It'd be bad if our cover gets blown!
ST_MainDialogue.MT_DMP01_01_0018_04: Tap, tap, tap, Miss Karen's new shoes gleam,
ST_MainDialogue.MT_DMP01_01_0018_06: Tap, tap, tap, Miss Karen's old shoes sigh,
ST_MainDialogue.MT_DMP01_01_0018_08: Tap, tap, tap, Miss Karen's red shoes glow,
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC008_010: Ugh, stuck here doing this mind-numbing task for days… How dumb…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_025: Hey, are you here for the manga artist, too?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_070: Wow, look at this setup and the sense of mystery. This is what the headquarters of the Coluccis should look like.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_106: Taking their side already, are we? No wonder they follow you everywhere.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_186: Big brothers and sisters, what can I do for you…?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC020_010: There is no need to go into the details with them.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC009_007: Oh, don't worry, we wouldn't let the best photo studio in Bridge Crossings close down.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_023: Oh! You're right! Why does it only say Eibon? Could it be that I, Nanally Colucci, am not famous enough?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02301_012: By the way! "Clear Skies in Summer" also includes a secret signed version in their recently published script! Want one?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC009_009: Oh, right, I just got a postcard earlier.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_037: Oh? If you want to grow tall soon, you can't be picky about food.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_081: Oh? Looks like the supplies have arrived as well.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC009_022: Oh, that's rare… now, last question.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_078: Even after all your mistakes, we couldn't help but love you like real family. You were our most precious little girl.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_021: Even if it's just for a brief moment…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_119: Even when faced with the "Registry"… faced with the curse you invited, all we could do was to give everything we got, and do our best to fulfill our mission until the countdown ends.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC020_006: What a rude kid… If you hurt this man in front of you, none of you will be going home today.
ST_MainDialogue.MT_DMP01_01_0018_07: Cry, cry, the one-legged swan is shy.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC011_004: Humph, I guess I will have to lead the way.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC009_021: Hmph, you don't get it. Things are different now—
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_008: Hmph, don't underestimate me! Auction venues monitor common communication devices! That's where I come in.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC008_003: Hmph, you dummy! Thought you could team up with Taygedo and keep secrets from us? Well, congrats! You've just won yourself a month of errand duty!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_010: Hmph, the bad dog and stinky bird must be in cahoots!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_072: Can you believe it? The famous Kapé won't even let you take leftovers. So stingy!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_039: That's just a bunch of nonsense!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC011_012: Heh, it's all thanks to the Coluccis' unbeatable adaptability and can-do spirit!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_053: Hmph, fine. We'll see when we go there tonight. And don't fool around and get in my way, yeah?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC009_019: Ugh, I just hope today's parent-teacher conference doesn't set a new record for length…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_020: Ugh… Why do you think they're sending puppets to our place in Eibon?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_025: Renee… You basically forgot everything about us.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC009_001: Ugh… Can't even chill this morning! Not all of us can skip beauty sleep and still be beautiful like that woman …
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_002: Oops, we made fun of Taygedo for nothing! Not his, not mine, not Sakiri's, nor Adler's… Whose is this? It's taking up a lot of space.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC086A_012: Alas, as I suspected! Wrinkles on one's face are simply intolerable! How dreadful! You understand now, don't you? How fragile beauty truly is! Time, violence, sorrow… anything can destroy it, and once these things have stripped beauty bare, all that remains is the hideous, the ugly, and the utterly vulgar.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC009_030: After so many years, the Bureau's shabby elevator is still so slow.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_053: Ugh… my head hurts, but my limbs are where they should be. What about you, Appraiser?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC06806_003: Hmm… Esteemed guest, we'll have someone replenish the refreshments shortly. Please enjoy them to your heart's content.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_025: Hmm… I hope Jenson brought enough money.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_248: Well… in addition, to make the most of this precious rebirth, I've decided to travel around the world.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_036: Hmm… both that lady's divination and mine resulted in blankness… maybe that advice applies to me too?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_074: Hmm, she just walked away without responding...
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_306: Mm. I can eat meals with my family, play hide and seek, and listen to Mom's stories every night before I sleep… How wonderful!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_041: Woohoo! Please lead the way, Mr. Nantanì.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_029: Every night at exactly nine o'clock… What kind of kink is that? Maybe it's like those guys from gangster movies, who like to dress up scary to shake people down for money. They usually show up at the same time to establish an air of authority.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC021_019: Umm… your fate is rather unusual. I'm afraid I can't give you further interpretations.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_028: Umm! Then I'll walk ahead. He'll show up soon…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_091: Hmm, this doesn't feel right! We need to find Sakiri and the others quickly!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC012_008: Mhm, anyway, people are afraid they'll be the next target, and more and more have been claiming that a certain puppet is someone they know, or even sharing close encounters with the anomaly…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_179: Hmm, if they are names… they do match with the voices we heard earlier.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_311: Hmm, when I grow up… I also want to…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_049: Well, Sir tried to win Miss Tako a plush toy, but it's not going very smoothly…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_059: Hmm, what are the odds of this actually working?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_001: Pecky! Can you eat more politely?!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_093: Ah… So it's called The First Branch…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00401_003: Ah, an Ebisu invitation. A fine piece.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_024: Ah… Even our dim-witted staff wouldn't be fooled by this.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00501_001: Ah, we're late! Seems like we can't get in anymore.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_013: Ah—That won't do! Those intel dealers won't give us information for free!
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Mint_00041: Ahhh… My poor ears can't take it anymore…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC012_011: Ah… right. To create lasting memories for the other person…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02201_032: Ah… I am really sorry. I am not blaming you. It's just that the collar is very important to me.
ST_MainDialogue.HM_Prologue_MainSQC003_Fadia_00001: Oh man, Just a Class V? I thought I could finally have some fun…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC011_010: Oh that, hahaha. We were… just passing by last time. Yep, just passing by!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC02303_005: Ah, please handle it with care. It's still soft by nature and can easily lose its shape… I spent ages molding this into a tutorial…
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC01001_009: Ah! My studio… it won't close down, will it?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_072: Ah! It's that lady from before!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00702_005: Ah, hello. You are Miss Bianca's guest. I remember you.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC01001_019: Ah, since Hotori requested film photography, your photos won't be ready today. I'll have them delivered to Eibon tomorrow.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02301_005: Ah, sorry sir, this customer was here first…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_062: Oops, got a bit sidetracked there.
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Mint_00030: Huh? You can understand their calls?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_063: Huh? Renee, are you somehow connected to the Constantine family? I knew last night's story was different!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC009_038: Tsk. What should I buy with the commission fee?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_024: Pfft, please. "Tales of Nil" is mid at best, it's not beating "Gen Z".
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC011_009: Hey, don't even think about stealing our newcomer!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_072: Hey, how could you guys leave the boss behind and come in first?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_069: Hey! Poker face, say that again—
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC024_012: Whoever's out there watching and laughing at us right now… feel free to pop a champagne.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_029: Hey, what's the point of remembering such bad stuff?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC011_001: Hey, you, the show-off over there. There's a huge <TypingTitle titlename="Insect" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">Hercules Beetle</> on your back!
ST_MainDialogue.MT_DMP01_01_0018_10: Kind executioner, let the axe go,
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_096: Look who's here, just who you've been looking for.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC011_006: This is the Grinster, the manager of the group that sells intel.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_006: Feelings of love or hate… didn't matter at first. I simply had to run the salons. I had to use these connections to reverse the decline of the Constantine family.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC01001_023: Hey, wasn't the store previously asked to temporarily suspend business by the BAC? So we just gave everyone a break. Now it's just me and Rocky here.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC009_014: Hmm… Looks like Eibon should take this commission.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC015_012: Hmm… Let me think… New customer discount, one piece of intel, in exchange for getting to know the appraiser. How about it?
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC009_025: Hmm… These models don't look too different. Could use them as set pieces, get double the work done—
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC009_006: Hmm… This can be a big or small issue…
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC011_013: Hmm… This photo is very clear.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_067: Hmm—that over there looks pretty good.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_083: Hmm… Everything is in place now.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC009_021: Hmm… another new face. Just joined ETD?
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Zero_00008: Hmm… just intuition. The atmosphere here is no different from where we came from.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00803_003: Hmm… This is probably the grandest affair we've seen since the New Helios incident.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1049_019: Well… I was worried something might be wrong with her, so I told her to go to the hospital, but the girl insisted she was fine… so I just let her be…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1049_013: Mhm… I did see her curled up on the ground, but I definitely didn't see the "cloaked person" she described.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_235: Yes. Mom gave it to me. It's a precious treasure that protects me from the Debt Collector.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_044: Yeah, we're inside an Anomalous Realm. Be careful.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_055: You're right. Even if we attack it now, it'd likely be as futile as last night. If Blackbird is right, it only nullifies itself after completing its mission.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_023: Mm, little one, you self-contradict and don't act as you say, but I believe you, because you've already paid the price.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC027_005: Mm-hmm, I do have stuff to do.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC001_002: Yes! It's on this street here, follow me!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_093: That's a good idea. I want to talk to her too.
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Alphard_00009: Alright, then this containment breach will count towards your performance.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_040: Yes, Taygedo can deconstruct objects he touches and then reconstruct them.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC027_013: Yes. The Director told me to give you this.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_031: Yeah, it's not like he was trying to exclude Nanally and Sakiri… Taygedo's just feeling a bit shy.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_039: Yes, {Gender}|gender(he,she) will come to see you tomorrow.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC016_003: Hmm, don't worry. I'll look after Hotori. Focus on the commission.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_Player_023: Yes, thank you for accompanying me. See you next time.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_041: Yep, the invitation has been swapped.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_040: Okay. I'll head back first, see you tomorrow.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_019: Yes, it suits you well, sir.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_035: Right. Please remind the others to turn in early as well. See you all tomorrow.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_100: Hmm, no wonder he looked uneasy when Hotori made inquiries.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_140: Hmm, no wonder he looked uneasy when Hotori made inquiries.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC001_003: Hmm? Oh, you mean the <blue>Wertheimer Tower</>! Yes, the data orb you saw at the Bureau rely on these for real-time monitoring.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_025: Hmm? Compared to seeing a doctor, you need to see this more.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC015_008: Hmm? You must be the new appraiser at Eibon?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC076A_001: Tsk, tsk, tsk! You dummy, don't tell me you forgot what you were supposed to deliver!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC080A_001: Tsk, tsk, tsk! You dummy, don't tell me you forgot what you were supposed to deliver!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC076A_002: Tee-hee-hee, I'm an evil spirit that can devour souls! If you dare  disrespect me…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC080A_002: Tee-hee-hee, I'm an evil spirit that can devour souls! If you dare  disrespect me…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_014: Shh—quiet! If Boss lady knows about this she's gonna go funky on my ears again!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC01208_002: Shh! Keep it down. You know that woman is cursed…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02501_027: Ahh! The air condition here is still as cold as ever.
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Mint_00005: Hey! Wanna join CSU? Stick with me in Unit 2, you'll be in good hands!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_014: Hehe, did you take a look around?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_013: Hehe, if you need help, I'll appear like an anime hero to save the day!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC034A_005: Hehe, so, where should we head for some fun?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00401_005: Hehe, I'll give it my best.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC01001_028: Hey, there's no such thing as being a bother. Just ask if you have any questions.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC011_001: Hey! You're back already? That was quicker than I thought.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC001_027: Pfft, haha—Coco understands oddity language. Taygedo, don't underestimate {Gender}|gender(him,her)!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_114: Oooh! So Chaos is handing Renee over to ETD-6 to take care of? Hello there!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC009_031: Oh, by the way, we pride ourselves on our business integrity, so it's only natural that we try to make up for it after mistakenly accepting a commission from a villain…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC034A_009: Oh! I wanna go, I wanna go! They have claw machines there! I love collecting plushies!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_042: Oh! No wonder you recommended us to Renee! Master's commissions always get perfect reviews!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC034A_006: Oh! Don't tell me it's one of those private theaters!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_117: Oh, that? Of course it was all about—the Fons grab.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_026: Really? Trust is a valuable investment… So, how do we get in?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_034: Oh yeah? Am I that amazing in our precious' eyes?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_046: Oh? Containment action begins! Should we disguise as Bureau agents? Immersive experience, more engaging!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC015_004: Oh? Is there a new commission?
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC011_015: Oh? Detective Adler, please enlighten us.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC01201_001: Hype… Or did it really come from that place?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_073: Whoa! This door is so ancient! It's not going to fall apart if I push it, right?
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC001_029: I still have to work overtime… I'll head off now. Coco, remember to keep in touch!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00201_008: Not long after we got back, I learned that Kenneth's restaurant indeed got a new star. But I was hesitant… I couldn't decide if I wanted to use the censer I brought back.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_106: Now that you remember what happened when we were children, now that you know of the curse you cast upon us… are you shaken? Do you even feel the slightest bit of guilt?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_046: Back already? Did everything go off without a hitch?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_062: Because he's just a tired middle-aged man being pestered by kids.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_261: (laughs) Because… whether it's awful, bland, or delicious… they're all flavors you can experience in everyday life.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC019_012: Due to some… private issues, we cannot answer some of your questions.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_013: Due to the difference in nature, many foods and daily necessities aren't easily shared between humans and oddities. This is especially true for specific types of clothing, I suppose.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_183: They truly loved me once, which is why now they hate me so much.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC08901_006: It still feels like dough to the touch… and if you pour hot water into the Imaginadough cup, poof! It'll melt like any other dough.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_239: …every little thing in life that becomes precious because of the flow of time.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC010_010: Respect and understanding for team members is also one of the prerequisites for us to advance cooperation with our clients.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC05604_001: The new ski resort in Tuscur is quite challenging. Following the scenic route from the summit offers some absolutely breathtaking views.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_033: From the very beginning, we were just wooden puppets sleeping in Mother's box.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC010_034: I lack some key information and so it is difficult to make a judgment.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_045: It will certainly assist the appraiser greatly in future anomaly commissions.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00911_004: Listen closely to what's around you… Fons… Anomalies… Fons… Anomalies…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_002: Being noisy while others are working isn't a good habit. Don't you agree?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_104: Making a deal with Pawn Moonlight on the same day must point to a deeper connection…
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_Player_013: It's tough to make a living in a big city…
