ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_080: Oh right, that Debt Collector anomaly is also related to clocks!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_005: The most distressing part for Taygedo must be that there's not much time left before she moves away from Hethereau with her Guarantor.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_033: Well, I bet she finds them more terrifying than getting her door busted down!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_086: Any clues about the one who took it?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00910_001: Maybe this could help our stagnant football business finally gain some traction.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC012_028: I don't think he wanted to pick a fight, but I couldn't stop Sakiri…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_054: That's right! It was swinging a huge scythe at Renee! I don't know if my eyes were playing tricks, but the scythe went through Renee's body! I was worried!
ST_MainDialogue.HM_Prologue_MainSQC005_Alphard_00007: Anything to add to your report?
ST_MainDialogue.HM_Prologue_MainSQC003_Nelly_00001: Yes, the <blue>Wertheimer Index</>— measures how much an object deviates from reality.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_013: Yes, it should be an anomaly, just like Fuuka said. She told me to look for help at the Eibon Antique Shop.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_035: Searching for the dog's owner… a gluttonous anomaly… interesting kids and a kind-hearted mysterious person…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC06804_001: Good day, dear guest. How may I be of service?
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_038: Lady has a point. With the Appraiser's help, Eibon will surely see new opportunities.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC010_006: Lady, you've sold your car to pay for the rent for the store.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC09306_005: Miss, I'm afraid there's a misunderstanding. There's no Cordelein here, just an old fool who's happy to see his dear friend find happiness.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC010_008: My lady, is there something special about the auction items?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC010_003: Lady, an old friend is here.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_018: Watch out, or she'll trick you out of your info!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_076: Do you recall anything else from when you were a kid? Any thing helps.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC009_006: But… the BAC will compensate for missed working hours for Precious, Daff, and me.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1049_008: Didn't little Renee tell you about it? The anomaly she saw was a strange figure that looked like someone wearing a cloak…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC002_008: This is Lavinia, an operative from the Yggash Court. We'll be relying on the court's support for intel related to unknown anomalies.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00301_015: Y-Yup, that's exactly what I said! And this is better taken care of sooner than later. You guys should probably check Green Wall Slope tonight up in the north.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_076: It's like an interactive movie…! No, wait! It's more like a stage play!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC012_033: Otro said there's no ability in this world that can grant every wish.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_089: Just like the fate of the Dolores family.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02501_001: As I emphasized, this is critical. Don't brush me off with domesticated oddities or children.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_149: Just like what Bella said, we're all puppets that woke up in response to Mom's wishes. We exist to keep Mom company.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_029: You were the only one she had in her eyes and in her heart, as if the rest of us didn't even exist.
ST_MainDialogue.HM_Prologue_MainSQC006_Alphard_00008: Consider it a thank you for helping nullify <blue>Hypervortex</>… Living in Hethereau will likely be more interesting than you think.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC001_015: It means… it means a store in this corner where passersby can hear the owner's stomach grumbling… hehe…
ST_MainDialogue.MT_DMP01_01_0021_03: It's him. The crow said, in the mirror.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC001_010: The BAC is also directly under the Circle, enforcing anomaly control.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC08901_005: Exactly… Ahem. But! However! Keep in mind that the products of Imaginadough cannot be used as actual products and tools.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_067: Even if Tako isn't ready to reciprocate the feelings outright, she'll find it hard to refuse firmly in such a situation. This gives Taygedo a better chance of getting at least an "I'll think about it" kind of response.
ST_MainDialogue.MT_DMP01_01_0018_11: Even at Miss Karen's funeral, the dance will flow.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC024_006: Even without a client, what harm is there in examining a gift at your doorstep?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC05901_001: Did you just let everyone go like that?
ST_MainDialogue.HM_Prologue_MainSQC002_Nelly_00002: The director is in the office right now. Please follow me.
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Mint_00011: Director! You're here… Coco and I will complete the mission!
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Mint_00034: Wouldn't I be more impressive than them? I won't be called a goofball any more, right?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_051: It's pretty obvious now that this Pawn Moonlight is not only the one behind the missing cases but also tricked people into believing things that are simply too good to be true.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_085: It's all over now. Is everyone alright?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00911_002: Bacchus doesn't make you drunk… must've eaten too much… hic!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_119: Master, do you have any siblings?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_037: How about you, Master? Master hasn't worked on a commission with the Appraiser yet! Maybe this is a good time to show you my latest training results!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_106: Master, what should we do? Renee's commission…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_065: Master, the Appraiser, and Nanally Colucci! The mystery of the Debt Collector is about to be revealed!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_068: I hope that… I will find a place where I belong and it won't abandon me.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC012_026: I hope… that all our wishes come true.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_024: I would love to have it again someday.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_095: Bring them home… All of them…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02201_014: I named him Dandelion because he sheds his fur all the time, which makes me sneeze all the time.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_051: They leave with the item as planned, and the <blue>gift</> left behind sets off the security… Anyone in their way gets trapped here. Clever plan.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC015_024: Gotta help in all the ways I can.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC009_026: What? No breaking things, or you'll be left here as collateral!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC011_002: What are we doing? Isn't it obvious? When something fun's going down, you bet we're jumping in!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_008: Being called "gramps" wouldn't feel good for anyone young.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC01401_007: A toss-up between fortune and curse, shelter and banishment. Ninety-nine black pearls strung by fate's own threads—a cryptic gamble of destinies, and an eternal tussle of shadows and light!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_020: Lucky necklace? If I buy it, my game pulls won't—hehe!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_018: We couldn't get anything out of Kool Express. The manager even said they're going to avoid hiring temps for a while.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_043: It was probably back when the shop first opened, right? After all, we have monopoly on all anomaly commissions now!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_191: I think so… I do remember something like that happened when I was a kid. But I only remembered part of it. What we saw should be the whole thing.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_079: There must be a breached anomaly on this floor.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_008: So the one our shop received is the sixth puppet?
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC01001_001: We noticed that something was off when we opened the shop this morning. We immediately reported it to the BAC and, after taking a look, they said they would be sending the CSU here.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC01001_022: Feel free to use any equipment in the store. If you have any questions, just ask me.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC009_022: We've got a treasure here, and business will follow!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_091: Boss… Was it you who unfroze us today?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_030: Looks like Hotori isn't finished yet.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC05604_002: There's also a five-star hotel modeled after Fort Balc in the resort area. They keep some dangerous but intriguing anomalies in the nearby mountains—perfect for those looking to do some… hunting.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_EC_NPC034A_004: Anomaly Hunter! Transform! Wall running! Espers! Screenful of effects!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_081: Very strong Anomaly presence. It looks like Toshi did sign a contract with Pawn Moonlight…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_018: The anomaly's aura seems to be coming from these cards…
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Mint_00022: Different anomalies must be nullified in different ways. Even if you find their Nexus and attack it, some anomalies cannot be nullified.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_085: Don't worry about that. Anything can happen in an Anomalous Realm. In fact, hostile anomalies are rather common.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_028: After an investigation by the BAC <TypingTitle titlename="Joint Task Force" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">JTF</> field team, it was discovered that the disappearance of items is periodic and limited to the photo studio, with no signs of spreading.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_096: One of the puppets recovered by the BAC is also called Bella.
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Nelly_00008: The Bureau of Anomaly Control has contained many different types and classes of anomalies. Emergency response measures for sudden situations are collectively referred to as the Crisis Response Protocol.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC012_009: BAC has stepped in and urged citizens to exercise judgment, refrain from spreading rumors, and share relevant information to help the investigation.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_266: The official from the Bureau gave me two choices. She said…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_105: So the puppets at the Bureau… they were Renee's family… removed by the Debt Collector.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC024_057: Thanks, everyone from Eibon. The Bureau will continue to investigate into the aftermath of the issue between the Debt Collector and the Constantine family.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_047: All the siblings, except for Renee, can hear the approaching footsteps of death.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC019_016: Mismo means that he will miss Morphix.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC011_005: Stealing from the shop, reaping undeserved fruits, such evil anomaly cannot be forgiven!
ST_MainDialogue.HM_Prologue_MainSQC006_Alphard_00004: When it reappears, you will need to handle it together.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC011_006: Ta-da—The righteous Coluccis trio is here, ready to strike and nullify the evil!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_Player_021: If you mean as a minion… I must decline respectfully.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC012_037: Mismo said he went out to investigate when Toshi didn't pay his price.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_049: Back then I… climbed all the way to the top of the tree, wanting to pick the prettiest cherry blossom for my sister.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_140: Back then, when I was looking up at this tree, I suddenly wanted to pick the most beautiful branch for big sis.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_010: I was too young and too foolish. I mistakenly thought gathering them under this roof could bring me some comfort.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_053: We were escorting Renee to the parking lot of Food First, and at exactly nine o'clock, there was a "POOF," and a wild Debt Collector appeared!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC009_041: Of course, it's because of my excellent skills as the owner. Now with our Treasure, let's make a name for ourselves with this case, and after that, the future of Eibon will be up to you.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC034A_004: Oh of course it's fine! Please come along and join the fun! The more the merrier!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_061: On the flip side, these pretentious norms gave us an opening to sneak Hathor and the other two in.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00910_005: Of course! People always love something new and exciting. With the power of social media behind us, we can make this happen…
ST_MainDialogue.HM_Prologue_MainSQC006_Nelly_00003: Needless to say, they only handle anomalies of Class I to IV.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_010: Of course, we'll blend into the party too—don't be too surprised when you see us!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1049_006: Of course, let's sit down and talk.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_114: Of course, I'd love to hear more.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_057: Soon enough. A new puppet was sitting on her workbench. There was nothing special about it. But the old carpenter let out a satisfied sigh, as if she completed a masterpiece.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_185: I'm sorry I'm only learning this just now, but I'm grateful that I finally do.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_016: Interesting way to activate your ability.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_017: Very handy, like a personal earpiece.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC024_040: It's getting late. Let's call it a night. Thanks for all of your help.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1050_005: Unfortunately, we haven't found any matching Anomalies in our records.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_078: We'll have to squeeze through the crowd. It's going to be tough. Why are there so many people here…?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_072: We need to meet up with them as soon as possible.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_057: Chances are… Lady Dolores has met her demise.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC021_024: Lady Dolores told me that she is one without heart, which is the truth about the curse of immortality.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_115: As you expected, all of Lady Dolores' guests have left.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC00815_003: Dolores is also the most gracious hostess, always generous when she lends out money…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_102: I hate people with schemes! Once I get out of here, I'll grab that cook by the collar and squeeze a clear answer out of him!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_012: Hurry, hurry! Trust me, empty them!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_214: Hurry, hurry! The food's getting cold!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC024_003: Do you remember what the delivery person looked like?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC034A_035: What's up, Taygedo? Not happy with how the shot turned out? Don't worry, we'll slap on a beauty filter later!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_027: What's wrong, Renee? You haven't eaten much.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC034A_007: No way…! I guess that can't be helped then!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_050: How did it get away? Don't tell me I'm getting rusty! Gah!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_078: Why is it stuck? Let me fix it!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_094: Another grandfather clock? Either Lady Dolores is a clock nerd, or this Anomalous Realm is related to the concept of time!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_Player_038: That's a lot for me as a newcomer… No pressure, right?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_022: Why do you seem oddly excited?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC011_005: How about that? I brought in our first customer today!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_070: Did our precious treasure actually give the food here a try?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1049_017: So, any leads yet? Hunters from Eibon?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_015: How is it? Nothing seems off, right?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_003: Why are you so confused? Did you oversleep again? Mother warned us to not interrupt her salon, but you just had to go see what's going on, like the time you hid in that cabinet to peek through.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00702_009: How? How did he just disappear like that?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC01401_034: What? Drawing the line so soon?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC009_015: Mhm? Our Precious wants to feel the cool AC and expensive sofa, as well as the endless lectures from the Director?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC002_012: In any case, we can conclude that someone is spreading rumors. But I'm afraid clearing this up won't be easy.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_086: I'm afraid we didn't fully understand this anomaly, even though it's a commercially available product…
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC01001_015: You're so kind! No problem, I'll take the best photo for you!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02301_006: Hello, is there anything you need help with?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_062: You were long banished from this world by "that thing"… You have never lived in the "present." Even when the clock of fate dictated your end… as long as "that thing" offers you protection, you exist beyond the laws of nature.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC09001_001: Are you inquiring about… a men's suit that would fit this oddity's measurements?
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_020: So you want us to deal with the anomaly at the Photo Studio and reopen it as soon as possible?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC012_015: So you're saying that your dog has been gone for about a year now and recently showed up in the manga?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC012_016: The Fire Phoenix from one of your works burned itself down to help its owner. Does that have to do with Pawn Moonlight?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC010_013: Please, have a seat and tell us more.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_003: Intel… wait, the Sterry Express that we worked with?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00803_005: Ebisu took on a big contract back then around New Helios. Unfortunately, luck wasn't on their side…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC01401_025: Ebisu always welcomes those who respect auction rules. However, those who disrupt the order are no longer our friends.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_089: Ebisu has the right to set the rules for Nantanì's space. Breaking them triggers Nantanì's security ability.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_058: Is Ebisu's security anomaly also a rule-based one? Nantanì is its name, right?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_032: Ebisu's auction, eh? The food and drinks alone will make the trip worth it.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_018: Auctions at Ebisu are always one of a kind.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_007: Are you out of your mind? Do you really think a shut-in manga artist would go out of her way to kidnap a dog when she barely even wants to go downstairs for food?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC01308_003: This is my last chance to find her source of immortality!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_065: Besides the good booze, tomorrow night's probably gonna be a headache. Best to turn in early.
ST_MainDialogue.MT01_04_NPC05612_001: Hey, get in line if you want to butter up the missus! Take turns like everyone else. You're not the only ones who need something from her!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_009: I apologize for not introducing myself first.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC012_021: It appears this plan was put together rather hastily, with many aspects left unchecked for feasibility. However, so far… things seem to be proceeding relatively smoothly.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC09001_009: Trying on clothes is fine… but if any items are damaged, you'll be responsible for the cost…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_113: Do you remember now? That most selfish and greedy wish you made to our mother?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_032: Do you remember? About the time our family spent here?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_038: As expected, Michael Pay did his best.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC08901_012: If you're interested, why not try creating your own Imaginadough model in our demo area? If you like what you make, you can take it home with you! For checkout, please head to the front counter!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_055: Thanks for your help. You've worked hard.
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Zero_00012: Thank you for your help. Mint, let's go.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00911_007: Thank you for your kindness… not many would spare a glance for a drunk in the corner.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_054: Thanks for giving it a try! I must get back to work now!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_025: Thank you for choosing Eibon. Please allow us some time to prepare and my colleague will be with you in a minute.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_018: Thank you for your understanding. We'll take our leave now.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_023: Thank you for your coffee, Adler.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC010_016: Thank you for choosing Eibon. The invoice has been sent to your shop owner's email address.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00401_013: Thank you, Jenson. Luck always favors those who keep their word!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_087: And he disappeared before it could—
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC086A_011: I… will carry a melancholy for what has befallen her. When does this future arrive? I cannot bear for that day to be close at hand.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC001_022: I… I… I'll be right back! And you're the most understanding person in the whole wide world, Coco—!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_098: I… I didn't mean to, big sis…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_039: I… I don't know. I don't remember.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02201_035: I… I don't know where Pawn Moonlight is exactly. After reading the manga, I came to Hethereau to visit Cake Sweeper Sensei and got a new clue about Dandelion.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02201_036: I… I will keep looking. I must find Dandelion!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_038: I… uhh… I'm in charge of ensuring your safety during the outing.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02201_026: I wanna go, too! Dandelion is waiting for me there.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1049_015: I thought she was hallucinating at first, but on the way home, she told me that this weird thing happens every night at 9 PM. It didn't sound like she was lying…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_010: Though you might have forgotten or… abandoned us, we've been waiting for you all this time.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00301_022: I don't care how it's done. As long as the problem is solved, you'll get a handsome reward.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_131: …I wouldn't… I wouldn't know what I wanted, and I wouldn't know what I could do. I wouldn't even remember what I've ever done…
ST_MainDialogue.HM_Prologue_MainSQC006_Zero_00003: I don't need to stay here for further observation?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00201_003: I met Kenneth at a corporate dinner party. A little while ago, he learned that I'd been troubled by my work with Landric, so he asked to meet up and told me about Pawn Moonlight.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC021_029: I'm not sure if this helped her, but I remember her face when she left… She seemed more at ease.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_145: And I woke up because of Mom's magic…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_025: I'll have the same! I don't know about the other stuff at this place, but I like the spicy chicken rice since it doesn't have those gross green peas.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_252: I lived a very different day today.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_162: I thought… you left me behind.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_189: I thought we were "it", so we can find my siblings.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_163: We are a family, and we'll always be together…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_080: Let's look around. Maybe we can find the key to your memories.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_054: We're not its target. Renee is.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_013: We also don't have any leads.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC06804_005: We traverse through history, seeking out beauty buried beneath the sands of time. By bringing these treasures into the light, we allow clients from all corners of the world to witness magnificent art.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_018: Whatever time we have left, we must treasure every moment together.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_014: We will look out for more leads.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC019_005: We're just passing through. Strictly speaking, Dandelion is the real owner of Pawn Moonlight.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_018: We're covered with the disguise anomaly <blue>Lar</>. It can be… a bit unstable occasionally.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_104: There was one bell chime when we came in. The salon started at one o'clock.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_040: Our existence, our calling, and our purpose…
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Jin_00001: Our director is still as rigid as ever.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02501_013: We've searched everywhere, but there's no sign of him. While we can't completely rule out a kidnapping for ransom, no one has contacted us.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC011_011: We've done all we can. Now it's Taygedo's time to shine!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC008_018: We're always on a half-off sale…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_026: Fuka, we'd like to ask about the strange thing happening to Renee. Can you tell us about it?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_032: We want to know about the bird.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_037: All of us shared Mother's gift of eternity. In return, we brought her laughter and companionship. The happy times seemed to last forever.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00910_003: We're planning to organize an anomaly football league. The rules would be mostly the same as regular football, just with anomalies competing against each other.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_055: We don't know it's real name. Nanally has been calling it the "Debt Collector."
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC024_013: We have two important leads. First, the puppet was delivered to Eibon by a fake delivery person.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_111: Our findings regarding the owner of Pawn Moonlight align closer with the manga artist.
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Zero_00022: We're getting closer to the source of all this noise.
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Zero_00026: We're getting closer to the source of all this noise.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_010: Could the person we're looking for have been taken by that dog, like the bird?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC008_009: Shouldn't we watch Taygedo's show from a bit further away? I mean, only a dummy like him wouldn't find it suspicious to see so many similar faces in one day!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_002: When did this tiny alley by my stall turn into private parking for some extravagant boss? Don't forget to pay your fees!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00401_001: I think I heard Fons calling.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_032: Now, on the count of three. Three, two, one…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_047: Hey, I'll go first! I want old man to put cheese eggrolls in my lunch tomorrow!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_120: Hey, I'll go first! I want old man to put cheese eggrolls in my lunch tomorrow!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC009_004: My friends in BAC told me your shop isn't doing too well…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_051: No way, did it really work?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_040: I'm just a taxi driver who's always been alone. How could I be connected to some strange family…?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_003: I just didn't want you to see those people too early… to witness the greed, foolishness, and ugliness of those who long for so-called immortality.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC020_008: I was just trying to check why the costs weren't being paid yet.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_019: I water flowers like a normal person.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_011: I can only confirm whether the item is an anomaly and its general intensity fluctuations. As for specific abilities…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02201_013: My name is Boomboom, and I came to Hethereau to look for my dog—Dandelion, that is. I found Dandelion on my way home from a convenience store. He was trying to fish a cookie out of the trash can, but then the can flipped and landed right on its head…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00910_006: Not that I go around telling everyone I used to be a quarterback or anything.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_027: I doubt Ebisu sends invitations to all upstanding citizens.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC021_014: I could do a divination for Renee. Maybe we can find something.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC01001_014: I can double the payment! Please handle it properly, I'm counting on you all!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_016: I consider myself to have the Disguise of the Year! With today's look, even <TypingTitle titlename="Detective Manga Protag" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">Mr. Ten</> from <TypingTitle titlename="Manga" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">Case in Point</> wouldn't suspect a thing out of me!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_064: Taygedo and I met Mismo in Moby-Dick.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC019_003: Mismo and I… for certain reasons, we've been drifting from city to city.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC020_016: Otro said that those… Everything in this pawn shop has its destined owner.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC009_040: As for me, I'll be waiting at Eibon for your good news.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_014: I'm learning from my master! Integrate every bit of training into daily life! Using the weight of the watering can to increase the training intensity. How's that? Pretty clever, right!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_157: Did I steal Mom's love away from the other siblings? Did I even take away their lives…?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_056: I think I saw that too.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_104: I think I'm starting to remember… she was the sister who caught me when I fell from the tree…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_114: I've got zero interest in cleaning up others' mess.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_082: In any case, these things aren't on the same level as that censer that could spit out a bird!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00401_012: I've done my best, Jenson. I won't be able to use my ability again for a week…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_009: I did not think too much at the time, so I signed and took it into to the shop.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_202: I'm so sorry, I'm so sorry…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_016: I must correct this mistake. And the catalyst for that change is you, my dear. My little petal.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_040: How should I repay you? Hmm, let me think, how about I give you some free manga?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC020_019: How would I know anything about your wish? Go ask him yourself if you don't want it.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_037: How was I supposed to know it would respond?!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC008_019: I feel like I've heard that many times before.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_238: For me… the Eternal Present negated the meaning of time. I gradually lost touch with my past, and became unaware of everything happening around me…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_001: I don't think it's part of Hotori's collection.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC021_022: I think that was because she lived for far too long.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_181: I don't think Mom did this.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC009_009: Let me think… I'll tell you what, how about you give us a group photo when it's all done? We can display it in our shop, free advertising for you!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_102: I don't think the Bella we met is a real person. Remember how this is an Anomalous Realm?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_022: I think the puppets should be ordinary puppets. They were simply in proximity to an anomaly…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_068: I want a pair of <TypingTitle titlename="Anomaly" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">Ora Punchers</>!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_150: I remember many, many things now. I had tea with my siblings. We also played hide and seek at home.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02501_015: Our request is simple—find him, and fast.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_066: I understand. As you wish, Mother.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC001_007: Got it, got it! There's nothing good about the city anyway! Commutes are crowded, rent is high, and these big things are ugly, ugly, ugly, and not interesting at all!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC02502_002: I'm an agent from First Agency, and your arrival with Sterry Express has caused quite a stir around here.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_100: I'm an agent from First Agency, and your arrival with Sterry Express has caused quite a stir around here.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_279: Am I the last one to be found? Hehe! That means… I almost won, right? Next time, I'm going to hide somewhere no one can find!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC015_011: I like dealing with straightforward, clever people. I think we'll get along—
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC04306_001: I absolutely love cats, so I wanted some cat-themed decorations. I molded the Imaginadough into little cat shapes.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC009_020: I have a feeling Eibon is going to get busy…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00201_005: I thought it was a scam at first, until… we saw the giant door up in the mountain and we pushed it open…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_052: I'll tell you! Renee came to our shop because she wanted us to deal with some weird thing that appears every night at nine o'clock to attack her.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_044: Let me see if there's a good angle to climb. It's been a while, I'm not sure if I can do it…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_100: So I really am part of the Constantine family? I'm her daughter…?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_145: I'm fine, but Daffodill… are you okay?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_134: No! I didn't forget you on purpose, big sis… It's not like that…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_015: Can I take a look at it?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC086A_008: I don't want to answer that right now! You should realize that what you just told me is a truly terrible thing! You are hinting at the tragic fate that awaits my dear, poor Mistress and her companion…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_118: My dear treasure, wearing your heart on your sleeve might not win you any fans, you know.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02201_010: I'm talking about my dog! It looks like… it's the dog from the last chapter of your manga! It looks exactly the same as my Dandelion!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_019: There goes one of my reliable side gigs! The Coluccis' funds are running low…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_049: You're gonna get cursed and hit the pity every time!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC011_017: Let me see… <blue>"Dear Mr. Adler, thank you so much for risking your life to save me that day"</>… pfft!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_088: Oh, I got it, I got it! The pawnshop owner must have regretted the deal, so he coaxed Dandelion into stealing the censer!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1043_005: I know! It's a world where you're all alone. No Mommy, no big brothers or sisters, just a world that's always dark.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_187: I came back here, because there was something I can do, right…?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_090: I can sense Lady Dolores's sincere feelings as she cared for her children. Though they are puppets, she treated them as real children. In contrast, the other "Mother" simply manipulated the children she collected into decorative pieces for her own fancy…
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Zero_00016: I can feel it's different from the surroundings.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_237: I was tossed outside the flow of time, and taken away from this world, where the years still pass and the seasons still change.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_040: I'll be mingling with some regulars shortly. Before the auction kicks off, feel free to get comfy, appraiser.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_116: I'm going to see Lady Dolores now…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_083: My brain is getting fried from what the guests are saying. So many conversations…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_069: I remember hearing someone at DSD say there was something odd about Imaginadough, but I didn't think much of it at the time…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_091: Could I have been… their driver? I'm pretty confident in my driving skills.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_223: I told her I wanted to grow up fast.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_066: I thought he was just being cautious.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_276: No one will think Renee is hiding here! It's Renee's secret hideout!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00301_006: I was blown away and was going to pay this Pawn Moonlight another visit to thank the guy properly, but then I lost my sense of taste a few days after that… and the knife was gone, too!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_023: I thought the manga artist would live in a big, cold house like the perfumer.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_106: I was worried that without us, Sakiri would get in trouble.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_178: I'm still bothered by those red letters…
ST_MainDialogue.HM_Prologue_MainSQC005_Zero_00001: I still have no memory of anything before…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00301_008: For a master chef like me, taste is as important as my life. If you let this scammer take it away, it'll be the same as taking my life!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00301_026: For a chef at my level, having my sense of taste taken away is killing me! Since he used a shady trick, he can't blame me for showing no mercy!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00301_007: And that's when it hit me that I'd been played and that the pawnshop might have been an anomaly!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC01001_011: Then, right in front of me, a table turned into a photo! I've never seen anything like it!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_008: Why would I want a dog when I'm barely keeping myself alive?!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_026: I will see you off. This way please—
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_184: I understand. I'm sorry for making you go through so much in the past…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1049_012: I asked her what was wrong, but she couldn't answer. She just kept muttering things like "Don't hit me"… Nobody else was around, let alone anyone hitting her.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00301_013: I… don't care what I need to do…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_075: Or rather, an illusory world tailor-made to her understanding of Renee, after thoroughly excavating Renee's thoughts and feelings.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_108: Or rather, what role did he play in Toshi's disappearance…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02301_010: Or something light-hearted with constant twists and jokes? "Operation: Losers"?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_269: The other choice was to live meaningfully as a "human being."
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_048: He probably wished for a new dish or something.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC009_046: Maybe you can go and check the nearby mountain, since Eibon's performance…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC010_030: Perhaps there will be new clues at Mr. Toshi's residence.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_109: Maybe we'll find the answer here. Let's look further ahead.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_013: Let's look for a more budget-friendly option.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC05607_002: Staying true to his rock spirit, I suppose. He didn't show up today.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_059: Sometimes, believing in a prophecy is all it takes to make it come true…
ST_MainDialogue.HM_Prologue_MainSQC005_Alphard_00014: Perhaps, through pursuing Code Zero, you may uncover your past.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC010_027: Perhaps this comparison is somewhat inappropriate, but in my humble opinion, Landric's commission will indeed resolve some of Eibon's existing crises.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC021_004: Do any of you remember how long the fight lasted?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_027: So… I turned them down, although I did take advantage of the opportunity and asked them if I could take a look around in Pawn Moonlight since I was in there already anyway.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC009_020: So what are you going to do exactly? Are you going to destroy this Pawn Moonlight?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC024_031: So the key is to understand the rules and master them before we can nullify or use them to our advantage.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_036: So, take it easy and brainstorm some ideas with me for another side hustle!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_107: So she's my sister from the past! Though… I don't understand everything she said, that's what she meant, right?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_123: So Mom's not running the salon anymore?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_224: So Mom gave it to me… her "Eternal Present."
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_057: Have we traveled to the past?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_033: That's why we want you, the appraiser, to verify the authenticity of the items.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC04306_005: So I came here to complain. The staff said they'd pass the feedback to the manufacturer. I just hope it doesn't fall on deaf ears.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_090: I guess I'm really connected to this strange family?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_154: So Zankou used scarlet letters to spell "BETRAYER"…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_149: In other words, Zankou used her Esper Ability to alter the family's history, making Renee believe she was responsible for her family's deaths… leading her to voluntarily give up her Eternal Present…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_099: So it was his own will!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_193: So those words, all those hurtful words, they were real too.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_063: Turn on the light at the end!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_025: Bella, managing family affairs has drained you. I'm tired too.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_050: It makes more sense to hire savvy anomaly hunters who know the ropes, even if it means paying them a cut, rather than just some Joe who only knows how to raise a paddle.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00401_010: Keep the replica close to the invitee for a while, and it will complete the <blue>contract replacement</>.
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Alphard_00006: Focus on the task and stop fooling around.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC00814_001: We need to seize this last chance to butter up the Lady. Maybe she might even invite you as a guest in the future?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_047: After all that effort, we've finally got our <blue>golden ticket</> from Ebisu.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1050_002: Sorry to interrupt, I was thinking, what if this person wanted the Appraiser's help?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_073: Ah! Sorry! Wait a minute… Were you talking to me?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_071: Sorry, I can't be sure… but this… this is no ordinary anomaly.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC020_002: Apologies, thought no one was here.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC09001_002: I apologize, but since each oddity's physique varies greatly, we typically don't carry ready-made sizes.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_050: If the auctioned items are fine, then the tampered ones must be the unsold anomalies in the collection room.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC06804_002: The auction will commence at the designated time. Please be patient for a moment.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00911_005: That's how these auctions have always been.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC016_005: The item is gone, only 1 Fons left behind.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC06804_003: While our selection might not cover everything, please let us know if you have any special requests. We will do our utmost to accommodate your needs.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_011: What… will be at the auction?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00301_021: A deceitful pawnshop. It scammed my taste buds.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02201_027: Please do! I can't live without my Dandelion!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC01401_021: Pierce the haze, catch a glimpse of what's to come, heed the overture, and carve your destiny amid the whispers of the divine…
ST_MainDialogue.HM_Prologue_MainSQC003_Nelly_00002: By monitoring the changes in the Wertheimer Index across different areas, we can respond to emerging anomalies.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_032: She recommended our shop? That's a first.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC012_022: At this rate, we'll be done cleaning up soon.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_062: Next on the plan, Sir Taygedo's <blue>Operation Love Confession</>.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_048: From what Fuka said, not everyone can see it, right?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_087: Time is up for hide and seek. Once again, you're all alone.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC008_008: In other words, you're just relying on everyone else to pick up the slack, right?
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_027: According to the owner, items in the photo studio started disappearing mysteriously since opening this morning.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02501_030: My records show that your utility bills, insurance, and fines for unauthorized ads have been overdue for months.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_033: According to Renee, the anomaly will appear in the parking lot right on time.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC03819_001: Apparently the Lady wants to focus on family affairs, so she's withdrawing from the social circles of the nobility.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC01401_016: Next up is auction item number 2, <TypingTitle titlename="Anomaly" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">Glittering Gold</>…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC010_002: I'll take care of pruning from here.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_096: We've got it from here. Thanks for the effort, Appraiser, and apologies for the mishap.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC024_033: The next questions are: Why target Renee, and what do the numbers on Renee's card mean?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_267: I could accept help from the Bureau, receive their protection as an "Esper construct."
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_066: Just so we're clear—I'm here for the wine, not the drama.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_027: Now that you mention it, there was a time when Nanally and the others gave Taygedo a ton of books on the subject to study thoroughly…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_084: Containment is complete, and protection rules are lifted.
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Alphard_00004: The key to containing or nullifying an anomaly is called a <blue>Nexus</>. It's usually related to the anomaly's nature or cause.
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Alphard_00014: Containing the breached anomaly will return the space to normal. There's no need to be surprised.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC009_015: Time to wrap up, let's get paid and take our photo.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC009_001: Are you done cleaning up? We've been closed for days now. If we keep this up, the landlord's gonna think we've finally gone bust and come rushing to take back the place.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC009_007: Let's get ready to head out. The sooner we leave, the sooner we're back… for my nap…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_075: An old mansion abandoned for decades… I better be careful. I won't be able to pay for damages if I break anything historical…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC008_005: If we let you run around spouting nonsense, you dumb otter, Eibon's reputation will be in tatters!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC011_008: No worries, Boss (for today)! Everything's been arranged to perfection for you!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC008_006: Don't worry, I won't help you for nothing. Let's make a deal. You're treating us to a fancy feast afterward, and no backing out!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_040: Don't worry. That's Kiroumaru for you—always ending up whining when people tell it not to eat what it isn't supposed to eat.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_Player_017: Don't worry, I'll get there safely.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_043: Don't worry, our precious can surely identify that item. As for me, I haven't socialized for a while, might as well have some fun.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_017: I'll be fine. They've got their goals, but they won't really do anything to us for now…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_108: Take it easy, don't be so nervous. I'm here with you.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC04306_002: The result was just as good as I'd imagined. They even looked a bit fluffy and incredibly lifelike! Except that I couldn't pet them…
ST_MainDialogue.HM_Prologue_MainSQC006_Alphard_00003: A few days ago, <TypingTitle titlename="Anomaly" titlecolor="grey" font="16" contextcolor="blue">Prophet</> in the <blue>Central Intelligence Division</> predicted that an anomaly of this class would appear again soon.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_078: The entire space will be locked in a closed loop—until the item is recovered.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_040: Blacked out? Did you drink too much like Hotori?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_051: Sterry might look like your average courier service, but they're deep in the intel trade game and know all the ins and outs of the anomaly underworld.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_105: Sterry's little owls are way nicer than those two little rascals back in the shop!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC02502_003: Sterry Express always participates in these auctions as an agent, and they've never lost. Looks like I'll be going home empty-handed today.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_011: The Sterry Express has accepted a commission recently and needs the help of an appraiser.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_142: Does "newcomer" just mean we're meeting for the first time…?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02501_032: With the new product launch coming up, word of Toshi's disappearance must not get out. Our request is simple—find him as soon as you can.
ST_MainDialogue.MT_DMP01_01_0021_02: Who's the bride? The owl said, who's the bride?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_017: New friend, or rather, an old friend now.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00803_002: A new face? But hey, it's just a passing thought…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC05606_003: New dishes with new stories… quite the marketing angle. It suits his style.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_133: Days with nothing to do, with no meaning, and with no end in sight… so that's why it's a curse?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_051: All-knowing Jenson, what's the next anomaly to contain?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_031: Can't confirm if the intel is true, so Sterry wants me to verify the authenticity of the item.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_038: This way, we'll be punctual without arriving so early that it compromises the gravitas expected of a person of importance.
ST_MainDialogue.HM_Prologue_MainSQC006_Zero_00001: If you have the ability to see into the future… why don't you use this power to pinpoint its location?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_009: Since you're asking sincerely, let me show you my ability!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC009_023: Since we're talking about a pawnshop here, do you know what's gonna happen to the items pawned…?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC011_006: Since Taygedo plans to act as the <blue>big boss</>, I'm definitely the one here who understands best what effect he's aiming to create!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC014_017: Stealth mode activated, and I've scooped up some juicy intel!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_032: Now that everyone understands what's going on and is willing to help, let's work together. We don't have much time left to prepare.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_006: Since Jenson invited you, I'd say it's just getting interesting.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_001: If this is about Eibon's future, shouldn't we consult with Hotori and the others?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_039: We've agreed on terms with Hotori, and Sterry won't break the agreement.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_104: So as the days go by, she's just… uh… racking up life debt?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02301_002: Good morning! Here to buy the latest "Anomalies Guide" for Adler?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_001: Morning, Appraiser! Look here! Is the package yours?
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC001_024: Mornin', Mr. Adler! And Taygedo—hehe, Have you been putting on weight?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC05707_001: I told you, those so-called exorcists you hired are nothing but frauds. You better give up on your delusions.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC009_028: The sooner we finish, the sooner we can call it a day…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_109: Hey Sakiri. What did you wish for?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC009A_001: Can I eat Nanally up, Sakiri?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC009A_002: Can I eat this dummy, Sakiri?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC009A_008: Sakiri, tummy, tummy hurts! Sakiri! Sakiri! Tummy hurts!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC009A_007: Sakiri, can I eat that one with the blue hair?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_110: The clock still turns backward… Let's return to the past, to witness that final day of destiny, where you are forever frozen…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_081: It's getting late… Ebisu always knows how to keep people in suspense, but even they wouldn't delay until our distinguished guests lose their patience.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_062: It's getting late. Good kids should be sleeping now.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_037: It's about time we head out. If we leave now, we'll arrive precisely five minutes before the scheduled time.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_035: Tomorrow, you and I will be responsible for following Taygedo the whole time. As personal bodyguards to our esteemed organization leader, maintaining a sharp appearance is also part of our job description.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC024_058: Tomorrow morning, I want those who know anything about The Scarlet Letter at the Bureau. We need to have a proper chat… Daffodill.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_108: Master got hurt the worst, and it's all because of me…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC011_004: You're the one who tried to ditch us, Taygedo. Come on, tell us, was that cool of you?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC012_008: Hmm… I see… a date, huh. I'll look into the books.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_081: Got it, Master! Let me look around for clocks, watches, and stuff like that!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_031: Understood. Let's prepare and head out together.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC009_006: Those sleazeballs at EZ-Hire have been watching you guys head out with your tools before sunrise every day. Today, they had the nerve to come over, putting on this fake concern act, asking if we'd finally gone broke and were making you do illegal work to pay off debts. They even offered to "help out" with some job connections…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_035: Heard from the crew at the shop yesterday.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_063: Yesterdays, todays, and countless tomorrows are all but the “present” to you, as you were forever frozen at the moment "that thing" took effect. Beyond that point, time no longer works on you.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_010: You worked all night, Mint. Please rest well when you get back.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC012_006: <TypingTitle titlename="Anomaly Hunter Group" titlecolor="grey_title" contextcolor="blue">Sterry Express</>… they run a courier service, but they also deal in intel on the side.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC019_004: It was <blue>Morphix</>—or as you call it, Dandelion—that took us in, letting us use this space for the time being.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_002: Y-yes… what do I need to do? Do I sign a contract? Do I have to sign-up for something?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_071: Yes. During last night's discussion about this plan… I hesitated to bring up this point. I wondered if we were too focused on Taygedo's emotional expression as the confessor, while overlooking Tako's feelings as the recipient.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_054: Picky's ability opens one lock within its range every 30 seconds.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC024_021: Could someone have schemed all these encounters, just to involve you?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_003: Oh, really? This is instant coffee we got for free from the convenience store.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_008: Is that so? Do you really think I'm your "sister"?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_062: So you're considering it from the perspective of respecting Tako's wishes…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02301_001: Eibon's restorer is here, it's been a while.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC01001_021: Look who's here. Come on in.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_138: It's the same tree from before.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_120: Are you talking about the people who were just around you?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_160: Maybe she is assisting the Bureau?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_065: So they're super powerful when stacked? Then why do they collect a price for each wish? It sounds absolutely unnecessary!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC012_001: Is that so? Taygedo only called the three of us.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC086A_003: Is that so? Perhaps the me from then felt such a melancholic expression brought on by my full splendor. As for my beauty going unnoticed… what difference is there between the future and the present? Many people come and go, yet only you and that one have eyes that appreciate beauty, and are willing to spare a word with an unrivaled beauty such as myself…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_018: Yup, you'd think, right? That's what I thought, too. I thought I'd be running into at least one gigantic monster that pointed at me with a balance and went, "Life… or death…?"
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_066: You're right. This is the best life, being with you. The best times in Mama's life is when I spend time together with you, my family.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_029: Yup, and I saw a bunch of interesting and rare things on the tour! And just right when I was about to leave, I asked the brothers if I could incorporate what I saw that day into my work. They agreed to that, on the condition that they were excluded.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_023: Yup, that caught me by surprise, too, but they went, <blue>"Your wish is sure to come true once the Pawn Contract is signed, and you will only be paying your price after your wish is thoroughly enjoyed."</>
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_096: Perhaps it's because the knife's power is fading, and by the time Kenneth entered the second time, it couldn't fulfill his first wish anymore…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_094: Are they having a banquet, salon, or something like that?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_090: It's Edgar and Taygedo. They've been here already.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_172: It's a gift from Mom to all of us. I have one too.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC009_014: I'd love to hang around and meet teams I've never seen before. But my dear Director Alphard needs me for some grown-up discussions…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_010: Is it about Ebisu? Should I go with you?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_022: I'm the one who told Fuka that I was okay! Really, I'm fine! It didn't hurt at all, it's just that the anomaly was scary…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_125: I knocked it over. I was just about to ask her to prepare another one.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_014: She's my friend. Well, more like my food-buddy. Fuka said… it's definitely an anomaly, and the anomaly hunters from Eibon Antique Shop can help me.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_003: I may have made a mistake…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_156: Did I… curse my own family? Am I the bane of my family, causing its ruin?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC002_004: Those refer to human criminal incidents that involve the exploitation of anomaly characteristics or Espers.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_089: There are some similarities. But knowing the Constantines, I find it somewhat ironic… that our "Mother" and Dolores are complete opposites…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_026: Did you use your ability to turn it into what you want? It sure is faster than doing it by hand.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_126: Yes… as long as you give up the Eternal Present, cleanse yourself of your greed for life, we will forgive you for the sins you committed.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_123: Yes. The Eternal Present that should have protected Mother, is now in your eyes.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC01001_004: Yes, yes! The earlier the better!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_069: Yep! You said you climbed this tree when you were a kid! "When—you—were—a—kid!"
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_081: It's true. I was once a member of the Scarlet Letter.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_046: Yes, Mother. Even though you never allowed us to enter the study and never let us touch the registry. I understand.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_087: Yes, Sir. You did an excellent job.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_030: Yes, the limited-time commission from Film Orbit Studio down the street.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_136: Did I? But what about you, big sis? Mom? Are you all alive? At least you weren't made into puppets! Thank goodness…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC010_006: The Appraiser and Taygedo are back.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_054: Yes, Sir. We shall deliver this victory to you.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_015: Good evening. How was your rest?
ST_MainDialogue.MT_DMP01_01_0020_14: In the evening we attended his funeral.
ST_MainDialogue.MT_DMP01_01_0021_14: In the evening we attended his funeral.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_026: Doesn't someone need to spend time with that child later?
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC012_001: For now… not really… When the shop has no business or commissions, it's quite peaceful.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC016_016: Not at the moment… Work takes priority.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_007: Besides, I don't even remember all the little things.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC011_024: It looks even funnier now, haha!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_050: More puppets were born from the old carpenter's hands: an entertainer who could make children burst into laughter, a grand magician with unpredictable tricks… but no, she shook her head and said: "No, these aren't real children."
ST_MainDialogue.MT_DMP01_01_0021_12:
The once beautiful groom, 
And the ugly bride,
ST_MainDialogue.Main_Prologue_Mint_00002: A troublesome one sent over by a senior colleague. They haven't found a way to nullify it yet.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_018: Watch these kids for Adler and don't let them crash the place while we're gone. We'll be back in a bit.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_240: In the end… I forgot what Mom and my siblings expected of me. I forgot why I was born, and why I even existed… until now.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC00906_001: There was this talent show recently. The rock star contestant might be just what we're looking for…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_245: Most importantly, you helped me remember things from the past, and I finally found myself… That feels so great.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_056: Pawn Moonlight seems to be connected to your disappearance. Is there any misunderstanding here?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00301_025: The new knife did make cooking easier. I thought my fortune changed for the better wanted to thank that young man, but after a few days, I couldn't taste anything anymore… the knife was also gone!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC00301_005: And things went a lot more smoothly in the kitchen thanks to the knife. It only took me a few days to come up with my new dishes… Oh, but I happen to be a pretty good chef, too, just so we all know that!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC021_010: Some rule-based anomalies symbolize rules themselves… You can think of them as the manifestation of rules.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_013: Someone disguised themself as a delivery person just to give Eibon a puppet?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC021_023: They say that Lady Dolores is an immortal with eternal youth, that she made a deal with the devil for unlimited lifespan at a huge price. However, eternal life can be a curse, and the Constantine family met their demise decades ago…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_025: Thank you for taking the time to explain this to us. We really appreciate it.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_074: That makes sense! And then Renee dispelled the illusion! She must be part of this family! In other words, the master of the family returns!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC018_052: You have good taste! Next time I get my hands on something special, I'll be sure to find you!
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_001: We have a visitor, excuse me.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_Player_137: I tried some of the refreshments. They taste quite good.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_022: We will prioritize urgent tasks, but that will be a special request and will require additional fees.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC08901_010: Isn't Imaginadough just incredibly fun, AND surprisingly practical?! No wonder it's our latest flagship product!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC034A_025: With the sweet candy as my fuel, I'll bring it to life! I'll make sure to send you a video, Taygedo!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC024_004: Curious. From the package to the delivery person, everything was fake.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_112: Good point! Thanks for coming up with a plan. I couldn't have done this alone. Umm, when does the salon end again?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_Player_047: Makes sense. The chef said he got pulled in without knowing what happened…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1053_053: For a moment, she had an idea she didn't fully understand… Perhaps the dancing candlelight added some warmth to the puppets' faces?
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_Player_029: Is there anything I can help with?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_105: We look forward to working with Eibon again.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC01401_012: I must remind everyone—once a bid is made, it cannot be retracted.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC002_002: ETD-6 is taking over this case. I'll introduce you to the operation lead in a moment.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_111: Come then… child of betrayal. I'll be waiting for you on the final stage.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_015: Come on, Renee. To return to the past, you must reclaim the choices of your past… including all your mistakes.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_127: Come, Renee, my sister, come to us. We're all waiting on the other side to reunite with you, never to be separated again…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_050: Here, try saying this out loud: "I hope—that Edgar—can—speak his mind—."
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02601_044: Since I was already there, I figured I should make the most out of it. I asked the staff if I could look around in Pawn Moonlight… for research purposes.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_005: She's definitely driving a hard bargain again…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC017_032: Several factions are eyeing this item. To ensure success, we need all hands on deck.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC002_009: According to our investigation of Kool Express in Bridge Crossings, the delivery person responsible for Hankaku Street does not match Daffodill's description, and their work records show no irregularities. The shipping records from the package center also show no fragile items being delivered to Eibon.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_063: Based on our discussion last night, the key to this phase is to create a scene with enough impact…
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_016: Dinner has been left on the table. Please let me know if it's not to your tastes.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC01401_009: Mr. Zander—42 million, 45 million, 48 million, and 50 million Fons!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_006: With so many hunter agencies in Bridge Crossings, why did they choose us? It can't be because they trust our uh… reliable shop owner…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_139: The cherry blossoms… they're so pretty.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC015_004: Welcome, the doors of Sterry are always open to "friends."
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC08901_001: Welcome to DSD! The home of pop toys!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC010_004: Welcome to Eibon. You must be here for an anomaly commission.
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_002: Welcome to Eibon. Are you here to buy antiques or discuss a commission?
ST_MainDialogue.HM_Prologue_MainSQC002_Nelly_00001: Welcome to the Hethereau <blue>Bureau of Anomaly Control</>. Nice to meet you. I am Nelly, the secretary-general.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_135: Ehhh? What do you mean? Me? Eternal life? No way…!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_031: Huh? Wait, what anomaly? The one that turns people into puppets? So those people really were…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC011_073: Huh, isn't she with you guys?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_296: Huh? Why? Is it because you are grown-ups…? Because grown-ups are strong?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_046: Huh? Why are you all looking at me?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_109: Huh? Says who? Master deserves some rest tomorrow!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_035: Huh? She lived for a very, very long time?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_099: Huh, big sis? But aren't you…?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_102: Huh? I don't understand, wait… sister!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_102: Huh? Let's see… twenty thousand days is roughly fifty years! Blackbird also said the family was gone for about half a century!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC008_070: Eh? That's for me to know and you to wonder!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_EC_NPC034A_007: Eh? Then what's it really like?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_055: Huh? This is my fault… I'm so sorry! I had no idea this would happen…
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC01001_026: I'm planning to use these few free days to study the latest scenic design trends and see if I should add anything.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_070: As mentioned before, it's difficult to refuse in front of a crowd. This means a grand public confession might put undue pressure on the recipient.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_265: The fact that life is fleeting and fragile compels us to treasure each and every day.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_076: Precisely. We're not just looking out for Sir Taygedo; Tako's feelings are equally important.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC012_017: And then "Tales of Nil" became the bomb…
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC010_043: By the way, the lady mentioned that you still don't have a phone, so we've prepared one for you. We hope it will be useful for you in the future.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC02501_008: Also, fines for property damage, printing debts, breach of contract lawsuits…
ST_MainDialogue.MainUI_Prologue_Mint_00004: The Oddities are getting tougher, but still no match for us!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_012: It's true that oddities often face challenges when shopping for everyday items.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC010_029: An oddity's values might differ from those of humans. Whatever best expresses Taygedo's feelings should be the right choice.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_289: Is there anything after death…? Will we die too?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1043_008: Dying isn't that big of a deal.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_031: Mother, Elliott, Teresa… everyone is waiting for you. Won't you come see them?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_026: Mother, the one who gave us life, loved you so much.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_048: Each day we spend with you brings us one day closer to the end. Each day we dispel your solitude takes away another day from us. Isn't that so?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_027: He attacks you every day? Even if it's just a prank, that's messed up!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC022_074: Every time you fell and tore your clothes, someone would mend them meticulously. Nevertheless, you always ignored their efforts and pestered Mother for new clothes.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_Player_074: Such as… the residence of Lady Dolores, head of the Constantine family?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_130: Like, if you have endless time, couldn't you do as many things as you wanted? If I had eternal life, I…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC010_008: Bianca, everyone here works at Eibon. The owner will join us shortly. Feel free to bring us up to speed as we wait.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC012_004: Miss Bianca, do you recognize that censer?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_Player_050: This is tougher than I expected…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC021_009: For example, if any of you were to enter the Anomalous Realm it creates, you wouldn't be able to get out easily. Instead, you'd have to follow its rules.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1049_021: Wouldn't it be better if you experts helped her instead of having an amateur like me mess around?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_057: But hey, I'm more interested in your take on this <blue>prophecy</>.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_129: Well… having something is better than having nothing, and having more is better than having less… right?
ST_MainDialogue.MP00_00_NPC01001_025: After all, customers probably aren't coming to a recently-suspended-due-to-an-anomaly-incident business for photos… haha…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC009_061: After all, when it comes to prophecies, the only clear measure is <blue>Time</> itself…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_02_NPC08901_008: After all, it can be shaped into any precious gem or material you could think of! You can make any space look luxurious without breaking the bank, that's its biggest selling point!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC002_003: Since there's already online unrest, we decided to assign a team specializing in anomaly crimes and Meme Anomalies.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC011_070: Impressive! Classy! Great taste! That's how big families do it!
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC1046_128: But how can eternal life be a curse? Isn't it great to live forever?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC009_036: Should we replace the sofa? Oh dear, why do I always feel uneasy after Landric's final payment arrives…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC01308_004: The salon ends at three o'clock. Look what time it is already! What's taking those useless guys so long to make a move?
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_03_NPC01401_030: No… nothing else, you… please go…
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_01_NPC019_011: It's okay. I believe what we saw. These people aren't here to hurt us.
ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC086A_007: To think… when beauty goes unappreciated by those with taste, it ends up hanging on the wall of some antique shop!

ST_MainDialogue.MU01_04_NPC013_028: Can I ask one more question?
