ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1003:
A few days ago, Nanally dragged the local idiot and me into some "special ops meeting" and made us promise not to tell you. You're clever—I bet you've already guessed what it was about, right? Happy Birthday!! Honestly, Nanally was such a headache about the whole thing… she had zero clue what you wanted, so she had us running all over the New Herland District for the entire afternoon!
Of course, I personally got a birthday gift for you, too. Don't worry, I can attest that it hasn't been inside Kiroumaru's stomach… yet. Keeping that pig from eating it these past two days was a full-time job!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1019:
Knock, knock! Mint Logistics here, running like the wind to deliver something for Coco! Please make sure you're at home to receive the gift and sign for it (the delivery fee will be billed to your account)!! I'd better see your biggest, brightest smile today!
Chop chop! Draw a smiley face on this 'Happy Birthday' card and open the exclusive surprise I got just for you, Coco!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1039:
Happy Birthday, sweet thing~
On this day, however long ago, the world robbed you of your decision to decide on whether you wanted to be born or not—congratulations! So, what's it gonna be? What kind of wish are you cooking up? Don't be shy, spill everything. I want to all of it.
Also, I might've… gotten you a little something. Guaranteed to be unlike anything you've ever seen. Swing by tonight, and it's yours.
Ooh, I can't wait to see the look on your face~~!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1010:
HAPPPPPPPY BIRTHDAAAAAY!!! I was the first to message you, right? I stayed up all night to make sure…
Everyone at Eibon got you a whole bunch of stuff—cake, books, some weird new tech… I didn't actually see our Boss's present, just a tiny little box with your name on it. As for Sakiri's gift… she wouldn't tell me she got you. She said if I'd knew, I'd totally spill the beans. AS IF!!
I couldn't sleep trying to come up with a gift for you, so I left it in the hands of the universe! Whatever you get, you gotta' let me know, OK? I'm dying to know!!!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1055:
Happy birthday, Appraiser.
Sterry Express prides itself on its brand image—just sending a voicemail on your big day isn't enough. Since today's all about you, I had to personally oversee the delivery of your gift. The gifts themselves are already on their way. All that's left is the letter.
If you're free, why not come over and see it for yourself?
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1073:
Happy Birthday!
I saw on your Bagel profile that today's your day—Hopefully I got the date right… If I didn't, consider this a belated happy birthday… or an early one! Even if my little message doesn't mean much, I still wanted to let you know!
Actually, I baked a cake and even got you a gift. I only found out after moving to Hethereau that everyone here does the cake-and-presents thing for birthdays. I was super excited planning and prepping your gift—who knew you could be this happy for someone else? As for the gift, I'm gonna keep it under wraps for now. I'll tell you once we meet up!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1025:
Route locked, package loaded, engine on—that's my daily mantra, day in, day out. Today was supposed to be the same… except this delivery's a little different. It's not headed for a bunch of different addresses on a list. It's going to one place, for one very specific person…
I'm not great at celebrations, and I don't care for those 'feel-good' lines. I prefer actions over words. So,
—Happy Birthday, Appraiser.
If I didn't fear that showing up in person might bother you, I would've already been right in front of you, saying these words to you myself.
Hopefully your future is full of clear skies and smooth sailing. If you ever need anything, just let me know—Sterry's Elite Courier is on call for you, anytime.
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1020:
Appraiser, I've got a super-duper top-secret to tell you—this morning, while I was out delivering packages, I passed a big tree with a bunch of birds chirping, and I suddenly realized… I could actually understand what the birds were saying! Isn't that crazy? I couldn't bear to walk away from something so magical, so the brilliant Haniel slammed on the brakes, perked her ears, and listened carefully to what each little birdie had to say. Unsurprisingly, they all had the same message—
"Happy birthday, Appraiser!"
Naturally, Haniel also yelled, "Happy birthday, Appraiser!"
Now the Appraiser's got twice the amount of "happy birthday" messages. But well-wishes alone aren't enough, hmph. The great Haniel has also prepared a huuuuge gift just for you!
"What if the Appraiser doesn't like the gift?" one of the little birdies asked.
"Oh? Are you doubting the all-knowing, all-powerful Haniel?" I responded. "No need to worry—today, Haniel will grant your every wish. If you want it, I'll make it happen!"
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1033:
Happy birthday, Appraiser.
As this is your first birthday in Eibon as our Appraiser, I have prepared a few gifts for you. They were put together somewhat in haste, so I hope you'll overlook any shortcomings. Everyone in Eibon has prepared gifts as well, so please, take the day to truly relax. I shall handle any of your commissions in your stead.
And, of course—welcome to Eibon.
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1004:
Happy Birthday, Appraiser… Lacrimosa didn't get the date wrong… right? Huh… Lacrimosa made sure to write it down in her phone… It… should be right.
Birthdays are really nice… You get to take the day off. And give gifts to good friends. The Appraiser is a good friend, so lacrimosa had to get a gift. But… Lacrimosa didn't know what to get. She went to the team for help, so we went out to pick out a gift together. There was so much stuff to choose from at the store… Lacrimosa started to get dizzy. But we finally picked something out. Appraiser, wanna take a look?
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1070: The title for Haiyue is currently unavailable.
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Title_1070: The title for Haiyue is currently unavailable.
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1054: I noticed your weapon was looking a bit dull during our last training session. Make sure you're keeping up with the maintenance—I don't want you to get hurt. Actually, uh… Is there anything special you'd like to eat today? I'm not exactly a pro in the kitchen… but I can pick up some stuff from the store and maybe get some pointers from Mr. Adler. Also, I heard that the moon is going to be out in full tonight—the kind of night perfect for making a couple of wishes. Anyway… Happy Birthday. I'm looking forward to what the future brings.
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Title_1019: Special Delivery! An Awesome, Incredible, Fantastic Surprise Just for Coco!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1052: It's your big day, so I'll let you off the hook. Enjoy your day off. In this day and age, a manager who actually cares about her employees is basically nonexistent. So appreciate me while you still can! Don't let those food delivery gigs delude you with all that talk of "work-life balance". I've had Adler prepare a ton of food—even the expensive stuff. I tried some of it, and it's pretty good. The little rascals will get to enjoy the day because of you. While you're at it, throw a coin in the fountain for the shop!
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1021: Happy birthday, Appraiser. Would you happen to know what the best possible gift to get someone is? I hope the one I got for you is good enough. If it wasn't exactly what you wanted, then… I'll just have to get a better one next time. :D
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1008:
On your birthday, I'd like to extend my sincere congratulations on behalf of the Bureau of Anomaly Control ETD-4.
Not everyone would say something this formal, so I'll take the honor… We've always felt fortunate to have someone as dependable as you outside the Bureau.
Here's to continuing our strong collaboration in the future.
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Title_1004: Is the Gift More Important Than the Meaning Behind It?
ST_PlayerBirthdayMail.UI_PlayerBirthday_Content_1023: No wonder my sleep's been garbo lately. I've even been skipping work, totes convinced that something huge was about to go down… turns out it's just because it's *someone's* birthday today!! Having birthdays is actually great for your health, by the way. Research shows that the more birthdays you have, the longer you live (factual, by the way). As for the well-wishes… I'm not really the type to say things like 'stay young' or 'keep that chin up'. Life's a long road—since when was it ever a smooth ride? I'm just hopin' that you continue being you. No deeper meaning, just good vibes!<(￣︶￣)>

ST_Quest.s110604_01_Picture: A wall covered in layers of overlapping spray-painted graffiti designs.
ST_Quest.q110136_Dlg_Des: Meanwhile, on the other side of the city, Boomboom and Dandelion are also preparing to head home…
ST_Quest.q110192_Blackfade_02: Later, the guarantor takes Miss Tako home. Due to scattered Imaginadough, Azure Vista is in disarray, forcing us to spend the next few days…
ST_Quest.CR_Battle_AirWallMessage: Nullify the Oddities to secure evacuation
ST_Quest.s110611_01_BlackScreen: After enduring several rounds of bewildered stares from passersby, you waited until dawn…
ST_Quest.s110626_01_BlackScreen: You told Ethan everything about your investigation process and showed him the photos. His expression changed like a revolving lantern—from shock to disappointment, and finally settling into calmness.
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_12_Desc:
Grandpa Issac at the Mechanic Shop is a bit hard of hearing, so when you are checking! The billing info! With him!! Please! Speak! Louder! Other than sorting out financial records, Grandpa Issac seems to have a knack for vehicle repair…
"Time flies like an arrow, and the past can only… What? Speak louder! I can't hear you!"
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_11_Desc:
The Backstreet Boxer longs for a fight! Temper your strength in the white hot crucible of the ring, fist against fist!
"Left! Right! Too slow! Harder… phew, that was a nice massage for the shoulders, thanks!"
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_8_Desc:
Help Nydia, the manager of Jingle Wrangle find a new home for the oddities. Good deeds never go unappreciated.
"Jingle, jangle, and a brand new home."
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_14_Desc:
In front of you is a pile of trash and three Trash Cans, now make the right choice and escape from the tedious trash sorting work!
"Ding dong ding dong ding! Congratulations on becoming recognized by the Trash Can!"
ST_Quest.s111135_ItemDescription:
Solifugae Vita withers in summer, and blooms only in snow.
So the snowman who dared not even cry, gathered the courage to shake a city and reverse a season—
Creating an "eternal winter" for their friend.
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_7_Desc:
Little Buni makes highly praised goods, to the point that she struggles to keep up with demand! Oh kind fella, please go show some care for the busy Little Buni.
"Buni is always here for others, but who will be there for Buni?"
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_4_Desc:
There is a bottle of soda constantly vibing in the square. The soda could burst out of the bottle cap at any moment! Fight and stop it before that happens!
"I must stay bubbled, carbonated, energized! Don't you dare take it from me!"
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_5_Desc:
Crazy Cat Milk Tea is trying to come up with new milk tea flavors and needs a creative partner to brainstorm along!
"A bit of Weather Vine sap, some Boom Boom Cloud, and maybe some Fungus Child spores?"
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_9_Desc:
Luna Bay has recently imported a batch of ornamental fish. If someone meets the store owner's standards in aquatic species breeding knowledge, they might just win the opportunity to breed the fishes themselves.
"Well, all you have to know about taking care of fishes is the cycle of 1-3-5-7: feed every day, change the water every 3 days, clean the tank every 5 days, and uh… change the fishes every 7 days."
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_2_Desc:
Delivery orders are surging in Bridge Crossings and we are in urgent need of part-time delivery personnel. Save the hungry Bridge Crossings!
"Bridge Crossings' legendary speed! From kitchens to your tables in eight minutes, none shall starve under our watch!"
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_1_Desc:
Lively Greens has recently imported a batch of large plants, some prefer shade while others prefer sunlight. We need strong movers to manage their positions and let the greens thrive.
"Come on newbies, the sun has moved again! On me… One! Two! Three! Move!"
ST_Quest.DunnerHouseAirMsg_B: Approaching the edge of Paradise. Adjust your course promptly.
ST_Quest.DunnerHouseAirMsg_A: Approaching the edge of the Anomalous Realm. Adjust your course to avoid getting lost.
ST_Quest.s111110_Item_Description: Due to the seafood shop owner's distrust, I need to pay a 30,000 Fons deposit first before getting the truck key fob… I'm not sure if I'll actually get this deposit back in the end. I hope I won't end up paying out of my own pocket to work here!
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_10_Desc:
The reading area in Moby-Dick needs to be organized! For that, we are looking for profound scholars… or people with a reading habit… or at least someone who can read…?
"Every book an ocean and every read an adventure… and I need a life jacket on this adventure."
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_13_Desc:
Who on earth threw trash into the river! It's hard work cleaning the waters, but guess it ain't all bad with cute lil' kappas by your side, eh?
"The kappa burst out of the river, blubbed, then chucked away the person littering in the river…"
ST_Quest.DelegateMissionQuest_16_Desc:
There are many legends scattered around the corners of the city. The owner of Oops! Chest thinks this is a great way to get inspiration.
"Great warriors, fear not! Explore, and discover!"

ST_RoleReviewQuest.Main_1_3_des:
Jenson, the owner of Sterry Express, suddenly paid a visit, hoping to invite you to participate in an auction hosted by Ebisu Auction House to help authenticate an anomaly lot. After some negotiation, Hotori proposed the additional condition of "going along herself" and struck a deal with Jenson.

To successfully infiltrate the auction, you used Esper Michael Pay's ability to duplicate and swap singer Settyn's invitation. On the day of the auction, Haniel and others disguised themselves as waitstaff to sneak into the venue, while you and Hotori entered officially as guests alongside Jiuyuan and Jenson.

When the target lot—the anomaly "The First Branch," said to possess precognitive abilities—was presented, a mysterious girl suddenly appeared. Using the freeze effect of the anomaly "Cheese," she forcibly acquired the lot for just 1 Fons and left immediately. After Hotori lifted the freeze effect on you all, you discovered that the girl had used the anomaly "Picky" to release several anomaly lots, triggering the security anomaly "Nantanì" and trapping you all in the auction house. Once the duplicated invitations expired, you would no longer be protected by Nantanì's rules. Therefore, you had to act quickly to re-contain the breached anomalies.

Afterward, Ebisu tried to shift the blame to Sterry and Eibon, but through Jiuyuan and Hotori's maneuvering, you managed to escape unscathed. Hotori avoided discussing your many questions but informed you that you could collaborate with Sterry's people in the future.

However, this incident seems to hide a deeper conspiracy—Ebisu Auction House's true intentions remain unclear, and the mysterious girl's motives for stealing the lot are still unknown… More mysteries have yet to surface.
ST_RoleReviewQuest.Main_1_1_des:
Eibon received a commission from Bianca, PR manager of Landric, to search for the genius Perfumer Toshi who had suddenly disappeared. While searching for clues in his apartment, a strange bird and dog appeared and made off with Toshi's Censer.

Following intel from Jiuyuan of Sterry Express, you tracked down "Cake Sweeper," the author of manga Tales of Nil, and met a young man named Boomboom outside her home. His dog Dandelion, who had been missing for a long time, had appeared in the manga. Cake Sweeper told you about her encounter with Pawn Moonlight, claiming that "any wish could be granted there for the right Price," and revealed that the dog and bird that inspired her work were both in the pawnshop.

As fate would have it, chef Kenneth commissioned you to retrieve his sense of taste, which was taken by the pawnshop owner without reason, and pointed you to Green Wall Slope. You headed there immediately. Inside the pawnshop, you met the owners—twin brothers Otro and Mismo. It turned out Kenneth had kidnapped Toshi—who had accompanied him to the pawnshop before—fearing exposure after regretting his Pawn Contract. Mismo had rescued Toshi.

In the end, the cunning Kenneth's scheme failed, Boomboom reunited with his beloved dog—who was actually Anomaly U-5228 "Morphix"—and Otro and Mismo left Hethereau, taking their unsolved mysteries with them. On Green Wall Slope, Pawn Moonlight vanished without a trace.
ST_RoleReviewQuest.Main_1_4_des:
Eibon receives an anonymous package—a mysterious puppet. Simultaneously, there are rumors being spread on Bagel of citizens being turned into puppets by an Anomaly. You and Daffodill follow Hotori to the Bureau of Anomaly Control to assist with the investigation. Working alongside ETD-6, and using intel from Yggash Court, you discuss the case. After some investigating, you all conclude that this "puppet" was not initially a human. The clue that led to the discovery of the actual Anomaly lies in the black cards hidden in the Anomaly's pocket: each one has a name and is labeled with the number "0".

That same evening, a taxi driver named Renee comes to Eibon with a commission: every night at exactly nine o'clock, a cloaked, scythe-wielding Anomaly called the "Debt Collector" appears and attacks her—yet shockingly, she feels no pain at all. You, Nanally, and Daffodill take the commission and go with Renee to "Food First" to get more details from one of her regulars: Fuuka.

At nine o'clock that very night, the Debt Collector appears as planned. After a brief scuffle, it retreats, dropping a card that reads "Renee" and the number "-20088". You recognize it as identical to the cards from the earlier puppet case, and immediately contact Chaos. Everyone then agrees to head to The Witch's House, where Blackbird performs a divination for Renee. Strangely, the result of the divination is entirely blank, similar to the case years ago with Dolores, the head of the Constantine family. Blackbird concludes that the Debt Collector must be a Rule Anomaly, and that its nullification hinges on breaking the rule it follows.

The next day, someone drops a forged card into Renee's mailbox, with the address of the old Constantine estate printed on the front. Chaos guesses that Fuuka and the disguised courier who sent the puppet to Eibon must be operating under the same mastermind's orders. They invite Renee to walk to the family estate, as long as she's willing. When the group arrives, Renee stares at the cherry tree in the yard, recalling that she had once fallen from that same tree as a child. Suddenly, everyone is pulled into an Anomalous Realm.

The Anomalous Realm recreates the Constantine estate as it once was, years ago. You and Renee watch a farewell party, and piece together the family's history from the guests' conversations. Meanwhile, Nanally and Daffodil discover the Debt Collector hidden in the estate's study, along with a "register" that lists the family members' names with a number next to each. Every name has "0" listed next to it, except for Renee's, which is "-20088". Daffodil realizes that this must mean Renee has long overstayed her welcome amongst the living.

The eldest daughter, "Bella", appears before Renee and reveals the Constantine family's secret: Dolores was a unique Esper. To ease her loneliness, she used her own lifeforce as fuel to awaken a group of puppet children, letting them share an "eternity" granted by her contract with an Anomaly and stay by her side. All of these children were once puppets, and their lifespans began to count down from the moment Renee was born. They all hit zero over fifty years ago. Renee was the last to awaken and also Dolores's most favored child. Dolores seemingly was able to escape death because her mother gifted her the Anomaly "Eternal Present", which was the source of her own endless life.

However, everything that was revealed of this "past" turned out to be an illusion, instrumented by Zankou, the actor performing "Bella". Zankou twisted the memories of the family, casting Renee as the sinner whose selfish bretrayal brought misfortune upon the family. Through the mockery of children's voices and display of false illusions, Renee's sanity was slowly whittled down. It only took a few moments for Renee's mind to finally break, accepting the lie of her identity, and, on the verge of collapse, decide to give up the Eternal Present to atone for her "sins". At that crucial moment, you shout for her to stop—only for Zankou to snatch the Eternal Present. As you and Zankou go head to head, the nine o'clock bell tolls, and the Debt Collector returns. At that same moment, Chaos tears open space-time and steps through, with Nanally and Dafodill arriving in a spectacular, wall-breaking fashion. Just before retreating, Zankou turns to Dafodill and passes along "Mother's" regards. Afterwards, everyone at Eibon, together with Chaos, drive the Debt Collector back to where it came from.

After the battle, Chaos reveals Zankou's true identity: a core member of the criminal organization, "The Scarlet Letter". Actually, it seems that every actor in this play—the fake courier, Fuuka, and Bella from the party—were performed by her and her alone. Her goal was to force Renee to surrender the Anomaly "Eternal Present", while also using the entire incident as a way to announce the presence of The Scarlet Letter in Hethereau.

Back at Eibon, you and Daffodil discuss her past—she once was a member of The Scarlet Letter herself, and that her "Mother" was the group's leader, the very person she should have ended years ago.

Several days later, Renee returns to Eibon to thank everyone in person. Having lost "Eternal Present", she is finally released from immortality, and her missing memories and past have graudally been returning to her. She says that she has finally concluded that being alive is a blessing, precisely because life is fragile and fleeting. She bids Eibon farewell and sets off on a journey around the world, determined to experience all of life's ups and downs with the time she has left.
ST_RoleReviewQuest.Role_1023_1_des:
You received a missing person commission from a married couple—their son Maiyue, who had a speech impediment, had gone missing after school.

After a chance encounter with Captain of ETD-4—Baicang, he joined your investigation. The clues led you to an abandoned manor that once belonged to the Serenetti family. The squad's lieutenant Skia noted that the location showed abnormal Wertheimer Index fluctuations, which the Bureau was investigating. In the manor's courtyard, you found Maiyue trapped. He was being parasitized by plants affected by Location Anomaly C-3624 "Silent Garden," and in his dazed state, he resisted rescue attempts.

Baicang used sign language to wake Maiyue from his stupor, then activated his Esper Ability. In an instant, all the plants in the manor withered as if fall had come early, and the Anomaly was successfully nullified.

Though Maiyue permanently lost his ability to speak due to the Anomaly's nullification, he was otherwise unharmed. Later, he made flower cards by hand to express his gratitude to you all. Perhaps sincere feelings need no words to be conveyed.
ST_RoleReviewQuest.Role_1020_1_des:
Haniel invited you to come watch a performance at Livehouse "StarSign," where you met her friends Akane and owner Kiyosawa. Infected by the atmosphere of live music, an excited Haniel decided to pick up the guitar she had once taught herself, while Kiyosawa generously provided a practice space.

Soon after, Nanally proposed forming a band and enthusiastically invited you and Haniel to join. Moved by your enthusiasm, Akane began supporting you all as a mentor. With Akane's help, the band started serious rehearsals.

After some time and effort, your band completed its warm-up debut at StarSign. Despite some mistakes due to nerves during the performance, Akane stepped in to save the day, and the show was completed successfully to audience applause. Encouraged by this, you decided to take on an even greater challenge: the legendary music festival, the Location Anomaly "Night of Moondog."

To achieve a high score at the Night of Moondog and find a way to resonate with anomalies, Haniel and Nanally decided to risk challenging the graffiti anomaly "Bopp" with music. When you discovered the two had gone missing, you and Akane immediately rushed to find them. Akane, in a rare display of anger, scolded them for their reckless behavior.

Finally, Akane decided to officially join the band, and the group, now named "The Whoots!!!!" successfully took the stage at the Night of Moondog. Though they didn't win first place, they achieved a score of 60 points on their debut performance. After the show, Akane reunited with Mitsuki, a former bandmate from "Lines," and a long-held grudge was finally resolved. Even when starlight scatters across the heavens, it never truly disappears, and the music that resonates on stage will continue forever…
ST_RoleReviewQuest.Main_0_2_des:
Accompanied by Mint, you arrived at Eibon Antique Shop on Hankaku Street in Bridge Crossings. After a small commotion caused by Anomaly T-1377 "Hospitable House," you finally met the antique shop's members properly and became part of Eibon.

That evening, you received your first commission as an Anomaly Hunter: Kodak, the owner of Film Orbit Studio in Bridge Crossings, reported that an Anomaly had appeared in his photo studio, turning the interior fixtures into photographs. Eibon accepted the commission and went to investigate.

After some investigation, you pinpointed the culprit: a film roll forgotten by time. In the darkroom, you found Anomaly R-5791 "Film - MANISH" and successfully contained it.

Kodak was very grateful and promised to take photos for you free of charge. As the newest member, you took a group photo with everyone. Soon after, these photos would be developed and displayed on your desks and bedsides, bearing witness to more stories yet to come.
ST_RoleReviewQuest.Role_1004_1_des:
Taygedo took on a bounty commission: nullify the "Tomato Devil"—an anomaly that specifically destroys tomato jelly vending machines. You accompanied Taygedo to investigate, but learned from other Anomaly Hunters tracking the case that the Tomato Devil's true identity wasn't an anomaly at all, but rather Lacrimosa, a member of the Enforcement Tactical Division Squad Four under the Bureau of Anomaly Control.

Through Mint's introduction, you officially met Lacrimosa and learned the whole story: due to her lack of common sense, Lacrimosa had accidentally destroyed a vending machine. Although she compensated for the damage and apologized afterward, photos taken by passersby spread widely online, attracting a flood of malicious rumors. These false statements about Lacrimosa gradually fermented and eventually evolved into a Meme Anomaly—the Tomato Devil. This anomaly, born from rumors about Lacrimosa, resembled her in appearance, dragging Lacrimosa even deeper into public opinion.

To clear up the rumors, you and Taygedo planned a live stream, broadcasting footage of the real Lacrimosa battling the Tomato Devil anomaly, letting the truth speak for itself. As public opinion gradually shifted, the Meme Anomaly born from rumors was significantly weakened and finally dissolved into tomato jelly and disappeared.

Although new trending topics quickly diverted public attention, it was precisely because you and Taygedo took action that you were able to clear up the public's misunderstanding of Lacrimosa, restore her reputation, and truly protect her. Even if the truth gets buried temporarily, persisting in speaking out is never in vain.
ST_RoleReviewQuest.Main_1_2_des:
Taygedo fell head over heels for an anomaly named Tako whom he met on Bagel. He bragged to Tako that he was the "boss of an anomaly hunter organization" with countless subordinates. Recently, with Tako about to leave Hethereau, they arranged to meet before her departure. At Taygedo's earnest request, you all decided to orchestrate a grand "love operation" for him.

After accompanying Taygedo to buy new clothes and the anomaly toy N-0132-4 "Imaginadough" as a gift, the date officially began. Everything proceeded according to Edgar's plan: you played the bodyguard to "Sir Taygedo," Adler played the butler, and Nanally and Sakiri… also provided plenty of assistance along the way. Despite frequent mishaps during the date, your stellar acting skills saved the day multiple times.

Finally, you arrived at the scenic destination, Azure Vista. Taygedo molded the prepared Imaginadough into a sculpture of himself and Tako holding hands as part of his performance, planning to confess his feelings. Just then, the Imaginadough sculpture suddenly went haywire for some unknown reason, wildly attacking everything around it. In the critical moment, you stepped in and restored the Imaginadough to its original state, resolving the crisis. Adler also promptly rescued Tako, ensuring her safety.

A few days later, Eibon received a postcard that Tako sent after moving to her new home. However, the letter wasn't addressed to Taygedo, but was a thank-you note to Adler for stepping up to help. Amid laughter and cheer, Taygedo's first love seemed to come to an end…
ST_RoleReviewQuest.Main_0_1_des:
When New Helios was struck by a Level VII anomaly disaster, you appeared out of nowhere and assisted the Bureau of Anomaly Control in locating the "Hypervortex" Nexus, greatly accelerating its natural nullification process. At that moment, an unidentified anomaly with undetectable Wertheimer Index readings appeared—"Code Zero"—attempting to interfere with your actions. In the end, "Code Zero" was nullified along with the "Hypervortex." Afterward, you were temporarily detained at Ghroth Island prison for observation.

Seven weeks later, you were released to Hethereau, where you signed a contract with BAC Director Alphard, agreeing to participate in future "Code Zero" containment operations. She then assigned you to the Anomaly Hunter team "Eibon Antique Shop."

Before your departure, an unexpected incident occurred: CSU operative Mint reported that Anomaly R-3707 "Picture Frame" had suddenly breached containment. Once again, you demonstrated exceptional sensitivity to Anomaly Nexuses, helping Mint nullify the threat.

With everything wrapped up smoothly, you set out for Eibon. Are you ready for your new life to begin?

ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_NPC1029_WJ1047_010: When I… used to work part-time at the livehouse, I liked coming here after performing.
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_NPC1029_WJ1047_003: The Fairy of the Lake… is that me?
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WJ102401_des: The Beat King is an Anomaly we can't underestimate at any cost. However, just before the fight, I thought I saw a Lacrimosa in my periphery. Is she here?
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_NPC026_WJ1046_003: N-no, it's okay. I'm just… passing by.
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_WJ1046_Player_004: No pressure if you'd rather not say.
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_NPC026_WJ1046_006: It's nothing grand… I just… I hope everyone at home stays safe and healthy.
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_WJ1047_Player_012: It's not your fault. Most people are simply curious.
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_WJ1047_Player_017: You're making me want to give this ritual a try…
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSU_WJ1047_B_001: No, you. You're the one who mentioned the rumors first.
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_WJ1047_Player_001: What are you doing in the middle of the road?
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_WJ1047_Player_007: You are… one of Aurelia's jellyfish?
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_NPC1029_WJ1047_007: It's a popular spot in the day full of visitors. But as you can see… it's so serene now.
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_WJ1047_Player_004: Stop it now. I'm intrigued by this anomaly too. Let me join you.
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_NPC1029_WJ1047_004: I just thought it'd be easier to take this one on strolls in the night… I didn't want to scare people.
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_WJ1046_Player_005: I see. So that's the deal.
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_NPC026_WJ1046_007: It's just… my family… I don't think they'd want a blessing from an Anomaly, anyway…
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_NPC1029_WJ1047_016: If I spend this time with you, I might have an extraordinary dream tonight!
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_NPC1029_WJ1047_005: Umm… I probably should stay closer to the land. People won't be scared if they can clearly see the jellyfish.
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_WJ1047_B_001: Oh, Great Fairy, I'm not doing anything wrong!
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_NPC1029_WJ1047_013: Hmm… I can't say you're wrong. But when I think about how people return the next day, and the show goes on like how the sun rises… I feel much excited.
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_NPC1029_WJ1047_006: Yes, I like Caltrop Lake at this time.
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_NPC1029_WJ1047_009: Hehe, this is my favorite spot for a late night stroll.
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WJ103901_des: There's somebody standing near the plaza who looks really familiar… is that Hathor? What's she doing here?
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WJ104601_des: The weather's perfect for a stroll in the park… Is Chiz tagging along?
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_WJ1047_A_002: They say there's this… anomaly that appears on the lake only in the night. It's got a humanoid upper body but transparent lower body. People call it the "Fairy of the Lake."
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_NPC_013_WJ1035_A_002: The owner handed us the developed photos.
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_NPC026_WJ1046_004: Wishes… I suppose it's okay if they don't come true.
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_WJ1047_A_003: The two of us wanted to check it out, but as we got close, I thought… wouldn't something without a clear face floating be… a ghost? He got spooked as I mentioned this.
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_NPC026_WJ1046_008: S-so, I'll take the f-fons back then… Anyway, it's all good!
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_WJ1046_Player_002: They say if you toss a coin, Nacupeda will hear your wish… and make it come true.
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSU_WJ1047_A_001: Stay ahead. You're the one who wanted to come here.
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WJ104601_name: Clear to Snow—Perfect for a Snowbrawl
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_NPC1029_WJ1047_008: Moonlight shines across the lake, a breeze stirs the trees, and somewhere in the distance a night bird calls… as though the city has fallen asleep, and I am wandering inside its dream, listening to the rhythm of its breath.
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_NPC1029_WJ1047_012: I reminisce about those times when I look at this night view.
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_NPC1029_WJ1047_002: Oh, Appraiser, what are you doing here this late?
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_NPC1029_WJ1047_014: It's less about shaking off the loneliness after performances, more like a ritual that makes me treasure the moment and look forward to tomorrow.
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WJ104701_des: There's a rumor about a 'Lake Fairy' at Caltrop Lake. Could it be…?
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_WJ1046_Player_007: It snows quite a bit in Hethereau.
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_NPC1029_WJ1047_011: The lights go dark, the instruments rest, the singing and the applause recede like a tide, leaving nothing but an empty stage…
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_WJ1047_Player_015: It is gorgeous indeed. I didn't notice because I was too busy looking for anomalies.
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_WJ1047_A_001: W-Wait… this one isn't an anomaly.
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_WJ1047_B_003: Sure, but you'll have to take the lead!
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_WJ1047_B_002: As if you're the brave one! You can take the lead if you're not afraid!
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_WJ1047_Player_014: By the way, do you stroll around here often?
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_WJ1047_Player_013: That's a good idea. If anyone mentions this "anomaly," I'll explain it to them.
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_NPC026_WJ1046_012: Th-then… i-if there's a chance… could we… maybe hang out again?
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_NPC1029_WJ1047_015: Aren’t you at the perfect place and time? Let's do it together!
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_WJ1047_Player_003: (An anomaly with a humanoid upper body and a transparent lower body…? Never heard of it.)
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_WJ1046_Player_006: (This seems like a heavy burden to carry.)
ST_SideQuest_QQ.WLSD_WJ1047_B_004: (Ghost fire! Ghost fire!) (It‘s coming this way! Run!)

ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_003_WJ1026_012: …But I'm not planning to move away.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_004_WJ1024_003: Ah… Nullified anomaly… need to write report…
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_004_WJ1023_005: Oh… a ferris wheel. Close to the sky. If we ride it, can we see stars?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_011_WJ1001_009: …Alright, used it is! Better than nothing!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_003_WJ1025_Player_001: …I honestly don't know what my limit is.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ019_0014: …Well, I was planning to tell them about it later.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_004_WJ1023_002: In new Duke K episode… everyone look stars. Seemed fun… Lacrimosa want to try.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_013_WJ1036_003: …Yes, I nearly hurt Kiroumaru by mistake.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_004_WJ1024_005: Appraiser… you're right. So smart. Almost genius.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_011_WJ1005_Player_002: Sin City Chronicles? You mention this movie a lot, so you must have seen it many times already, right?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_003_WJ1026_B_001: "Are human desires really just a disease? Or are you… afraid to admit it?"
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ1020_0010: "During routine patrol, encountered trapped anomaly hunter and stepped in to assist, working together to resolve dangerous anomaly."
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_010_WJ1006_004: Such a simple wish as wanting to eat cake doesn't need to wait for a birthday to come true.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_013_WJ1034_003: "My apologies. I should have warned you sooner. Do not panic. In 7 minutes, you will return to normal."
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_013_WJ1034_001: "W-welcome." "What do you need?" "That will not work. Taygedo is not for sale." "Do not touch that model house."
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_003_WJ1026_B_002: "Crime requires talent, Merry my dear. And you… are a genius."
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_003_WJ1026_B_003: "Come with me. I'm the only one who truly understands you."
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSU_NPC_003_WJ1025_002: Drinking alone is so boring. Why don't you join me?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_016_WJ1044_002: Coming here alone… it seems we really do have some kind of connection.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_013_WJ1035_004: An anchor that keeps me from losing my way, no matter how far I drift.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC010_WJ1007_011: I was merely repeating platitudes, but in my humble opinion…
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_011_WJ1002_012: Of course we can! After all, my luck… Ahem, I mean, my skills are amazing!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ019_0017: Come watch the sunset together? Or sunrise? Or we could pick a weekday afternoon and sunbathe in the flower fields. That sounds nice too.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_001_WJ1013_004: The retake is next week, and I've been pulling all-nighters studying for the past two days, but I still don't feel confident about it, so I thought I'd come to school to get a feel for things.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_003_WJ1025_010: Next time… let's do grown-up things.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_001_WJ1014_010: Let's make another cake together next time! But next time, we're keeping it for ourselves!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_016_WJ1043_004: Don't forget my favorite flower next time.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_011_WJ1002_013: Next time we have some free time, let's go fishing together again!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_001_WJ1016_Player_004: There'll be other chances next time.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_004_WJ1023_Player_007: Next time, let's look at real stars together.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_008_WJ1011_003: Nonono. I'm not wasting my time spinning around in circles up there.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ018_Player_007: How about you stop slacking off at work from now on?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_004_WJ1023_Player_005: I had a great time too!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_013_WJ1036_002: Do not worry. Some painkillers will help.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ019_0010: When there's nothing to stress about, you should live a little more relaxed!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_013_WJ1034_Player_009: That's so like you, Daffodill! You always see right to the heart of things! But…
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_010_WJ1006_003: It's not a birthday. Nanally and the others said they wanted some cake.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_011_WJ1003_Player_005: More than a bit, I'd say… How did you manage to eat so many bowls?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_008_WJ1010_006: Nonono, I'm fine! Just go away already!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_011_WJ1005_Player_008: Don't worry about it. The fireworks are beautiful, and that's enough, isn't it?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_013_WJ1034_Player_005: Don't put so much pressure on yourself, Daffodill.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_004_WJ1022_Player_006: Oh my, it's already so late.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_009_WJ1030_Player_003: I don't know what to wish for…
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_011_WJ1003_009: Either way, a bowl of noodles usually costs so much money, but this time we totally struck it rich!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ018_Player_008: Is not being able to slack off really that serious…
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSU_NPC_001_WJ1013_005: No, no, no, none of that's going to happen!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ018_0016: But… does this actually count as finding it? We saw some good stuff, but in the end we came back empty-handed…
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_016_WJ1039_005: But, by the way… do you have some time, Appraiser?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_011_WJ1001_Player_008: But thinking back on it, that feeling of shooting straight up… it really was pretty cool.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_016_WJ1042_007: But there's no need to rush into an answer. Some relationships can't be defined by words alone. We have plenty of time ahead of us.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ019_007: Though, if only you really had come earlier.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_011_WJ1005_Player_007: Wait, they actually have fireworks here?
ST_SideQuest_World.WQ100301_QuestPanel: Chat with documentary photographer Bilar, then photograph the street musician he found.
ST_SideQuest_World.WQ100201_QuestPanel: Chat with landscape photographer Cassie, then head to the Drive-in Theater and try photographing a sunset featuring Tikal Bridge and the lighthouse.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSU_NPC012_WJ1009_006: The exhibits on both sides include anomalies as well as traditional treasures.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSU_NPC012_WJ1009_003: The golden one in the middle is a statue of Giovanni.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_003_WJ1026_Player_001: Spur of the moment thing. What about you?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ019_005: Or perhaps you saved me from a nightmare?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_011_WJ1003_004: I mainly just didn't know how else to thank you… I guess treating someone to food is still the easiest way to go about it.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ1020_007: No big deal! I was just on patrol and happened to be passing by.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_011_WJ1005_007: Never seen them before. Wait, is today some kind of holiday?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_004_WJ1021_001: Came with everyone… before… Field work… convenient.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_016_WJ1042_Player_001: Jiuyuan…? What are you doing here?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_016_WJ1042_Player_009: I believe that you wouldn't do me any harm…?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_016_WJ1044_player_002: Are you inviting me to dinner?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_016_WJ1044_player_004: Do you come here alone often?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_016_WJ1043_Player_002: Do you come here often, Jiuyuan?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_016_WJ1043_Player_004: Haha… So do you have any flowers you particularly like?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_008_WJ1010_Player_003: You're right… Sakiri really thinks things through.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_011_WJ1001_007: What?! It's just an electric scooter, why is it so expensive?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_012_WJ1009_Player_005: I learned so much from you today… Having a friend as your guide really does feel different from having a stranger, doesn't it?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_008_WJ1012_Player_003: How about trying one flavor today and another one tomorrow?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSU_NPC_011_WJ1004_002: That's enough training for today, right?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_016_WJ1044_008: So, how do you find the meal?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_004_WJ1021_007: Today… event. BYOB… can build your own… burger.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_008_WJ1011_014: The view from the Ferris wheel… not bad at all.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_013_WJ1034_010: Also, I always throw customers who greet me from behind with a shoulder throw…
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_04923_004: All the prices are set by headquarters, so it's really difficult…
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC010_WJ1007_012: While Eibon may not be a well-managed business, we still have enough budget for a few flowers. If a flower is ruined, we can simply buy another.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_016_WJ1040_008: Break time's over! I still haven't finished today's goals yet.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ018_0010: Wonder what good things we'll run into!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_008_WJ1012_005: But after I got sick from eating too much last time, Hotori made a rule that I can only have one ice cream a day.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSU_NPC_003_WJ1027_007: But next time… I'll be collecting some "interest" for myself… you understand?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSU_NPC_003_WJ1027_002: But forgiveness is forgiveness… punishment is punishment. Those are two different things.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_010_WJ1007_Player_003: But I don't really know anything about flower arranging…
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_004_WJ1023_003: But… different from manga. The sky is dark. Lacrimosa can't see… anything.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_011_WJ1005_003: But this movie is totally different! It's not just any ordinary movie! It's packed with deep family wisdom and life lessons. You discover something new every time you watch it!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_001_WJ1017_004: As a thank you, want to grab dinner together after I get off work?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_011_WJ1002_Player_009: Do you know how to clean fish?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ1020_Player_004: You were about to say taking a walk, weren't you…
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_009_WJ1031_003: What about you? If you're feeling cold, want to share a drink?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_003_WJ1026_010: Could you really… push her away?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_003_WJ1027_001: Every string of your soul is pulled toward me…
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_013_WJ1036_Player_001: You look like you have a headache? Daffodill.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_016_WJ1044_010: If you're willing to come with me, the sights you could see would be far more than just this.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_003_WJ1026_006: What do you think? Will she "fix" the Joker, or will his madness ultimately "infect" her?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSU_NPC_006_WJ019_002: Do you think we might be the first people in all of Hethereau to come up with the idea of stargazing in a flower field tonight?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_WJ1041_Player_009: You're starting to make me nervous too…
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_016_WJ1043_002: I wouldn't say often. Just occasionally when I pass by here. I like to check and see how they're blooming lately.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_016_WJ1044_005: Sometimes, but having you here tonight certainly makes dinner more interesting.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ018_Player_004: Sounds like one of those promotional posts that tourist spots write to generate buzz…
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_WJ1007_Player_008: That sounds like something you would say.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_001_WJ1014_001: First add flour… no wait, no! First prepare the cream, then what was it again…
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ019_Player_0016: Wouldn't that be skipping work for you…
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_003_WJ1026_004: Villains… danger… destruction… What a deliciously thrilling plot!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ1020_Player_005: Actually, I could've handled it myself…
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ019_009: Next thing I knew, I opened my eyes to nothing but stars filling the sky.
ST_SideQuest_World.WQ100205_QuestPanel: Cassie mentioned the beautiful scenery of the underwater tunnel on sunny days. Use your camera to capture the sun as seen from inside the underwater tunnel.
ST_SideQuest_World.WQ100209_QuestPanel: The place Cassie mentioned… should be near the basketball court at the end of Baihui Alley. Let's go there and try taking a shot. Remember, the angle should be from top to bottom.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_001_WJ1016_006: The train should be here soon. Let's wait here for a bit.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_001_WJ1016_004: I was just thinking that maybe I'd run into you if I came to Hankaku Street, and I actually did! Hehe, today's definitely going to be a lucky day!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_016_WJ1040_Player_003: Just happened to be passing by.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_011_WJ1036_001: Don't even think about running! You've been defeated by the boss of The Coluccis!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ018_Player_009: As long as it's not some weird anomaly…
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_009_WJ1030_003: Don't overthink it. Whatever you're hoping for most right now is exactly what you should wish for. No need to second-guess yourself.
ST_SideQuest_World.WQ100201_ObjDes_1: Go to <blue>Drive-in Theater</> and film the <blue>sunset</>.
ST_SideQuest_World.WQ100205_ObjDes_1: Go to the <blue>underwater tunnel</> to take photos
ST_SideQuest_World.WQ100303_ObjDes_1: Go to <blue>Bluegaze Campground</> and photograph the <blue>people barbecuing</>
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_011_WJ1002_Player_012: That's assuming we can actually keep catching fish consistently.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_013_WJ1034_Player_008: I was worried those letters might make you feel down…
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ019_Player_007: Oh, so you were already awake.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_004_WJ1023_014: So there are… more stars on land…
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_016_WJ1040_002: Oh, it's you, Appraiser! Hehe… Running into you here, does that count as us being connected by fate?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ1020_003: Words spoken aloud, must be honored!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_013_WJ1034_012: Only one of the letter writers was a very unique woman.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_016_WJ1041_004: This is my last chance, Appraiser. I'm counting on you.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_016_WJ1039_004: I'll just have to wait for next time…
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_016_WJ1044_007: But a dinner with some people will always be invaluable.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_011_WJ1001_Player_004: Could you give us a discount? We'll recommend our friends to buy vehicles here in the future too.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_012_WJ1009_001: I suppose you could say that. Are you here to visit the museum too, Appraiser?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_013_WJ1035_Player_002: Could I have a few copies? I'd love to keep them too!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_001_WJ1013_005: Coco… are you free right now?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSU_NPC_001_WJ1013_006: Over here, Coco. This is the place.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_001_WJ1014_002: Coco! That's wonderful! Coco, you're a lifesaver!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_008_WJ1012_004: But what if tomorrow comes and I want to eat today's flavor again?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_011_WJ1002_Player_007: But we don't have any fishing rods or bait.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ018_005: Maybe it's some kind of rare anomaly? Or maybe a treasure chest? Anyway, it shouldn't be a total waste of time for us.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_003_WJ1026_007: Oh, Appraiser… None can resist the sweetest poison in this world.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSU_NPC_008_WJ1012_001: Should I get some ice cream…?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ019_Player_0013: Being a lucky charm though… I'll pass on that…
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_012_WJ1008_Player_002: From what you were saying earlier, is there an event here?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_008_WJ1011_013: Did you hear that? No food now. You'll have to stay hungry!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSU_NPC_006_WJ018_002: I heard that once, some rich guy was checking out a villa in Green Wall Slope when he got bitten by mosquitoes and flew into a rage…
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_003_WJ1025_004: Oh, it's your heartbeat! It's beating so fast, isn't it? Appraiser!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_008_WJ1012_002: Ugh… Fine, it's not like I can hide it from you anyway!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_003_WJ1026_Player_005: Uh… Yeah, the movie's about to start. Let's head in.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_001_WJ1013_Player_008: I found some past papers shared on Bagel, so I compiled them for you. Hope they help.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_001_WJ1017_001: Phew… Coco, that was a huge help!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_011_WJ1002_002: Whoa! When did you get here, Appraiser?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_WJ1008_A_001: Went upstairs with Edgar to attend a book club…
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_012_WJ1008_Player_004: Discussing books with everyone… it felt really great.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_WJ1003_A_001: Finished a satisfying feast together with Nanally.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_001_WJ1016_Player_005: I enjoyed chatting with you too, Mint.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_003_WJ1025_Player_002: A-hem! But I'm really… not used to drinking hard liquor…
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_004_WJ1021_Player_005: Ahem… looks like Lacrimosa really likes the food.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_011_WJ1001_003: Ahem, no laughing! For the family's growth, I, the Ichi-daime, am willing to endure any hardship!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_008_WJ1010_005: Ahem, anyway, I need to get back to work… And don't you dare tell anyone I'm working here!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_001_WJ1013_007: Ahem! Now it's time for the Ultimate Serious Makeup Exam Study Operation!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_008_WJ1011_010: Ahem, if you want to come again next time, I could tag along too!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_001_WJ1014_Player_005: Ahem. It's the thought that counts.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSU_NPC_001_WJ1013_003: Ooooo, just walking around the school is making me nervous.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ019_0018: Haha! Just don't tell Skia and the others, okay? Otherwise our secret hideout will be under surveillance by workaholics.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_013_WJ1034_Player_007: Haha! Seeing that you're still full of energy, I feel relieved.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_016_WJ1040_Player_005: You have times like that too, Haniel?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_016_WJ1040_007: Haniel at 100% battery, fully recharged! Hehe, having an Appraiser around makes my charging way more efficient!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ018_006: Oh come on! We're just taking a walk anyway, so let's check it out together while we're at it. I'll split whatever we find fifty-fifty with you.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSU_NPC_006_WJ1020_001: Oh my, looks like you're in for a tough fight. Need me to give you a hand?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ1020_008: Phew, that was quite the fight. If only the Bureau would pay me overtime for this stuff.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ1020_005: Oh wow, that was faster than I expected! That's just like you.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ1020_0011: Oh, of course you could! Come on, you think I don't know how capable you are? Just do me this favor, and I'll buy you tea later.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_008_WJ1012_006: Ooh! I've got it! One ice cream, but he never said how big that "one" had to be!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_009_WJ1030_001: Oh hey, my precious, what brings you here?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_016_WJ1042_006: Oh? So, what do you think about it?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_011_WJ1003_003: What do you mean sudden! You have helped me out so many times before, and I never properly thanked you for it.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_011_WJ1002_Player_003: Where can we get grilled fish?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ018_0019: Heh heh! Pretty reasonable, don't you think?
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_001_WJ1014_009: Heh heh! As expected from the combined efforts of elite reserve member Mint and Eibon's strongest Appraiser!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_004_WJ1023_011: Umm… not really. Flying too high… tiring. Rarely… fly this high.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_011_WJ1001_Player_007: Uh, my heart can't really handle it right now… I think I'll pass.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_003_WJ1025_002: Mm, trying to act tough like that… how cute.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ018_001: Oh hey, Appraiser! What a coincidence.
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_001_WJ1016_010: Ahh! My colleagues are still waiting for me! See you later, Coco!
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_006_WJ018_008: Tch, looks like we absolutely have to find something today, no matter what the price…
ST_SideQuest_World.WLSD_NPC_011_WJ1003_011: Oh! That way we can keep eating together forever!

ST_SideQuest_wzy.s111136_PanelC: "I love this world!" With tears in its eyes, the little snowman held onto this thought before disappearing. It gazed at the sky as it slowly changed, turning lead-blue. It gently touched the grass, understanding how precious life is. It was precisely because life is precious that it hoped Solifugae Vita could survive too. If its friend could only exist in winter, then Puff would turn the entire city… into winter! May you live freely in the wild winds forever.

ST_SideQuest_wzy.K110417_PanelC: Finished reading the message Kilos sent from his father's account. There's no time to waste, let's head to the newsstand right away.
ST_SideQuest_wzy.s111119_PanelC: All deliveries are complete. Time to find the shop owner and get my deposit back.
ST_SideQuest_wzy.S110305_QuestPanel: Walk into the rain and search for traces of the student who left…
ST_SideQuest_wzy.K110705_QuestPanel: Let's take this opportunity to browse Q³ with Haniel.
ST_SideQuest_wzy.s111220_PanelC: While Patty is organizing her inspiration, let me take a look around the area.
ST_SideQuest_wzy.K111506_PanelC: We still have some time before the movie starts. How about we get some snacks first?
ST_SideQuest_wzy.S110309_QuestPanel: Follow the JTF member to investigate the streets…
ST_SideQuest_wzy.S110329_QuestPanel: Follow Bixing and continue the investigation.
ST_SideQuest_wzy.K110733_QuestPanel: A cute little kitten appeared on the path. Let's go take a look.
ST_SideQuest_wzy.s111115_PanelC: Road conditions are good, and we're approaching faster than expected. I can already smell the oil from the fryer… I'll definitely have to snag some fresh french fries when I get there.
ST_SideQuest_wzy.s111227_PanelC: The past has been crushed by pain and is on the verge of collapse. Let's return to the present and see what awaits me.
ST_SideQuest_wzy.s111234_PanelC: The girl from the past refused the letter, and it seems you won't cross paths again. Go give this letter to someone who truly needs it.
ST_SideQuest_wzy.s111236_ObjDes: Return to the exhibition hall and talk to <blue>Tungsten</>
ST_SideQuest_wzy.K110411_PanelC: The root of these strange incidents might just be that diary emanating an anomalous aura… Let's share my thoughts on the current situation with Miles.
ST_SideQuest_wzy.s110615_PanelC: That girl seems to be a fan of Ethan. Maybe she knows something.
ST_SideQuest_wzy.s110616_PanelC: This guy, somewhere between 20 and 40, seems ready to talk.
ST_SideQuest_wzy.s110604_PanelC: The artist seems to have let his guard down. Ask him for more details.
ST_SideQuest_wzy.s111132_PanelC: Everyone witnessed this great snowfall, but the little snowman's traces have vanished. It seems that miracles and regrets… are simultaneous…
ST_SideQuest_wzy.s110608_PanelC: So this is street art? I don't get it, but it looks awesome.
ST_SideQuest_wzy.s111117_PanelC: By the time this batch of sashimi arrives, the restaurant's lanterns are already glowing, and the customers have just finished their first beers.
ST_SideQuest_wzy.s111221_PanelC: The path to the second floor is now open. Let's go check it out.
ST_SideQuest_wzy.s111217_PanelC: The inspiration-gathering trip has come to an end. After wandering around for so long, let's go back and sort through my thoughts.
ST_SideQuest_wzy.s111202_01_PanelC: Tungsten thoughtfully shows the way to explore. Head toward where the light shines, let's go!
ST_SideQuest_wzy.s111202_02_PanelC: Tungsten thoughtfully shows the way to explore. Head toward where the light shines, let's go!
ST_SideQuest_wzy.s111202_PanelC: Tungsten thoughtfully shows the way to explore. Head toward where the light shines, let's go!
ST_SideQuest_wzy.K110426_PanelC: Aria proposed a plan that's… somewhat far-fetched, but it seems like we don't have any other options right now. Since we're already here, let's give it a shot.
ST_SideQuest_wzy.K110418_PanelC: Aria is already waiting in the shop. Let's hear what plan she's prepared.
ST_SideQuest_wzy.S110331_QuestPanel: There are fluctuations behind the door, let's check if the warehouse gate can be opened…
ST_SideQuest_wzy.S110332_QuestPanel: The door is locked. Try to find another entrance.
ST_SideQuest_wzy.s111109_QuestName: You Can Never Be Too Careful with People
ST_SideQuest_wzy.s111103_PanelC: Help Puff create a miracle and make this city snow in summer!
ST_SideQuest_wzy.s111126_PanelC: Accompany Puff to Hethereau Skytower to see the view from the highest point in Hethereau.
ST_SideQuest_wzy.s111206_PanelC: The so-called difficult great designer is right in front of us. Perhaps she'll know what happened.
ST_SideQuest_wzy.s111106_PanelC: After passing the interview, Puff starts working! Oh no, why is the customer flow suddenly dropping instead…
ST_SideQuest_wzy.S1104091_QuestPanel: The music is coming from inside Eibon…
ST_SideQuest_wzy.S110407_QuestPanel: The music went toward 9°C Coffee. Let's go investigate.
ST_SideQuest_wzy.s111126_QuestName: The Wind Remembers We Were Here
ST_SideQuest_wzy.s111107_01_QuestName: Delicious Secret Recipe Ramen with Floating "Hair"
